The model's key innovations included: (1) end-to-end training; (2) an Encoder encoding the input sequence into a fixed-length vector; (3) a Decoder generating the output sequence from that vector; and (4) reversing the input sequence, using a 4-layer LSTM, and employing beam search.

events.title_zh: AI 风险公开信
events.title_en: Open Letter on AI Safety
events.summary_zh:
2015 年，科技界公开呼吁重视 AI 对社会和安全的潜在影响。
深度学习能力快速上升后，问题开始从“能不能做出来”扩展到“应该怎样使用”。
研究者、企业和公众都需要讨论风险、责任、治理和长期影响。
这封公开信像一次提醒：AI 的发展速度越快，安全和社会边界越需要提前进入议程。
events.source_name: Timeline of Artificial Intelligence
events.summary_en: In 2015, the tech community issued a public call to confront the potential impacts of AI on society and safety. As deep learning capabilities skyrocketed, the core question shifted from "can we build it" to "how should we use it," forcing researchers, corporations, and the public to grapple with risk, responsibility, governance, and long-term consequences. This open letter served as a stark reminder: the faster AI advances, the sooner safety and societal guardrails must be put on the agenda.

events.title_zh: Redmon YOLO:实时目标检测突破
events.title_en: Redmon YOLO: Real-Time Object Detection Breakthrough
events.summary_zh:
2015 年 6 月 8 日,Joseph Redmon、Santosh Divvala、Ross Girshick、Ali Farhadi 在 CVPR 2016 发表论文《You Only Look Once: Unified, Real-Time Object Detection》。
YOLO 把目标检测从“两阶段(区域提议 + 分类)”改为“单阶段(直接回归 bbox + class)”,在 PASCAL VOC 2007 上 mAP 63.4,推理速度 45 FPS(YOLO Fast 155 FPS),比 R-CNN(2 FPS)快 22 倍。
YOLO 后续版本:YOLOv2(2017)、YOLOv3(2018)、YOLOv4(2020,Alexey Bochkovskiy 接手)、YOLOv5(2020,Ultralytics)、YOLOv8(2023)、YOLOv9(2024)、YOLOv10(2024,清华大学)。
events.source_name: Redmon, J. et al. (2015) CVPR 2016; arXiv:1506.02640
events.summary_en: On June 8, 2015, Joseph Redmon, Santosh Divvala, Ross Girshick, and Ali Farhadi published the paper "You Only Look Once: Unified, Real-Time Object Detection" at CVPR 2016. YOLO shifted object detection from a "two-stage (region proposal + classification)" process to a "single-stage (direct regression of bbox + class)" pipeline, achieving a 63.4 mAP on PASCAL VOC 2007 at an inference speed of 45 FPS (155 FPS for YOLO Fast)—making it 22 times faster than R-CNN (2 FPS). This breakthrough paved the way for subsequent versions: YOLOv2 (2017), YOLOv3 (2018), YOLOv4 (2020, taken over by Alexey Bochkovskiy), YOLOv5 (2020, Ultralytics), YOLOv8 (2023), YOLOv9 (2024), and YOLOv10 (2024, Tsinghua University).

events.title_zh: AlphaGo 胜樊麾:围棋 AI 首次击败职业棋手
events.title_en: AlphaGo Beats Fan Hui: Go AI Beats Professional for the First Time
events.summary_zh:
2015 年 10 月 9 日,DeepMind AlphaGo 在伦敦闭门比赛中以 5:0 击败欧洲围棋冠军樊麾二段,这是围棋 AI 首次击败职业棋手。
AlphaGo 用 CNN + MCTS(蒙特卡洛树搜索)+ RL(强化学习),训练分两阶段:(1) 监督学习模仿人类专家走子,达到业余强手水平;(2) 自我对弈强化学习,超过人类专家水平。
2016 年 1 月 27 日 Nature 529:484-489 论文正式发表,2016 年 3 月 AlphaGo 在首尔 4:1 击败李世石九段。
events.source_name: Silver, D. et al. (2016) Nature 529:484-489; AlphaGo vs Fan Hui (2015-10)
events.summary_en: On October 9, 2015, DeepMind’s AlphaGo defeated European Go champion Fan Hui 2-dan 5-0 in a closed-door London match, marking the first time a Go AI beat a professional player. AlphaGo utilized CNN + MCTS (Monte Carlo Tree Search) + RL (Reinforcement Learning) in a two-stage training process: first, mimicking human expert moves via supervised learning to reach a strong amateur level, and second, using self-play reinforcement learning to surpass human experts. Following the official publication of its paper in Nature 529:484-489 on January 27, 2016, AlphaGo went on to defeat Lee Sedol 9-dan 4-1 in Seoul in March 2016.

events.title_zh: He ResNet:超深网络训练突破
events.title_en: He ResNet: Ultra-Deep Network Training Breakthrough
events.summary_zh:
2015 年 12 月 10 日,Kaiming He、Xiangyu Zhang、Shaoqing Ren、Jian Sun 在 CVPR 2016 发表论文《Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition》。
ResNet 用“残差连接(Skip Connection)”让 152 层 CNN 可训练,在 ImageNet 上 top-5 错误率 3.57%,首次超过人类(5.1%)。
ResNet 关键创新:(1) 残差块 y = F(x) + x,让梯度直接流过 Skip Connection;(2) 152 层 vs VGG 19 层,参数更少但精度更高;(3) BatchNorm + He 初始化让训练稳定。
ResNet 至今仍是视觉 + NLP + 语音 + RL 的标准组件。
events.summary_en: On December 10, 2015, Kaiming He, Xiangyu Zhang, Shaoqing Ren, and Jian Sun published the paper "Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition" at CVPR 2016. ResNet used "Skip Connections" to make a 152-layer CNN trainable, achieving a 3.57% top-5 error rate on ImageNet and surpassing human performance (5.1%) for the first time. Its key innovations—the $y = F(x) + x$ residual block that lets gradients flow directly through skip connections, a 152-layer architecture vs. VGG's 19 layers that had fewer parameters but higher accuracy, and BatchNorm plus He initialization for stable training—ensure ResNet remains a standard component in vision, NLP, speech, and RL to this day.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 成立:非营利 AI 研究实验室启动
events.title_en: OpenAI Founded: Nonprofit AI Research Lab Launched
events.summary_zh:
2015 年 12 月 11 日,OpenAI 在旧金山成立,由 Sam Altman、Elon Musk、Greg Brockman、Ilya Sutskever、Wojciech Zaremba、John Schulman 联合创办。
初始承诺 10 亿美元资金,实际到位约 1.3 亿美元。
OpenAI 宣称目标“构建安全有益的通用人工智能(AGI),为全人类而非单一公司服务”,以非营利形式运营。
2019 年 OpenAI 转型为“有限利润(capped-profit)”公司 OpenAI LP,Microsoft 2019-2023 年累计投资 130 亿美元,OpenAI 从非营利实验室变成 Microsoft 旗下 AI 子公司。
events.source_name: OpenAI founding announcement (2015-12-11); OpenAI LP structure (2019-03)
events.summary_en: On December 11, 2015, OpenAI was founded in San Francisco by Sam Altman, Elon Musk, Greg Brockman, Ilya Sutskever, Wojciech Zaremba, and John Schulman as a non-profit dedicated to "building safe and beneficial artificial general intelligence (AGI)" for all humanity rather than a single company. While the organization launched with $1 billion in pledged funding, only about $130 million was actually received. In 2019, OpenAI transitioned into a "capped-profit" company, OpenAI LP, and following a cumulative $13 billion investment from Microsoft between 2019 and 2023, the former non-profit lab effectively became a Microsoft AI subsidiary.

events.title_zh: AlphaGo 4:1 胜李世石:围棋 AI 越过职业九段
events.title_en: AlphaGo 4:1 Beats Lee Sedol: Go AI Crosses Pro 9-Dan
events.summary_zh:
2016 年 3 月 9-15 日,DeepMind AlphaGo 在首尔四季酒店 5 局比赛中以 4:1 击败韩国职业九段李世石(Lee Sedol),李世石在第 4 局(3 月 13 日)唯一胜局被称为“神之一手”(Move 78)。
AlphaGo 用 MCTS + 深度策略网络 + 深度价值网络,176 个 GPU + 1202 个 CPU,每步搜索 0.2 秒。
Nature 2016 年 1 月 28 日论文《Mastering the game of Go with deep neural networks and tree search》预演结果,3 月正式对弈震惊全球。
events.source_name: Silver, D. et al. (2016) Nature 529:484-489; AlphaGo vs Lee Sedol match record
events.summary_en: From March 9 to 15, 2016, DeepMind’s AlphaGo defeated Korean professional 9-dan Lee Sedol 4:1 in a five-game match at the Four Seasons Hotel in Seoul, with Lee’s sole victory in Game 4 (March 13) dubbed the "divine move" (Move 78). AlphaGo utilized MCTS, deep policy networks, and deep value networks running on 176 GPUs and 1202 CPUs, searching for 0.2 seconds per move. While the results were previewed in the January 28, 2016 *Nature* paper *Mastering the game of Go with deep neural networks and tree search*, the official March showdown shocked the world.

events.title_zh: Google TPU v1:AI 专用芯片公开
events.title_en: Google TPU v1: AI-Specific Chip Public
events.summary_zh:
2016 年 5 月 18 日,Google 在 Google I/O 2016 主题演讲公开 TPU(Tensor Processing Unit)。
TPU v1 是 Google 2013 年内部立项、2015 年数据中心部署的 ASIC,专为矩阵乘法优化,8-bit 整数 Systolic Array 架构,28nm 工艺,700MHz,92 TOPS,28W TDP。
TPU 在 AlphaGo 与李世石对弈(2016-03)中担任推理硬件,在 RankBrain 搜索排序中已运行 3 年。
2017 年 4 月 Norman Jouppi 等在 ISCA 2017 发表论文《In-Datacenter Performance Analysis of a Tensor Processing Unit》。
events.source_name: Jouppi et al. (2017) ISCA; Google I/O 2016 keynote
events.summary_en: At the Google I/O 2016 keynote on May 18, 2016, Google officially unveiled the Tensor Processing Unit (TPU), a custom ASIC initiated internally in 2013 and deployed in datacenters by 2015. Optimized for matrix multiplication, the TPU v1 leveraged an 8-bit integer Systolic Array architecture, a 28nm process, 700MHz clock speed, 92 TOPS, and a 28W TDP, having already run for 3 years in RankBrain search ranking and served as the inference hardware during AlphaGo's match against Lee Sedol (2016-03). In April 2017, Norman Jouppi et al. published the landmark paper "In-Datacenter Performance Analysis of a Tensor Processing Unit" at ISCA 2017.

events.title_zh: Google Magenta 与 AI 艺术开源
events.title_en: Google Magenta: AI Art Goes Open Source
events.summary_zh:
2016 年 6 月 1 日,Google Brain 团队 Doug Eck、Mike Liang 公开 Magenta 项目,目标是用深度学习生成音乐、绘画、文字。
Magenta 第一篇博文《Welcome to Magenta》发布在 Google Research Blog。
Magenta 后续开源工具包括 NSynth(2017 音色合成)、SketchRNN(2017 草图生成)、MusicVAE(2018 音乐序列)。
Magenta 是 Google 在生成式 AI 艺术方向的第一笔投资,直接催生 2021 年 Imagen、2022 年 MusicLM。
events.source_name: Google Magenta launch (2016-06-01); Magenta GitHub
events.summary_en: On June 1, 2016, Doug Eck and Mike Liang of the Google Brain team introduced Project Magenta in a Google Research Blog post titled "Welcome to Magenta," aiming to use deep learning to generate music, drawings, and text. The project subsequently released open-source tools including NSynth (2017 timbre synthesis), SketchRNN (2017 sketch generation), and MusicVAE (2018 music sequences). As Google's first investment in generative AI art, Magenta directly spawned 2021's Imagen and 2022's MusicLM.

events.title_zh: DeepMind WaveNet:神经网络生成原始音频波形
events.title_en: DeepMind WaveNet: Neural Network Generates Raw Audio Waveform
events.summary_zh:
2016 年 9 月 8 日,DeepMind 在 arXiv:1609.03499 发表《WaveNet: A Generative Model for Raw Audio》。
WaveNet 用 Causal Dilated Convolution(因果膨胀卷积,膨胀系数 1,2,4,...,512),把音频波形作为时间序列自回归预测下一采样点。
WaveNet 在 TTS(文本转语音)上达到人类级 MOS 评分(4.21 vs 人类 4.55),在钢琴、语音生成上接近真实。
events.source_name: van den Oord, A. et al. (2016) arXiv:1609.03499
events.summary_en: On September 8, 2016, DeepMind published "WaveNet: A Generative Model for Raw Audio" on arXiv:1609.03499. WaveNet utilized causal dilated convolutions (with dilation coefficients of 1, 2, 4, ..., 512) to treat audio waveforms as a time series, autoregressively predicting the next sample point. The model achieved a human-level MOS score of 4.21 in TTS (text-to-speech) versus 4.55 for humans, and came close to reality in piano and speech generation.

events.title_zh: Google GNMT:神经机器翻译全面替代 SMT
events.title_en: Google GNMT: Neural Machine Translation Replaces SMT
events.summary_zh:
2016 年 9 月 27 日,Google 发表论文《Google's Neural Machine Translation System: Bridging the Gap between Human and Machine Translation》(arXiv:1609.08144)。
GNMT 用 8 层 LSTM Encoder-Decoder + Attention,128 个 GPU 训练 6 天,在 Google 翻译中把中英翻译错误率降低 58%,接近人类水平。
GNMT 上线后 Google 翻译一夜之间提升一个版本号,2016 年 11 月 Google 翻译完全切换到 GNMT。
events.summary_en: On September 27, 2016, Google published the paper "Google's Neural Machine Translation System: Bridging the Gap between Human and Machine Translation" (arXiv:1609.08144). Driven by an 8-layer LSTM Encoder-Decoder + Attention and trained on 128 GPUs for 6 days, GNMT reduced Chinese-to-English translation error rates in Google Translate by 58%, approaching human-level performance. Following its launch, Google Translate upgraded by a version number overnight, and by November 2016, Google Translate had completely switched to GNMT.

events.title_zh: PyTorch 开源:动态图框架进入主流
events.title_en: PyTorch Open-Sourced: Dynamic Graph Framework Goes Mainstream
events.summary_zh:
2017 年 1 月 18 日,Facebook AI Research(FAIR)发布 PyTorch 0.1,Adam Paszke、Sam Gross、Soumith Chintala 主导开发。
PyTorch 基于 Torch7,核心创新是动态计算图(Define-by-Run),比 TensorFlow 1.x 静态图更易调试,Python 原生语法接近 NumPy。
2017 年 8 月 PyTorch 0.2 分布式训练,2018 年 4 月 0.4 合并 Variable 与 Tensor,2018 年 12 月 1.0 稳定版。
2019 年 PyTorch 在顶级会议论文使用率超过 TensorFlow,2020 年 HuggingFace 全面转向 PyTorch。
events.source_name: Paszke, A. et al. (2017) PyTorch 0.1 release; NeurIPS 2019 autodiff workshop
events.summary_en: On January 18, 2017, Facebook AI Research (FAIR) released PyTorch 0.1, a Torch7-based framework led by Adam Paszke, Sam Gross, and Soumith Chintala that featured a dynamic computation graph (Define-by-Run) and a NumPy-like Python-native syntax, making it far easier to debug than TensorFlow 1.x's static graphs. PyTorch 0.2 introduced distributed training in August 2017, version 0.4 merged Variable and Tensor in April 2018, and the stable 1.0 version arrived in December 2018. By 2019, PyTorch’s usage rate in top conference papers surpassed TensorFlow’s, and HuggingFace fully pivoted to PyTorch in 2020.

events.title_zh: Asilomar AI 原则:23 条 AI 伦理基准
events.title_en: Asilomar AI Principles: 23 AI Ethics Baselines
events.summary_zh:
2017 年 1 月 23 日,Future of Life Institute 在加州 Asilomar 会议中心召集 23 位 AI 专家(Stuart Russell、Demis Hassabis、Yann LeCun、Fei-Fei Li 等),发布《Asilomar AI Principles》23 条原则,涵盖研究问题(5 条)、伦理价值(13 条)、长期问题(5 条)。
原则包括:AI 目标应与人类价值对齐、AI 设计应可审计、AI 应避免军备竞赛等。
截至 2017 年底,1275 名 AI 研究者签署原则。
events.source_name: Future of Life Institute (2017) Asilomar AI Principles
events.summary_en: On January 23, 2017, the Future of Life Institute convened 23 AI experts (including Stuart Russell, Demis Hassabis, Yann LeCun, and Fei-Fei Li) at California's Asilomar Conference Center to release the 23 "Asilomar AI Principles," covering research issues (5), ethical values (13), and longer-term issues (5). These guidelines dictate that AI goals should align with human values, AI designs must be auditable, and an AI arms race should be avoided. By the end of 2017, 1,275 AI researchers had signed onto the principles.

events.title_zh: TensorFlow 1.0:Google ML 框架成工业主流
events.title_en: TensorFlow 1.0: Google ML Framework Becomes Industry Mainstream
events.summary_zh:
2017 年 2 月 15 日,Google 在 TensorFlow Dev Summit 2017 发布 TensorFlow 1.0。
TF 1.0 提供 Python/C++/Java API、分布式训练、TensorBoard 可视化、TF Serving 部署、移动端 TF Lite。
TF 1.0 在工业部署占主导(2017-2020),Pinterest、Airbnb、Snapchat、Uber、Twitter 都用 TF 生产。
但 TF 1.x 静态图 + Session.run 模型在学术界被 PyTorch 蚕食,2019 年 Google 推出 TF 2.0 + Keras 整合转向动态图。
events.source_name: Abadi, M. et al. (2016) TensorFlow 1.0; TF Dev Summit 2017
events.summary_en: On February 15, 2017, Google launched TensorFlow 1.0 at the TensorFlow Dev Summit 2017, providing Python/C++/Java APIs, distributed training, TensorBoard visualization, TF Serving deployment, and mobile TF Lite. While TF 1.0 dominated industrial deployment from 2017 to 2020—powering production at Pinterest, Airbnb, Snapchat, Uber, and Twitter—its static graph and Session.run model were steadily eroded in academia by PyTorch, prompting Google to transition to dynamic graphs in 2019 by integrating Keras into TF 2.0.

events.title_zh: AlphaGo 3:0 战胜柯洁:围棋 AI 退役战
events.title_en: AlphaGo 3:0 Beats Ke Jie: Go AI Retirement Match
events.summary_zh:
2017 年 5 月 23-27 日,DeepMind AlphaGo Master 在中国乌镇未来围棋峰会上 3:0 击败中国职业九段柯洁。
AlphaGo Master 用 1 个 TPU v2 单机运行,远少于 2016 年李世石版的 176 GPU。
比赛中 AlphaGo 评分约 4800 ELO,柯洁约 3600 ELO。
赛后 DeepMind 宣布 AlphaGo 退役,不再参加围棋比赛,转而研发 AlphaGo Zero 与 AlphaZero。
events.source_name: DeepMind (2017) Future of Go Summit Wuzhen; AlphaGo Master matches
events.summary_en: Between May 23 and 27, 2017, DeepMind's AlphaGo Master defeated Chinese professional 9-dan Ke Jie 3-0 at the Future of Go Summit in Wuzhen, China. Running on a single machine with just 1 TPU v2—a massive reduction from the 176 GPUs used in the 2016 Lee Sedol version—AlphaGo boasted an ELO rating of approximately 4800 during the match, compared to Ke Jie's 3600. Following the victory, DeepMind announced AlphaGo's retirement from Go competition, shifting its focus to developing AlphaGo Zero and AlphaZero.

events.title_zh: Transformer 论文:Attention Is All You Need
events.title_en: Transformer Paper: Attention Is All You Need
events.summary_zh:
2017 年 6 月 12 日,Ashish Vaswani 等 8 位 Google Brain/Google Research 研究员在 NeurIPS 2017 发表《Attention Is All You Need》(arXiv:1706.03762)。
Transformer 抛弃 RNN/CNN,只用 Self-Attention(Q/K/V 点积注意力) + Positional Encoding + Feed-Forward 层 + 残差连接 + LayerNorm。
原论文在 WMT 2014 英德/英法翻译上达到 SOTA,训练成本是当时最好的 RNN 模型的 1/10。
events.source_name: Vaswani, A. et al. (2017) NeurIPS; arXiv:1706.03762
events.summary_en: On June 12, 2017, Ashish Vaswani and 8 other Google Brain/Google Research researchers published "Attention Is All You Need" (arXiv:1706.03762) at NeurIPS 2017. The Transformer ditched RNN/CNN, relying only on Self-Attention (Q/K/V dot-product attention), Positional Encoding, Feed-Forward layers, residual connections, and LayerNorm. The original paper achieved SOTA on WMT 2014 English-German/English-French translation, at just 1/10 the training cost of the best RNN models at the time.

events.title_zh: fast.ai 成立:深度学习教育平民化
events.title_en: fast.ai Founded: Democratizing Deep Learning Education
events.summary_zh:
2017 年 8 月 3 日,Jeremy Howard、Rachel Thomas 创办 fast.ai(非营利,旧金山大学 USF Data Institute)。
fast.ai 推出「Practical Deep Learning for Coders」免费 MOOC,7 周 8 节课用 PyTorch + fastai 库教零基础程序员做图像分类、NLP、推荐、表格学习。
fast.ai 2018-2020 年学员超 50 万,2020 年学员 ULMFiT、AWD-LSTM 影响 HuggingFace、Stability AI。
events.source_name: Howard, J. & Thomas, R. (2017) fast.ai launch; Practical Deep Learning MOOC
events.summary_en: On August 3, 2017, Jeremy Howard and Rachel Thomas founded fast.ai (a non-profit at the USF Data Institute) and launched "Practical Deep Learning for Coders," a free, 7-week, 8-lesson MOOC using PyTorch and the fastai library to teach zero-background programmers image classification, NLP, recommendation, and tabular learning. Between 2018 and 2020, fast.ai amassed over 500,000 students, and by 2020, its students, ULMFiT, and AWD-LSTM had influenced HuggingFace and Stability AI.

events.title_zh: AlphaGo Zero:从零自学击败旧版 AlphaGo
events.title_en: AlphaGo Zero: Self-Play Beats Old AlphaGo from Scratch
events.summary_zh:
2017 年 10 月 18 日,DeepMind 在 Nature 550:354-359 发表《Mastering the game of Go without human knowledge》。
AlphaGo Zero 完全不用人类棋谱,只用自我对弈 + RL,从随机落子开始 3 天击败 2016 年胜李世石的 AlphaGo Lee,21 天击败 2017 年 60 连胜 Master 版本,40 天训练达到超越所有人类围棋 AI 的水平。
AlphaGo Zero 用单一残差网络同时输出策略和价值,简化了原 AlphaGo 双网络结构。
events.source_name: Silver, D. et al. (2017) Nature 550:354-359; AlphaZero arXiv:1712.01815
events.summary_en: On October 18, 2017, DeepMind published "Mastering the game of Go without human knowledge" in Nature 550:354-359. Training solely on self-play and reinforcement learning without human game records, AlphaGo Zero started from random moves to defeat the 2016 Lee Sedol-beating AlphaGo Lee in 3 days, conquer the 60-win 2017 Master version in 21 days, and surpass all human and Go AI levels in 40 days. It simplified the original AlphaGo's dual-network structure by using a single residual network to simultaneously output policy and value.

events.title_zh: NVIDIA V100 Tensor Core:LLM 训练硬件主力
events.title_en: NVIDIA V100 Tensor Core: LLM Training Hardware Workhorse
events.summary_zh:
2018 年 3 月 27 日,NVIDIA 在 GTC 2018 推出 DGX-1 with V100。
V100 是 Volta 架构 GPU,16nm FFET 工艺,815mm² die,21.1B 晶体管,16GB/32GB HBM2,900 GB/s 显存带宽,640 个 Tensor Core(FP16 100 TFLOPS / FP32 15.7 TFLOPS)。
V100 引入 Tensor Core,用混合精度训练(Mixed Precision Training)把 LLM 训练成本降低 2-3 倍。
DGX-1 V100 8 卡版约 149,000 美元,2018-2020 年是 OpenAI、DeepMind、FAIR 训练主力。
events.source_name: NVIDIA Volta whitepaper (2017); NVIDIA DGX-1 V100 (2018)
events.summary_en: On March 27, 2018, NVIDIA introduced the DGX-1 with V100 at GTC 2018, featuring a Volta-architecture GPU with a 16nm FFET process, an 815mm² die, 21.1B transistors, 16GB/32GB HBM2, 900 GB/s memory bandwidth, and 640 Tensor Cores (FP16 100 TFLOPS / FP32 15.7 TFLOPS). The V100 introduced Tensor Cores, leveraging Mixed Precision Training to reduce LLM training costs by 2-3 times. Priced at approximately $149,000 for the 8-card version, the DGX-1 V100 served as the primary training workhorse for OpenAI, DeepMind, and FAIR from 2018 to 2020.

events.title_zh: GLUE 基准:NLP 任务评测标准化
events.title_en: GLUE Benchmark: NLP Evaluation Standardization
events.summary_zh:
2018 年 4 月 22 日,纽约大学 Alex Wang、Samuel Bowman 等在 arXiv:1804.07461 发表《GLUE: A Multi-Task Benchmark and Analysis Platform for Testing Natural Language Understanding Systems》。
GLUE 包含 9 个 NLU 任务:CoLA、SST-2、MRPC、STS-B、QQP、MNLI、QNLI、RTE、WNLI,涵盖情感、相似度、蕴含、问答。
GLUE 排行榜 2018-2019 年 BERT、RoBERTa、T5、ALBERT 接力刷新,2020 年 1 月 SuperGLUE 诞生,2021 年 GLUE 饱和(模型超过人类)。
events.source_name: Wang, A. et al. (2018) arXiv:1804.07461; GLUE benchmark
events.summary_en: On April 22, 2018, New York University’s Alex Wang, Samuel Bowman, and others published "GLUE: A Multi-Task Benchmark and Analysis Platform for Testing Natural Language Understanding Systems" on arXiv:1804.07461. The benchmark comprises 9 NLU tasks—CoLA, SST-2, MRPC, STS-B, QQP, MNLI, QNLI, RTE, and WNLI—covering sentiment, similarity, entailment, and question answering. After the GLUE leaderboard was successively shattered by BERT, RoBERTa, T5, and ALBERT between 2018 and 2019, SuperGLUE was born in January 2020, and GLUE reached saturation in 2021 as models surpassed human performance.

events.title_zh: OpenAI GPT-1:预训练 + 微调范式确立
events.title_en: OpenAI GPT-1: Pre-training + Fine-tuning Paradigm Established
events.summary_zh:
2018 年 6 月 11 日,OpenAI 在论文《Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training》发布 GPT-1。
GPT-1 用 12 层 Transformer Decoder(768 维隐藏层,12 头,117M 参数),在 BookCorpus(7000+ 本未出版小说)上无监督预训练,然后在 12 个 NLP 任务上微调。
GPT-1 在 9/12 任务上达到 SOTA,证明“无监督预训练 + 有监督微调”范式可行。
events.source_name: Radford, A. et al. (2018) OpenAI blog; GPT-1 paper
events.summary_en: On June 11, 2018, OpenAI introduced GPT-1 in the paper "Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training." The model, featuring a 12-layer Transformer decoder (with a 768-dimensional hidden layer, 12 heads, and 117M parameters), underwent unsupervised pre-training on BookCorpus (7000+ unpublished novels) before being fine-tuned on 12 NLP tasks. By achieving SOTA on 9/12 tasks, GPT-1 proved the viability of the "unsupervised pre-training + supervised fine-tuning" paradigm.

events.title_zh: 李飞飞国会作证:以人为本 AI 的政策时刻
events.title_en: Fei-Fei Li Testifies to Congress: Human-Centered AI
events.summary_zh: 李飞飞赴美国国会就「以人为本 AI」作证，母亲病危中坚持出席，提出 AI 发展的动机永远应该是以人为本。
events.summary_en: Insisting on testifying before the U.S. Congress on "human-centered AI" even while her mother was critically ill, Fei-Fei Li argued that the motivation behind AI development must always be human-centered.

events.title_zh: HuggingFace 创立:NLP 开源社区中心
events.title_en: HuggingFace Founded: NLP Open Source Community Hub
events.summary_zh:
2018 年 10 月 10 日,HuggingFace(2016 年由 Clément Delangue、Julien Chaumond、Thomas Wolf 在纽约创立,最初做面向青少年的聊天机器人 App)发布 pytorch-pretrained-bert 库(后改名 transformers),把 BERT/GPT 等预训练模型整合为统一接口。
2019-04 与 OpenAI GPT-2、Google BERT 整合。
2020 年 Model Hub 上线,2021 年 5 月 4000 万美元 A 轮,2023 年 2.35 亿美元 D 轮估值 45 亿美元,Google、Amazon、NVIDIA、Salesforce、IBM 全部参投。
events.source_name: HuggingFace founding (2018-10); transformers library (2018-11)
events.summary_en: On October 10, 2018, Hugging Face—founded in New York in 2016 by Clément Delangue, Julien Chaumond, and Thomas Wolf as a teenage chatbot app—released the pytorch-pretrained-bert library (later renamed transformers), unifying pre-trained models like BERT and GPT into a single interface. After integrating OpenAI GPT-2 and Google BERT in April 2019, the company launched its Model Hub in 2020. This set the stage for a $40 million Series A in May 2021 and a $235 million Series D in 2023 at a $4.5 billion valuation, with Google, Amazon, NVIDIA, Salesforce, and IBM all participating.

events.title_zh: Google BERT:双向预训练 NLP 范式确立
events.title_en: Google BERT: Bidirectional Pre-training NLP Paradigm Established
events.summary_zh:
2018 年 10 月 11 日,Google AI 在 arXiv:1810.04805 发表《BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding》。
BERT 用 24 层 Transformer Encoder(340M 参数),在 BookCorpus + English Wikipedia(3.3B 词)上用 Masked Language Model(MLM) + Next Sentence Prediction(NSP)预训练。
BERT 在 11 个 NLP 任务上刷新 SOTA,包括 GLUE(7.7% 提升)、SQuAD v1.1(1.5% F1)、SQuAD v2.0(4.6% F1)。
events.source_name: Devlin, J. et al. (2018) arXiv:1810.04805; NAACL 2019
events.summary_en: On October 11, 2018, Google AI published "BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding" on arXiv:1810.04805. The model, featuring a 24-layer Transformer Encoder with 340M parameters, was pre-trained on BookCorpus and English Wikipedia (3.3B words) using Masked Language Model (MLM) and Next Sentence Prediction (NSP). BERT went on to set new state-of-the-art benchmarks across 11 NLP tasks, including GLUE (7.7% improvement), SQuAD v1.1 (1.5% F1), and SQuAD v2.0 (4.6% F1).

events.title_zh: AlphaFold 1:CASP13 蛋白质结构预测初突破
events.title_en: AlphaFold 1: CASP13 Protein Structure Prediction Breakthrough
events.summary_zh:
2018 年 12 月 3-7 日,CASP13(第 13 届 Critical Assessment of Protein Structure Prediction)会议在墨西哥 Cancun 举办,DeepMind AlphaFold 1 在 13 届比赛中第一次达到“实验级精度”。
AlphaFold 1 用 Deep Learning 预测蛋白质距离矩阵 + 梯度下降优化 3D 结构。
CASP13 中 AlphaFold 在 GDT_TS 评分中位 60,远超第二名 40。
events.source_name: Senior, A. et al. (2019) Nature 577:706-710; CASP13 results
events.summary_en: At the CASP13 (13th Critical Assessment of Protein Structure Prediction) conference in Cancun, Mexico, from December 3–7, 2018, DeepMind’s AlphaFold 1 reached "experimental accuracy" for the first time in the 13th competition. By using deep learning to predict protein distance matrices and gradient descent to optimize 3D structures, AlphaFold achieved a median GDT_TS score of 60 at CASP13, far outstripping the runner-up's score of 40.

events.title_zh: OpenAI GPT-2:大规模生成预训练首次披露
events.title_en: OpenAI GPT-2: Large-Scale Generative Pre-training Disclosed
events.summary_zh:
2019 年 2 月 14 日,OpenAI 在博客《Better Language Models and Their Implications》发布 GPT-2 论文《Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners》(Radford 等)。
GPT-2 用 48 层 Transformer Decoder,1.5B 参数,在 WebText(4500 万网页,40GB)上训练。
GPT-2 在零样本(zero-shot)下完成翻译、问答、摘要、写作等 7 个任务。
OpenAI 以“恶意使用风险”为由,分阶段发布:2019-02-14 发布 117M 小模型,2019-05 发布 345M,2019-08 发布 774M,2019-11-05 发布完整 1.5B 模型。
events.source_name: Radford, A. et al. (2019) GPT-2 paper; OpenAI blog
events.summary_en: On February 14, 2019, OpenAI published the GPT-2 paper "Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners" (Radford et al.) alongside its blog post "Better Language Models and Their Implications." Built with a 48-layer Transformer decoder and 1.5B parameters, GPT-2 was trained on WebText (45 million webpages, 40GB) and demonstrated the ability to perform seven zero-shot tasks, including translation, Q&A, summarization, and writing. Citing "malicious use risks," OpenAI opted for a staged rollout: releasing the 117M model on February 14, 2019, the 345M in May 2019, the 774M in August 2019, and the complete 1.5B model on November 5, 2019.

events.title_zh: OpenAI LP 设立: capped-profit 转型
events.title_en: OpenAI LP: Capped-Profit Transition
events.summary_zh:
2019 年 3 月 11 日,OpenAI 宣布成立 OpenAI LP(Limited Partnership),从非营利转为“capped-profit”架构。
原 OpenAI Inc.(非营利)成为 OpenAI LP 的唯一控制方,Microsoft 投 10 亿美元,投资回报上限 100 倍。
架构设计:投资者回报达到上限后,剩余利润归原 OpenAI Inc.(非营利)。
理由是“训练大模型需要超大规模资本,纯非营利无法支撑”。
2019-2023 年 Microsoft 累计投资 130 亿美元。
events.source_name: OpenAI (2019) OpenAI LP announcement; Microsoft investment
events.summary_en: On March 11, 2019, OpenAI announced the creation of OpenAI LP (Limited Partnership), transitioning from a non-profit to a “capped-profit” structure because training large models requires massive capital that a pure non-profit cannot sustain. Solely controlled by the original non-profit OpenAI Inc., the new entity secured a $1 billion investment from Microsoft with returns capped at 100x, after which any remaining profits revert to OpenAI Inc. Between 2019 and 2023, Microsoft’s cumulative investment reached $13 billion.

events.title_zh: NVIDIA Megatron-LM:大模型并行训练范式
events.title_en: NVIDIA Megatron-LM: Large Model Parallel Training Paradigm
events.summary_zh:
2019 年 9 月 19 日,NVIDIA 在 arXiv:1909.08053 发表《Megatron-LM: Training Multi-Billion Parameter Language Models Using Model Parallelism》。
Megatron-LM 用 Tensor Parallelism(把每层 Attention/FFN 矩阵切到多 GPU)+ Pipeline Parallelism(把不同层放到不同 GPU),在 512 个 V100 GPU 上训练 8.3B 参数 GPT-2,达到 52% 单 GPU 训练效率。
Megatron-LM 直接催生 NVIDIA NeMo Megatron、Microsoft DeepSpeed、Megatron-DeepSpeed。
events.source_name: Shoeybi, M. et al. (2019) arXiv:1909.08053
events.summary_en: On September 19, 2019, NVIDIA published "Megatron-LM: Training Multi-Billion Parameter Language Models Using Model Parallelism" on arXiv (arXiv:1909.08053). By combining Tensor Parallelism (splitting each layer's Attention/FFN matrices across multiple GPUs) and Pipeline Parallelism (placing different layers on different GPUs), Megatron-LM trained an 8.3B parameter GPT-2 on 512 V100 GPUs, achieving a 52% single-GPU training efficiency. This breakthrough directly spawned NVIDIA NeMo Megatron, Microsoft DeepSpeed, and Megatron-DeepSpeed.

events.title_zh: Google T5:Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer
events.title_en: Google T5: Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer
events.summary_zh:
2019 年 10 月 10 日,Google 在 JMLR 21 发表《Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer》(arXiv:1910.10683)。
T5(Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer)用 Encoder-Decoder Transformer,把所有 NLP 任务统一为“文本输入 → 文本输出”格式。
T5 11B 在 GLUE、SuperGLUE、SQuAD、CNN-DM 等 30+ 任务上达到 SOTA。
T5 论文同时发布 C4(Colossal Clean Crawled Corpus)750GB 预训练数据集。
events.source_name: Raffel, C. et al. (2019) arXiv:1910.10683; JMLR 21
events.summary_en: On October 10, 2019, Google published "Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer" (arXiv:1910.10683) in JMLR 21, introducing T5 (Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer) to unify all NLP tasks into a "text input → text output" format using an Encoder-Decoder Transformer. T5 11B achieved SOTA on 30+ tasks, including GLUE, SuperGLUE, SQuAD, and CNN-DM. The paper also released the 750GB C4 (Colossal Clean Crawled Corpus) pre-training dataset.

events.title_zh: DeepMind AlphaStar:星际争霸 II 超大师级
events.title_en: DeepMind AlphaStar: StarCraft II Grandmaster Level
events.summary_zh:
2019 年 10 月 30 日,DeepMind 在 Nature 575:350-354 发表《Grandmaster level in StarCraft II using multi-agent reinforcement learning》。
AlphaStar 用 Transformer + Pointer Network + LSTM + Multi-Agent RL,在 StarCraft II Battle.net 上达到大师级(欧洲服务器前 0.2%)。
AlphaStar 训练用 200 年人类游戏 + 14 天自我对弈,League 训练模式让智能体互相竞争进化。
events.source_name: Vinyals, O. et al. (2019) Nature 575:350-354; AlphaStar blog
events.summary_en: On October 30, 2019, DeepMind published "Grandmaster level in StarCraft II using multi-agent reinforcement learning" in *Nature* (575:350-354). By combining Transformers, Pointer Networks, LSTMs, and multi-agent reinforcement learning, AlphaStar achieved Grandmaster status on StarCraft II's Battle.net, ranking in the top 0.2% of the European server. The agent was trained on 200 years of human gameplay followed by 14 days of self-play, utilizing a "League" training mode where agents competed to drive their own evolution.

events.title_zh: NVIDIA A100:LLM 训练硬件主力 4 年
events.title_en: NVIDIA A100: LLM Training Hardware Workhorse for 4 Years
events.summary_zh:
2020 年 5 月 14 日,NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang 在 GTC 2020 Keynote(厨房录制,COVID 期间)发布 A100 GPU。
A100 是 Ampere 架构,7nm 工艺,826mm² die,54.2B 晶体管,40GB/80GB HBM2e,1.55TB/s 显存带宽,108 个 SM,432 个 Tensor Core(FP16 312 TFLOPS / TF32 156 TFLOPS / BF16 312 TFLOPS)。
DGX A100 8 卡版约 199,000 美元,2020-2024 年是 GPT-3、PaLM、LLaMA、GPT-4 训练主力。
events.source_name: NVIDIA Ampere whitepaper (2020); NVIDIA GTC 2020 keynote
events.summary_en: On May 14, 2020, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang unveiled the A100 GPU during his GTC 2020 Keynote, which was recorded in his kitchen during the COVID pandemic. Built on the Ampere architecture, the 7nm chip features an 826mm² die, 54.2B transistors, 40GB/80GB HBM2e with 1.55TB/s memory bandwidth, 108 SMs, and 432 Tensor Cores (FP16 312 TFLOPS / TF32 156 TFLOPS / BF16 312 TFLOPS). The 8-card DGX A100 version, priced at around $199,000, served as the primary training workhorse for GPT-3, PaLM, LLaMA, and GPT-4 from 2020 to 2024.

events.title_zh: Lewis RAG:检索增强生成范式提出
events.title_en: Lewis RAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation Paradigm Proposed
events.summary_zh:
2020 年 5 月 22 日,Facebook AI Research Patrick Lewis 等在 NeurIPS 2020 发表《Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks》(arXiv:2005.11401)。
RAG 用「检索器(Dense Passage Retrieval)+ 生成器(BART)」两阶段:检索器从知识库召回 top-k 文档,生成器基于检索文档生成答案。
RAG 在 OpenQA、Jeopardy QG、TriviaQA 上达到 SOTA,且知识库可热更新。
events.source_name: Lewis, P. et al. (2020) arXiv:2005.11401; NeurIPS 2020
events.summary_en: On May 22, 2020, Patrick Lewis and others at Facebook AI Research published "Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks" (arXiv:2005.11401) at NeurIPS 2020. RAG uses a two-stage process pairing a retriever (Dense Passage Retrieval) and a generator (BART), where the retriever recalls top-k documents from a knowledge base and the generator generates answers based on those retrieved documents. The framework achieved SOTA on OpenQA, Jeopardy QG, and TriviaQA, while allowing the underlying knowledge base to be hot-updated.

events.title_zh: OpenAI GPT-3 175B:Scaling Laws 验证
events.title_en: OpenAI GPT-3 175B: Scaling Laws Validated
events.summary_zh:
2020 年 5 月 28 日,OpenAI 在 arXiv:2005.14165 发表《Language Models are Few-Shot Learners》。
GPT-3 用 96 层 Transformer Decoder,175B 参数,在 Common Crawl(499B token)+ WebText2 + Books1 + Books2 + Wikipedia 上训练。
GPT-3 首次展示“in-context learning”:不需微调,只在 prompt 中给 0/few-shot 示例就能完成翻译、问答、编程、推理等 50+ 任务。
GPT-3 论文引用 2024 年超 3 万次,是 LLM 时代奠基论文。
events.source_name: Brown, T. et al. (2020) arXiv:2005.14165; NeurIPS 2020
events.summary_en: On May 28, 2020, OpenAI published "Language Models are Few-Shot Learners" on arXiv:2005.14165, introducing GPT-3, a model trained on Common Crawl (499B tokens), WebText2, Books1, Books2, and Wikipedia using a 96-layer Transformer Decoder and 175B parameters. GPT-3 first demonstrated "in-context learning," performing over 50 tasks like translation, Q&A, programming, and reasoning without fine-tuning, using only zero- or few-shot examples in the prompt. With over 30,000 citations by 2024, it remains a foundational paper of the LLM era.

events.title_zh: OpenAI API:LLM-as-a-Service 商业模式启动
events.title_en: OpenAI API: LLM-as-a-Service Business Model Launched
events.summary_zh:
2020 年 6 月 11 日,OpenAI 发布《OpenAI API》博客,推出 GPT-3 商用 API(private beta)。
API 端点统一为「text-in text-out」,价格按 token 计费(初期 0.06 美元/1K token)。
API 不卖模型权重,只卖推理服务,这是 LLM 时代「LLM-as-a-Service」商业模式起点。
2021-09 公测,2022-08 Codex API(GitHub Copilot),2022-11-30 ChatGPT 上线,2023-03 GPT-4 API。
events.source_name: OpenAI (2020-06-11) OpenAI API blog; private beta launch
events.summary_en: On June 11, 2020, OpenAI published its "OpenAI API" blog post to launch the commercial GPT-3 API in private beta, featuring a unified "text-in, text-out" endpoint priced initially at $0.06 per 1K tokens. By selling only inference services rather than model weights, this move marked the beginning of the LLM era's "LLM-as-a-Service" business model, which paved the way for a public beta in September 2021, the Codex API (GitHub Copilot) in August 2022, the launch of ChatGPT on November 30, 2022, and the GPT-4 API in March 2023.

events.title_zh: OpenAI iGPT:图像自回归预训练探索
events.title_en: OpenAI iGPT: Image Autoregressive Pre-training Exploration
events.summary_zh:
2020 年 6 月 24 日,OpenAI 在 arXiv:2012.12656 发表《Generative Pretraining from Pixels》(实际 2020-06 公开 blog)。
iGPT(Image GPT)把 GPT-2 自回归架构扩展到图像:把 32×32 图像展开为 1024 序列,用 Transformer Decoder 自回归预测下一个像素。
iGPT-XL(6.8B 参数)在 ImageNet 上半监督分类达 72.0% top-1,接近 SimCLR 等 contrastive 路线。
events.source_name: Chen, M. et al. (2020) arXiv:2012.12656; OpenAI iGPT blog
events.summary_en: On June 24, 2020, OpenAI published "Generative Pretraining from Pixels" on arXiv:2012.12656 (having originally debuted the work in a June 2020 blog post), introducing iGPT (Image GPT) to adapt the autoregressive architecture of GPT-2 for computer vision by flattening 32×32 images into a sequence of 1024 and using a Transformer Decoder to predict the next pixel. The model's largest variant, iGPT-XL (6.8B parameters), achieved a 72.0% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet under semi-supervised classification, bringing it close to contrastive learning approaches like SimCLR.

events.title_zh: AlphaFold2:CASP14 蛋白质结构预测达到实验级精度
events.title_en: AlphaFold2: CASP14 Protein Structure Prediction Reaches Experimental Accuracy
events.summary_zh:
2020 年 11 月 30 日,CASP14(第 14 届 Critical Assessment of Protein Structure Prediction)会议公布结果,DeepMind AlphaFold2 在 GDT_TS 中位 92.4,远超第二名 75.6,首次达到实验级精度(X-ray 晶体学误差范围内)。
AlphaFold2 用 Evoformer + Structure Module,用 MSA(Multiple Sequence Alignment)+ Pair Representation 联合表征。
Nature 2021-07 15 发表 AlphaFold2 论文《Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold》。
events.source_name: Jumper, J. et al. (2021) Nature 596:583-589; CASP14 results (2020-11)
events.summary_en: On November 30, 2020, the results of the 14th Critical Assessment of Protein Structure Prediction (CASP14) were announced, showing DeepMind’s AlphaFold2 achieving a median GDT_TS of 92.4—far outstripping the runner-up's 75.6—to reach experimental-grade accuracy (within the margin of error of X-ray crystallography) for the first time. AlphaFold2 utilizes Evoformer and Structure Module, employing MSA (Multiple Sequence Alignment) and Pair Representation for joint representation. On July 15, 2021, *Nature* published the AlphaFold2 paper, "Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold."

events.title_zh: OpenAI CLIP + DALL·E:多模态预训练范式确立
events.title_en: OpenAI CLIP + DALL·E: Multimodal Pre-training Paradigm Established
events.summary_zh:
2021 年 1 月 5 日,OpenAI 同时发布 CLIP(Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training,arXiv:2103.00020,实际 2021-02-26 arXiv)和 DALL·E(arXiv:2102.12092,2021-01-05 blog)。
CLIP 用 4 亿图文对训练双塔模型,把图像和文本映射到同一 512 维空间,在 30+ 视觉分类任务上 zero-shot 接近监督 SOTA。
DALL·E 用 120 亿参数 dVAE + Transformer,文本生成图像。
两篇论文奠定「多模态统一表征」路线。
events.source_name: Radford, A. et al. (2021) CLIP arXiv:2103.00020; Ramesh, A. et al. DALL·E arXiv:2102.12092
events.summary_en: On January 5, 2021, OpenAI simultaneously released CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training, arXiv:2103.00020, actually 2021-02-26 arXiv) and DALL·E (arXiv:2102.12092, 2021-01-05 blog). CLIP trained a dual-tower model on 400 million image-text pairs to map images and text into the same 512-dimensional space, approaching supervised SOTA on 30+ visual classification tasks via zero-shot learning, while DALL·E employed a 12-billion-parameter dVAE + Transformer for text-to-image generation. Together, these two papers laid the foundation for the "unified multimodal representation" pathway.

events.title_zh: Hu LoRA:低秩适配器开启高效微调时代
events.title_en: Hu LoRA: Low-Rank Adapters Enable Efficient Fine-tuning Era
events.summary_zh:
2021 年 6 月 17 日,Microsoft Edward Hu 等在 arXiv:2106.09685 发表《LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models》。
LoRA 把权重更新 ΔW 分解为两个低秩矩阵 BA(B∈r×d,A∈d×r,r≪d),只训练 BA 不动原权重,可训练参数降低 1000-10000 倍。
LoRA 在 GPT-3 175B 上把微调参数从 175B 降到 4.7M(0.003%),性能持平或略优。
events.summary_en: On June 17, 2021, Microsoft’s Edward Hu and others published "LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models" on arXiv:2106.09685. LoRA decomposes the weight update ΔW into two low-rank matrices BA (B∈r×d, A∈d×r, r≪d), training only BA while keeping the original weights frozen, which slashes trainable parameters by 1,000 to 10,000 times. On GPT-3 175B, this method reduced fine-tuning parameters from 175B to just 4.7M (0.003%) while delivering comparable or slightly superior performance.

events.title_zh: GitHub Copilot 公测:AI 编程助手进入主流
events.title_en: GitHub Copilot Public Beta: AI Coding Assistant Goes Mainstream
events.summary_zh:
2021 年 6 月 29 日,GitHub 与 OpenAI 联合宣布 GitHub Copilot Technical Preview 公测。
Copilot 基于 OpenAI Codex(GPT-3 微调版,代码训练 159GB GitHub 代码),在 VS Code 中提供行级 / 函数级代码补全,月费 10 美元。
2022-06-21 正式版上线,2023-03 推出 Copilot X(GPT-4 + Chat),2024-12 推出 Copilot Workspace(任务级 Agent)。
events.source_name: GitHub (2021-06-29) Copilot preview announcement; OpenAI Codex
events.summary_en: On June 29, 2021, GitHub and OpenAI jointly announced the public beta of GitHub Copilot Technical Preview. Powered by OpenAI Codex—a fine-tuned version of GPT-3 trained on 159GB of GitHub code—Copilot provides line-level and function-level code completion in VS Code for $10 a month. It officially launched on June 21, 2022, followed by the debuts of Copilot X (GPT-4 + Chat) in March 2023 and Copilot Workspace (a task-level Agent) in December 2024.

events.title_zh: OpenAI Codex API:代码 LLM 商业化
events.title_en: OpenAI Codex API: Code LLM Commercialization
events.summary_zh:
2021 年 8 月 10 日,OpenAI 发布 Codex API 私测。
Codex 是 GPT-3 的代码专精版,在 OpenAI 收集的 159GB GitHub 公开代码(2021 年论文)上微调,支持 Python、JavaScript、Go、C++ 等 12+ 语言。
Codex API 端点 /v1/completions(code-davinci-001 模型),按 token 计费 0.06 美元/1K。
Codex 是 GitHub Copilot 背后模型,2022-08 Codex 退役,被 GPT-3.5 / GPT-4 取代。
events.source_name: Chen, M. et al. (2021) arXiv:2107.03374; OpenAI Codex API blog
events.summary_en: On August 10, 2021, OpenAI launched the private beta of its Codex API, a code-specialized version of GPT-3 fine-tuned on 159GB of public GitHub code (from its 2021 paper) that supports 12+ languages including Python, JavaScript, Go, and C++. The API endpoint `/v1/completions` (using the code-davinci-001 model) was priced at $0.06/1K tokens. Serving as the underlying model for GitHub Copilot, Codex was retired in August 2022 and replaced by GPT-3.5 and GPT-4.

events.title_zh: InstructGPT 论文:RLHF 路线工业落地
events.title_en: InstructGPT Paper: RLHF Industrialized
events.summary_zh:
2022 年 3 月 4 日,OpenAI 在 arXiv:2203.02155 发表《Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback》。
InstructGPT 用三阶段训练:1) SFT(监督微调,演示数据) 2) RM(奖励模型,偏好数据) 3) PPO(强化学习优化)。
1.3B InstructGPT 输出优于 175B GPT-3,证明 RLHF 比 scaling 更有效。
events.source_name: Ouyang, L. et al. (2022) arXiv:2203.02155; NeurIPS 2022
events.summary_en: On March 4, 2022, OpenAI published "Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback" on arXiv:2203.02155, training InstructGPT via three stages: 1) SFT (supervised fine-tuning, demonstration data), 2) RM (reward model, preference data), and 3) PPO (reinforcement learning optimization). The resulting 1.3B InstructGPT outperformed the 175B GPT-3, proving that RLHF is more effective than scaling.

events.title_zh: LAION-5B:58 亿图文对开源数据集发布
events.title_en: LAION-5B: 5.8B Image-Text Pairs Open Dataset Released
events.summary_zh:
2022 年 3 月 31 日,德国非营利组织 LAION(Large-scale Artificial Intelligence Open Network)在 arXiv:2210.08402 发表 LAION-5B 数据集。
LAION-5B 包含 58.5 亿英文 / 多语种图文对(2.3B 英文 + 2.3B 多语种 + 1.2B 未知语言),240TB 数据,从 Common Crawl 抓取,CLIP 过滤。
LAION-5B 直接训练 Stable Diffusion 1.x / 2.x,是 2022-2024 年开源文生图模型基础。
events.source_name: Schuhmann, C. et al. (2022) arXiv:2210.08402; LAION-5B
events.summary_en: On March 31, 2022, the German non-profit LAION (Large-scale Artificial Intelligence Open Network) published the LAION-5B dataset on arXiv:2210.08402. Scraped from Common Crawl and filtered using CLIP, the 240TB dataset contains 5.85 billion English/multilingual image-text pairs (comprising 2.3B English, 2.3B multilingual, and 1.2B unknown language pairs). LAION-5B directly trained Stable Diffusion 1.x / 2.x, serving as the foundation for open-source text-to-image models from 2022 to 2024.

events.title_zh: Google PaLM 540B:Pathways 大模型训练框架
events.title_en: Google PaLM 540B: Pathways Large Model Training Framework
events.summary_zh:
2022 年 4 月 4 日,Google 在 arXiv:2204.02311 发表《PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways》。
PaLM 540B 用 6144 个 TPU v4 训练,780B token(社交媒体 + 网页 + 代码 + 多语种)。
PaLM 在 BIG-bench 上 144 任务超越人类平均,在多语种、推理、代码任务上达 SOTA。
PaLM 是 Pathways 系统首次大规模应用,支持跨 TPU Pod 训练。
events.source_name: Chowdhery, A. et al. (2022) arXiv:2204.02311; PaLM 540B
events.summary_en: On April 4, 2022, Google published "PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways" on arXiv:2204.02311, detailing PaLM 540B, which was trained on 6144 TPU v4 chips across 780B tokens of social media, web pages, code, and multilingual data. Representing the first large-scale deployment of the Pathways system to support training across TPU Pods, the model achieved SOTA results in multilingual, reasoning, and coding tasks while beating the human average on 144 BIG-bench tasks.

events.title_zh: DeepMind Chinchilla:数据-参数标度律修正
events.title_en: DeepMind Chinchilla: Data-Parameter Scaling Law Correction
events.summary_zh:
2022 年 4 月 12 日,DeepMind 在 arXiv:2203.15556 发表《Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models》。
Chinchilla 70B(70B 参数 + 1.4T token 训练)在 MMLU、BIG-bench、阅读理解上击败 GPT-3 175B(175B 参数 + 300B token)。
Chinchilla 论文核心结论:Kaplan 2020 Scaling Laws 高估参数、低估数据,最优 compute-optimal 训练是「token 数 ≈ 20 × 参数数」。
events.source_name: Hoffmann, J. et al. (2022) arXiv:2203.15556; NeurIPS 2022
events.summary_en: On April 12, 2022, DeepMind published "Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models" on arXiv:2203.15556, demonstrating that Chinchilla 70B (70B parameters + 1.4T tokens training) beat GPT-3 175B (175B parameters + 300B tokens) on MMLU, BIG-bench, and reading comprehension. The paper's core conclusion is that the Kaplan 2020 Scaling Laws overestimated parameters and underestimated data, asserting that compute-optimal training requires "number of tokens ≈ 20 × number of parameters."

events.title_zh: Tri Dao FlashAttention:注意力 IO 优化奠基
events.title_en: Tri Dao FlashAttention: Attention IO Optimization Foundation
events.summary_zh:
2022 年 5 月 27 日,Tri Dao、Daniel Fu 在 arXiv:2205.14135 发表《FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness》(后 NeurIPS 2022 接收)。
FlashAttention 用 tiling + recomputation 优化 GPU SRAM/HBM IO,把 attention 计算从 O(N²) 显存降到 O(N),速度提升 2-4 倍,支持 16K+ 长上下文训练。
FlashAttention 开源后 2023 年成所有 LLM 训练标配。
events.source_name: Dao, T. & Fu, D. (2022) arXiv:2205.14135; NeurIPS 2022
events.summary_en: On May 27, 2022, Tri Dao and Daniel Fu published "FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness" on arXiv (arXiv:2205.14135), which was later accepted by NeurIPS 2022. By optimizing GPU SRAM/HBM IO through tiling and recomputation, FlashAttention slashed attention memory consumption from O(N²) to O(N), delivered a 2- to 4-fold speedup, and enabled 16K+ long-context training. Following its open-source release, FlashAttention became the standard for all LLM training in 2023.

events.title_zh: Midjourney v3 公测:订阅制文生图商业化
events.title_en: Midjourney v3 Beta: Subscription Text-to-Image Commercialization
events.summary_zh:
2022 年 7 月 12 日,David Holz 创立的 Midjourney 推出 v3 公测,通过 Discord 订阅(10/30/60 美元/月)。
Midjourney v3 用 Latent Diffusion + 自有数据集,在艺术风格、人脸、构图上优于 Stable Diffusion 1.x。
2022-08 OpenAI DALL·E 2、Stability SD 1.4、Midjourney v3 三家在 1 个月内集中发布,2022 年成「文生图元年」。
events.source_name: Midjourney (2022-07) v3 beta launch; David Holz interviews
events.summary_en: On July 12, 2022, David Holz’s Midjourney launched its v3 public beta via Discord subscriptions ($10/$30/$60 per month), using Latent Diffusion and a proprietary dataset to outperform Stable Diffusion 1.x in artistic style, faces, and composition. In August 2022, the concentrated release of OpenAI’s DALL·E 2, Stability’s SD 1.4, and Midjourney v3 within a single month cemented 2022 as the inaugural year of text-to-image generation.

events.title_zh: Stability AI Stable Diffusion 1.4:开源文生图爆发
events.title_en: Stability AI Stable Diffusion 1.4: Open Text-to-Image Era Begins
events.summary_zh:
2022 年 8 月 22 日,Stability AI 在 GitHub / HuggingFace 发布 Stable Diffusion 1.4 模型权重(CreativeML Open RAIL-M 许可)。
SD 1.4 用 Latent Diffusion(Rombach 2022 CVPR)+ CLIP text encoder,在 LAION-5B 子集上训练,512×512 图像生成,可在消费级 GPU(8GB VRAM)运行。
SD 1.4 上线 1 周内 HuggingFace 下载超 10 万次,2022-10 SD 1.5 改进版发布。
events.source_name: Rombach, R. et al. (2022) arXiv:2112.10752; Stability AI SD 1.4 release
events.summary_en: On August 22, 2022, Stability AI released the Stable Diffusion 1.4 model weights on GitHub / HuggingFace under the CreativeML Open RAIL-M license. Built on Latent Diffusion (Rombach 2022 CVPR) and a CLIP text encoder, SD 1.4 was trained on a subset of LAION-5B for 512×512 image generation and could run on consumer-grade GPUs with 8GB VRAM. Within one week of its launch, SD 1.4 surpassed 100,000 downloads on HuggingFace, followed by the release of the improved SD 1.5 in October 2022.

events.title_zh: OpenAI Whisper:开源语音识别奠基
events.title_en: OpenAI Whisper: Open-Source Speech Recognition Foundation
events.summary_zh:
2022 年 9 月 21 日,OpenAI 在 arXiv:2212.04356 发表《Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision》。
Whisper 用 68 万小时多语种音频训练(65% 英文 + 17% 非英文 + 18% 翻译对),Encoder-Decoder Transformer,在 0-shot 跨语种语音识别上接近监督 SOTA。
Whisper 模型权重开源( MIT 许可),tiny / base / small / medium / large 5 个版本。
events.source_name: Radford, A. et al. (2022) arXiv:2212.04356; Whisper GitHub
events.summary_en: On September 21, 2022, OpenAI published "Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision" on arXiv:2212.04356. Trained on 680,000 hours of multilingual audio (65% English, 17% non-English, and 18% translation pairs), the Encoder-Decoder Transformer-based Whisper approached supervised SOTA in zero-shot cross-lingual speech recognition. Its model weights were open-sourced under the MIT license in five versions: tiny, base, small, medium, and large.

events.title_zh: LangChain 开源:LLM 应用框架奠基
events.title_en: LangChain Open-Sourced: LLM Application Framework Foundation
events.summary_zh:
2022 年 10 月 20 日,Harrison Chase 在 GitHub 开源 LangChain v0.0.1。
LangChain 提供 Prompt 模板、Memory、Chains、Agents、Tools、VectorStores 抽象,让开发者用 Python / JS 构建端到端 LLM 应用。
LangChain 2023 年成 LLM 应用框架事实标准,2023-07 LangChain + LangSmith + LangServe 三件套,2024 年 ARR 5000 万美元,估值 11 亿美元。
events.source_name: Chase, H. (2022) LangChain v0.0.1 GitHub release
events.summary_en: On October 20, 2022, Harrison Chase open-sourced LangChain v0.0.1 on GitHub, offering abstractions for Prompt templates, Memory, Chains, Agents, Tools, and VectorStores to let developers build end-to-end LLM applications using Python / JS. LangChain became the de facto standard LLM application framework in 2023—introducing its LangChain + LangSmith + LangServe trio in July 2023—before reaching a $50 million ARR and a $1.1 billion valuation in 2024.

events.title_zh: OpenAI ChatGPT:AI 的 iPhone 时刻
events.title_en: OpenAI ChatGPT: AI's iPhone Moment
events.summary_zh:
2022 年 11 月 30 日,OpenAI 在 blog 发布 ChatGPT(chat.openai.com),免费公测。
ChatGPT 基于 GPT-3.5(2020 年 GPT-3 + 2022 年 InstructGPT RLHF 微调),支持多轮对话、上下文记忆、代码生成、写作、翻译。
5 天用户破 100 万(史上最快),2 个月 MAU 1 亿(TikTok 9 个月、Instagram 2.5 年),2023-01 月估值 290 亿美元,2023-04 ChatGPT Plus 上线,2024 年 ARR 超 30 亿美元。
events.source_name: OpenAI (2022-11-30) ChatGPT launch blog
events.summary_en: On November 30, 2022, OpenAI released ChatGPT (chat.openai.com) on its blog for a free public beta. Powered by GPT-3.5 (combining 2020's GPT-3 and 2022's InstructGPT RLHF fine-tuning), the chatbot supports multi-turn conversation, contextual memory, code generation, writing, and translation. It quickly became the fastest-growing service in history, hitting 1 million users in 5 days and 100 million MAUs in 2 months (compared to TikTok's 9 months and Instagram's 2.5 years), leading to a $29 billion valuation in January 2023, the launch of ChatGPT Plus in April 2023, and an ARR exceeding $3 billion by 2024.

events.title_zh: ElevenLabs 推出商业化语音合成
events.title_en: ElevenLabs Commercial Speech Synthesis Launch
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 1 月 23 日,ElevenLabs 公测语音合成平台 Beta。
ElevenLabs 用 60 秒参考音频克隆任意说话人音色,生成接近真人的多语种语音。
2023-01 Beta 上线后,语音合成质量超过 Google Wavenet、Amazon Polly、Microsoft Azure TTS。
ElevenLabs 支持 29 种语言,1 分钟参考音频即可克隆音色,5 分钟参考音频达到声音难以区分。
events.source_name: ElevenLabs (2023-01-23) Beta launch; TechCrunch coverage
events.summary_en: On January 23, 2023, ElevenLabs launched the public beta of its speech synthesis platform, cloning any speaker's voice with just 60 seconds of reference audio to generate near-human, multilingual speech. Following its January 2023 launch, the platform's synthesis quality surpassed Google Wavenet, Amazon Polly, and Microsoft Azure TTS. Supporting 29 languages, ElevenLabs can clone a voice with a 1-minute reference sample, making the voice virtually indistinguishable with 5 minutes of audio.

events.title_zh: 微软 Bing Chat:GPT-4 进入搜索引擎
events.title_en: Microsoft Bing Chat: GPT-4 in Search Engine
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 2 月 7 日,微软在 Redmond 发布 Bing Chat(新版 Bing + Edge),集成 GPT-4(内部代号 Sydney)。
Bing Chat 把 LLM 接入搜索引擎,用户问题先由 LLM 答 + 引用网页,再列出搜索结果。
Bing Chat 上线 48 小时内 waitlist 排到 100 万人,2 个月内 1 亿次对话。
微软 2023-03 把 Bing Chat 嵌入 Windows 11 任务栏,2023-07 改名 Microsoft Copilot。
events.source_name: Microsoft (2023-02-07) Bing Chat launch; The Verge coverage
events.summary_en: On February 7, 2023, Microsoft launched Bing Chat (the new Bing + Edge) in Redmond, integrating GPT-4 (internally codenamed Sydney) to connect an LLM to its search engine so user queries are first answered by the LLM with web citations before search results are listed. The service saw its waitlist swell to 1 million people within 48 hours of launch and reached 100 million conversations within two months. Microsoft embedded Bing Chat into the Windows 11 taskbar in March 2023, before rebranding it as Microsoft Copilot in July 2023.

events.title_zh: Meta LLaMA 泄露:开源大模型起点
events.title_en: Meta LLaMA Leak: Open-Source LLM Beginning
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 2 月 24 日,Meta AI 在 arXiv:2302.13971 发布《LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models》。
LLaMA 包括 7B/13B/33B/65B 四档,训练数据 1.4T tokens(Common Crawl + Wikipedia + Github + Books)。
LLaMA 论文宣称「研究专用」,权重需申请。
但 2023-03-03 权重通过 4chan 泄露到 GitHub,3 天内遍布 BitTorrent。
开源社区立刻基于 LLaMA 衍生:Alpaca(Stanford,$600 微调)、Vicuna(LMSYS)、WizardLM、Guanaco、ChatLLaMA。
events.source_name: Touvron, H. et al. (2023) arXiv:2302.13971; Meta AI blog
events.summary_en: On February 24, 2023, Meta AI published "LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models" on arXiv:2302.13971, featuring 7B/13B/33B/65B models trained on 1.4T tokens (Common Crawl + Wikipedia + GitHub + Books). Although the paper claimed LLaMA was for "research only" with weights requiring an application, the weights were leaked via 4chan to GitHub on March 3, 2023, spreading across BitTorrent within three days. The open-source community immediately began building LLaMA-based derivatives, including Alpaca (Stanford, $600 fine-tuning), Vicuna (LMSYS), WizardLM, Guanaco, and ChatLLaMA.

events.title_zh: OpenAI GPT-4 发布:多模态 + 推理提升
events.title_en: OpenAI GPT-4 Release: Multimodal + Reasoning
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 3 月 14 日,OpenAI 发布 GPT-4(内部代号 GPT-4-base + GPT-4-turbo)。
GPT-4 在 MMLU 86.4%(GPT-3.5 70.0%)、HumanEval 67%、GSM8K 92%。
GPT-4 支持图像输入(GPT-4V),32K 上下文(后续 128K)。
GPT-4 在律师资格考试 BAR 上前 10%,在 SAT 1410/1600,在 AP 考试多门 5 分。
GPT-4 API 2023-03-14 waitlist,2023-07-06 全面开放。
GPT-4 是 2023 年所有前沿模型的基准线。
events.source_name: OpenAI (2023-03-14) GPT-4 Release blog; GPT-4 Technical Report
events.summary_en: On March 14, 2023, OpenAI released GPT-4 (internally codenamed GPT-4-base + GPT-4-turbo), which became the benchmark for all frontier models in 2023. The model featured image input (GPT-4V) and a 32K context window (later 128K), scoring 86.4% on MMLU (vs. GPT-3.5's 70.0%), 67% on HumanEval, and 92% on GSM8K, while placing in the top 10% on the BAR, scoring 1410/1600 on the SAT, and earning a 5 on multiple AP exams. Its API launched with a waitlist on March 14, 2023, and was fully opened on July 6, 2023.

events.title_zh: Anthropic Claude 1 发布:Anthropic 商业化起点
events.title_en: Anthropic Claude 1 Launch: Anthropic Commercialization Begins
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 3 月 14 日,Anthropic 发布 Claude 1(同年 GPT-4 同日发布)。
Claude 1 上下文 9K,在 Cohere 多项任务上接近 GPT-3.5。
Claude 1 强调 Constitutional AI(AI 通过「宪法」原则自我修正),避免 GPT 的 RLHF 失控。
Claude 1 商用 API 2023-03-14,2023-07-11 Claude 2(100K 上下文,首次突破 LLM 上下文上限)。
Claude 路线:Claude 1(2023-03) → Claude 2(2023-07) → Claude Instant(2023-08) → Claude 3(2024-03) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet(2024-06) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2(2024-10) → Claude 3.7 Sonnet(2025-02) → Claude 4 Opus(2025-05)。
events.source_name: Anthropic (2023-03-14) Claude launch; Constitutional AI paper
events.summary_en: On March 14, 2023, Anthropic released Claude 1 (the same day GPT-4 debuted), featuring a 9K context window, approaching GPT-3.5 on multiple Cohere tasks, and emphasizing "Constitutional AI" (AI self-correction via "constitutional" principles) to avoid GPT's runaway RLHF issues. Following its commercial API launch on 2023-03-14, Claude 2 arrived on 2023-07-11 with a 100K context window, breaking the LLM context limit for the first time. This established Anthropic’s product roadmap: Claude 1 (2023-03) → Claude 2 (2023-07) → Claude Instant (2023-08) → Claude 3 (2024-03) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet (2024-06) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2 (2024-10) → Claude 3.7 Sonnet (2025-02) → Claude 4 Opus (2025-05).

events.title_zh: GPT-4 系统卡:前沿模型透明度范式
events.title_en: GPT-4 System Card: Frontier Model Transparency Paradigm
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 3 月 14 日,OpenAI 与 GPT-4 同步发布《GPT-4 System Card》(60 页)。
System Card 详述 GPT-4 的预训练、RLHF、红队测试、危险能力评估(生化武器、网络攻击、社会工程、自主复制)。
System Card 把「前沿模型透明度」变成行业标准,后续 Claude 3、Gemini 1.5、Llama 3、DeepSeek-R1 都发布 System Card。
events.source_name: OpenAI (2023-03-14) GPT-4 System Card
events.summary_en: On March 14, 2023, OpenAI launched its 60-page *GPT-4 System Card* alongside the model's debut, detailing its pre-training, RLHF, red teaming, and evaluations of dangerous capabilities like biological weapons, cyberattacks, social engineering, and autonomous replication. The document effectively turned "frontier model transparency" into an industry standard, with Claude 3, Gemini 1.5, Llama 3, and DeepSeek-R1 all following suit with their own System Cards.

events.title_zh: 百度文心一言:中国大模型产品化第一波
events.title_en: Baidu ERNIE Bot: China's First Wave of LLM Products
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 3 月 16 日,百度在北京总部发布文心一言(ERNIE Bot)。
文心一言基于 ERNIE 3.0+,支持文本、图像、代码生成。
文心一言发布演示为「录播」(预录视频),Robin Li 解释「出于安全考虑」。
文心一言 2023-08-31 公测,2023 年底 MAU 1.3 亿。
文心一言后,2023-03-阿里通义千问、2023-08-华为盘古、2023-10-讯飞星火、2023-10-智谱 ChatGLM 接连发布。
events.source_name: 百度 (2023-03-16) 文心一言发布会
events.summary_en: On March 16, 2023, Baidu unveiled ERNIE Bot—an ERNIE 3.0+-based model supporting text, image, and code generation—at its Beijing headquarters, opting for a pre-recorded demonstration that Robin Li explained was "for safety reasons." Following ERNIE Bot’s debut, a wave of competitors rolled out, including Alibaba’s Tongyi Qianwen in March 2023, Huawei’s Pangu in August 2023, and both iFlytek’s Spark and Zhipu AI’s ChatGLM in October 2023; ERNIE Bot itself entered public testing on August 31, 2023, reaching an MAU of 130 million by the end of the year.

events.title_zh: OpenAI Evals 开源:LLM 评测框架标准化
events.title_en: OpenAI Evals Open-Sourced: LLM Evaluation Framework Standardization
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 3 月 23 日,OpenAI 在 GitHub 开源 Evals(框架用于评估 LLM)。
Evals 定义标准化评测协议:任务定义、prompt、参考答案、评分函数、数据集。
Evals 内置 MMLU、HellaSwag、GSM8K、HumanEval、TruthfulQA 等。
Evals 开源后 lm-evaluation-harness(EleutherAI)、lighteval(HuggingFace)、OpenCompass(上海AI实验室) 都基于其协议。
events.source_name: OpenAI (2023-03-23) Evals GitHub
events.summary_en: On March 23, 2023, OpenAI open-sourced Evals on GitHub, a framework for evaluating LLMs that defines a standardized protocol covering task definitions, prompts, reference answers, grading functions, and datasets. Featuring built-in benchmarks including MMLU, HellaSwag, GSM8K, HumanEval, and TruthfulQA, the release prompted EleutherAI's lm-evaluation-harness, HuggingFace's lighteval, and the Shanghai AI Laboratory's OpenCompass to base their own protocols on it.

events.title_zh: AutoGPT 引爆自主 Agent 开源热潮
events.title_en: AutoGPT Sparks Open-Source Autonomous Agent Trend
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 3 月 30 日,开发者 Toran Bruce Richards 在 GitHub 开源 AutoGPT。
AutoGPT 用 GPT-4 + Pinecone 做「目标驱动自主 Agent」:用户输入目标(如「研究并写一份量子计算报告」),AutoGPT 自动拆解、调用搜索、保存到 Pinecone、迭代生成。
AutoGPT 上线 7 天 GitHub stars 破 5 万,30 天破 10 万,2023 年 GitHub 第一热门仓库。
events.source_name: Richards, T. B. (2023-03-30) AutoGPT GitHub
events.summary_en: On March 30, 2023, developer Toran Bruce Richards open-sourced AutoGPT on GitHub. Utilizing GPT-4 and Pinecone to power a "goal-driven autonomous agent," the system takes a user-input goal (such as "research and write a report on quantum computing") and automatically breaks it down, executes searches, saves to Pinecone, and iteratively generates the output. AutoGPT surpassed 50,000 GitHub stars within 7 days of launch and topped 100,000 within 30 days, becoming the most popular repository on GitHub in 2023.

events.title_zh: DPO 论文:RLHF 替代方案
events.title_en: DPO Paper: RLHF Alternative
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 5 月 26 日,斯坦福 + CMU + Berkeley 在 arXiv:2305.18290 发表《Direct Preference Optimization》。
DPO 把 RLHF 从「训练 reward model + PPO 强化学习」简化为「直接用偏好数据微调 LLM」一步。
DPO 训练成本是 PPO 的 1/10,稳定性更高,质量接近。
DPO 后被 Llama 2 Chat、Mistral Instruct、Zephyr、Qwen 2 Instruct、DeepSeek-R1 全部采用。
events.source_name: Rafailov, R. et al. (2023) arXiv:2305.18290; NeurIPS 2023
events.summary_en: On May 26, 2023, Stanford, CMU, and Berkeley published "Direct Preference Optimization" on arXiv:2305.18290, simplifying RLHF from training a reward model and PPO reinforcement learning into a single step of directly fine-tuning the LLM with preference data. At just 1/10 the training cost of PPO, DPO offers higher stability and comparable quality. The breakthrough was later adopted by Llama 2 Chat, Mistral Instruct, Zephyr, Qwen 2 Instruct, and DeepSeek-R1.

events.title_zh: Meta Llama 2 商用开源:开源 LLM 商业化起点
events.title_en: Meta Llama 2 Commercial Open-Source: Open-Source LLM Commercialization Begins
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 7 月 18 日,Meta 在 arXiv:2307.09288 发布《Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models》。
Llama 2 包括 7B/13B/70B,4K 上下文,商用许可(月活 7 亿以下免费)。
Llama 2-Chat 用 RLHF + Safety RLHF + Red Teaming 训练。
Llama 2 上线 1 周下载量 100 万次,3 个月内 AWS、Azure、Google Cloud、AWS Bedrock 全部上架。
events.source_name: Touvron, H. et al. (2023) arXiv:2307.09288; Meta blog
events.summary_en: On July 18, 2023, Meta published "Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models" on arXiv:2307.09288, offering 7B/13B/70B models with a 4K context window under a commercial license free for under 700 million monthly active users. Its dialogue-tuned counterpart, Llama 2-Chat, was trained using RLHF, Safety RLHF, and red teaming. Llama 2 racked up 1 million downloads in its first week of launch and was deployed on AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and AWS Bedrock within three months.

events.title_zh: 阿里通义千问开源:中国开源 LLM 旗舰起点
events.title_en: Alibaba Qwen Open-Source: China's Open-Source LLM Flagship Begins
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 8 月 3 日,阿里云发布通义千问 Qwen-7B(2023-09-25 开源)。
Qwen-7B 在 C-Eval、MMLU、HumanEval 多项中文评测上超过 Llama 2 7B。
Qwen 后续路线:Qwen-7B(2023-08) → Qwen-14B(2023-09) → Qwen-72B(2023-12) → Qwen 1.5(2024-02) → Qwen 2(2024-06) → Qwen 2.5(2024-09) → Qwen 3(2025-04)。
events.source_name: Bai, J. et al. (2023) Qwen Technical Report; arXiv:2309.16609
events.summary_en: On August 3, 2023, Alibaba Cloud released Tongyi Qianwen Qwen-7B (open-sourced on September 25, 2023), which outperformed Llama 2 7B on multiple Chinese benchmarks including C-Eval, MMLU, and HumanEval. The subsequent Qwen roadmap progressed as follows: Qwen-7B (2023-08) → Qwen-14B (2023-09) → Qwen-72B (2023-12) → Qwen 1.5 (2024-02) → Qwen 2 (2024-06) → Qwen 2.5 (2024-09) → Qwen 3 (2025-04).

events.title_zh: Meta Code Llama:开源代码 LLM 起步
events.title_en: Meta Code Llama: Open-Source Code LLM Begins
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 8 月 24 日,Meta 在 arXiv:2308.12950 发布《Code Llama》。
Code Llama 基于 Llama 2 用 500B code tokens 微调,包括 7B/13B/34B 三档 + Code Llama-Python 专门版 + Code Llama-Instruct。
Code Llama 34B 在 HumanEval 53.7%,超过 GPT-3.5(48.1%)。
Code Llama 用 Apache 2.0 + Llama 2 商用许可开源。
events.source_name: Rozière, B. et al. (2023) arXiv:2308.12950; Meta blog
events.summary_en: On August 24, 2023, Meta released "Code Llama" on arXiv:2308.12950, introducing a family of models fine-tuned from Llama 2 on 500B code tokens. The release spans 7B, 13B, and 34B sizes—along with specialized Code Llama-Python and Code Llama-Instruct versions—with Code Llama 34B scoring 53.7% on HumanEval to beat GPT-3.5's 48.1%. Code Llama is open-sourced under the Apache 2.0 and Llama 2 commercial licenses.

events.title_zh: ChatGPT 语音 + 视觉:多模态 LLM 落地
events.title_en: ChatGPT Voice + Vision: Multimodal LLM Goes Live
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 9 月 25 日,OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 上线 Voice(语音对话) + Vision(图像理解)。
Voice 用 Whisper + 自己的 TTS,接近真人对话延迟。
Vision 用 GPT-4V,支持用户上传图片提问。
ChatGPT Voice + Vision 让 ChatGPT 从「文本对话」走向「多模态助手」,直接催生 2024 年 GPT-4o(实时多模态)。
events.source_name: OpenAI (2023-09-25) ChatGPT Voice + Vision blog
events.summary_en: On September 25, 2023, OpenAI rolled out Voice and Vision for ChatGPT: Voice paired Whisper with proprietary TTS for near-human conversational latency, while Vision used GPT-4V to let users upload images and ask questions. Evolving ChatGPT from a text chatbot into a multimodal assistant, this update directly spawned the real-time multimodal GPT-4o in 2024.

events.title_zh: Mistral 7B 发布:欧洲开源大模型旗舰起点
events.title_en: Mistral 7B Release: European Open LLM Flagship
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 9 月 27 日,Mistral AI 在 arXiv:2310.06825 发布《Mistral 7B》。
Mistral 7B 用 7.3B 参数在所有评测上超过 Llama 2 13B,代码任务上超过 Llama 2 34B。
关键创新:Grouped Query Attention(GQA)、Sliding Window Attention(SWA,4096)、Rolling Buffer Cache。
Mistral 7B 用 Apache 2.0 许可开源权重,首次让欧洲团队进入全球开源 LLM 第一梯队。
events.source_name: Jiang, A. Q. et al. (2023) arXiv:2310.06825; Mistral AI blog
events.summary_en: On September 27, 2023, Mistral AI released "Mistral 7B" on arXiv:2310.06825, presenting a 7.3B-parameter model that outperformed Llama 2 13B on all benchmarks and beat Llama 2 34B on coding tasks. Built on key innovations like Grouped Query Attention (GQA), Sliding Window Attention (SWA, 4096), and Rolling Buffer Cache, the model open-sourced its weights under the Apache 2.0 license, marking the first time a European team entered the top tier of global open-source LLMs.

events.title_zh: OpenAI DevDay:GPTs + Assistants API + GPT-4 Turbo
events.title_en: OpenAI DevDay: GPTs + Assistants API + GPT-4 Turbo
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 11 月 6 日,OpenAI 在 San Francisco 举办首届 DevDay。
发布:1) GPT-4 Turbo(128K 上下文,知识截至 2023-04,价格降 2.7 倍);2) GPTs(用户可视化搭建 GPT,无需代码);3) Assistants API(状态管理 + 工具调用 + 代码解释器 + 检索);4) DALL·E 3 API;5) Whisper v3;6) Custom Models 计划;7) 版权保护 Copyright Shield。
GPT Store 2024-01 上线。
events.source_name: OpenAI (2023-11-06) DevDay keynote
events.summary_en: At its inaugural DevDay in San Francisco on November 6, 2023, OpenAI debuted GPT-4 Turbo, boasting a 128K context window, knowledge cutoff of April 2023, and a 2.7x price reduction. The company also unveiled no-code GPTs for visual bot-building, the Assistants API (featuring state management, tool calling, a code interpreter, and retrieval), the DALL·E 3 API, Whisper v3, the Custom Models program, and Copyright Shield protection. Finally, OpenAI announced that the GPT Store would launch in January 2024.

events.title_zh: Google Gemini 1.0:原生多模态 LLM
events.title_en: Google Gemini 1.0: Native Multimodal LLM
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 12 月 6 日,Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini 1.0(Ultra/Pro/Nano 三档)。
Gemini 是首个原生多模态 LLM(图像/音频/视频/文本统一编码),非拼接。
Gemini Ultra 在 MMLU 90.0%(GPT-4 86.4%),首次反超 GPT-4。
Gemini Pro 集成到 Bard、Pixel 8 Pro、Google Search。
Gemini Nano 在 Pixel 8 Pro 本地运行。
events.source_name: Google DeepMind (2023-12-06) Gemini 1.0 blog; Technical Report
events.summary_en: On December 6, 2023, Google DeepMind launched Gemini 1.0 in three tiers (Ultra, Pro, and Nano) as the first natively multimodal LLM featuring unified encoding of image, audio, video, and text instead of a stitched-together system. Gemini Ultra scored 90.0% on MMLU, surpassing GPT-4 (86.4%) for the first time. While Gemini Pro was integrated into Bard, Pixel 8 Pro, and Google Search, Gemini Nano runs locally on the Pixel 8 Pro.

events.title_zh: Google Imagen 2:Google 文生图升级
events.title_en: Google Imagen 2: Google Text-to-Image Upgrade
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 12 月 7 日,Google DeepMind 在 Vertex AI 发布 Imagen 2。
Imagen 2 用扩散模型 + 文本理解 + RLHF,在图像质量、文字渲染、人脸生成上超过 Imagen 1。
Imagen 2 集成到 Bard、Google Slides、Google Ads。
Imagen 2 不开源权重,只 API。
events.source_name: Google DeepMind (2023-12-07) Imagen 2 blog
events.summary_en: On December 7, 2023, Google DeepMind launched Imagen 2 on Vertex AI, utilizing diffusion models, text understanding, and RLHF to outperform Imagen 1 in image quality, text rendering, and face generation. Now integrated into Bard, Google Slides, and Google Ads, the model's weights remain closed-source, with access offered only via API.

events.title_zh: Mixtral 8x7B:开源 MoE LLM 起步
events.title_en: Mixtral 8x7B: Open-Source MoE LLM Begins
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 12 月 11 日,Mistral AI 在 arXiv:2401.04088 发布《Mixtral of Experts》。
Mixtral 8x7B 用 8 个专家(expert),每 token 路由到 2 个专家,总参 46.7B、激活 12.9B。
Mixtral 8x7B 在多数评测上超过 Llama 2 70B,GPT-3.5。
Mixtral 8x7B 用 Apache 2.0 商用开源。
Mixtral 路线:Mixtral 8x7B(2023-12) → Mixtral 8x7B Instruct(2023-12) → Mixtral 8x22B(2024-04) → Mistral Large 2(2024-07)。
events.source_name: Jiang, A. Q. et al. (2023) arXiv:2401.04088; Mistral blog
events.summary_en: On December 11, 2023, Mistral AI published "Mixtral of Experts" on arXiv:2401.04088, detailing Mixtral 8x7B, a model utilizing 8 experts (routing 2 per token) with 46.7B total and 12.9B active parameters. Commercially open-sourced under the Apache 2.0 license, it outperformed Llama 2 70B and GPT-3.5 on most benchmarks, paving the way for a roadmap that evolved from Mixtral 8x7B (2023-12) and Mixtral 8x7B Instruct (2023-12) to Mixtral 8x22B (2024-04) and Mistral Large 2 (2024-07).

events.title_zh: OpenAI Sora 公布:视频生成里程碑
events.title_en: OpenAI Sora Reveal: Video Generation Milestone
events.summary_zh:
2024 年 2 月 15 日,OpenAI 公布 Sora(text-to-video 模型,最长 60 秒)。
Sora 用 DiT(Diffusion Transformer)架构,把视频生成从「U-Net 扩散」推向「Transformer 扩散」。
Sora 演示视频质量震惊业界,但 OpenAI 未开源 + 延迟发布。
Sora 2024-12 才开放给 ChatGPT Plus 用户,2024-12-09 Sora 2 发布。
events.source_name: OpenAI (2024-02-15) Sora reveal; Brooks-Peebles DiT paper
events.summary_en: On February 15, 2024, OpenAI unveiled Sora, a text-to-video model capable of generating clips up to 60 seconds long. Utilizing a DiT (Diffusion Transformer) architecture, Sora pushed video generation from "U-Net diffusion" to "Transformer diffusion." Although its stunning demo quality shocked the industry, OpenAI kept the model closed-source and delayed its release, only opening it to ChatGPT Plus users in December 2024, followed by the launch of Sora 2 on December 9, 2024.

events.title_zh: Anthropic Claude 3 发布:首次反超 GPT-4
events.title_en: Anthropic Claude 3: First to Surpass GPT-4
events.summary_zh:
2024 年 3 月 4 日,Anthropic 发布 Claude 3(Haiku/Sonnet/Opus 三档)。
Claude 3 Opus 在 MMLU 86.8%(GPT-4 86.4%),首次反超 GPT-4。
Claude 3 Opus 200K 上下文,vision 多模态。
Claude 3 Sonnet 速度更快,价格更低,实际生产部署最多。
Claude 3 路线:Claude 3(2024-03) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet(2024-06-20) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2(2024-10-22) → Claude 3.7 Sonnet(2025-02-24) → Claude 4 Opus(2025-05-22)。
events.source_name: Anthropic (2024-03-04) Claude 3 launch; Model Card
events.summary_en: On March 4, 2024, Anthropic released its Claude 3 family—spanning the Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus tiers—with the flagship Claude 3 Opus scoring 86.8% on the MMLU to edge out GPT-4 (86.4%) for the first time. While the multimodal, vision-capable Opus boasted a 200K context window, the faster and cheaper Sonnet saw the most actual production deployments. This launched a rapid release cycle: Claude 3 (2024-03) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet (2024-06-20) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2 (2024-10-22) → Claude 3.7 Sonnet (2025-02-24) → Claude 4 Opus (2025-05-22).

events.title_zh: 欧盟 AI Act 通过:全球首部 AI 监管法
events.title_en: EU AI Act Passed: World's First AI Regulation Law
events.summary_zh:
2024 年 3 月 13 日,欧洲议会通过《AI Act》。
AI Act 按风险分四档:不可接受(禁)、高风险(限)、有限风险(透明)、最小风险(自由)。
AI Act 对 General Purpose AI(GPAI) + Systemic Risk LLM(>=10^25 FLOPS) 设特殊义务:模型卡、版权披露、红队测试、严重事件报告。
AI Act 2024-08-01 生效,2026-08 全面执行,违规罚 3500 万欧元或营收 7%。
events.source_name: European Parliament (2024-03-13) AI Act adoption; Official Journal
events.summary_en: On March 13, 2024, the European Parliament passed the AI Act, which categorizes AI into four risk tiers: unacceptable (banned), high risk (restricted), limited risk (transparency), and minimal risk (free). The Act imposes special obligations on General Purpose AI (GPAI) and Systemic Risk LLM (>=10^25 FLOPS), requiring model cards, copyright disclosures, red-teaming, and serious incident reporting. Taking effect on August 1, 2024, and entering full enforcement by August 2026, the Act penalizes violations with fines of 35 million euros or 7% of revenue.

events.title_zh: Meta Llama 3 发布:开源 LLM 跨过 GPT-3.5
events.title_en: Meta Llama 3 Release: Open-Source LLM Crosses GPT-3.5
events.summary_zh:
2024 年 4 月 18 日,Meta 发布 Llama 3(8B/70B)。
Llama 3 用 15T tokens 训练(比 Llama 2 多 7 倍),8K 上下文。
Llama 3 70B 在 MMLU 82.0%(GPT-4 86.4%),Llama 3 8B 在多数任务上超过 Llama 2 70B。
Llama 3 Instruct 用 SFT + DPO + RLHF 训练。
Llama 3 路线:Llama 3 8B/70B(2024-04) → Llama 3.1 405B(2024-07-23,首个 405B 开源) → Llama 3.2 1B/3B(2024-09,边缘) → Llama 3.3 70B(2024-12) → Llama 4(2025-04-05)。
events.source_name: Meta (2024-04-18) Llama 3 release; Meta AI blog
events.summary_en: On April 18, 2024, Meta launched Llama 3 (8B/70B)—trained on 15T tokens (7x more than Llama 2) with an 8K context window—employing SFT, DPO, and RLHF for its Instruct version. While Llama 3 70B hit 82.0% on MMLU (against GPT-4's 86.4%) and the 8B model beat Llama 2 70B on most tasks, it also kicked off an ambitious roadmap: Llama 3 8B/70B (2024-04) → Llama 3.1 405B (2024-07-23, the first open-source 405B) → Llama 3.2 1B/3B (2024-09, edge) → Llama 3.3 70B (2024-12) → Llama 4 (2025-04-05).

events.title_zh: DeepSeek-V2:中国开源 MoE + API 价格战起点
events.title_en: DeepSeek-V2: China's Open-Source MoE + API Price War Begins
events.summary_zh:
2024 年 5 月 7 日,DeepSeek 在 arXiv:2405.04434 发布《DeepSeek-V2: A Strong, Economical, and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Language Model》。
DeepSeek-V2 用 236B 总参、21B 激活的 MoE,创新 MLA(Multi-Head Latent Attention) + DeepSeekMoE。
DeepSeek-V2 API 价格 ¥1/1M input(同档 Llama 3 70B 的 1/100),直接引爆中国 LLM 价格战。
events.source_name: DeepSeek-AI (2024) arXiv:2405.04434; DeepSeek blog
events.summary_en: On May 7, 2024, DeepSeek published "DeepSeek-V2: A Strong, Economical, and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Language Model" on arXiv:2405.04434, introducing an MoE model with 236B total and 21B active parameters that features innovative MLA (Multi-Head Latent Attention) and DeepSeekMoE architectures. Priced at just ¥1/1M input—1/100 of the cost of the comparable Llama 3 70B—the DeepSeek-V2 API instantly ignited a price war in the Chinese LLM market.

events.title_zh: GPT-4o:实时多模态 LLM 起点
events.title_en: GPT-4o: Real-Time Multimodal LLM Begins
events.summary_zh:
2024 年 5 月 13 日,OpenAI 发布 GPT-4o(omni)。
GPT-4o 是首个原生多模态 LLM(文本+图像+音频统一编码),语音对话延迟 232ms(接近人类 200ms)。
GPT-4o 在 MMLU 88.7%(超过 GPT-4 Turbo 86.5%)。
GPT-4o 免费向所有 ChatGPT 用户开放,Plus 5 倍额度。
GPT-4o API 价格降 50%($5/1M input)。
events.source_name: OpenAI (2024-05-13) GPT-4o launch; System Card
events.summary_en: On May 13, 2024, OpenAI released GPT-4o (omni), the first native multimodal LLM featuring unified encoding for text, images, and audio, boasting a voice conversation latency of 232ms (nearing the human rate of 200ms). Scoring 88.7% on the MMLU to surpass GPT-4 Turbo's 86.5%, the model is available for free to all ChatGPT users, with Plus users receiving 5 times the limit. Additionally, the GPT-4o API price has been cut by 50% ($5/1M input).

events.title_zh: Claude 3.5 Sonnet:开源编程模型新基准
events.title_en: Claude 3.5 Sonnet: New Benchmark for Coding
events.summary_zh:
2024 年 6 月 20 日,Anthropic 发布 Claude 3.5 Sonnet。
Claude 3.5 Sonnet 在编程(HumanEval 92.0%)、推理(GPQA 59.4%)、视觉(文档理解)上全面超越 GPT-4o。
Claude 3.5 Sonnet 价格是 GPT-4o 的 1/5。
Claude 3.5 Sonnet 推出 Artifacts(代码 + 文档实时渲染)。
events.source_name: Anthropic (2024-06-20) Claude 3.5 Sonnet launch
events.summary_en: On June 20, 2024, Anthropic released Claude 3.5 Sonnet, which outperforms GPT-4o in coding (HumanEval 92.0%), reasoning (GPQA 59.4%), and vision (document understanding) at one-fifth the price of GPT-4o. The release also introduces Artifacts, a feature enabling the real-time rendering of code and documents.

events.title_zh: Meta Llama 3.1 405B:首个 405B 开源模型
events.title_en: Meta Llama 3.1 405B: First 405B Open-Source Model
events.summary_zh:
2024 年 7 月 23 日,Meta 发布 Llama 3.1(8B/70B/405B 三档)。
Llama 3.1 405B 是首个 405B 开源模型,在 MMLU 88.6%(超过 GPT-4o 88.7%)、GSM8K 96.8%。
Llama 3.1 405B 训练用 16K H100,54 天,15T tokens,成本约 6.5 亿美元。
Llama 3.1 把上下文从 8K 扩到 128K,工具调用 + 多语言(8 种)强化。
events.source_name: Meta (2024-07-23) Llama 3.1 release; arXiv:2407.21783
events.summary_en: On July 23, 2024, Meta released Llama 3.1 in three sizes (8B/70B/405B), featuring the first-ever 405B open-source model, which scored 88.6% on MMLU (surpassing GPT-4o's 88.7%) and 96.8% on GSM8K. Training the 405B model required 16K H100 GPUs, 54 days, and 15T tokens, costing approximately $650 million. Llama 3.1 expands the context window from 8K to 128K and features enhanced tool use and multilingual support across 8 languages.

events.title_zh: OpenAI o1:推理模型时代起点
events.title_en: OpenAI o1: Reasoning Model Era Begins
events.summary_zh:
2024 年 9 月 12 日,OpenAI 发布 o1-preview + o1-mini。
o1 用 RL + Chain-of-Thought 训练,在数学(AIME 83.3%,GPT-4o 13.4%)、编程(Codeforces 89%)、博士级科学(GPQA 78%) 上大幅超越 GPT-4o。
o1 推理时输出长 CoT(几千-几万 token),延迟从 GPT-4o 1 秒到 o1 10-30 秒。
events.source_name: OpenAI (2024-09-12) o1 launch; Learning to Reason blog
events.summary_en: On September 12, 2024, OpenAI released o1-preview and o1-mini. Trained using reinforcement learning and Chain-of-Thought, o1 dramatically outperforms GPT-4o in mathematics (scoring 83.3% on AIME compared to GPT-4o's 13.4%), coding (89% on Codeforces), and PhD-level science (78% on GPQA). During inference, o1 generates a long Chain-of-Thought spanning thousands to tens of thousands of tokens, which increases latency from GPT-4o's 1 second to 10-30 seconds for o1.

events.title_zh: Hassabis 与 Jumper 获诺贝尔化学奖:AI for Science 里程碑
events.title_en: Hassabis & Jumper Nobel Chemistry Prize: AI for Science Milestone
events.summary_zh:
2024 年 10 月 9 日,诺贝尔化学奖一半授予 Demis Hassabis 和 John Jumper(AlphaFold),另一半授予 David Baker(蛋白质设计)。
AlphaFold 2(2020-11) 解决蛋白质结构预测 50 年难题,AlphaFold 3(2024-05-08) 扩展到 DNA/RNA/配体。
Hassabis 是首位获诺贝尔奖的 AI 公司 CEO。
events.source_name: Nobel Prize (2024-10-09) Chemistry announcement; DeepMind AlphaFold
events.summary_en: On October 9, 2024, the Nobel Prize in Chemistry was awarded, with one half going to David Baker for protein design, and the other half to Demis Hassabis and John Jumper for AlphaFold, making Hassabis the first AI company CEO to win a Nobel Prize. AlphaFold 2 (2020-11) solved a 50-year challenge in protein structure prediction, while AlphaFold 3 (2024-05-08) expanded the model's capabilities to DNA, RNA, and ligands.

events.title_zh: Claude Computer Use:LLM 直接操作电脑
events.title_en: Claude Computer Use: LLM Directly Operates Computer
events.summary_zh:
2024 年 10 月 22 日,Anthropic 在 Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2 同步推出 Computer Use API(beta)。
Claude Computer Use 让 LLM 通过截图 + 鼠标键盘控制直接操作电脑(浏览器、终端、文件)。
Claude Computer Use 是首个商用 Computer Use Agent,定义 2024-2025 年「GUI Agent」方向。
events.source_name: Anthropic (2024-10-22) Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2 + Computer Use
events.summary_en: On October 22, 2024, Anthropic launched the Computer Use API (beta) alongside Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2. Claude Computer Use allows LLMs to directly operate computers (browsers, terminals, files) via screenshots and mouse/keyboard control. As the first commercial Computer Use Agent, it defines the direction of "GUI Agents" for 2024-2025.
