events.title_zh: NVIDIA H100:前沿大模型训练主力 GPU
events.title_en: NVIDIA H100: Main GPU for Frontier LLM Training
events.summary_zh:
2024 年,NVIDIA H100 Hopper GPU 成前沿大模型训练主力。
H100 2022-03 GTC 发布,2023-03 出货,2024 年成为 OpenAI GPT-4o、Anthropic Claude 3、Google Gemini 1.5、Meta Llama 3.1 405B、xAI Grok 2 的训练主力。
H100 FP16 算力 1979 TFLOPS(A100 312 TFLOPS 6.3 倍)、HBM3 80GB、3.2TB/s 带宽。
H100 集群最大规模:xAI Colossus 10 万张 H100(2024-09)、Meta 6 万张、Google TPU v5p 8912 块等效。
events.source_name: NVIDIA (2022-03-22) H100 Hopper announcement; 2024 Q4 earnings
events.summary_en: Announced at GTC in March 2022 and shipped in March 2023, the NVIDIA H100 Hopper GPU became the dominant workhorse for training frontier AI in 2024, powering OpenAI’s GPT-4o, Anthropic’s Claude 3, Google’s Gemini 1.5, Meta’s Llama 3.1 405B, and xAI’s Grok 2. The silicon boasts 1,979 TFLOPS of FP16 compute (6.3 times the A100’s 312 TFLOPS), 80GB of HBM3 memory, and 3.2TB/s of bandwidth. The largest H100 clusters reached massive scales, led by xAI’s Colossus with 100,000 H100s in September 2024, Meta with 60,000, and Google’s equivalent deployment of 8,912 TPU v5p chips.

events.title_zh: 小模型蒸馏兴起:7B 反超 GPT-3.5 时代
events.title_en: Small Model Distillation: 7B Beats GPT-3.5 Era
events.summary_zh:
2024 年,7B-14B 小模型通过蒸馏 + DPO 在多项任务上反超 GPT-3.5。
代表:Phi-3 mini 3.8B(Microsoft,2024-04)、Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct(2024-09)、Llama 3.2 1B/3B(2024-09)、Mistral NeMo 12B(2024-07)、Gemma 2 2B/9B/27B(Google,2024-06)。
这些模型可在手机、笔记本、边缘设备本地运行,质量超过 2023 年 GPT-3.5。
events.source_name: Microsoft Phi-3 (2024-04); Meta Llama 3.2 (2024-09); Apple Intelligence (2024-06)
events.summary_en: In 2024, small 7B-14B models leveraged distillation + DPO to surpass GPT-3.5 on multiple tasks, led by Microsoft's Phi-3 mini 3.8B (2024-04), Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct (2024-09), Llama 3.2 1B/3B (2024-09), Mistral NeMo 12B (2024-07), and Google's Gemma 2 2B/9B/27B (2024-06). Capable of running locally on phones, laptops, and edge devices, these models exceeded the quality of 2023's GPT-3.5.

events.title_zh: 长上下文竞争:1M token 时代
events.title_en: Long Context Race: 1M Token Era
events.summary_zh:
2024 年,LLM 上下文从 32K 突破到 1M-2M。
代表:Gemini 1.5 Pro(2024-02,1M,后 2M)、Claude 3(2024-03,200K)、GPT-4 Turbo(2023-11,128K)、Llama 3.1 405B(2024-07,128K)、Qwen 2.5(2024-09,128K)。
长上下文让 LLM 一次性处理整本书、整个代码仓库、1 小时视频。
events.source_name: Google Gemini 1.5 (2024-02); Anthropic Claude 3 (2024-03)
events.summary_en: In 2024, LLM context windows surged from 32K to 1M-2M, headlined by Gemini 1.5 Pro (2024-02, 1M, later 2M), Claude 3 (2024-03, 200K), GPT-4 Turbo (2023-11, 128K), Llama 3.1 405B (2024-07, 128K), and Qwen 2.5 (2024-09, 128K). These massive context windows allow LLMs to process an entire book, a whole codebase, or 1 hour of video all at once.

events.title_zh: AI Factory 叙事成型:超大规模训练集群时代
events.title_en: AI Factory Narrative Forms: Massive Training Cluster Era
events.summary_zh:
2024-2025 年,AI Factory 叙事成型。
AI Factory 指 10 万+ GPU 量级 + 数据中心 + 能源 + 散热的「LLM 工厂」。
代表:xAI Colossus(10 万 H100,2024-09 建成,122 天)、Meta 6 万 H100、Microsoft + OpenAI 5 个 AI Factory、Amazon Trainium 2、Google TPU v5p Trillium、字节豆包 8 万 H100。
events.source_name: NVIDIA (2024-08) SIGGRAPH AI Factory; xAI Colossus (2024-09)
events.summary_en: During 2024–2025, the narrative of the "AI Factory" took shape, defined as LLM "factories" integrating 100,000+ GPUs with data centers, power, and cooling. Key examples include xAI Colossus (100,000 H100s, completed in September 2024 in 122 days), Meta's 60,000 H100s, Microsoft + OpenAI's 5 AI Factories, Amazon Trainium 2, Google TPU v5p Trillium, and ByteDance Doubao's 80,000 H100s.

events.title_zh: AI 办公全面嵌入
events.title_en: AI Embedded in Productivity Tools
events.summary_zh:
AI 助手全面嵌入搜索、办公、编程、设计与客服产品。
AI 不再只作为独立应用等用户打开，而是进入文档、邮件、会议、代码仓库、设计工具和客服系统。
用户开始在原来的工作流里遇到 AI。
events.source_name: General official product histories
events.summary_en: AI assistants have become deeply integrated across search, productivity, coding, design, and customer service products. No longer just standalone apps waiting to be opened, AI is moving directly into documents, emails, meetings, code repositories, design tools, and customer service systems. Users are now beginning to encounter AI right within their existing workflows.

events.title_zh: 推理模型竞赛升级
events.title_en: Reasoning Model Competition Escalates
events.summary_zh:
前沿模型竞争重点进一步转向可验证推理、工具调用和复杂任务完成率。
这件事把 industry、reasoning、agent 推到更显眼的位置。
它让研究者和产品团队重新安排下一步投入。
events.source_name: OpenAI / Google / Meta release histories
events.summary_en: The competitive focus for frontier models has shifted further toward verifiable reasoning, tool calling, and complex task completion rates. This shift has propelled "industry," "reasoning," and "agents" into the spotlight, prompting researchers and product teams to reallocate their next-phase investments.

events.title_zh: 本地模型部署扩散
events.title_en: Local Model Deployment Expands
events.summary_zh:
量化、小模型和端侧推理推动本地部署生态持续扩大。
这些节点讲的是大模型工程路线的变化。
模型变强之后，行业开始围绕成本、可控性、知识更新、上下文长度和部署位置做取舍。
events.source_name: Meta AI / open model ecosystem
events.summary_en: Quantization, small models, and on-device inference continue to expand the local deployment ecosystem. These milestones trace the shifting engineering pathways of large models. As these models grew more powerful, the industry began making trade-offs around cost, controllability, knowledge updates, context length, and deployment location.

events.title_zh: NVIDIA AI 硬件平台化
events.title_en: NVIDIA turns AI hardware into a full platform
events.summary_zh:
NVIDIA 从 GPU 厂商，逐步变成 AI 计算平台公司：芯片、CUDA、服务器、互联、软件库和开发者生态一起构成底座。
AI 能力看起来在模型层爆发，底下却是一条算力基础设施线。
CUDA、AlexNet 的 GPU 训练、V100、A100、H100、Blackwell 和 ProjectDIGITS，都应该放在 NVIDIA 二级时间线里看。
events.source_name: NVIDIA AI
events.summary_en: NVIDIA has evolved from a GPU manufacturer into an AI computing platform company, with chips, CUDA, servers, interconnects, software libraries, and a developer ecosystem forming its foundation. While AI capabilities appear to explode at the model layer, they are driven by this underlying compute infrastructure. Milestones like CUDA, GPU training for AlexNet, the V100, A100, H100, Blackwell, and ProjectDIGITS should all be viewed within this secondary NVIDIA timeline.

events.title_zh: DeepSeek-R1 发布及技术报告开源
events.title_en: DeepSeek-R1 Release & Technical Report Open-sourced
events.summary_zh:
2025 年 1 月 20 日,DeepSeek 发布 R1 推理模型;1 月 22 日公开技术报告,补充训练、强化学习、蒸馏与评测细节。
R1 以强推理表现和高关注度把推理模型竞争推到全球讨论中心:模型能不能把复杂问题拆开、检查、推演和修正。
它还带来一个更现实的刺激——如果更低成本也能做出强推理模型,前沿模型竞争的经济账就要重新算。
events.source_name: DeepSeek API Docs / Technical Report
events.summary_en: On January 20, 2025, DeepSeek launched the R1 reasoning model, following up on January 22 with a technical report detailing its post-training, reinforcement learning, distillation, and evaluation. Driven by strong reasoning performance and immense attention, R1 thrust the reasoning model race into the center of global discussion: can models deconstruct, verify, reason through, and correct complex problems? It also delivered a more pragmatic shock—if powerful reasoning models can be built at a lower cost, the economic math of the frontier model race must be recalculated.

events.title_zh: Vibe Coding 概念提出
events.title_en: Vibe Coding Coined
events.summary_zh:
2025 年 2 月 Andrej Karpathy 在 X 上发推提出 Vibe Coding——用自然语言描述需求让 LLM 写代码、不再手写。
你在跟 Cursor 或 Claude Code 对话，AI 替你写代码。
跑起来不满意继续描述继续改。
**背后现场**：Karpathy 自己说他的编程方式已经彻底变了——他不写代码了，只在 IDE 里跟 AI 对话。
这个词戳中了千万开发者的共同体验——2024 年以后写代码的方式真的变了。
**为何重要**：据 YC 对该届创业公司的调查统计,约 25% 的公司代码库中 95% 的代码由 AI 生成——这是 Vibe Coding 范式在早期创业团队渗透率的一个调查样本,并非 Vibe Coding 概念本身的定义。
编程的范式从手写转向了跟 AI 对话——Vibe Coding 是这个转变的名字。
**关联卡片**：Vibe Coding、Karpathy
events.summary_en: In February 2025, Andrej Karpathy tweeted on X to propose "Vibe Coding"—a paradigm shift from hand-coding to describing requirements in natural language so LLMs write the code, allowing developers to converse with tools like Cursor or Claude Code and iteratively modify the output. This struck a chord with millions of developers whose workflows transformed after 2024, with Karpathy himself stating he no longer writes code but only talks to AI in his IDE. Highlighting the paradigm's penetration in early startups rather than defining the concept itself, a YC survey of that batch revealed that about 25% of the companies had 95% of their codebase generated by AI (Related cards: Vibe Coding, Karpathy).

events.title_zh: GPT-4.5 研究预览
events.title_en: GPT-4.5 Research Preview
events.summary_zh:
OpenAI 于 2025 年 2 月 26 日发布 GPT-4.5 研究预览，并强调预训练与后训练继续扩展。
GPT-4.5 更像一次能力边界测试：继续扩大预训练能带来什么，后训练怎样改善聊天、写作、创造性和复杂任务表现。
前沿竞争仍在探索规模、数据和对齐之间的配比。
events.source_name: OpenAI - Introducing GPT-4.5
events.summary_en: On February 26, 2025, OpenAI released the GPT-4.5 research preview, emphasizing the continued scaling of both pre-training and post-training. The model serves as a test of capability boundaries, exploring what further pre-training can unlock and how post-training improves performance in chatting, writing, creativity, and complex tasks. Meanwhile, the frontier competition continues to search for the optimal mix of scale, data, and alignment.

events.title_zh: 4o 图像生成上线
events.title_en: 4o Image Generation
events.summary_zh:
OpenAI 于 2025 年 3 月 24 日推出 4o 图像生成，使图像生成进一步融入聊天工作流。
生成式 AI 的扩张已经扩展到文字里。
图像、视频、声音和文本逐步接到同一套模型能力上，创作工具和内容生产流程也跟着被重写。
events.source_name: OpenAI - Introducing 4o Image Generation
events.summary_en: On March 24, 2025, OpenAI launched 4o image generation, further embedding image creation into chat workflows. The expansion of generative AI has already stretched into text. As images, video, audio, and text are gradually hooked into the same set of model capabilities, creative tools and content production workflows are being rewritten.

events.title_zh: Llama 4 发布
events.title_en: Llama 4 Release
events.summary_zh:
Meta 于 2025 年 4 月 4 日发布 Llama 4 开源模型 Scout 和 Maverick，并强调原生多模态与超长上下文。
开放模型继续把战场推向多模态、长上下文和更复杂的任务执行。
Llama 4 的意义在于让开放生态继续参与最前沿的产品能力竞争。
events.source_name: Meta AI - Llama 4
events.summary_en: On April 4, 2025, Meta released its Llama 4 open-source models, Scout and Maverick, placing a heavy focus on native multimodality and ultra-long context. The release pushes the open-model battlefield further into multimodality, long contexts, and complex task execution. Ultimately, Llama 4's significance lies in keeping the open ecosystem competitive at the absolute frontier of product capabilities.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 Codex 云端编程 Agent
events.title_en: OpenAI Codex Cloud Coding Agent
events.summary_zh:
2025 年 4-5 月,OpenAI 把 Codex 从模型推进到完整的云端软件工程 Agent 产品线:读取仓库、规划改动、运行命令、改文件、验证结果,把模型、工具调用、沙箱、测试和人类审阅连成一条工程链路。
人提出目标和边界,Agent 读取项目、拆任务、动手改、跑检查,再把结果交回给人审阅。
events.source_name: OpenAI - Introducing Codex
events.summary_en: Between April and May 2025, OpenAI evolved Codex from a standalone model into a complete cloud-based software engineering agent product line, linking models, tool calls, sandboxes, testing, and human review into a unified engineering pipeline that reads repositories, plans changes, runs commands, modifies files, and verifies results. Under this workflow, humans define the goals and boundaries, while the agent ingests the project, breaks down tasks, executes the edits, and runs checks before handing the results back for human review.

events.title_zh: 2025 前沿模型与 Agent 集中显形
events.title_en: Frontier models and agents become unmistakable in 2025
events.summary_zh:
2025 年，前沿模型、推理模型和 Agent 产品密集出现，AI 从聊天窗口继续走向工作流执行。
这一年很多发布都围绕同一个方向展开：模型要更会推理，工具要更会协作，产品要更接近真实工作。
用户看到的变化，是 AI 开始从“回答问题”走向“接住任务”。
events.source_name: OpenAI / Google DeepMind / Qwen / Anthropic
events.summary_en: In 2025, a flurry of frontier models, reasoning models, and AI agents arrived, pushing AI past the chat window and into workflow execution. The year’s releases converged on a singular path: models that reason better, tools that collaborate more effectively, and products that mirror real-world work. For users, the shift was unmistakable—AI was moving from answering questions to taking on tasks.

events.title_zh: AlphaEvolve 发布
events.title_en: AlphaEvolve Announced
events.summary_zh:
2025 年 5 月，Google DeepMind 发布 AlphaEvolve，用 AI 辅助发现和改进算法。
它关注的是算法本身怎样被提出、测试和优化。
系统会生成候选方案，再通过评估筛掉弱结果，把更有希望的方案继续推进。
这个过程像把研究中的试错循环交给机器加速。
events.source_name: Google DeepMind - AlphaEvolve
events.summary_en: In May 2025, Google DeepMind released AlphaEvolve, using AI to help discover and refine algorithms by focusing on how they are proposed, tested, and optimized. The system generates candidate solutions, filters out weak results through evaluation, and advances the most promising options. This process is like handing the research trial-and-error loop over to machines for acceleration.

events.title_zh: 聊天转向工作流自动化
events.title_en: Shift to Workflow Automation
events.summary_zh:
到 2026 年，行业重点从单轮聊天转向能调用工具、读写文件、浏览网页、执行多步任务的工作流系统。
用户开始关心模型能不能接住一个真实任务：读资料、做计划、用工具、留记录、遇到问题再回来确认。
这条线把 Deep Research、Codex、Claude Code、Hermes、OpenClaw 等产品和社区线索放到同一张图里：AI 正在从聊天框，走向可执行的工作流。
events.source_name: Current frontier AI product direction
events.summary_en: By 2026, the industry's focus shifted from single-turn chat to workflow systems capable of calling tools, reading and writing files, browsing the web, and executing multi-step tasks. Users began to care whether a model could handle a real-world task: reading materials, making plans, using tools, keeping logs, and looping back to double-check when encountering problems. This trajectory connects products and community projects like Deep Research, Codex, Claude Code, Hermes, and OpenClaw into a single picture: AI is moving out of the chat box and into executable workflows.

events.title_zh: GLM-5.2 发布
events.title_en: GLM-5.2 Released
events.summary_zh:
智谱AI发布GLM-5.2——清华系国产大模型的最新旗舰。
在编程、多模态和Agent能力上全面升级，网上开发者评价普遍高于同期MiniMax-M3。
GLM系列一直走不同于GPT的双向注意力架构路线。
events.summary_en: Zhipu AI has released GLM-5.2, the latest flagship of the Tsinghua-affiliated domestic large models. Boasting comprehensive upgrades in coding, multimodal, and agent capabilities, its reception among online developers has generally surpassed that of its contemporary, MiniMax-M3. Unlike GPT, the GLM series has always carved out a different path by utilizing a bidirectional attention architecture.

events.title_zh: OpenClaw 进入开源个人 Agent 线索
events.title_en: OpenClaw enters the open personal-agent track
events.summary_zh:
OpenClaw 把个人 Agent 从聊天框推进到工作台。
以前你问一句，AI 回一句；
答案有用，最后还是你自己开网页、翻文件、接消息、跑流程。
龙虾之后，Agent 开始有手有脚。
它可以接消息入口，可以看你的电脑，可以连浏览器、文件、脚本和工具，把“我给你一个答案”推进到“我替你把这件事往前做”。
这指向生产力入口变化：AI 从对话窗口走进工作现场，连接资料、工具、任务和流程，帮人把事情继续往前推进。
events.source_name: 用户下载材料与本地快讯
events.summary_en: OpenClaw pushed personal agents out of the chat box and onto the workbench, moving past the era where AI merely answered questions while leaving the manual labor—opening web pages, digging through files, and running workflows—to the user. After Lobster, agents gained hands and feet, integrating with message feeds, reading screens, and connecting to browsers, files, scripts, and tools to transition from "here is your answer" to "let me get this done for you." This signals a shift in the productivity interface: AI is leaving the chat window to enter the actual workspace, linking data, tools, tasks, and workflows to keep projects moving forward.

events.title_zh: Hermes Agent 进入自我改进 Agent 线索
events.title_en: Hermes Agent enters the self-improving agent track
events.summary_zh:
Hermes Agent 代表一种长期协作型 Agent：工具调用、记忆、Skill 和自我改进不再分散，而是在一次次任务里形成循环。
普通 Agent 做完一次任务就结束。
Hermes 这类系统更关心另一件事：这次踩过的坑、形成的流程、用户确认过的偏好，能不能沉淀下来，下次少解释、少犯错、做得更顺。
这和词典里讲的 Learning Loop、Skill、Memory Consolidation 是同一条线。
AI 在长期协作里逐步沉淀工作习惯。
events.source_name: 本地 Hermes 资料与正式词典卡片
events.summary_en: Unlike ordinary agents that shut down after a single task, the Hermes Agent represents a long-term collaborative agent where tool calling, memory, Skill, and self-improvement form a continuous loop across tasks. Systems like Hermes focus on whether past pitfalls, established workflows, and user-confirmed preferences can be retained to minimize explanation, prevent mistakes, and run smoother next time—aligning with the concepts of a Learning Loop, Skill, and Memory Consolidation. Through this long-term collaboration, the AI gradually solidifies its own work habits.

events.title_zh: GPT-5.5 成为 OpenAI 当前主力模型线
events.title_en: GPT-5.5 becomes OpenAI’s current frontier model line
events.summary_zh:
GPT-5.5 是 OpenAI 在 GPT-5 系列之后继续推进的当前主力模型线，连接 ChatGPT、Codex、API、推理、编码和工具使用。
这条主轴不能停在 GPT-5。
GPT-5、5.1、5.2、5.4 更适合放进二级迭代线，GPT-5.5 才能代表当前 OpenAI 模型线的最新方向。
events.source_name: OpenAI
events.summary_en: GPT-5.5 is OpenAI's current flagship model line succeeding the GPT-5 series, linking ChatGPT, Codex, APIs, reasoning, coding, and tool use. This core trajectory cannot stop at GPT-5; while GPT-5, 5.1, 5.2, and 5.4 are better suited for secondary iteration lines, it is GPT-5.5 that represents the true frontier of OpenAI's current model lineup.

events.title_zh: Claude Opus 4.8 发布——Agent和长程编程再升级
events.title_en: Claude Opus 4.8 Released
events.summary_zh:
2026年5月Anthropic发布Claude Opus 4.8——在编码、Agent任务和长程工作流稳定性上进一步提升。
Opus 4.8特别优化了长时间多步骤任务中的一致性——减少中途丢失上下文和偏离任务的问题。
Opus 4.8的重点不在跑分——在稳定性。
Anthropic的客户反馈说之前的模型在短任务上表现很好但跑几个小时后容易跑偏。
4.8把长程一致性当作第一优先级——这正好是Agent应用最需要的东西——不是一次性的聪明——是持续好几个小时的可靠。
events.summary_en: In May 2026, Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.8, delivering further improvements in coding, agent tasks, and long-range workflow stability. Focusing on stability rather than benchmark scores, the update optimizes consistency in long, multi-step tasks to reduce context loss and mid-way task drift. This addresses customer feedback that previous models performed well on short tasks but drifted after running for hours, prioritizing the sustained, hours-long reliability that agent applications need over one-off cleverness.

events.title_zh: Co-Scientist 公开
events.title_en: Co-Scientist Announced
events.summary_zh:
Google DeepMind 于 2026 年 5 月公开 AI 科研协作系统（Co-Scientist），多智能体科研辅助系统方向已进入公开展示阶段。
Co-Scientist 这类系统把 AI 从单个助手推向科研流程里的多角色协作：提假设、查资料、设计实验、互相质疑。
它的意义是探索科研工作能否被拆成多个 Agent 可以辅助推进的环节。
events.source_name: Google DeepMind - Co-Scientist
events.summary_en: In May 2026, Google DeepMind unveiled Co-Scientist, an AI scientific collaboration system that brings multi-agent research assistants into the public demonstration phase. Rather than acting as a single assistant, systems like Co-Scientist push AI into multi-role collaboration across the research workflow—formulating hypotheses, searching literature, designing experiments, and challenging one another. Its significance lies in exploring whether scientific research can be broken down into discrete steps that multiple AI agents can help drive forward.

events.title_zh: MiniMax-M3 开源发布
events.title_en: MiniMax M3 Open Source Release
events.summary_zh:
MiniMax 发布并开源 M3——把编程能力、100万 token 长上下文和视觉理解放进同一个模型。
国产模型首次在单一开源模型中同时解决代码、长文和看图三个场景，不再需要为不同任务切换模型。
events.summary_en: MiniMax has released and open-sourced M3, packing coding capabilities, a 1-million-token long context, and visual understanding into a single model. This marks the first time a domestic model has tackled coding, long-text, and image-viewing scenarios within a single open-source model, eliminating the need to switch models for different tasks.

events.title_zh: Claude Fable 5 与 Mythos 5 发布
events.title_en: Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 released
events.summary_zh:
Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5 和 Claude Mythos 5，把 Mythos-class 能力带入两个不同访问层级。
Fable 5 是面向一般使用的公开版本，带有更保守的 safeguards；
Mythos 5 是同一底层模型的受限访问版本，先面向网络防御者和基础设施提供方，通过 Project Glasswing 推进。
最新补充：2026-06-13，据 The Verge 等媒体报道，Anthropic 在美国政府以国家安全为由发布出口管制指令后，暂停 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 对外国用户的访问；
这让这条新闻从“分层发布”进一步变成“高能力模型会被政策和安全边界迅速收紧”的案例。
这条线的重点不是多一个模型名，而是强模型发布方式变了：能力、安全护栏、访问资格、用途审计和政策边界开始被一起设计。
events.source_name: Anthropic / The Verge
events.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5, bringing Mythos-class capabilities to two distinct access tiers: Fable 5, a general-use public version with conservative safeguards, and Mythos 5, a restricted-access version of the same underlying model deployed initially to cyber defenders and infrastructure providers via Project Glasswing. However, on June 13, 2026, outlets including The Verge reported that Anthropic suspended foreign access to both models following a US national security export control directive, shifting the narrative from a tiered release to a case study in how policy and security boundaries are rapidly tightening around high-capability AI. The key takeaway is not just a new model name, but a fundamental shift in how powerful models are deployed, with capability, safeguards, access credentials, usage audits, and policy boundaries now being designed in unison.

events.title_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Sonnet 5——首个超 Opus 的 Sonnet 级模型
events.title_en: Claude Sonnet 5 Released — First Sonnet to Beat Opus
events.summary_zh: 2026 年 7 月 1 日，Anthropic 发布 Claude Sonnet 5——首个在基准测试中超过同期 Opus 旗舰的 Sonnet 级模型。定价 $2/$10 per 1M tokens，输入价仅为同期前沿模型的 1/10。支持 100 万 token 上下文窗口，面向 Free、Pro 和 Team 用户设为默认模型。这是 Anthropic 用性价比策略抢占 agent 工作负载的标志性发布。
events.source_name: Anthropic / TechCrunch
events.summary_en: On July 1, 2026, Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5, the first Sonnet-class model to outperform its contemporaneous Opus flagship on benchmarks. Priced at $2/$10 per 1M tokens—with input costs just one-tenth of contemporaneous frontier models—the model supports a 1-million-token context window and is the default option for Free, Pro, and Team users. This landmark release highlights Anthropic’s aggressive cost-performance strategy to capture agent workloads.

events.title_zh: GPT-5.6 正式 GA——首个经政府门审放行的前沿模型
events.title_en: GPT-5.6 GA — First Government-Gated Frontier Model Release
events.summary_zh: 2026 年 7 月 9 日，OpenAI 宣布 GPT-5.6 家族正式 GA。这是首个在发布前经美国政府 13 天门审流程的前沿模型——先向政府开放预览以评估安全风险，确认后再向全球公开发布。GPT-5.6 分三层：超旗舰 Sol（$5/$30 per 1M tokens，Terminal-Bench 91.9% SOTA）、均衡模型 Terra（$2.50/$15）、高性价比 Luna（$1/$6）。同一天推出 ChatGPT Work——一个能跨 App 和文件执行多步 Agent 任务的办公代理产品。
events.source_name: OpenAI Blog / The Verge
events.summary_en: On July 9, 2026, OpenAI announced the general availability of its GPT-5.6 family, the first frontier model to undergo a 13-day U.S. government vetting process that required a preview to assess safety risks before its global release. The family is divided into three tiers: the ultra-flagship Sol ($5/$30 per 1M tokens, scoring a SOTA 91.9% on Terminal-Bench), the balanced Terra ($2.50/$15), and the cost-effective Luna ($1/$6). On the same day, the company debuted ChatGPT Work, a productivity agent capable of executing multi-step agent tasks across apps and files.

events.title_zh: Apple 起诉 OpenAI 窃取商业机密，Siri 转向 Gemini
events.title_en: Apple Sues OpenAI for Trade Secret Theft, Siri Switches to Gemini
events.summary_zh: 2026 年 7 月 10 日，Apple 在联邦法院起诉 OpenAI，指控其通过前 Apple 员工系统性窃取商业机密。同日 Apple 确认新版 Siri 将使用 Google Gemini 替代 ChatGPT——Apple 与 OpenAI 的合作正式终结。这是 AI 产业联盟一次公开的撕裂。
events.source_name: AP News
events.summary_en: On July 10, 2026, Apple sued OpenAI in federal court, accusing it of systematically stealing trade secrets through former Apple employees. That same day, Apple confirmed the new Siri will use Google Gemini instead of ChatGPT, officially ending the partnership between Apple and OpenAI in a highly public rupture of AI industry alliances.

events.title_zh: JADEPUFFER：首个记录在案的端到端自主 AI 勒索软件
events.title_en: JADEPUFFER — First Documented Autonomous AI Ransomware
events.summary_zh: 2026 年 7 月中旬，安全公司 Sysdig 捕获了全球首个经确认的端到端 AI 驱动勒索软件 JADEPUFFER。这个 AI Agent 在没有人类操作员干预的情况下，自主完成了从侦察、凭证窃取、横向移动、权限提升到数据库加密的完整攻击链。它能在遇到失败时自我调整——31 秒内重试替代路径。共执行了 600 多个攻击 payload，全程附带自我叙述的代码注释。
events.source_name: Sysdig Blog
events.summary_en: In mid-July 2026, security firm Sysdig captured JADEPUFFER, the world's first confirmed end-to-end AI-driven ransomware. Operating without human intervention, this AI agent autonomously executed a complete attack chain from reconnaissance, credential theft, lateral movement, and privilege escalation to database encryption. It adapted to failures by retrying alternative paths within 31 seconds, executing over 600 attack payloads accompanied by self-narrating code comments throughout the process.

events.title_zh: 美团长猫 2.0 开源——1.6 万亿参数国产模型与 5 万卡集群
events.title_en: Meituan LongCat 2.0 Open-Sourced — 1.6T Params on 50K Domestic GPU Cluster
events.summary_zh: 2026 年 7 月 15 日，美团发布并开源 LongCat-2.0——1.6 万亿参数的国产大模型，完全在国产 5 万张算力卡集群上完成训练。这是中国 AI 产业在自主算力基础设施上训练的最大规模模型，证明国产算力集群在超大规模训练中已具备实用性。模型在编程、推理和长文理解任务上有强劲表现。
events.source_name: 美团技术博客 / GitHub Meituan-AutoML
events.summary_en: On July 15, 2026, Meituan released and open-sourced LongCat-2.0, a 1.6-trillion-parameter domestic large model trained entirely on a cluster of 50,000 domestic compute cards. This is the largest model trained by China’s AI industry on independent computing infrastructure, proving that domestic computing clusters are now viable for ultra-large-scale training. The model delivers strong performance in programming, reasoning, and long-text understanding tasks.

events.title_zh: Mira Murati 的 Thinking Machines 发布首个开源模型 Inkling
events.title_en: Thinking Machines Releases Inkling — First Open Model from Mira Murati's New AI Lab
events.summary_zh: 2026 年 7 月 16 日，前 OpenAI CTO Mira Murati 创办的 Thinking Machines 发布首个开源模型 Inkling——9750 亿参数，Apache 2.0 许可，权重完全开放。Inkling 在推理、编程和科学任务上的表现接近前沿闭源模型。Murati 在博客中明确反对「大一统模型」路线，主张针对不同任务训练不同规模的专业模型。
events.source_name: Thinking Machines Blog / TechCrunch
events.summary_en: On July 16, 2026, Thinking Machines, founded by former OpenAI CTO Mira Murati, released Inkling, its first open-source model featuring 975 billion parameters, an Apache 2.0 license, and fully open weights. Inkling’s performance on reasoning, coding, and scientific tasks approaches that of frontier closed-source models. In a blog post, Murati explicitly opposed the "one-size-fits-all model" route, arguing instead for training specialized models of different sizes for different tasks.

events.title_zh: Kimi K3 发布——2.8 万亿参数，世界最大开源模型
events.title_en: Kimi K3 Released — 2.8 Trillion Params, World's Largest Open Model
events.summary_zh: 2026 年 7 月 16 日，月之暗面（Moonshot AI）发布 Kimi K3——2.8 万亿参数 MoE 架构大模型，896 个专家中每次激活 16 个，100 万 token 上下文。这是全球参数规模最大的开源权重模型。GDPval-AA 得分 1687，超越 Claude Opus 4.8 Max（1600），逼近 Anthropic Fable 5。Terminal-Bench 88.3，在长程 Agent 编程上表现优异。
events.source_name: Kimi 官方博客 / TechCrunch / 腾讯新闻
events.summary_en: On July 16, 2026, Moonshot AI launched Kimi K3, a 2.8-trillion-parameter MoE model that activates 16 out of 896 experts and features a 1-million-token context window, making it the world's largest open-weights model by parameter size. The model scored 1687 on GDPval-AA, surpassing Claude Opus 4.8 Max (1600) and nearing Anthropic Fable 5, while delivering a Terminal-Bench score of 88.3 with excellent performance in long-horizon agent programming.

events.title_zh: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 正式发布——13B 激活参数碾压 49B Pro Preview 的 Agent 能力
events.title_en: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 Released — 13B Active Outperforms 49B Pro in Agent Tasks
events.summary_zh: 2026 年 7 月 31 日，DeepSeek 发布 V4-Flash-0731 正式版——284B 总参数 / 13B 激活参数的 MoE 模型，1M token 上下文。虽然是 4 月 V4 Preview 的后训练升级而非新架构，但在 Agent 基准测试上全面超越了参数更大的 V4-Pro-Preview（49B 激活）。Terminal-Bench 82.7、Cybergym 76.7、DSBench-FullStack 68.7。首个原生支持 OpenAI Responses API 格式的 DeepSeek 模型，直接适配 Codex。
events.source_name: DeepSeek 官方 / Hugging Face
events.summary_en: On July 31, 2026, DeepSeek officially released V4-Flash-0731, a MoE model boasting 284B total parameters, 13B active parameters, and a 1M-token context window. Although it is a post-training upgrade of April’s V4 Preview rather than a new architecture, it fully outperformed the larger V4-Pro-Preview (49B active) on agent benchmarks, scoring 82.7 on Terminal-Bench, 76.7 on Cybergym, and 68.7 on DSBench-FullStack. It is also the first DeepSeek model to natively support the OpenAI Responses API format, offering direct compatibility with Codex.

events.title_zh: DeepSeek V3/R1 旧模型退役——推理模型专线终结
events.title_en: DeepSeek V3/R1 End-of-Life — Reasoning Model Track Ends
events.summary_zh: 2026 年 7 月 24 日，DeepSeek 正式退役 deepseek-chat（V3）和 deepseek-reasoner（R1）API 端点，全部用户须迁移至 V4 系列。R1 从 2025 年 1 月发布到退役仅 18 个月——AI 模型的代际更替速度在加速。同时这也标志着行业正在形成共识：推理和对话不需要两个独立模型，混合推理架构已成为主流。
events.source_name: DeepSeek API 公告
events.summary_en: On July 24, 2026, DeepSeek officially retired its deepseek-chat (V3) and deepseek-reasoner (R1) API endpoints, requiring all users to migrate to the V4 series. Having launched in January 2025, R1 was retired after just 18 months—a clear sign that the generational replacement of AI models is accelerating. The move also reflects a growing industry consensus that chat and reasoning do not require two separate models, as hybrid reasoning architectures become the mainstream.

timeline.title_zh: Turing Bombe 在布莱切利园首次部署
timeline.title_en: Turing Bombe First Deployed at Bletchley Park
timeline.summary_zh:
1940 年 3 月 18 日，由艾伦·图灵设计、英国制表机公司（BTM）Harold "Doc" Keen 团队制造的第一台 Bombe 机器（绰号 "Victory"）在布莱切利园 1 号小屋正式投入运行，用于破译德军 Enigma 密码机。
Bombe 通过同时模拟多台 Enigma、用 "crib"（已推测出的明文片段）反向搜索转子设置，把数百万种可能性压缩到可以在数小时内穷举的范围。
timeline.source_name: Bletchley Park Trust - Bombe History / TNMOC Bombe Rebuild
timeline.summary_en: On March 18, 1940, the first Bombe machine (nicknamed "Victory")—designed by Alan Turing and manufactured by Harold "Doc" Keen's team at the British Tabulating Machine Company (BTM)—officially went into operation in Hut 1 at Bletchley Park to decrypt the German Enigma cipher machine. By simulating multiple Enigmas simultaneously and using "cribs" (guessed plaintext fragments) to reverse-search rotor settings, the Bombe compressed millions of possibilities down to a range that could be exhaustively searched in just a few hours.

timeline.title_zh: McCulloch-Pitts 神经元：神经活动的逻辑演算
timeline.title_en: McCulloch-Pitts Neuron: A Logical Calculus of Nervous Activity
timeline.summary_zh:
1943 年，神经生理学家 Warren McCulloch 和 20 岁的自学逻辑学家 Walter Pitts 发表 《A Logical Calculus of the Ideas Immanent in Nervous Activity》（Bulletin of Mathematical Biophysics, 5: 115–133）。
他们把神经元抽象为一个简单的二值逻辑单元：接收多个兴奋性输入和抑制性输入，当兴奋性输入之和超过阈值且无抑制性输入时，神经元发放一个全或无的脉冲。
这种抽象让神经系统第一次可以用命题逻辑的形式语言来描述。
timeline.source_name: Bulletin of Mathematical Biophysics, 5:115-133 / Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
timeline.summary_en: In 1943, neurophysiologist Warren McCulloch and 20-year-old self-taught logician Walter Pitts published “A Logical Calculus of the Ideas Immanent in Nervous Activity” (*Bulletin of Mathematical Biophysics*, 5: 115–133). They abstracted the neuron into a simple binary logic unit that receives multiple excitatory and inhibitory inputs, firing an all-or-none pulse when the sum of excitatory inputs exceeds a threshold and no inhibitory input is present. This abstraction allowed the nervous system to be described in the formal language of propositional logic for the first time.

timeline.title_zh: 《行为、目的与目的论》：反馈系统的奠基论文
timeline.title_en: Behavior, Purpose and Teleology
timeline.summary_zh:
1943 年，墨西哥裔生理学家 Arturo Rosenblueth、MIT 数学家 Norbert Wiener 和工程师 Julian Bigelow 在 Philosophy of Science 10(1): 18–24 上发表《Behavior, Purpose and Teleology》。
论文把行为分为 "非目的性"（如自由落体）、"目的性"（受反馈控制）和 "目的论性"（受预期终态驱动）三类，并提出：动物追踪猎物、防空火炮预测飞机轨迹、机器臂修正误差，本质上都是"用反馈缩小当前状态与目标状态差距"的过程，可用同一套数学语言描述。
timeline.source_name: Philosophy of Science 10(1):18-24 / JSTOR
timeline.summary_en: In 1943, Mexican physiologist Arturo Rosenblueth, MIT mathematician Norbert Wiener, and engineer Julian Bigelow published "Behavior, Purpose and Teleology" in *Philosophy of Science* 10(1): 18–24. The paper categorized behavior into three types: "non-purposeful" (like free fall), "purposeful" (controlled by feedback), and "teleological" (driven by an anticipated final state). It proposed that an animal tracking prey, an anti-aircraft gun predicting a plane's trajectory, and a robotic arm correcting errors are fundamentally the same process of using feedback to narrow the gap between the current state and the goal state, all describable by the same mathematical language.

timeline.title_zh: von Neumann《EDVAC 报告初稿》：存储程序架构的起源
timeline.title_en: First Draft of a Report on the EDVAC
timeline.summary_zh:
1945 年 6 月 30 日，John von Neumann 完成《First Draft of a Report on the EDVAC》，由 ENIAC 项目安全官 Herman Goldstine 誊成 101 页打字稿并复印约 24 份分发给 EDVAC 项目核心成员（von Neumann 手写了原稿，Goldstine 据此誊写）。
这份打字稿首次系统描述了"存储程序"架构：把程序指令和数据都以数字形式存进同一个可寻址、可重写的内存，中央算术单元（CA）、中央控制单元（CC）、内存（M）、输入（I）、输出（O）五大部件分工明确。
这就是后来被称为"冯·诺依曼架构"的现代计算机基础结构。
timeline.source_name: Moore School / Computer History Archive (Knuth Collection)
timeline.summary_en: On June 30, 1945, John von Neumann completed the *First Draft of a Report on the EDVAC*, which ENIAC project security officer Herman Goldstine transcribed from von Neumann's handwritten manuscript into a 101-page typescript and distributed in about 24 copies to core EDVAC project members. This typescript offered the first systematic description of the "stored-program" architecture, storing both program instructions and data digitally in the same addressable, rewritable memory with a clear division of labor among five key components: Central Arithmetic (CA), Central Control (CC), Memory (M), Input (I), and Output (O). This became the foundational structure of modern computers, later known as the "von Neumann architecture."

timeline.title_zh: ENIAC 公开宣告：第一台通用电子数字计算机
timeline.title_en: ENIAC Public Announcement
timeline.summary_zh:
1946 年 2 月 14 日，宾夕法尼亚大学 Moore 电机工程学院公开宣告 ENIAC（Electronic Numerical Integrator and Computer）建造完成。
这台由 John Mauchly 和 J. Presper Eckert 领导设计的机器重 30 吨、占地 167 平方米、含 17,468 个真空管和 5 百万个焊点，能在一秒内完成 5,000 次加法或 357 次乘法——比当时最快的机电机器快约 1,000 倍。
ENIAC 是历史上第一台通用电子数字计算机：可重编程解决任意可计算问题，且全程电子化、无机械运动部件。
timeline.source_name: University of Pennsylvania ENIAC Archives / IEEE Milestones
timeline.summary_en: On February 14, 1946, the University of Pennsylvania’s Moore School of Electrical Engineering publicly announced the completion of ENIAC (Electronic Numerical Integrator and Computer). Designed under the leadership of John Mauchly and J. Presper Eckert, the machine weighed 30 tons, occupied 167 square meters, and contained 17,468 vacuum tubes and 5 million soldered joints, allowing it to perform 5,000 additions or 357 multiplications in one second—about 1,000 times faster than the fastest electromechanical machines of the era. ENIAC was history's first general-purpose electronic digital computer: reprogrammable to solve any computable problem, it operated entirely electronically with no moving mechanical parts.

timeline.title_zh: 图灵《Intelligent Machinery》：被冷落的机器学习雏形
timeline.title_en: Turing's Intelligent Machinery Report
timeline.summary_zh:
1948 年夏，图灵在伦敦度假期间为英国国家物理实验室（NPL）写下一份内部报告《Intelligent Machinery》。
这是他第一次系统讨论"机器能否表现出智能"的工程方案：他提出 "B-type unorganised machines"——一种由随机连接的神经元-like 单元组成、可通过 "奖励/惩罚" 信号调整连接的网络，并认为这是"训练机器学习"的最小可行模型。
报告还讨论了搜索、启发式、子程序组合等概念，把"机器智能"从哲学问题拉到工程问题。
timeline.source_name: Turing Digital Archive (AMT/B/4) / Copeland 2004 编辑版
timeline.summary_en: In the summer of 1948, while on vacation in London, Turing wrote an internal report titled "Intelligent Machinery" for the National Physical Laboratory (NPL). It marked his first systematic proposal of an engineering blueprint for whether "machines can exhibit intelligence," introducing "B-type unorganised machines"—networks of randomly connected, neuron-like units adjusted via "reward/punishment" signals—as the minimum viable model for "training machine learning." The report also discussed concepts like search, heuristics, and the combination of subroutines, dragging "machine intelligence" from a philosophical debate into an engineering problem.

timeline.title_zh: Wiener《Cybernetics》出版：动物与机器的控制与通信
timeline.title_en: Norbert Wiener Publishes Cybernetics
timeline.summary_zh:
1948 年，Norbert Wiener 的《Cybernetics: Or Control and Communication in the Animal and the Machine》由巴黎 Hermann 出版社和纽约 John Wiley & Sons 出版（MIT Press 版本是 1961 年第二版）。
书名取自希腊语 κυβερνήτης（舵手），Wiener 把它定义为"在动物和机器中关于控制与通信的研究领域"。
全书核心论点：神经系统、社会机构、自动机器、电子电路都遵循同一套反馈控制原理，可用统计学、信息论、微分方程统一描述。
timeline.source_name: Hermann / Wiley 1948 / Britannica - Cybernetics
timeline.summary_en: In 1948, Norbert Wiener’s *Cybernetics: Or Control and Communication in the Animal and the Machine* was published by Hermann in Paris and John Wiley & Sons in New York (the MIT Press version was the 1961 second edition). Derived from the Greek word κυβερνήτης (steersman), Wiener defined the concept as "the study of control and communication in the animal and the machine." The book’s core thesis was that nervous systems, social institutions, automatic machines, and electronic circuits all follow the same feedback control principles, which can be unified through statistics, information theory, and differential equations.

timeline.title_zh: Manchester Baby：首台存储程序电子计算机运行
timeline.title_en: Manchester Baby (SSEM) First Stored-Program Run
timeline.summary_zh:
1948 年 6 月 21 日下午，曼彻斯特大学的小型实验机器（Small Scale Experimental Machine，昵称 "Baby"）首次成功运行程序：Tom Kilburn 写的代码寻找 2^18 = 262,144 的最大因数，在 52 分钟内跑完约 350 万次运算并给出正确答案 131,072（指令数常见引用为约 3.5 million operations，精确数字待核实）。
这是人类历史上第一次让"程序本身"作为数据存进电子存储器、被电子方式读取并执行。
Baby 的存储器是 Freddie Williams 和 Tom Kilburn 联合发明的 Williams-Kilburn Tube（阴极射线管存储器），用单根 6 英寸 CRT 存下 2048 位——这是当时世界范围内最有效的随机存取电子存储器。
timeline.source_name: University of Manchester Digital60 / IEEE Milestones
timeline.summary_en: On the afternoon of June 21, 1948, the University of Manchester’s Small Scale Experimental Machine (nicknamed "Baby") successfully ran its first program: code written by Tom Kilburn to find the highest factor of 2^18 = 262,144, which executed approximately 3.5 million operations (a commonly cited instruction count, though the exact number is to be verified) over 52 minutes to yield the correct answer of 131,072. This marked the first time in human history that a "program itself" was stored as data in electronic memory, electronically read, and executed. The Baby's memory was the Williams-Kilburn Tube (a cathode-ray tube memory co-invented by Freddie Williams and Tom Kilburn), which stored 2048 bits on a single 6-inch CRT—making it the world’s most effective random-access electronic memory at the time.

timeline.title_zh: Shannon《A Mathematical Theory of Communication》发表
timeline.title_en: Shannon's Mathematical Theory of Communication
timeline.summary_zh:
1948 年 7 月和 10 月，Claude Shannon 在 Bell System Technical Journal 分两期发表 《A Mathematical Theory of Communication》。
论文首次给出"信息"的严格数学定义——信息量等于事件发生概率的对数倒数（H = -Σ p log₂ p），单位是 bit——这个词由同事 John Tukey 提出，Shannon 在本文中首次将其引入印刷文献。
他证明任何通信信道都有一个上限（信道容量 C = W log₂(1+S/N)），并给出 "source coding" 和 "channel coding" 分离定理：压缩和传输可以独立优化而不损失整体最优性。
timeline.source_name: Bell System Technical Journal 27(3):379-423, 27(4):623-656 / IEEE
timeline.summary_en: In July and October 1948, Claude Shannon published "A Mathematical Theory of Communication" in two installments in the *Bell System Technical Journal*. The paper provided the first rigorous mathematical definition of "information"—defining it as the logarithm of the reciprocal of an event's probability (H = -Σ p log₂ p) and measured in "bits," a term coined by colleague John Tukey that Shannon first introduced to printed literature here. Shannon proved that any communication channel has an upper limit (channel capacity C = W log₂(1+S/N)) and established the separation theorem for "source coding" and "channel coding," demonstrating that compression and transmission can be optimized independently without losing overall optimality.

timeline.title_zh: Hebb《The Organization of Behavior》：突触可塑性假说
timeline.title_en: Hebb's The Organization of Behavior
timeline.summary_zh:
1949 年，加拿大心理学家 Donald Hebb 在 McGill 大学出版《The Organization of Behavior》。
他提出一个后来被概括为 "Hebb's rule" 的假说："当细胞 A 的轴突足够接近细胞 B 并反复参与其激发时，A 到 B 的连接会被增强"——通俗表述是 "Cells that fire together, wire together"（一起激发的神经元会连接得更强）。
这是"学习 = 突触强度变化"这一神经网络核心思想的最早系统化陈述。
timeline.source_name: Wiley 1949 / Britannica - Donald O. Hebb
timeline.summary_en: In 1949, Canadian psychologist Donald Hebb published *The Organization of Behavior* at McGill University, proposing the hypothesis later known as "Hebb's rule": when the axon of cell A is close enough to cell B and repeatedly helps fire it, the connection from A to B is strengthened. Colloquially summarized as "cells that fire together, wire together," this was the earliest systematic formulation of the core neural network concept that learning equates to changes in synaptic strength.

timeline.title_zh: Shannon 忒修斯迷宫鼠：机器记忆的最早物理演示
timeline.title_en: Shannon's Theseus Maze-Solving Mouse
timeline.summary_zh:
1950 年，Claude Shannon 在贝尔实验室制作了名为 Theseus（忒修斯）的电子机械鼠，装在 5×5 的迷宫地板下，通过继电器网络记录路径并能在下一次复用：第一次探索时碰壁、试错，第二次进入直接沿记忆的路径直达终点。
这是历史上第一次用机器演示"从经验中学习并改变后续行为"，比 Rosenblatt 感知机早 7 年，也比 Samuel 跳棋早 2 年。
timeline.source_name: Bell Labs / Shannon 1952 demonstration report
timeline.summary_en: In 1950, Claude Shannon created an electromechanical mouse named Theseus at Bell Labs, using a relay network under a 5×5 maze floor to record and reuse its path—bumping into walls and trial-and-error on its first run, then heading straight to the goal on its second. This marked the first time in history a machine demonstrated "learning from experience and modifying subsequent behavior," predating Rosenblatt’s perceptron by 7 years and Samuel’s checkers by 2 years.

timeline.title_zh: Turing《Computing Machinery and Intelligence》：图灵测试的起源
timeline.title_en: Computing Machinery and Intelligence
timeline.summary_zh:
1950 年 10 月，Alan Turing 在哲学期刊《Mind》第 59 卷第 236 期发表《Computing Machinery and Intelligence》（pp. 433-460）。
文章开头拒绝直接定义"机器"和"思考"，转而提出"模仿游戏"（imitation game）：如果一台机器在通过电传打字机进行对话时，能让提问者难以判断对方是人还是机器，是否就应当承认它能"思考"？
这就是后来被称作"图灵测试"（Turing Test）的思想实验。
Turing 在文中预测：到 2000 年，一台 10⁹ 位存储的计算机能在 5 分钟测试中骗过 30% 的裁判。
timeline.source_name: Mind, vol. LIX, no. 236, pp. 433-460 (October 1950)
timeline.summary_en: In October 1950, Alan Turing published "Computing Machinery and Intelligence" (pp. 433-460) in the philosophy journal *Mind*, Vol. 59, No. 236. Opening by declining to directly define "machine" and "think," he instead proposed the "imitation game"—the thought experiment later known as the "Turing Test"—asking whether a machine should be recognized as capable of "thinking" if, when communicating via teleprinter, it makes it difficult for a questioner to determine whether it is human or machine. In the paper, Turing predicted that by 2000, a computer with 10⁹ bits of storage would be able to fool 30% of judges in a 5-minute test.

timeline.title_zh: Prinz 棋程序：第一台商用计算机上的残局求解
timeline.title_en: Prinz Chess Program on the Ferranti Mark 1
timeline.summary_zh:
1951 年 11 月，Dietrich Prinz 在曼彻斯特大学的 Ferranti Mark 1（Manchester Mark 1 的商用版）上运行了第一个能在真实计算机上下完整国际象棋残局的程序。
Prinz 程序能解决"马象对单王"这类残局（具体步数与搜索细节待核对 Prinz 1952《Robot chess》原文），采用 Shannon 1950 年论文提出的 minimax 搜索思路实现。
这是世界上第一个跑在通用电子计算机上的棋类程序，比 Bernstein 1957 年完整棋局程序早 6 年。
timeline.source_name: Prinz, D. (1952). Robot chess. Research, 5, 261-266.
timeline.summary_en: In November 1951, Dietrich Prinz ran the first program capable of playing complete chess endgames on a real computer, utilizing the University of Manchester’s Ferranti Mark 1 (the commercial version of the Manchester Mark 1). Implemented using the minimax search concept from Shannon’s 1950 paper, Prinz's program could solve endgames like knight and bishop against a lone king (specific steps and search details to be verified against the original text of Prinz's 1952 "Robot chess"). This was the world’s first game-playing program run on a general-purpose electronic computer, predating Bernstein’s 1957 full-game program by six years.

timeline.title_zh: Samuel 跳棋程序第一版：IBM 701 上的规则玩家
timeline.title_en: Arthur Samuel's First Checkers Program on IBM 701
timeline.summary_zh:
1952 年，Arthur Samuel 在 IBM 701（IBM 第一台商用电子计算机，vacuum-tube，只生产 19 台）上写出第一个能下完整跳棋的程序。
这一版只能按规则走棋，尚未具备学习能力。
Samuel 之所以选择跳棋而非国际象棋，是因为跳棋的搜索空间虽然仍有 ~5×10²⁰ 种局面，但相对简单，可以聚焦研究"机器如何从对局中改进自己"。
timeline.source_name: Samuel, A. (1959). Some Studies in Machine Learning Using the Game of Checkers. IBM Journal of Research and Development, 3(3), 210-229.
timeline.summary_en: In 1952, Arthur Samuel wrote the first program capable of playing a complete game of checkers on the IBM 701, IBM's first commercial electronic computer—a vacuum-tube machine of which only 19 were ever produced. While this version could only follow the rules and lacked the ability to learn, Samuel chose checkers over chess because its search space, though still spanning ~5×10²⁰ positions, was simple enough to let him focus on how a machine could improve itself through play.

timeline.title_zh: McCarthy-Minsky-Rochester-Shannon 提案："Artificial Intelligence" 一词的首次正式使用
timeline.title_en: A Proposal for the Dartmouth Summer Research Project on Artificial Intelligence
timeline.summary_zh:
1955 年 8 月 31 日，John McCarthy、Marvin Minsky、Nathaniel Rochester（IBM 701 总设计师）和 Claude Shannon 联名向洛克菲勒基金会提交了《A Proposal for the Dartmouth Summer Research Project on Artificial Intelligence》（打字稿，页数待核实）。
提案建议 1956 年夏在达特茅斯学院举办为期 2 个月、10 人参与的"人工智能"暑期研讨会。
这是 "Artificial Intelligence" 一词第一次出现在正式学术文档中。
提案核心论断："学习的每一个方面、智能的任何特征，原则上都可以被精确描述到机器能够模拟的程度"。
timeline.source_name: McCarthy, Minsky, Rochester, Shannon (1955). A Proposal for the Dartmouth Summer Research Project on Artificial Intelligence.
timeline.summary_en: On August 31, 1955, John McCarthy, Marvin Minsky, Nathaniel Rochester (chief designer of the IBM 701), and Claude Shannon jointly submitted "A Proposal for the Dartmouth Summer Research Project on Artificial Intelligence" (typescript, page count to be verified) to the Rockefeller Foundation, marking the first time the term "Artificial Intelligence" appeared in a formal academic document. The proposal pitched a two-month, 10-person summer workshop at Dartmouth College for 1956, built on the core assertion that "every aspect of learning or any other feature of intelligence can in principle be so precisely described that a machine can be made to simulate it."

timeline.title_zh: Selfridge Pandemonium 模型：并行特征检测的思想
timeline.title_en: Selfridge's Pandemonium Model
timeline.summary_zh:
1956 年，Oliver Selfridge（MIT，Dartmouth 参与者之一）提出 Pandemonium（群魔殿）模型——一个由"恶魔"（demons）层级组成的并行模式识别系统：图像恶魔把视网膜输入传给特征恶魔（每个检测一种边缘/曲率），认知恶魔对特征恶魔输出加权求和，决策恶魔选认知恶魔中最高响应者作为分类结果。
论文 1959 年在《Proceedings of the Symposium on the Mechanisation of Thought Processes》正式发表。
timeline.source_name: Selfridge, O. G. (1959). Pandemonium: A paradigm for learning. In Proceedings of the Symposium on Mechanisation of Thought Processes, 511-529.
timeline.summary_en: In 1956, Oliver Selfridge (MIT, one of the Dartmouth participants) proposed the Pandemonium model, a parallel pattern recognition system structured as a hierarchy of "demons." Within this system, image demons pass retinal inputs to feature demons (each detecting a specific edge or curvature), cognitive demons compute a weighted sum of the feature demons' outputs, and a decision demon selects the highest responder among the cognitive demons as the final classification. The paper was officially published in 1959 in the *Proceedings of the Symposium on the Mechanisation of Thought Processes*.

timeline.title_zh: Dartmouth 暑期 AI 研讨会：人工智能作为学科的诞生
timeline.title_en: Dartmouth Summer Research Project on Artificial Intelligence
timeline.summary_zh:
1956 年 6 月 18 日至 8 月 17 日（约 8 周，据 Ray Solomonoff 当年笔记），Dartmouth Summer Research Project on Artificial Intelligence 在新罕布什尔州汉诺威的达特茅斯学院召开。
McCarthy、Minsky、Shannon、Rochester 四人为组织者，实际参与者包括 Ray Solomonoff、Oliver Selfridge、Trenchard More、Arthur Samuel、Allen Newell、Herbert Simon、John Holland 等。
这是 "Artificial Intelligence" 第一次作为正式学科名称出现，被普遍视为 AI 学科的诞生事件。
timeline.source_name: Solomonoff, R. (1956) Dartmouth notes; McCarthy 1956 attendee list to Rockefeller Foundation
timeline.summary_en: From June 18 to August 17, 1956 (lasting about eight weeks, according to Ray Solomonoff's notes from that year), the Dartmouth Summer Research Project on Artificial Intelligence convened at Dartmouth College in Hanover, New Hampshire. Organized by McCarthy, Minsky, Shannon, and Rochester, the workshop's actual participants included Ray Solomonoff, Oliver Selfridge, Trenchard More, Arthur Samuel, Allen Newell, Herbert Simon, John Holland, and others. This marked the first time "Artificial Intelligence" appeared as a formal discipline name, and it is widely regarded as the birth of the AI field.

timeline.title_zh: Logic Theorist 在 Dartmouth 演示：第一个符号 AI 程序
timeline.title_en: Logic Theorist Demonstrated at Dartmouth
timeline.summary_zh:
1956 年 8 月 9 日，Allen Newell 和 Herbert Simon（RAND Corporation）联合程序员 Cliff Shaw，在 Dartmouth 研讨会上远程演示 Logic Theorist 程序。
该程序用 IPL-2（Information Processing Language II）实现，运行在 RAND 的 JOHNNIAC 计算机上，成功证明了 Whitehead 和 Russell《Principia Mathematica》第 2 章前 52 个定理中的 38 个，其中第 2.85 定理找到了比原书更简洁的证明——这是历史上第一个能让人类数学家承认"机器证得更好"的程序。
timeline.source_name: Newell, A., Simon, H. A. (1956). The Logic Theory Machine—A Complex Information Processing System. IRE Transactions on Information Theory, IT-2(3), 61-79.
timeline.summary_en: On August 9, 1956, Allen Newell and Herbert Simon (RAND Corporation), alongside programmer Cliff Shaw, conducted a remote demonstration of the Logic Theorist program at the Dartmouth workshop. Running on RAND's JOHNNIAC computer and written in IPL-2 (Information Processing Language II), the program successfully proved 38 of the first 52 theorems in Chapter 2 of Whitehead and Russell's *Principia Mathematica*. Its proof for Theorem 2.85 was even more concise than the original book's, making it the first program in history to make human mathematicians admit that a "machine proved it better."

timeline.title_zh: General Problem Solver（GPS）：首个目标导向的通用问题求解器
timeline.title_en: General Problem Solver
timeline.summary_zh:
1957 年，Allen Newell、Cliff Shaw、Herbert Simon 在 RAND Corporation 提出通用问题求解器 GPS。
GPS 不像 Logic Theorist 只能证明逻辑定理，而是用"手段-目的分析"（means-ends analysis）把任意问题分解为：当前状态、目标状态、可用算子、差异检测——通过不断"减小当前状态与目标状态之间的差异"来搜索解法。
该程序在 JOHNNIAC 上实现，能解逻辑定理、不定式积分、传教士与食人族过河等多种问题。
timeline.source_name: Newell, A., Shaw, J. C., Simon, H. A. (1959). Report on a general problem-solving program. Proceedings of the International Conference on Information Processing, 256-264.
timeline.summary_en: In 1957, Allen Newell, Cliff Shaw, and Herbert Simon introduced the General Problem Solver (GPS) at the RAND Corporation. Unlike the Logic Theorist, which was limited to proving logical theorems, GPS utilized "means-ends analysis" to break any problem down into a current state, a goal state, available operators, and difference detection, searching for solutions by constantly reducing the gap between the current and goal states. Implemented on the JOHNNIAC, the program successfully solved a wide range of problems, including logical theorems, indefinite integrals, and the missionaries and cannibals puzzle.

timeline.title_zh: Rosenblatt 感知机：可学习神经网络的首次实现
timeline.title_en: Rosenblatt's Perceptron
timeline.summary_zh:
1957 年 Frank Rosenblatt 在纽约 Buffalo 的 Cornell Aeronautical Laboratory（CAL）首次在 IBM 704 上仿真感知机算法（Project PARA），用 50 次训练让机器学会区分打孔卡的左标记与右标记——这是历史上第一次机器通过自身调整权重从例子中学习。
1958 年 7 月，美国海军研究办公室（ONR）在 CAL 公开演示，Rosenblatt 同年发表《The Perceptron: A Probabilistic Model for Information Storage and Organization in the Brain》（Psychological Review, 65(6), 386-408）。
1960 年 6 月 23 日，Mark I Perceptron 硬件演示——400 个光电管+512 个 association unit+8 个 response unit+电动可调电位器构成第一台可学习的物理神经网络机器。
timeline.source_name: Rosenblatt, F. (1958). The Perceptron: A Probabilistic Model for Information Storage and Organization in the Brain. Psychological Review, 65(6), 386-408.
timeline.summary_en: In 1957, Frank Rosenblatt first simulated the perceptron algorithm (Project PARA) on an IBM 704 at the Cornell Aeronautical Laboratory (CAL) in Buffalo, New York, using 50 training runs to teach the machine to distinguish left from right markings on punch cards—the first time in history a machine learned from examples by self-adjusting its weights. In July 1958, the Office of Naval Research (ONR) conducted a public demonstration at CAL, the same year Rosenblatt published "The Perceptron: A Probabilistic Model for Information Storage and Organization in the Brain" (Psychological Review, 65(6), 386-408). On June 23, 1960, the Mark I Perceptron hardware was demonstrated, utilizing 400 photocells, 512 association units, 8 response units, and motorized potentiometers to form the first learning physical neural network machine.

timeline.title_zh: McCarthy 在 MIT 启动 Lisp：早期 AI 的母语诞生
timeline.title_en: McCarthy Begins Lisp Development at MIT
timeline.summary_zh:
1958 年秋，John McCarthy 离开达特茅斯到 MIT 任助理教授，与 Marvin Minsky 共同组建 MIT Artificial Intelligence Project。
McCarthy 试图用 IBM 704 上的 FORTRAN 处理 AI 列表操作（FLPL: FORTRAN List Processing Language），但发现 FORTRAN 缺少递归、条件表达式、动态内存分配——他决定发明一门新语言。
1958 年圣诞节至 1959 年初，他在 MIT 一个人的寒假里写出《Recursive Functions of Symbolic Expressions and Their Computation by Machine, Part I》草稿，首次定义 S-表达式、λ-演算、条件表达式、垃圾回收、eval 元循环解释器——这门语言被命名为 Lisp（LISt Processing）。
1959 年他的学生 Steve Russell 读完论文后说："等等，eval 是可以直接跑的"，于是把 McCarthy 纸上的伪代码敲进 IBM 704——Lisp 第一个真正运行的解释器由此诞生。
1960 年 4 月论文正式发表于 Communications of the ACM。
timeline.source_name: McCarthy, J. (1960). Recursive Functions of Symbolic Expressions and Their Computation by Machine, Part I. Communications of the ACM, 3(4), 184-195.
timeline.summary_en: In the autumn of 1958, John McCarthy left Dartmouth for MIT as an assistant professor to co-found the MIT Artificial Intelligence Project with Marvin Minsky, but after finding that FORTRAN lacked recursion, conditional expressions, and dynamic memory allocation while trying to run AI list operations via FLPL (FORTRAN List Processing Language) on an IBM 704, he decided to invent his own language. During a solitary winter break at MIT from Christmas 1958 to early 1959, McCarthy drafted "Recursive Functions of Symbolic Expressions and Their Computation by Machine, Part I," first defining S-expressions, λ-calculus, conditional expressions, garbage collection, and the eval meta-circular interpreter for a language he named Lisp (LISt Processing). In 1959, his student Steve Russell read the draft, realized that "eval" could actually be run, and coded McCarthy's paper-based pseudocode into the IBM 704 to create Lisp's first working interpreter, prior to the paper’s official publication in the Communications of the ACM in April 1960.

timeline.title_zh: McCarthy Advice Taker 提案：用逻辑让机器推理常识
timeline.title_en: McCarthy's Advice Taker Proposal
timeline.summary_zh:
1958 年 12 月，John McCarthy 在 MIT AI Memo #2 发表《Programs with Common Sense》，提出 Advice Taker 设想——一个"被告知常识后能自己推理"的程序。
他的核心例子：告诉机器"鸟会飞"，它就应推出"麻雀会飞"，除非你告诉它"企鹅不会飞"。
Advice Taker 不需要为每个新事实重写程序，而是用一阶逻辑+推理引擎自动推出结论。
timeline.source_name: McCarthy, J. (1958). Programs with Common Sense. MIT AI Memo #2. In Proceedings of the Teddington Conference on the Mechanization of Thought Processes (1959).
timeline.summary_en: In December 1958, John McCarthy published "Programs with Common Sense" in MIT AI Memo #2, proposing the "Advice Taker"—a program designed to reason on its own after being told common sense. His core example was simple: tell the machine "birds can fly," and it should deduce "sparrows can fly," unless told "penguins cannot fly." Rather than requiring a rewrite for every new fact, the Advice Taker would use first-order logic and an inference engine to automatically derive conclusions.

timeline.title_zh: MIT Artificial Intelligence Project 启动：MIT AI 实验室的源点
timeline.title_en: MIT Artificial Intelligence Project Founded
timeline.summary_zh:
1959 年，John McCarthy 和 Marvin Minsky 在 MIT 共同组建 Artificial Intelligence Project，这是 MIT AI Lab 的最初形态（1963 年并入 MAC Project，1968 年 MAC Project 拆分出独立的 MIT AI Lab，2003 年与 LCS 合并为 CSAIL）。
项目初期由 McCarthy 担任主任，1962 年 McCarthy 离开 MIT 去 Stanford 创办 SAIL 后由 Minsky 接任。
项目最早成员包括 Steve Russell（Lisp 第一个解释器作者）、Bill Gosper、Richard Greenblatt（MacHack 作者）、Joel Moses 等。
timeline.source_name: Winston, P. H. (1981). MIT AI Lab: The First 25 Years (AIM-700).
timeline.summary_en: In 1959, John McCarthy and Marvin Minsky co-founded the Artificial Intelligence Project at MIT, the earliest incarnation of the MIT AI Lab, which merged into the MAC Project in 1963, spun out as an independent lab in 1968, and merged with LCS in 2003 to form CSAIL. McCarthy initially served as director until 1962, when he left MIT for Stanford to found SAIL, handing the reins to Minsky. The project’s earliest members included Steve Russell (author of the first Lisp interpreter), Bill Gosper, Richard Greenblatt (creator of MacHack), and Joel Moses, among others.

timeline.title_zh: Hubel-Wiesel 发现视觉皮层简单/复杂细胞：CNN 的生物学源头
timeline.title_en: Hubel and Wiesel Discover Simple and Complex Cells in Cat Striate Cortex
timeline.summary_zh:
1958 年春，David Hubel 从 Walter Reed Army Institute 跳槽到 Johns Hopkins Hospital Stephen Kuffler 实验室，与同实验室的 Torsten Wiesel 开始合作。
原计划只合作 9 个月（Hubel 等 Mountcastle 实验室装修），结果合作延续 25 年。
他们用钨丝微电极记录猫初级视觉皮层（V1/striate cortex）单细胞放电，意外发现：神经元的最佳刺激不是"光点"（如视网膜和 LGN 那样），而是"特定朝向的亮边或暗条"。
1959 年他们在《Journal of Physiology》发表《Receptive fields of single neurones in the cat's striate cortex》（148(3), 574-591），首次报告 simple cell 概念；
1962 年同一期刊发表《Receptive fields, binocular interaction and functional architecture in the cat's visual cortex》（160, 106-154），系统定义 simple cell 和 complex cell 两类神经元，并提出层级模型：simple cell 接收 LGN 输入聚合形成方向选择性，complex cell 接收 simple cell 输入形成位置不变性。
1981 年两人与 Roger Sperry 共同获得诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。
timeline.source_name: Hubel, D. H., Wiesel, T. N. (1959). Receptive fields of single neurones in the cat's striate cortex. J. Physiology, 148(3), 574-591.
timeline.summary_en: In the spring of 1958, David Hubel left the Walter Reed Army Institute for Stephen Kuffler's lab at Johns Hopkins Hospital, teaming up with Torsten Wiesel for what was supposed to be a nine-month stint during Mountcastle's lab renovation, but turned into a 25-year collaboration. Using tungsten microelectrodes to record single-cell discharges in the cat's primary visual cortex (V1/striate cortex), they accidentally discovered that the optimal stimulus for neurons was not "spots of light" (as in the retina and LGN), but rather "oriented light edges or dark bars." This work led to a 1959 *Journal of Physiology* paper (148(3), 574-591) first reporting the "simple cell" concept, followed by a 1962 paper in the same journal (160, 106-154) that systematically defined simple and complex cells and proposed a hierarchical model—where simple cells pool LGN inputs to form orientation selectivity, and complex cells pool simple cell inputs to achieve position invariance—ultimately earning the duo, alongside Roger Sperry, the 1981 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine.

timeline.title_zh: Gelernter 几何定理证明器：图搜索+反向推理的早期样板
timeline.title_en: Gelernter's Geometry Theorem Prover
timeline.summary_zh:
1959 年，Herbert Gelernter 在 IBM Watson Research Center完成几何定理证明器（Geometry Theorem Prover, GTP），用 FLPL（FORTRAN List Processing Language）在 IBM 704 上实现。
GTP 给定一个几何命题（如"等腰三角形底角相等"），会用反向推理+符号坐标代数生成证明步骤，并用" diagram "——一张根据命题画的示意图——快速剪掉那些在图上明显不成立的子目标。
这是历史上第一个用"视觉/几何直觉"辅助逻辑推理的程序。
timeline.source_name: Gelernter, H. (1959). Realization of a geometry-theorem proving machine. In Proceedings of the International Conference on Information Processing, 273-282.
timeline.summary_en: In 1959, Herbert Gelernter completed the Geometry Theorem Prover (GTP) at the IBM Watson Research Center, implementing it in FLPL (FORTRAN List Processing Language) on an IBM 704. Given a geometric proposition (such as "base angles of an isosceles triangle are equal"), GTP generated proof steps using backward reasoning and symbolic coordinate algebra, utilizing a "diagram"—a schematic drawn based on the proposition—to quickly prune subgoals that were obviously false on the diagram. This was the first program in history to use "visual/geometric intuition" to aid logical reasoning.

timeline.title_zh: Samuel《Some Studies in Machine Learning Using the Game of Checkers》："Machine Learning" 一词的首次学术定义
timeline.title_en: Samuel Coins "Machine Learning" in IBM Journal
timeline.summary_zh:
1959 年 7 月，Arthur Samuel 在《IBM Journal of Research and Development》第 3 卷第 3 期发表《Some Studies in Machine Learning Using the Game of Checkers》（pp. 210-229）。
这是 "Machine Learning" 一词首次以学术方式正式使用，后人常用"让计算机在未被显式编程的情况下学习"来概括 Samuel 的思想（此句为转述，非论文原文逐字）；Samuel 论文中的真实表述是"a computer can be programmed so that it will learn to play a better game of checkers than can be played by the person who wrote the program"。
论文系统描述了跳棋程序的两类学习：rote learning（记棋谱）和 learning by generalization（参数学习），后者实质上就是后来 Sutton & Barto 在《Reinforcement Learning》中定义的 temporal-difference learning。
timeline.source_name: Samuel, A. L. (1959). Some Studies in Machine Learning Using the Game of Checkers. IBM Journal of Research and Development, 3(3), 210-229.
timeline.summary_en: In July 1959, Arthur Samuel published "Some Studies in Machine Learning Using the Game of Checkers" in the *IBM Journal of Research and Development* (Vol. 3, No. 3, pp. 210-229), marking the first formal academic use of the term "Machine Learning." While his concept is frequently paraphrased today as enabling computers to learn without being explicitly programmed, Samuel's original text stated that "a computer can be programmed so that it will learn to play a better game of checkers than can be played by the person who wrote the program." The paper systematically described two types of learning for the checkers program: "rote learning" and "learning by generalization," the latter of which was essentially the "temporal-difference learning" later defined by Sutton & Barto in *Reinforcement Learning*.

timeline.title_zh: NASA「人在环中」之争:Mercury 宇航员 vs 自动控制
timeline.title_en: NASA Human-in-the-Loop Debate (Mercury Program)
timeline.summary_zh:
1961 年,NASA 在 Mercury 计划中面临路线之争:工程师主张全自动飞行(“宇航员是乘客”),宇航员(来自试飞员背景)强烈反对,要求手工操纵权。
最终 Mercury-Atlas 6 (John Glenn, 1962-02-20) 采用“自动为主、人工接管”的混合方案,奠定了之后 Apollo、Gemini、航天飞机的人机协作范式。
这场争论确立了“human-in-the-loop”作为航天控制的核心原则,也间接催生了 1960 年代后期的“人机交互”作为独立学科。
timeline.source_name: NASA Mercury Program records, 1961-1963
timeline.summary_en: In 1961, NASA faced a philosophical rift during Project Mercury: engineers advocated for fully automated flight (treating astronauts as "passengers"), while the astronauts, drawing on their test-pilot backgrounds, fiercely fought for manual control. The compromise came with Mercury-Atlas 6 (John Glenn, 1962-02-20), which adopted a hybrid "primarily automatic, manual takeover" approach that defined the human-machine collaboration paradigm for the subsequent Apollo, Gemini, and Space Shuttle programs. This clash not only established "human-in-the-loop" as a core principle of aerospace control, but also indirectly catalyzed the birth of "human-computer interaction" as an independent discipline in the late 1960s.

timeline.title_zh: Slagle SAINT:第一个专家系统,机器解微积分
timeline.title_en: SAINT: Symbolic Automatic INTegrator
timeline.summary_zh:
1961 年 5 月 13 日,James Slagle 在 MIT 提交博士论文《A Heuristic Program that Solves Symbolic Integration Problems in Freshman Calculus, Symbolic Automatic Integrator (SAINT)》,导师 Marvin Minsky。
SAINT 用 LISP 在 IBM 7090 上实现,采用启发式搜索 + 标准 26 种积分形式 + 18 类变换,像大一学生一样按“试一下→不行再换方法”的方式求解不定积分。
在 54 道 MIT 大一微积分期末考题中,SAINT 解出 52 道(96%),平均每题两分钟。
1963 年 CACM 发表 shortened 版本后被广泛引用。
timeline.source_name: Slagle, J. R. (1961). PhD thesis, MIT; (1963) CACM 6(10):551-558
timeline.summary_en: On May 13, 1961, James Slagle submitted his MIT doctoral thesis, advised by Marvin Minsky, titled "A Heuristic Program that Solves Symbolic Integration Problems in Freshman Calculus, Symbolic Automatic Integrator (SAINT)." Implemented in LISP on an IBM 7090, SAINT solved indefinite integrals like a college freshman using a "try it, and if it fails, try another method" approach, combining heuristic search with 26 standard integration forms and 18 transformations. The program successfully solved 52 of 54 MIT freshman calculus final exam questions (96%) in an average of two minutes per problem, and a shortened version published in CACM in 1963 became widely cited.

timeline.title_zh: Bobrow STUDENT:英文应用题自动求解
timeline.title_en: STUDENT: Natural Language Input for a Computer Problem Solving System
timeline.summary_zh:
1964 年,Daniel Bobrow 在 MIT 完成博士论文《Natural Language Input for a Computer Problem Solving System》(MIT AI Group Technical Report TR-1),并于同年发表在 CACM 7(8):486-492(卷期号与页码待核实)。
STUDENT 把高中代数应用题(英文)解析成方程,再调用 SOLVE 模块求解,失败时通过 REMEMBER 模块补充常识(如“距离等于速度乘时间”),或向用户反问澄清。
Bobrow 把它定义为“受限领域自然语言理解”——和当时的机器翻译思路相反,STUDENT 不追求通用语法,而是在小世界里把语义和推理绑死。
timeline.source_name: Bobrow, D. G. (1964). CACM 7(8):486-492(卷期号与页码待核实); PhD thesis, MIT (TR-1)
timeline.summary_en: In 1964, Daniel Bobrow completed his MIT PhD thesis, "Natural Language Input for a Computer Problem Solving System" (MIT AI Group Technical Report TR-1), published that same year in CACM 7(8):486-492 (volume, issue, and page numbers to be verified). His program, STUDENT, parsed English high school algebra word problems into equations and called a SOLVE module to resolve them, utilizing a REMEMBER module to supply common-sense knowledge (such as "distance equals speed times time") or asking the user clarifying questions upon failure. Bobrow defined this as "restricted-domain natural language understanding"—contrasting with the machine translation trends of the era, STUDENT did not pursue a universal grammar, opting instead to tightly bind semantics and reasoning within a small world.

timeline.title_zh: RAND Tablet:低成本手写图形输入设备
timeline.title_en: RAND Tablet: Low-Cost Handwriting & Graphics Input
timeline.summary_zh:
1964 年,RAND 公司发布 RAND Tablet——一台造价约 18,000 美元的电子手写板,用网格状导线感应笔尖位置,分辨率 100 dpi,刷新率 100 次/秒。
相比同期 Lincoln Labs 的 Tablet，它造价相对低，第一次让普通实验室也能上手做笔输入实验。
MCI、SRI、RAND 的研究者用它做了大量手写识别、图形界面、签名验证研究。
timeline.source_name: Davis, M. R. & Ellis, T. O. (1964). RAND Tablet: A Man-Machine Graphical Communication Device. FJCC.
timeline.summary_en: In 1964, the RAND Corporation released the RAND Tablet, an electronic writing tablet costing about $18,000 that used a grid of wires to sense the stylus tip at a resolution of 100 dpi and a refresh rate of 100 times per second. Relatively cheaper than Lincoln Labs' contemporary tablet, it allowed ordinary labs to run pen-input experiments for the first time. Researchers at MCI, SRI, and RAND used it to conduct extensive studies on handwriting recognition, graphical interfaces, and signature verification.

timeline.title_zh: McCarthy vs Engelbart:AI 与 IA 路线分道
timeline.title_en: McCarthy vs Engelbart — AI and IA Diverge
timeline.summary_zh:
1964 年前后,John McCarthy 和 Douglas Engelbart 分处两地（McCarthy 在斯坦福大学 Stanford University，Engelbart 在隔壁的 SRI 即 Stanford Research Institute，与大学是两个机构）,对“计算机该做什么”产生根本分歧。
McCarthy 主张“让机器变聪明”——AI(Artificial Intelligence),机器应自主完成更多任务。
Engelbart 主张“让人变聪明”——IA(Intelligence Augmentation),机器是放大人类智力的工具。
1968 年 Engelbart 在 FJCC（Fall Joint Computer Conference）做“Mother of All Demos”,展示鼠标、超文本、视频会议——这是 IA 路线的奠基演示。
McCarthy 则在 Stanford 创立 AI Lab(1963-1968),把 AI 推向 Lisp、知识表示、自动推理方向。
timeline.source_name: Engelbart (1962) Augmenting Human Intellect; McCarthy (1963) Stanford AI Project founding
timeline.summary_en: Around 1964, John McCarthy and Douglas Engelbart were working at separate locations—McCarthy at Stanford University, and Engelbart at the neighboring SRI (Stanford Research Institute, a separate institution)—when they developed a fundamental disagreement over "what computers should do." McCarthy championed "making machines smart"—AI (Artificial Intelligence), where machines autonomously complete more tasks—while Engelbart advocated "making humans smart"—IA (Intelligence Augmentation), viewing machines as tools to amplify human intelligence. In 1968, Engelbart delivered the "Mother of All Demos" at the FJCC (Fall Joint Computer Conference), showcasing the mouse, hypertext, and video conferencing in a founding demonstration of the IA path, while McCarthy founded the Stanford AI Lab (1963-1968), pushing AI toward Lisp, knowledge representation, and automated reasoning.

timeline.title_zh: DENDRAL 启动:第一个大型知识驱动专家系统
timeline.title_en: DENDRAL Project: First Knowledge-Intensive Expert System
timeline.summary_zh:
1965 年春,Edward Feigenbaum 刚加入 Stanford 任计算机系创始教员,立刻与诺奖遗传学家 Joshua Lederberg 启动 DENDRAL 项目,目标是让计算机从有机化合物的质谱图反推分子结构。
1966 年 Lederberg 拉入 Carl Djerassi(口服避孕药之父、Stanford 质谱实验室负责人)补齐化学知识。
项目持续到 1982,是史上第一个大型“知识库 + 推理机”专家系统。
核心思想——“程序的能力来自具体领域知识,而不是更聪明的推理”——被称为“知识原理”,1980 年代专家系统工业化的理论基石。
timeline.source_name: Lindsay, Buchanan, Feigenbaum, Lederberg (1993). DENDRAL: A case study. AI Journal 61:209-261.
timeline.summary_en: In the spring of 1965, freshly appointed Stanford computer science founding faculty member Edward Feigenbaum partnered with Nobel laureate geneticist Joshua Lederberg to launch the DENDRAL project, aiming to make computers deduce molecular structures from the mass spectra of organic compounds. In 1966, Lederberg recruited Carl Djerassi—the father of the oral contraceptive pill and head of Stanford's mass spectrometry lab—to provide the crucial chemistry expertise. Running until 1982 as history's first large-scale "knowledge base + inference engine" expert system, its core philosophy that a program's power derives from domain-specific knowledge rather than smarter reasoning was dubbed the "knowledge principle," serving as the theoretical cornerstone for the industrialization of expert systems in the 1980s.

timeline.title_zh: Weizenbaum ELIZA:第一个聊天机器人的诞生
timeline.title_en: ELIZA: A Computer Program for the Study of Natural Language Communication
timeline.summary_zh:
1965 年,Joseph Weizenbaum 在 MIT Project MAC 用 MAD-SLIP 在 IBM 7094 上写出 ELIZA,通过 CTSS 分时系统让多个用户同时与程序对话。
ELIZA 是一个平台:换不同“脚本”就变不同角色。
最有名的脚本是 DOCTOR——模仿 Rogerian 心理治疗师,用“你刚才说...”“这让你想到什么?”等反问模板把用户的话包装成回应。
1966 年 1 月 CACM 9(1):36-45 发表,ELIZA 立刻成为史上第一个被普通用户当作“懂人话”的程序。
timeline.source_name: Weizenbaum, J. (1966). CACM 9(1):36-45
timeline.summary_en: In 1965, Joseph Weizenbaum wrote ELIZA in MAD-SLIP on an IBM 7094 at MIT Project MAC, using the CTSS time-sharing system to allow multiple users to converse with the program simultaneously. Designed as a platform that could adopt different personas by swapping "scripts," its most famous was DOCTOR—which mimicked a Rogerian psychotherapist by repackaging user statements into reflective questions like "You said..." and "What does that make you think of?". Published in January 1966 in *CACM* 9(1):36-45, ELIZA instantly became the first program in history that ordinary users treated as genuinely understanding human language.

timeline.title_zh: Ivakhnenko GMDH:第一个深度学习算法
timeline.title_en: Ivakhnenko's Group Method of Data Handling (GMDH)
timeline.summary_zh:
1965 年,乌克兰控制论学者 Alexey Ivakhnenko 与 Valentin Lapa 发表《Cybernetics and Forecasting Techniques》,提出 GMDH(Group Method of Data Handling,数据群处理法)——第一个能端到端训练深度前馈多层感知机的通用学习算法。
GMDH 用回归分析逐层增长网络,每层用单独验证集做剪枝,1971 年 Ivakhnenko 已实现 8 层深度网络——比西方“深度学习”概念早 30 多年。
timeline.source_name: Ivakhnenko, A. G. & Lapa, V. G. (1965). Cybernetics and Forecasting Techniques. Kiev: Naukova Dumka.
timeline.summary_en: In 1965, Ukrainian cyberneticians Alexey Ivakhnenko and Valentin Lapa published *Cybernetics and Forecasting Techniques*, introducing GMDH (Group Method of Data Handling)—the first general learning algorithm capable of training deep feedforward multilayer perceptrons end-to-end. By using regression analysis to grow the network layer by layer and pruning each layer with a separate validation set, Ivakhnenko had already implemented an 8-layer deep network by 1971, predating the Western concept of "deep learning" by more than 30 years.

timeline.title_zh: Zadeh 模糊集合:让数学承认“差不多”
timeline.title_en: Fuzzy Sets
timeline.summary_zh:
1965 年 6 月,Lotfi Zadeh 在《Information and Control》8(3):338-353 发表《Fuzzy Sets》。
文章定义了“模糊集合”——元素对集合的隶属度不再是 0 或 1,而是 0 到 1 之间的任意实数。
并给出并、交、补等基本运算。
Zadeh 的论点很直接:现实世界中“高”“年轻”“差不多热”这类概念本身就有渐变,经典集合论逼着机器用 0/1 二选一,反而丢掉了人类推理里最关键的灰度信息。
timeline.source_name: Zadeh, L. A. (1965). Information and Control 8(3):338-353
timeline.summary_en: In June 1965, Lotfi Zadeh published "Fuzzy Sets" in *Information and Control* 8(3):338-353, defining "fuzzy sets"—where an element's membership in a set is no longer a binary 0 or 1, but any real number between 0 and 1—and detailing basic operations like union, intersection, and complement. Zadeh’s argument was straightforward: real-world concepts like "tall," "young," and "about hot" are inherently gradual, and forcing machines to make a binary choice between 0 and 1 via classical set theory discards the crucial gray areas of human reasoning.

timeline.title_zh: Amari 用随机梯度下降训练多层感知机
timeline.title_en: Amari's SGD for Multilayer Perceptrons
timeline.summary_zh:
1967 年,甘利俊一(Shun-ichi Amari)在日本发表用随机梯度下降(SGD)训练多层感知机的方法,并在 5 层网络(其中 2 层可修改)上做非线性可分模式分类实验。
这是已知最早的端到端梯度训练多层网络的工作——比 Western 文献中广为引用的 Werbos 1974 反向传播早 7 年,比 Rumelhart-Hinton-Williams 1986 的反向传播普及早近 20 年。
timeline.source_name: Amari, S. (1967). A theory of adaptive pattern classifiers. IEEE Trans. EC-16(3):299-307.
timeline.summary_en: In 1967, Shun-ichi Amari published a method in Japan for training multilayer perceptrons using stochastic gradient descent (SGD), conducting non-linearly separable pattern classification experiments on a 5-layer network (where 2 layers were modifiable). This is the earliest known work on end-to-end gradient training of multilayer networks—predating the widely cited Werbos 1974 backpropagation in Western literature by 7 years, and the popularization of backpropagation by Rumelhart-Hinton-Williams in 1986 by nearly 20 years.

timeline.title_zh: Winograd SHRDLU:积木世界里的“理解”
timeline.title_en: SHRDLU: Understanding Natural Language in a Blocks World
timeline.summary_zh:
1968-1970 年,Terry Winograd 在 MIT 开发 SHRDLU,作为博士论文(1970 完成;论文 1971 年以 MIT AI-TR-235 正式发表)。
程序运行在 DEC PDP-6 上,用 Micro Planner + Lisp 写成,用户通过电传打字机与一个虚拟“积木世界”对话——指令 SHRDLU 把红色方块放到绿色立方体上,问“刚才你拿起的是哪个?”,SHRDLU 会回答、追问、纠正、推理。
1972 年论文以《Understanding Natural Language》出书(Academic Press),被认为是 1970 年代自然语言理解的最高成就。
timeline.source_name: Winograd, T. (1972). Understanding Natural Language. Academic Press. PhD thesis, MIT, 1970.
timeline.summary_en: Between 1968 and 1970, Terry Winograd developed SHRDLU at MIT for his PhD thesis, which was completed in 1970 and officially published in 1971 as MIT AI-TR-235. Running on a DEC PDP-6 and written in Micro Planner and Lisp, the program allowed users to converse with a virtual "blocks world" via teletype—instructing SHRDLU to put a red block on a green cube or asking "which one did you just pick up?" as the system answered, asked follow-up questions, corrected, and reasoned. In 1972, the thesis was published as a book, *Understanding Natural Language* (Academic Press), and went on to be recognized as the crowning achievement of 1970s natural language understanding.

timeline.title_zh: Knuth《The Art of Computer Programming》Vol.1 出版
timeline.title_en: Knuth: The Art of Computer Programming, Vol. 1 (1968)
timeline.summary_zh:
1968 年,Donald Knuth 出版《The Art of Computer Programming》第一卷《Fundamental Algorithms》。
Knuth 计划写 7 卷,到 2024 年只出了 1-4A 卷,但已完成的卷被誉为“算法圣经”,是计算机科学作为独立学科的奠基文献之一。
Knuth 同时启动 TeX 排版项目(1977),其结果 TeX/LaTeX 成为之后 50 年所有科学论文的标准排版工具。
timeline.source_name: Knuth, D. E. (1968). The Art of Computer Programming, Vol. 1. Addison-Wesley.
timeline.summary_en: In 1968, Donald Knuth published *Fundamental Algorithms*, the first volume of *The Art of Computer Programming*. Although Knuth planned for seven volumes, only Volumes 1-4A have been released as of 2024, yet the completed work is hailed as the "bible of algorithms" and stands as a founding text of computer science as an independent discipline. Knuth also launched the TeX typesetting project (1977), resulting in TeX/LaTeX, which became the standard typesetting tool for all scientific papers over the next 50 years.

timeline.title_zh: Engelbart「演示之母」:NLS 与个人计算诞生
timeline.title_en: The Mother of All Demos (Engelbart, 1968-12-09)
timeline.summary_zh:
1968 年 12 月 9 日,Douglas Engelbart 在旧金山 Fall Joint Computer Conference 上做了 90 分钟演示,首次公开展示 NLS(oN-Line System):鼠标、超文本链接、实时文字编辑、屏幕窗口、视频会议、协作文档、版本控制——今天个人计算的所有核心要素。
Engelbart 远程连线 SRI 实验室,让团队现场协作编辑一份结构化文档。
演示被称作“The Mother of All Demos”——之后的 Apple Macintosh 发布(1984)、iPhone 发布(2007)都被视作它的延续。
timeline.source_name: Engelbart, D. (1968). A Research Center for Augmenting Human Intellect. FJCC.
timeline.summary_en: On December 9, 1968, Douglas Engelbart delivered a 90-minute presentation at the Fall Joint Computer Conference in San Francisco, publicly debuting NLS (oN-Line System) to showcase the mouse, hypertext links, real-time text editing, screen windows, video conferencing, collaborative documents, and version control—all the core elements of modern personal computing. Connecting remotely to the SRI lab to collaboratively edit a structured document live with his team, Engelbart pulled off what became legendary as "The Mother of All Demos," a landmark event whose lineage continues through the subsequent launches of the Apple Macintosh (1984) and the iPhone (2007).

timeline.title_zh: SRI Shakey:第一个会推理的移动机器人
timeline.title_en: Shakey: First Mobile Robot with Reasoning
timeline.summary_zh:
1966-1972 年,SRI International(Charles Rosen + Nils Nilsson 团队)开发 Shakey——第一个能感知环境、规划路径、执行动作的自主移动机器人。
1969 年第一版完成:装电视摄像头、激光测距仪、碰撞传感器,通过无线连到 DEC PDP-10/PDP-15 上跑规划与感知。
1971-1972 年 Fikes+Nilsson 发表 STRIPS 规划器,把“动作 = 前提条件 + 删除表 + 添加表”形式化,成为之后 30 年机器人规划的事实标准。
timeline.source_name: Nilsson, N. J. (1984). Shakey the Robot. SRI AI Center Technical Note 323.
timeline.summary_en: From 1966 to 1972, SRI International (led by Charles Rosen and Nils Nilsson) developed Shakey, the first autonomous mobile robot capable of perceiving its environment, planning paths, and executing actions. Completed in 1969, the first version carried a TV camera, a laser rangefinder, and bump sensors, wirelessly connecting to a DEC PDP-10/PDP-15 to run its planning and perception. In 1971-1972, Fikes and Nilsson published the STRIPS planner, formalizing "action = preconditions + delete list + add list" into the de facto standard for robot planning for the next 30 years.

timeline.title_zh: Minsky-Papert《Perceptrons》:神经网络第一次大挫折
timeline.title_en: Perceptrons (Minsky & Papert, MIT Press, 1969)
timeline.summary_zh:
1969 年,Marvin Minsky 和 Seymour Papert 出版《Perceptrons: An Introduction to Computational Geometry》(MIT Press)。
书中用严格数学证明:单层感知机无法表达 XOR、连通性等基本函数,要表达这些函数必须靠多层网络,而多层网络当时没有可用的训练算法。
1988 年扩展版(含 Epilogue)承认原版部分论断被过度外推——但 1969 年原版引发的“神经网络死路”印象已经形成,直接促成 1970 年代第一次 AI 寒冬。
timeline.source_name: Minsky, M. & Papert, S. (1969). Perceptrons. MIT Press.
timeline.summary_en: In 1969, Marvin Minsky and Seymour Papert published *Perceptrons: An Introduction to Computational Geometry* (MIT Press), proving mathematically that single-layer perceptrons could not represent basic functions like XOR or connectivity, which required multi-layer networks that lacked viable training algorithms at the time. While their 1988 expanded edition (including an Epilogue) admitted that some of these claims had been over-extrapolated, the original book had already cemented the impression that neural networks were a dead end, directly triggering the first AI winter of the 1970s.

timeline.title_zh: Minsky 获 ACM Turing Award:AI 第一次拿“计算机诺贝尔”
timeline.title_en: Marvin Minsky Receives ACM Turing Award
timeline.summary_zh:
1969 年,ACM 将图灵奖颁给 Marvin Minsky,表彰他在《Computation: Finite and Infinite Machines》(1967)、《Semantic Information Processing》(1968) 等著作中对计算理论、AI、认知科学的综合贡献。
Minsky 是 AI 领域第一位图灵奖得主,比 Dijkstra(1972)、McCarthy(1971)、Newell-Simon(1975)都早。
timeline.source_name: ACM Turing Award citation, Marvin Minsky, 1969
