timeline.summary_en: In 1969, the ACM awarded the Turing Award to Marvin Minsky, recognizing his comprehensive contributions to computation theory, AI, and cognitive science in works such as *Computation: Finite and Infinite Machines* (1967) and *Semantic Information Processing* (1968). Minsky was the first Turing Award winner in the field of AI, preceding Dijkstra (1972), McCarthy (1971), and Newell-Simon (1975).

timeline.title_zh: IJCAI-1 第一届国际人工智能联合会议
timeline.title_en: First International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI-1)
timeline.summary_zh:
1969 年 5 月 7-9 日,第一届 IJCAI 在华盛顿举行,由 Allen Newell、Marvin Minsky、John McCarthy、Arthur Samuel 等发起,60 多位研究者参加。
会议确立了 AI 作为独立学科的学术共同体身份,首次把分散在 IEEE、ACM、心理学、控制论等领域的 AI 研究者聚到一起。
之后 IJCAI 变成两年一次的旗舰会议,1979 年 AAAI 成立后与之并行。
timeline.source_name: IJCAI-1 Proceedings (1969). Washington, D.C., May 7-9.
timeline.summary_en: From May 7–9, 1969, the inaugural IJCAI was held in Washington, initiated by Allen Newell, Marvin Minsky, John McCarthy, Arthur Samuel, and others, with over 60 researchers in attendance. The event established AI’s identity as an independent academic discipline, bringing together researchers previously scattered across IEEE, ACM, psychology, cybernetics, and other fields. IJCAI subsequently became a biennial flagship conference, running in parallel with AAAI after its founding in 1979.

timeline.title_zh: Linnainmaa 反向模式自动微分
timeline.title_en: Linnainmaa's Reverse-Mode Automatic Differentiation
timeline.summary_zh:
1970 年,芬兰数学家 Seppo Linnainmaa 在赫尔辛基大学硕士论文《The representation of the cumulative rounding error of an algorithm as a Taylor expansion of the local rounding errors》中首次给出反向模式自动微分的完整算法描述,把链式法则从输出端往输入端递归展开,把任意复合函数的偏导数压缩到一次正向 + 一次反向扫描。
这就是后来深度学习训练里“反向传播”的数学本体。
论文本身用 Fortran 做浮点舍入误差分析,只字未提神经网络。
timeline.source_name: Linnainmaa, S. (1970). M.Sc. thesis, University of Helsinki; (1976) BIT 16(2):146-160
timeline.summary_en: In 1970, Finnish mathematician Seppo Linnainmaa first described the complete algorithm for reverse-mode automatic differentiation in his University of Helsinki master’s thesis, *The representation of the cumulative rounding error of an algorithm as a Taylor expansion of the local rounding errors*, recursively expanding the chain rule from output to input to compress the partial derivatives of any composite function into a single forward and backward pass. This became the mathematical essence of "backpropagation" in deep learning training. Yet, the thesis itself used Fortran to analyze floating-point rounding errors and never once mentioned neural networks.

timeline.title_zh: SHRDLU:最早的自然语言理解程序
timeline.title_en: SHRDLU: Natural Language Understanding in a Blocks World
timeline.summary_zh:
1968-1970 年,Terry Winograd 在 MIT 完成博士论文《Procedures as a Representation for Datain a Computer Program for Understanding Natural Language》,1970 年初答辩,1971 年作为 MIT AI TR-235 正式发表。
SHRDLU 让用户用普通英语指挥一个虚拟“积木世界”里的机械臂:“把那个红色方块放到蓝色立方体上”,“刚才你碰过那个金字塔吗”。
程序能理解指代、时态、上下文、规划与回指,并能解释自己的操作理由。
在 1970 年的算力下,它在封闭世界里达成了惊人的语言理解水平。
timeline.source_name: Winograd, T. (1971). MIT AI TR-235; (1972) Cognitive Psychology 3(1):1-191
timeline.summary_en: Between 1968 and 1970, Terry Winograd wrote his MIT doctoral thesis, "Procedures as a Representation for Data in a Computer Program for Understanding Natural Language"—defending it in early 1970 and officially publishing it in 1971 as MIT AI TR-235. His program, SHRDLU, allowed users to command a robotic arm in a virtual "blocks world" using plain English, such as "put that red block on the blue cube" or "did you touch that pyramid just now?" Despite the limited computing power of 1970, it achieved an astonishing level of language understanding within a closed world, handling reference, tense, context, planning, and anaphora, while even explaining the logic behind its actions.

timeline.title_zh: Intel 4004:首颗商用微处理器
timeline.title_en: Intel 4004: First Commercial Microprocessor
timeline.summary_zh:
1971 年 11 月 15 日,Intel 发布 4004 微处理器。
这是全球第一款商用单芯片微处理器,把一台完整中央处理器的逻辑(2300 个晶体管,740 kHz,4 位字长,10 微米工艺)压进 16 针 DIP 封装里。
Federico Faggin、Marcian Hoff、Stanley Mazor 设计,Busicom 计算器是原始客户。
Intel 以 6 万美元从 Busicom 买回 4004 的非独家授权,允许 Intel 把它当通用产品卖。
这是微处理器从“为某个客户定制”变成“通用计算元件”的转折点。
timeline.source_name: Intel 4004 datasheet (1971); Faggin, F. (2009) IEEE Annals of the History of Computing 31(2)
timeline.summary_en: On November 15, 1971, Intel released the 4004, the world's first commercial single-chip microprocessor, which packed the logic of a complete CPU (2300 transistors, 740 kHz, 4-bit word length, 10-micron process) into a 16-pin DIP package. Designed by Federico Faggin, Marcian Hoff, and Stanley Mazor with the Busicom calculator as the original customer, the project became the turning point where microprocessors transitioned from custom-made client chips to universal computing components after Intel bought back the non-exclusive rights from Busicom for $60,000 to sell it as a general-purpose product.

timeline.title_zh: Prolog:逻辑编程语言问世
timeline.title_en: Prolog: First Logic Programming Language
timeline.summary_zh:
1972 年,Alain Colmerauer 和 Philippe Roussel 在马赛大学(Luminy)设计出 Prolog(Programmation en Logique)。
Robert Kowalski 同期在爱丁堡给出 SLD 反驳消解的理论基础,即“算法 = 逻辑 + 控制”。
Prolog 把程序员的角色改成两件事:写事实,写规则,机器自己用反演推理找答案。
1977 年 Warren 在爱丁堡实现首个 Prolog 编译器(DEC-10 Prolog);1983 年又设计了 Warren 抽象机(WAM),成为日后 Prolog 编译的事实标准,在 1980 年代成为欧洲 AI 和日本第五代计算机计划的核心语言。
timeline.source_name: Colmerauer, A. & Roussel, P. (1972); Kowalski, R. (1974) IFIP Congress
timeline.summary_en: In 1972, Alain Colmerauer and Philippe Roussel designed Prolog (Programmation en Logique) at the University of Marseille (Luminy), while Robert Kowalski in Edinburgh established the theoretical foundation of SLD resolution refutation, "Algorithm = Logic + Control." The language shifted the programmer’s job to simply writing facts and rules, leaving the machine to find answers through deductive reasoning. In 1977, Warren implemented the first Prolog compiler (DEC-10 Prolog) in Edinburgh, later designing the Warren Abstract Machine (WAM) in 1983, which became the de facto compilation standard and the core language of European AI and Japan’s Fifth Generation Computer Systems project in the 1980s.

timeline.title_zh: AARON:最早的长周期 AI 艺术系统
timeline.title_en: AARON: Early Long-Running AI Art System
timeline.summary_zh:
1973 年前后,英国艺术家 Harold Cohen 在加州大学圣地亚哥分校(UCSD)开始编写 AARON 绘画程序。
AARON 不是一次性生成器,而是 Cohen 用了 40 多年不断迭代的“合作者”。
早期版本(1970s)用规则在屏幕上画闭合轮廓与色块;1980 年代扩展到毛笔、岩石、植物造型;1990 年代加入色彩决策,程序能自己选颜色。
Cohen 后期让 AARON 直接驱动画布机械臂,真画物理水彩和丙烯。
timeline.source_name: Cohen, H. (1973-2010); Computer History Museum retrospective
timeline.summary_en: Around 1973, British artist Harold Cohen began writing the AARON painting program at the University of California, San Diego (UCSD), creating a "collaborator" he would iteratively develop for over 40 years rather than a simple one-off generator. While 1970s versions used rules to draw closed outlines and color blocks on screens, AARON expanded to brush, rock, and plant forms in the 1980s, and gained color decision-making in the 1990s to choose its own palette. Later on, Cohen had the program directly drive robotic arms to paint physical watercolors and acrylics onto canvas.

timeline.title_zh: WABOT-1:第一台全尺寸人形机器人
timeline.title_en: WABOT-1: First Full-Scale Humanoid Robot
timeline.summary_zh:
1973 年,早稻田大学加藤一郎实验室完成 WABOT-1(WAseda roBOT 1)。
它身高 1.6 米,重 130 公斤,由四个子系统组成:WAMOT-1(机械臂,5 自由度 + 抓持)、WL-5(下肢,液压驱动,静步态行走)、视觉系统(接触 / 触觉 / 简易距离感)、语音系统(简单元音识别和合成)。
走一步大约 45 秒,但能自主完成“看 - 走 - 抓 - 简单对话”闭环。
timeline.source_name: Kato, I. (1973). Waseda Univ. Bioengineering Lab report; humanoid.waseda.ac.jp
timeline.summary_en: In 1973, Ichiro Kato’s laboratory at Waseda University completed WABOT-1 (WAseda roBOT 1). Standing 1.6 meters tall and weighing 130 kilograms, it was composed of four subsystems: WAMOT-1 (a robotic arm with 5 degrees of freedom and gripping), WL-5 (hydraulically driven lower limbs for static gait walking), a vision system (contact, tactile, and simple distance sensing), and a voice system (simple vowel recognition and synthesis). Although it took about 45 seconds to take a single step, it could autonomously complete the closed loop of "seeing, walking, grasping, and simple conversation."

timeline.title_zh: Lighthill 报告:英国 AI 第一次大裁员
timeline.title_en: Lighthill Report: AI General Survey
timeline.summary_zh:
1973 年,英国科学研究委员会(SRC)出版《Artificial Intelligence: a paper symposium》,卷首是 Sir James Lighthill 撰写的《Artificial Intelligence: A General Survey》。
Lighthill 把 AI 分成 A(高级自动化)、B(机器人等搭桥研究)、C(中枢神经系统的计算机模拟)。
他直接批评 A 类(定理证明)和 B 类(机器人)研究在“组合爆炸”面前束手无策,结论是“在所有领域,已取得的发现都没有产生当时承诺的重大影响”。
报告导致英国政府除爱丁堡、苏塞克斯、埃塞克斯三校外,停止对其他大学的 AI 研究资助,直接引发英国第一次 AI 寒冬。
timeline.source_name: Lighthill, J. (1973). Artificial Intelligence: A General Survey. SRC Paper Symposium
timeline.summary_en: In 1973, the British Science Research Council (SRC) published *Artificial Intelligence: a paper symposium*, opening with Sir James Lighthill’s *Artificial Intelligence: A General Survey*. Lighthill divided AI into Category A (advanced automation), Category B (bridge research like robotics), and Category C (computer simulation of the central nervous system), directly criticizing Category A (theorem proving) and Category B (robotics) as helpless against "combinatorial explosion." Concluding that "in no part of the field have the discoveries made so far produced the major impact that was then promised," the report led the British government to halt AI research funding for all universities except Edinburgh, Sussex, and Essex, directly triggering the UK's first AI winter.

timeline.title_zh: Xerox Alto:第一台图形界面个人计算机
timeline.title_en: Xerox Alto: First GUI Personal Computer
timeline.summary_zh:
1973 年 3 月 1 日,Xerox PARC 的 Alto 计算机首次运行。
由 Butler Lampson 提案(1972 年 12 月备忘录),Chuck Thacker 主导硬件设计,Robert Metcalfe 与 David Boggs 发明以太网。
Alto 把“位图显示 + 鼠标 + 三键 + 窗口 + WYSIWYG 文档 + 局域网 + 激光打印机”整合到一台机器里。
这是 Steve Jobs 1979 年参观 PARC 看到的“未来”,直接催生 Apple Lisa 和 Macintosh。
timeline.source_name: Thacker, C. et al. (1979) Xerox Alto; Turing Award 2009
timeline.summary_en: On March 1, 1973, Xerox PARC’s Alto computer ran for the first time; proposed in a December 1972 memo by Butler Lampson, its hardware design was led by Chuck Thacker, while Robert Metcalfe and David Boggs invented Ethernet. The Alto integrated a bitmap display, a mouse, three buttons, windows, WYSIWYG documents, a local area network, and a laser printer into a single machine. This was the "future" Steve Jobs saw during his 1979 visit to PARC, directly spawning the Apple Lisa and Macintosh.

timeline.title_zh: 第一次 AI 寒冬:英美同步降温
timeline.title_en: First AI Winter Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
1973-1974 年,英美 AI 经费同步大砍,构成第一次 AI 寒冬。
英国:Lighthill 报告(1973)导致 SRC 停止对爱丁堡之外多数大学的 AI 资助。
美国:DARPA 1969 年 Mansfield 修正案后必须证明项目“直接军事相关”,1971-1974 年大幅削减 CMU、MIT、SRI、斯坦福的 AI 通用研究经费,1974 年的 DARPA AI 研究预算比 1968 年下降约 30%。
学术界:Minsky 与 Papert《Perceptrons》(1969)被误读为“神经网络已死”,连接主义研究在 70 年代几乎断流。
timeline.source_name: Crevier, G. (1993). AI: The Tumultuous History; McCorduck 2004; Russell & Norvig 3rd ed.
timeline.summary_en: The first AI winter set in during 1973–1974 as the UK and US simultaneously slashed funding: the UK’s Lighthill Report (1973) led the SRC to halt AI funding for most universities except Edinburgh. In the US, the 1969 Mansfield Amendment required projects to be "directly military-related," prompting DARPA to drastically cut general AI research funding at CMU, MIT, SRI, and Stanford between 1971 and 1974, leaving the agency's 1974 AI budget down about 30% compared to 1968. Meanwhile, in academia, Minsky and Papert’s *Perceptrons* (1969) was misread as declaring "neural networks are dead," causing connectionist research to almost completely dry up in the 1970s.

timeline.title_zh: Minsky 框架理论:知识表示的新结构
timeline.title_en: Minsky Frames: A Framework for Representing Knowledge
timeline.summary_zh:
1974 年 6 月,Marvin Minsky 在 MIT AI Lab Memo 306 发表《A Framework for Representing Knowledge》,1975 年收录进 Winston 编辑的《The Psychology of Computer Vision》。
论文提出“框架(Frame)”数据结构:一个框架描述一类刻板场景(如“走进客厅”),顶部是固定信息,底部是若干“槽(slot)”装具体实例,槽有默认值,可被子框架覆盖。
框架之间组成“框架系统”,通过变换表示视角、动作和因果关系。
timeline.source_name: Minsky, M. (1974). MIT-AI Memo 306; (1975) in Winston (ed.) Psychology of Computer Vision
timeline.summary_en: In June 1974, Marvin Minsky published "A Framework for Representing Knowledge" as MIT AI Lab Memo 306, which was later included in the 1975 book *The Psychology of Computer Vision* edited by Winston. The paper proposed the "Frame" data structure to describe stereotyped scenarios (like "entering a living room"), utilizing fixed information at the top and "slots" for specific instances at the bottom, which have default values that subframes can override. Together, these frames form a "frame system" that uses transformations to represent perspectives, actions, and causal relationships.

timeline.title_zh: Werbos 反向传播:深度学习的数学起点
timeline.title_en: Werbos Backpropagation: Beyond Regression (1974 Harvard PhD)
timeline.summary_zh:
1974 年 8 月,Paul Werbos 在哈佛大学通过博士论文答辩,题目《Beyond Regression: New Tools for Prediction and Analysis in the Behavioral Sciences》。
论文第二章首次完整提出用链式法则从输出端往输入端反推偏导,在多层复合函数里“一次正向 + 一次反向”算出所有参数的梯度,并明确指出这套方法可以训练多层神经网络。
这是 backpropagation 算法在西方文献中的首次完整描述。
timeline.source_name: Werbos, P. (1974). Harvard PhD thesis; (1994) Wiley book The Roots of Backpropagation
timeline.summary_en: In August 1974, Paul Werbos defended his PhD thesis at Harvard University, titled *Beyond Regression: New Tools for Prediction and Analysis in the Behavioral Sciences*. In the second chapter, he proposed for the first time in its entirety the use of the chain rule to reverse-propagate partial derivatives from the output to the input, calculating the gradients of all parameters in a multi-layer composite function via "one forward and one backward" pass, and explicitly pointed out that this method could train multi-layer neural networks. This marked the first complete description of the backpropagation algorithm in Western literature.

timeline.title_zh: MYCIN:专家系统进入医学诊断
timeline.title_en: MYCIN: Medical Expert System
timeline.summary_zh:
1974 年 10 月,Edward Shortliffe 在斯坦福提交博士论文《MYCIN: A Rule-Based Computer Program for Advising Physicians Regarding Antimicrobial Therapy Selection》(CS-TR-74-465, AIM-251)。
MYCIN 用 ~600 条产生式规则,把感染科医生判断菌血症、选抗生素的经验编码进 LISP 程序。
它最重要的一项创新是把确定性推理改造成“确定性因子(Certainty Factor)”,在规则之间传递部分置信度,这是当时不确定性推理的代表作。
1979 年 Yu 等人评估:MYCIN 的抗生素选择 65% 被专家评为可接受,高于 9 名人类住院医师的中位数(具体比例与对照人数待核实)。
timeline.source_name: Shortliffe, E. H. (1974). PhD thesis, Stanford CS-TR-74-465; (1975) Comput Biomed Res 8(4)
timeline.summary_en: In October 1974, Edward Shortliffe submitted his Stanford PhD dissertation, "MYCIN: A Rule-Based Computer Program for Advising Physicians Regarding Antimicrobial Therapy Selection" (CS-TR-74-465, AIM-251), introducing a LISP program that encoded infectious disease specialists' expertise in diagnosing bacteremia and selecting antibiotics into roughly 600 production rules. Its key innovation was adapting deterministic reasoning into "Certainty Factors" to propagate partial confidence between rules, serving as a landmark achievement in uncertainty reasoning for the era. In 1979, an evaluation by Yu et al. found that MYCIN's antibiotic selections were deemed acceptable by experts 65% of the time, outperforming the median of nine human residents (though the exact ratio and control count are pending verification).

timeline.title_zh: Altair 8800:个人计算机革命起点
timeline.title_en: Altair 8800: Personal Computer Revolution Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
1974 年 12 月 19 日,《Popular Electronics》1975 年 1 月号上市,封面故事是 Ed Roberts 和 Bill Yates 设计的 Altair 8800 微型计算机套件,封面标题“World's First Minicomputer Kit to Rival Commercial Models”。
整机基于 Intel 8080,套件 439 美元,组装版 621 美元。
Roberts 原本预计卖出 800 台,上市后 1 个月内收到 1000 多订单,MITS 公司从破产边缘翻身。
timeline.source_name: Roberts, H. E. & Yates, W. (1975). Popular Electronics Jan 1975; Computing History
timeline.summary_en: On December 19, 1974, the January 1975 issue of *Popular Electronics* hit newsstands, featuring a cover story on the Altair 8800 microcomputer kit designed by Ed Roberts and Bill Yates under the headline "World's First Minicomputer Kit to Rival Commercial Models." Powered by the Intel 8080, the machine cost $439 as a kit and $621 fully assembled. While Roberts initially expected to sell just 800 units, over 1,000 orders flooded in within a month of its release, pulling MITS back from the brink of bankruptcy.

timeline.title_zh: Holland 遗传算法:把进化变成算法
timeline.title_en: Holland Genetic Algorithm: Adaptation in Natural and Artificial Systems
timeline.summary_zh:
1975 年,密歇根大学 John Holland 出版《Adaptation in Natural and Artificial Systems》,提出遗传算法(Genetic Algorithm)。
GA 把“候选解”编码成二进制串,通过选择、交叉、变异三步迭代,在解空间里做“适者生存”式搜索。
Holland 在书中给出 Schema Theorem,试图从信息论角度证明GA 的“building block”会指数级增长。
1975 年同期的博士 Ken De Jong 用 GA 做函数优化,给出 GA 的首批实验基准。
timeline.source_name: Holland, J. H. (1975). Adaptation in Natural and Artificial Systems. U. Michigan Press
timeline.summary_en: In 1975, the University of Michigan’s John Holland published *Adaptation in Natural and Artificial Systems*, introducing the Genetic Algorithm (GA) to encode "candidate solutions" as binary strings and perform a "survival of the fittest" search through selection, crossover, and mutation. In the book, Holland presented the Schema Theorem to prove from an information-theory perspective that GA "building blocks" grow exponentially, while Ken De Jong, a PhD student at the same time in 1975, used GA for function optimization to establish the algorithm's first experimental benchmarks.

timeline.title_zh: 物理符号系统假说:Newell & Simon Turing 演讲
timeline.title_en: Physical Symbol System Hypothesis (Newell & Simon 1975 Turing Lecture)
timeline.summary_zh:
1975 年 10 月 20 日,Allen Newell 和 Herbert A. Simon 在明尼阿波利斯 ACM 年会上联合接受 1975 年 ACM Turing Award,演讲题为《Computer Science as Empirical Inquiry:Symbols and Search》,1976 年 3 月发表于 CACM 19(3)。
演讲正式提出物理符号系统假说(PSSH):“一个物理符号系统具备产生一般智能行为的必要和充分手段”。
他们把过去 20 年 Logic Theorist、GPS、NSS 的工作总结为两条原则:智能 = 符号操作 + 启发式搜索。
这是符号主义 AI 最完整的纲领性陈述。
timeline.source_name: Newell, A. & Simon, H. A. (1976). CACM 19(3):113-126
timeline.summary_en: On October 20, 1975, Allen Newell and Herbert A. Simon jointly accepted the 1975 ACM Turing Award at the ACM Annual Conference in Minneapolis, delivering the lecture "Computer Science as Empirical Inquiry: Symbols and Search," which was published in March 1976 in CACM 19(3). The address formally proposed the Physical Symbol System Hypothesis (PSSH): "A physical symbol system has the necessary and sufficient means for general intelligent action." By summarizing the past 20 years of work on the Logic Theorist, GPS, and NSS into two principles—intelligence equals symbol manipulation plus heuristic search—they delivered the most complete programmatic statement of symbolic AI.

timeline.title_zh: Lenat AM:机器自动做数学发现
timeline.title_en: Lenat AM: Automated Mathematical Discovery
timeline.summary_zh:
1975-1976 年,Douglas Lenat 在斯坦福完成博士论文《AM: An Artificial Intelligence Approachto Discovery in Mathematics》。
AM 用 ~250 个 Lisp 概念和 ~500 条启发式规则,从空集和集合论公理出发,自动“重新发现”了整数、加法、素数、唯一分解定理等数论概念。
AM 不会证明定理,但能“提出有趣的新概念并给评分”。
这是 AI 史上第一个被认真讨论的“自动发现系统”。
timeline.source_name: Lenat, D. (1976). Stanford PhD; (1977) IJCAI; (1982) Artificial Intelligence 21(1-2)
timeline.summary_en: In 1975-1976, Douglas Lenat completed his Stanford PhD thesis, *AM: An Artificial Intelligence Approach to Discovery in Mathematics*. Using ~250 Lisp concepts and ~500 heuristic rules, AM started from the empty set and set theory axioms to automatically "rediscover" number theory concepts like integers, addition, prime numbers, and the unique factorization theorem. Although unable to prove theorems, it could "propose interesting new concepts and score them," marking it as the first "automated discovery system" to be seriously discussed in the history of AI.

timeline.title_zh: Apple II:个人计算机走入家庭
timeline.title_en: Apple II: Personal Computer Goes Consumer
timeline.summary_zh:
1977 年 4 月,Steve Wozniak 设计的 Apple II 在 West Coast Computer Faire 首次公开展示;6 月 10 日开始正式发售,起价 1298 美元。
Apple II 是第一款大规模商业成功的“开箱即用”个人电脑:主板 + 键盘 + 电源整合在塑料壳内,直接接家用电视当显示器,内置 BASIC 解释器,普通家庭就能上手。
1978 年 5.25 英寸软盘驱动器(DOS 3.1)推出,1980 年 VisiCalc 表格程序上市,Apple II 进入企业市场。
timeline.source_name: Wozniak, S. (1977) Apple II Reference Manual; Apple Inc. history
timeline.summary_en: In April 1977, the Steve Wozniak-designed Apple II made its public debut at the West Coast Computer Faire, officially going on sale on June 10 at a starting price of $1,298. It became the first mass-market, commercially successful "out-of-the-box" personal computer, integrating a motherboard, keyboard, and power supply into a plastic case that plugged directly into a home TV and featured a built-in BASIC interpreter for ordinary families. The system broke into the enterprise market following the launch of a 5.25-inch floppy disk drive (DOS 3.1) in 1978 and the VisiCalc spreadsheet program in 1980.

timeline.title_zh: PROSPECTOR:专家系统找到矿
timeline.title_en: PROSPECTOR: Expert System for Mineral Exploration
timeline.summary_zh:
1976-1980 年,Peter Hart、Richard Duda、Nils Nilsson 在 SRI International 开发 PROSPECTOR,用于辅助地质学家评估矿藏潜力。
1977 年 10 月 20 日 SRI Technical Note 155 公开发表首版系统。
PROSPECTOR 用“推理网络(inference network)”编码地质学家的判断,节点是地质断言,边是 Bayesian 概率传递。
1980 年 PROSPECTOR 推测华盛顿州 Mount Tolman 存在大型钼矿,后续钻探证实了预测,这是 AI 史上首次重大“商业级”预测成功案例。
timeline.source_name: Duda, Hart, Nilsson et al. (1977) SRI TN-155; (1978) SRI Final Report
timeline.summary_en: Between 1976 and 1980, Peter Hart, Richard Duda, and Nils Nilsson at SRI International developed PROSPECTOR to assist geologists in assessing mineral potential, with the system's first version publicly released in SRI Technical Note 155 on October 20, 1977. The system used an "inference network" to encode geological expertise, utilizing nodes for geological assertions and edges for Bayesian probability propagation. In 1980, PROSPECTOR predicted a massive molybdenum deposit at Mount Tolman in Washington State, which subsequent drilling confirmed, marking the first major "commercial-grade" predictive success in AI history.

timeline.title_zh: Anderson BPS:神经联想记忆早期模型
timeline.title_en: Anderson BPS: Brain-State-in-a-Box Associative Memory
timeline.summary_zh:
1977 年 7 月,James Anderson、Jack Silverstein、Stephen Ritz、Richard Jones 在Psychological Review 84(5) 发表《Distinctive Features, Categorical Perception,and Probability Learning: Some Applications of a Neural Model》。
提出 BPS 模型,后称 Brain-State-in-a-Box(BSB),用线性联想记忆 + 反馈 + 阈值函数,让向量在“盒子”里收敛到一个角点,实现“自动补全 / 类别收敛”。
这是 70 年代少数仍坚持神经路线的工作之一。
timeline.source_name: Anderson, Silverstein, Ritz, Jones (1977). Psychological Review 84(5):413-451
timeline.summary_en: In July 1977, James Anderson, Jack Silverstein, Stephen Ritz, and Richard Jones published "Distinctive Features, Categorical Perception, and Probability Learning: Some Applications of a Neural Model" in *Psychological Review* 84(5). The paper introduced the BPS model, later known as Brain-State-in-a-Box (BSB), which used linear associative memory, feedback, and a threshold function to force vectors to converge to a corner inside the "box" to achieve "auto-completion / categorical convergence." It stood as one of the few research efforts during the 1970s that kept the neural network approach alive.

timeline.title_zh: Hofstadter《哥德尔、艾舍尔、巴赫》出版
timeline.title_en: Hofstadter GEB: An Eternal Golden Braid
timeline.summary_zh:
1979 年,Douglas Hofstadter 出版《Gödel, Escher, Bach: An Eternal Golden Braid》(Basic Books,777 页)。
书中通过哥德尔不完备定理、艾舍尔版画、巴赫赋格三个表面无关的领域,提取出共同结构“怪圈(Strange Loop)”:自指、层次缠绕、递归回旋。
Hofstadter 论证“意识”可能源于符号系统达到足够复杂度后的怪圈结构。
1980 年该书获普利策非小说类奖和美国国家图书奖(科学类)。
timeline.source_name: Hofstadter, D. R. (1979). Gödel, Escher, Bach. Basic Books. ISBN 0-465-02656-7
timeline.summary_en: In 1979, Douglas Hofstadter published *Gödel, Escher, Bach: An Eternal Golden Braid* (Basic Books, 777 pages), extracting a common structure called the "Strange Loop"—defined by self-reference, tangled hierarchies, and recursive looping—from the seemingly unrelated domains of Gödel's incompleteness theorem, Escher's prints, and Bach's fugues. Hofstadter argued that "consciousness" might emerge from these strange loop structures once a symbolic system reaches sufficient complexity. In 1980, the book won the Pulitzer Prize for General Nonfiction and the National Book Award (Science).

timeline.title_zh: Stanford Cart:5 小时穿越房间
timeline.title_en: Stanford Cart: 5-Hour Room Crossing
timeline.summary_zh:
1979 年 11 月,Hans Moravec 在斯坦福 AI Lab 完成 Stanford Cart 的标志性演示:在充满障碍物的房间内,小车靠双摄像头立体视觉“看 9 张图 - 选关键点 - 算视差 - 建 3D 地图 - 规划路径 - 走 1 米”循环,花了约 5 小时走完 20 米,中途没撞到任何椅子。
Cart 用一台 DEC KI-10 远程遥控,每轮计算要 15 分钟。
这是 AI 史上第一次让移动机器人在真实 cluttered 室内空间里完成自主导航。
timeline.source_name: Moravec, H. (1980). Stanford AIM-340; (1983) Vision Robot Navigation
timeline.summary_en: In November 1979, Hans Moravec completed a landmark demonstration of the Stanford Cart at the Stanford AI Lab, steering it through an obstacle-filled room using a dual-camera stereo vision loop of taking 9 pictures, selecting keypoints, calculating disparity, building a 3D map, planning a path, and moving 1 meter. Remotely controlled by a DEC KI-10 that required 15 minutes of computation per round, the Cart took about 5 hours to travel 20 meters without hitting any chairs. This marked the first time in AI history that a mobile robot successfully achieved autonomous navigation in a real, cluttered indoor space.

timeline.title_zh: XCON/R1:专家系统首次大规模商用
timeline.title_en: XCON/R1: First Large-Scale Commercial Expert System
timeline.summary_zh:
1978-1980 年,John McDermott 在 CMU 为 DEC 公司开发 R1(后改名 XCON,eXpert CONfigurer)。
1980 年 4 月正式上线,任务是自动配置 VAX-11/780 计算机订单,把销售员勾选的硬件清单转成可投产的连接方案。
R1 用 OPS5 产生式规则编写,初始约 500 条规则,到 1986 年膨胀到上千至上万条。
DEC 报告每年节省约 2500 万美元,几乎消灭了订单配置错误。
XCON 是专家系统商业化时代的旗舰案例,直接催生 1981 年 DEC 内部 40+ 个专家系统项目,以及全球企业跟风上马专家系统的浪潮。
timeline.source_name: McDermott, J. (1982). R1: A rule-based configurer of computer systems. Artificial Intelligence 19(1):39-88
timeline.summary_en: Between 1978 and 1980, John McDermott developed R1 (later renamed XCON, or eXpert CONfigurer) at CMU for DEC, launching it in April 1980 to automatically configure VAX-11/780 computer orders by converting salesperson-selected hardware lists into production-ready connection schemes. Built using OPS5 production rules, the system expanded from about 500 initial rules to thousands to tens of thousands by 1986, saving DEC an estimated $25 million annually and virtually eliminating order configuration errors. As the flagship success story of the commercial expert system era, XCON directly spawned 40+ internal expert system projects at DEC in 1981 and triggered a global wave of enterprises rushing to deploy their own expert systems.

timeline.title_zh: IBM PC:个人计算机标准化
timeline.title_en: IBM Personal Computer Released
timeline.summary_zh:
1981 年 8 月 12 日,IBM 发布 5150 Personal Computer,采用 Intel 8088 处理器(4.77 MHz)、微软 PC DOS 1.0 操作系统、16-256KB 内存。
售价 1565 美元起步,开放架构(open architecture)允许第三方厂商制造兼容机和扩展卡。
Don Estridge 带领的 IBM Boca Raton 实验室用 12 个月完成项目,打破 IBM 内部多年大型机研发节奏。
1982 年 IBM PC 成为《时代》年度机器,1983 年 PC 兼容机市场全面爆发。
timeline.source_name: IBM 5150 announcement (1981-08-12); Estridge, D. IBM Boca Raton
timeline.summary_en: On August 12, 1981, IBM released the 5150 Personal Computer starting at $1,565, featuring an Intel 8088 processor (4.77 MHz), Microsoft PC DOS 1.0, 16-256KB of memory, and an open architecture that allowed third-party manufacturers to build compatible machines and expansion cards. Don Estridge led the IBM Boca Raton lab to complete the project in 12 months, breaking IBM's internal mainframe development pace of many years. The IBM PC became *Time*’s "Machine of the Year" in 1982, and the PC-compatible market fully exploded in 1983.

timeline.title_zh: Hopfield 网络:神经网络复苏的火花
timeline.title_en: Hopfield Network: Revival of Neural Networks
timeline.summary_zh:
1982 年 4 月,Caltech 物理学家 John Hopfield 在 PNAS 79(8):2554-2558 发表《Neural networks and physical systems with emergent collective computational abilities》。
他构造了一个对称全连接的二值神经元网络,并引入“能量函数”的概念,证明网络状态会沿能量梯度下降,最终收敛到吸引子(局部极小)。
把一个记忆存进网络 = 把吸引子刻进能量地形;给网络一个残缺输入 = 让小球滚回最近的洼地。
这一刻神经网络突然有了物理直觉,不再只是心理学模型。
timeline.summary_en: In April 1982, Caltech physicist John Hopfield published "Neural networks and physical systems with emergent collective computational abilities" in *PNAS* 79(8):2554-2558. By constructing a symmetrically fully connected binary neural network and introducing an "energy function," he proved that network states would descend along the energy gradient to converge at an attractor (local minimum). Storing a memory meant carving an attractor into the energy landscape, while feeding the network a partial input was like letting a ball roll back into the nearest depression—suddenly giving neural networks physical intuition, rather than just psychological modeling.

timeline.title_zh: 日本第五代计算机计划:国家级 AI 投入的范式样本
timeline.title_en: Japanese Fifth Generation Computer Systems Project
timeline.summary_zh:
1982 年 4 月,日本通产省(MITI)正式启动"第五代计算机系统(FGCS)"计划,由 ICOT(新一代计算机技术开发研究所)执行,总投入约 570 亿日元(约 3-4 亿美元),为期 10 年。
目标是用 Prolog 作为核心语言,把并行推理硬件化,造出能直接处理知识推理的"第五代计算机",超越冯诺依曼架构。
计划在 1992 年结束,达成硬件原型(PSI、PIM)和 KL1(Kernel Language 1)等 Prolog 编译器,但没有实现预期的"知识信息处理"突破。
timeline.source_name: Feigenbaum, E. A. & McCorduck, P. (1983). The Fifth Generation; ICOT Final Report 1992
timeline.summary_en: In April 1982, Japan's Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) launched the 10-year "Fifth Generation Computer Systems" (FGCS) initiative, executed by the Institute for New Generation Computer Technology (ICOT) with a total investment of roughly 57 billion yen (about $300-400 million). The goal was to bypass the Von Neumann architecture by using Prolog as the core language to implement parallel inference in hardware, building a "fifth-generation computer" capable of directly processing knowledge inference. Although the project concluded in 1992 and yielded hardware prototypes (PSI, PIM) and Prolog compilers like KL1 (Kernel Language 1), it failed to deliver the anticipated breakthrough in "knowledge information processing."

timeline.title_zh: DARPA 战略计算计划:美国国家级 AI 反击
timeline.title_en: DARPA Strategic Computing Initiative
timeline.summary_zh:
1983 年 10 月,DARPA 启动 Strategic Computing Initiative(SCI),为期 10 年,总预算 10 亿美元,是美国对日本 FGCS 计划的直接回应。
SCI 三个支柱:1. 智能武器(自主巡航导弹、坦克火控系统)2. 智能飞行员助手(语音交互、战术规划)3. 智能自主载具(Naval Battle Management)项目资助 CMU、MIT、斯坦福、SRI 等核心 AI 实验室,并推动 MIPS RISC、Warp 并行机、CMU 自主驾驶 Navlab 等硬件平台。
timeline.source_name: Kahn, R. (1983). Strategic Computing Plan, DARPA; Roland & Shiman (2002) Strategic Computing
timeline.summary_en: In October 1983, DARPA launched the Strategic Computing Initiative (SCI), a 10-year, $1 billion program serving as America’s direct response to Japan's FGCS project. The initiative targeted three pillars: autonomous weapons (autonomous cruise missiles, tank fire-control systems), an intelligent pilot associate (voice interaction, tactical planning), and smart autonomous vehicles (Naval Battle Management). It funded core AI labs at CMU, MIT, Stanford, and SRI, while driving hardware platforms like MIPS RISC, the Warp parallel machine, and CMU's autonomous driving Navlab.

timeline.title_zh: Cyc 项目:常识知识库的漫长实验
timeline.title_en: Cyc Project: Long Experiment on Common Sense Knowledge Base
timeline.summary_zh:
1984 年 9 月,Douglas Lenat 在 MCC(Microelectronics and Computer Consortium)启动 Cyc 项目,目标是手工构建覆盖人类常识的百万级知识库。
Cyc 用谓词逻辑表达事实(“水是液体”“人会死”),用规则表达推理(“如果 X 是液体,则 X 会流动”)。
1995 年 Cyc 分拆出 Cycorp 公司,继续独立维护。
到 2024 年 Cyc 累计录入约 250 万条公理、3 万谓词,覆盖日常物理、生物、社会、法律等领域。
timeline.source_name: Lenat, D. B. & Guha, R. V. (1989). Building Large Knowledge-Based Systems; Cycorp 2024
timeline.summary_en: In September 1984, Douglas Lenat launched the Cyc project at the Microelectronics and Computer Consortium (MCC), aiming to manually build a million-scale knowledge base of human common sense. Cyc used predicate logic to represent facts (like "water is liquid" and "humans die") and rules to represent reasoning (such as "if X is a liquid, then X flows"). Spun off into Cycorp in 1995 for independent maintenance, the project had accumulated about 2.5 million axioms and 30,000 predicates by 2024, covering domains like everyday physics, biology, society, and law.

timeline.title_zh: 专家系统商业化受挫:规则维护成本失控
timeline.title_en: Expert System Commercialization Stalls: Rule Maintenance Costs Explode
timeline.summary_zh:
1985 年前后,大量模仿 XCON 的企业级专家系统项目开始集中暴露问题。
核心瓶颈是“知识获取瓶颈(Knowledge Acquisition Bottleneck)”:让工程师坐在医生、律师、地质学家身边,试图把他们的隐性经验拆成规则,几乎不可行。
领域专家自己说不清自己怎么判断,工程师抄出来的规则上线后,遇到边缘案例就崩溃。
XCON 自己的规则库到 1986 年已膨胀到上千至上万条,每条新规则都要检查和旧规则是否冲突,维护成本指数级上升。
timeline.source_name: Feigenbaum, E. A. (1977) IJCAI Keynote; Crevier (1993); Russell & Norvig AIAMA 1.4
timeline.summary_en: Around 1985, numerous enterprise expert system projects mimicking XCON began to face widespread issues, driven by the "Knowledge Acquisition Bottleneck"—the near-impossible task of having engineers shadow doctors, lawyers, and geologists to translate their tacit experience into rules. Domain experts struggled to explain their own decision-making, and the rules engineers transcribed frequently crashed when encountering edge cases in production. By 1986, XCON’s own database had bloated to thousands to tens of thousands of rules, sending maintenance costs soaring exponentially as every new rule had to be checked for conflicts with existing ones.

timeline.title_zh: Quinlan ID3:决策树机器学习的工程起点
timeline.title_en: Quinlan ID3: Engineering Origin of Decision Tree Learning
timeline.summary_zh:
1986 年 3 月,Ross Quinlan 在 Machine Learning 1(1):81-106 发表《Induction of Decision Trees》。
ID3 用信息增益(Information Gain)选择分裂属性,递归构造决策树,把表格数据自动转成可解释的判断规则。
1993 年 Quinlan 扩展为 C4.5,处理连续属性、缺失值、剪枝,C4.5 成为基础机器学习教科书的核心算法。
决策树路线后来在 2001 年 Breiman Random Forest、2014 年 Chen XGBoost、2017 年 Ke LightGBM 上达到工业顶峰。
timeline.source_name: Quinlan, J. R. (1986). Machine Learning 1(1):81-106; (1993) C4.5: Programs for Machine Learning
timeline.summary_en: In March 1986, Ross Quinlan published "Induction of Decision Trees" in *Machine Learning* 1(1):81-106, introducing ID3, which used Information Gain to select splitting attributes and recursively construct decision trees that automatically converted tabular data into interpretable decision rules. Quinlan expanded this in 1993 into C4.5 to handle continuous attributes, missing values, and pruning, cementing it as a foundational algorithm in machine learning textbooks. The decision tree lineage eventually reached its industrial peak with Breiman's Random Forest in 2001, Chen's XGBoost in 2014, and Ke's LightGBM in 2017.

timeline.title_zh: PDP 两卷本:连接主义的认知科学宣言
timeline.title_en: Parallel Distributed Processing: Connectionism Manifesto
timeline.summary_zh:
1986 年 7 月,MIT Press 出版两卷本《Parallel Distributed Processing: Explorations in the Microstructure of Cognition》(Rumelhart, McClelland, PDP Research Group)。
Volume 1: Foundations, Volume 2: Psychological and Biological Models。
PDP 把认知建模、神经网络、心理实验、神经科学统一在一个框架下:知识分布在大量简单单元的连接里,学习 = 调整连接权重,记忆 = 网络状态吸引子,思维 = 多个模块并行协作。
这是连接主义对符号主义的一次正面宣言。
timeline.source_name: Rumelhart, D. E., McClelland, J. L., PDP Research Group (1986). MIT Press, 2 vols
timeline.summary_en: In July 1986, MIT Press published the two-volume *Parallel Distributed Processing: Explorations in the Microstructure of Cognition* (Rumelhart, McClelland, PDP Research Group), consisting of *Volume 1: Foundations* and *Volume 2: Psychological and Biological Models*. The PDP framework unified cognitive modeling, neural networks, psychological experiments, and neuroscience under a single premise: knowledge is distributed across connections of simple units, learning is adjusting connection weights, memory is network state attractors, and thinking is the parallel collaboration of multiple modules. This served as connectionism’s direct manifesto against symbolism.

timeline.title_zh: Rumelhart-Hinton-Williams 反向传播:深度学习的工程起点
timeline.title_en: Rumelhart-Hinton-Williams Backpropagation Paper
timeline.summary_zh:
1986 年 10 月 9 日,Nature 323:533-536 发表《Learning representations by back-propagating errors》(Rumelhart, Hinton, Williams)。
论文把反向模式自动微分明确应用在多层神经网络上,给出干净的可计算梯度公式,让隐藏层权重可以用 SGD 更新。
虽然 Linnainmaa 1970 给过算法、Werbos 1974 在 PhD 里用过,但这篇 Nature 论文让 BP 成为 AI 圈共同语言,是深度学习工程化的真正起点。
timeline.source_name: Rumelhart, D. E., Hinton, G. E., Williams, R. J. (1986). Nature 323:533-536
timeline.summary_en: On October 9, 1986, *Nature* 323:533-536 published "Learning representations by back-propagating errors" (Rumelhart, Hinton, Williams), which explicitly applied reverse-mode automatic differentiation to multilayer neural networks, providing a clean, computable gradient formula to update hidden layer weights via SGD. Although Linnainmaa had proposed the algorithm in 1970 and Werbos used it in his 1974 PhD, this paper made BP the common language of the AI community, marking the true starting point of deep learning engineering.

timeline.title_zh: 第二次 AI 寒冬:LISP 机崩盘与专家系统时代结束
timeline.title_en: Second AI Winter: LISP Machine Collapse and End of Expert System Era
timeline.summary_zh:
1987-1993 年是 AI 史上最长的寒冬,起点是 1987 年下半年 LISP 机市场崩盘。
Symbolics、LMI 两家 LISP 机厂商销售额断崖式下跌,到 1988 年 Symbolics 破产保护,LMI 关闭;通用工作站(Sun、DEC、SGI)在性能价格比上全面碾压专用 LISP 硬件,AI 公司的硬件护城河一夜消失。
顶点是 1991 年 DARPA SCI 计划大幅削减 AI 通用资助,日本 FGCS 1992 年结算失败,结束点是 1993 年专家系统产业产值跌回 1980 年水平。
这六年间,CMU、MIT、斯坦福、SRI 的 AI 实验室经费腰斩,毕业生就业困难,大批研究者转向其他领域。
timeline.source_name: Crevier, G. (1993). AI: The Tumultuous History; Russell & Norvig AIAMA 4th ed Ch 1.4
timeline.summary_en: Triggered by the late-1987 collapse of the LISP machine market, the longest winter in AI history (1987–1993) saw sales at Symbolics and LMI plummet—leading to Symbolics' 1988 bankruptcy filing and LMI's closure—as general-purpose workstations from Sun, DEC, and SGI wiped out AI hardware moats overnight by dominating on price-performance. The crisis peaked when DARPA drastically cut general AI funding for its SCI program in 1991 and Japan’s FGCS concluded in failure in 1992, before finally ending in 1993 when the expert systems industry's output value fell back to 1980 levels. Over these six years, budgets at AI labs across CMU, MIT, Stanford, and SRI were halved, leaving graduates struggling to find jobs and driving a mass exodus of researchers to other fields.

timeline.title_zh: Pearl 贝叶斯网络:让概率推理进入 AI
timeline.title_en: Pearl Bayesian Networks: Probabilistic Reasoning Enters AI
timeline.summary_zh:
1985-1988 年,UCLA 的 Judea Pearl 系统化提出贝叶斯网络(Bayesian Network),1988 年 9 月由 Morgan Kaufmann 出版《Probabilistic Reasoning in Intelligent Systems: Networks of Plausible Inference》。
贝叶斯网络用有向无环图(DAG)表达变量间的条件依赖,节点 = 随机变量,边 = 条件概率关系。
推理 = 在 DAG 上做信念传播(Belief Propagation)。
这把概率推理从模糊的“不确定性”变成可计算、可可视化的结构。
timeline.source_name: Pearl, J. (1988). Probabilistic Reasoning in Intelligent Systems. Morgan Kaufmann; Turing Award 2011
timeline.summary_en: Between 1985 and 1988, UCLA’s Judea Pearl systematized the Bayesian Network, culminating in the September 1988 publication of *Probabilistic Reasoning in Intelligent Systems: Networks of Plausible Inference* by Morgan Kaufmann. By representing conditional dependencies among variables using directed acyclic graphs (DAGs)—where nodes are random variables and edges represent conditional probability relationships—inference is executed through belief propagation on the DAG. This transformed probabilistic reasoning from a vague concept of "uncertainty" into a computable, visualizable structure.

timeline.title_zh: Watkins Q-learning:强化学习的核心算法
timeline.title_en: Watkins Q-learning: Core Algorithm of Reinforcement Learning
timeline.summary_zh:
1989 年,Christopher Watkins 在剑桥大学提交博士论文《Learning from Delayed Rewards》。
提出 Q-learning 算法:智能体在状态 s 下采取动作 a,观察到奖励 r 和下一状态 s',更新 Q(s,a) ← Q(s,a) + α[r + γ max Q(s',a') - Q(s,a)]。
这是 off-policy 时序差分学习的关键形式,在足够探索和衰减学习率下可证明收敛到最优 Q 函数。
Q-learning 与 Sutton 1984/1988 的 TD(λ) 同属时序差分家族,但二者有别:Q-learning 是 off-policy 的动作价值迭代,TD(λ) 是状态价值预测。1992 年 Tesauro 的 TD-Gammon 用的是 TD(λ)(而非 Q-learning)在西洋双陆棋上达到接近顶尖选手水平,让主流重新关注强化学习。
timeline.source_name: Watkins, C. J. C. H. (1989). PhD thesis, University of Cambridge; (1992) Machine Learning 8(3-4)
timeline.summary_en: In 1989, Christopher Watkins submitted his University of Cambridge PhD thesis, *Learning from Delayed Rewards*, introducing the Q-learning algorithm, where an agent in state s takes action a, observes reward r and next state s', and updates Q(s,a) ← Q(s,a) + α[r + γ max Q(s',a') - Q(s,a)]. This key form of off-policy temporal difference learning provably converges to the optimal Q-function given sufficient exploration and a decaying learning rate. Though sharing the temporal difference family with Sutton’s 1984/1988 TD(λ), Q-learning differs as an off-policy action-value iteration rather than a state-value prediction; indeed, it was TD(λ) (not Q-learning) that revived mainstream interest in reinforcement learning when Tesauro’s TD-Gammon used it in 1992 to play backgammon at a level close to top-tier players.

timeline.title_zh: Berners-Lee 提出万维网:AI 的语料基础
timeline.title_en: Berners-Lee Proposes the World Wide Web
timeline.summary_zh:
1989 年 3 月 12 日,Tim Berners-Lee 在 CERN 提交《Information Management: A Proposal》备忘录,提出用超链接把 CERN 内部散落的研究文档连成可浏览网络。
1990 年 12 月他与 Robert Cailliau 提交正式立项书,同月完成第一个 Web 服务器(info.cern.ch)和第一个浏览器(WorldWideWeb)。
1991 年 8 月 6 日 Web 正式对外公开,1993 年 CERN 宣布 Web 免费开放,1994 年 W3C 成立。
timeline.source_name: Berners-Lee, T. (1989). Information Management: A Proposal, CERN; (1990) WorldWideWeb: Proposal
timeline.summary_en: On March 12, 1989, Tim Berners-Lee submitted his "Information Management: A Proposal" memo at CERN, proposing to link the organization's scattered research documents into a browsable network using hyperlinks. In December 1990, he and Robert Cailliau submitted a formal proposal, completing the first Web server (info.cern.ch) and first browser (WorldWideWeb) that same month. The Web officially went public on August 6, 1991, followed by CERN announcing it would be free to everyone in 1993, and the founding of the W3C in 1994.

timeline.title_zh: LeCun 卷积网络:神经网走进银行与邮局
timeline.title_en: LeCun Convolutional Network for Handwriting Recognition
timeline.summary_zh:
1989 年冬,Yann LeCun 等人在 Neural Computation 1(4):541-551 发表《Backpropagation Applied to Handwritten Zip Code Recognition》。
这是第一个真正可用的工业级卷积神经网络,用于 USPS 邮政编码识别,输入 16×16 像素,3 个卷积隐藏层,约 1000 个神经元。
1993 年 LeCun 团队进一步在 AT&T 部署商业版本 LeNet,用于 NCR 的支票自动读取,美国 90% 的支票金额识别都跑在 LeNet 上。
这是神经网络第一次大规模进入生产环境。
timeline.source_name: LeCun, Y. et al. (1989). Neural Computation 1(4):541-551; (1998) Proc. IEEE 86(11)
timeline.summary_en: In the winter of 1989, Yann LeCun et al. published "Backpropagation Applied to Handwritten Zip Code Recognition" in *Neural Computation* 1(4):541-551, introducing the first truly usable, industrial-grade convolutional neural network, which recognized USPS zip codes using a 16x16 pixel input, three convolutional hidden layers, and about 1,000 neurons. By 1993, LeCun's team deployed a commercial version, LeNet, at AT&T for NCR's automatic check reading, with 90% of US check amount recognition running on LeNet. This marked the first time neural networks entered a production environment on a large scale.

timeline.title_zh: TD(λ) 与游戏强化学习路线确立
timeline.title_en: TD(λ) and Game Reinforcement Learning Established
timeline.summary_zh:
1990 年,Gerald Tesauro（IBM Thomas J. Watson 研究中心）在 IJCNN 发表《Neurogammon: A Neural Network Backgammon Program》,程序还赢得 1989 年首届 Computer Olympiad 西洋双陆棋组。
这是第一个用神经网络 + 监督学习达到中等水平西洋双陆棋的程序。
1992 年 8 月 Tesauro 在 AAAI Fall Symposium 报告 TD-Gammon 1.0,用 Sutton 1984 博士论文提出的 TD(λ) 时序差分学习规则,80 个隐藏单元的两层神经网络通过自我对弈约 30 万局,首次达到与人类专家持平的水平(WR 0.81)。
1993 年 TD-Gammon 2.0 加入监督学习预训练,达到世界级水平;1996 年 TD-Gammon 3.0 与世界冠军 Bill Robertie 对弈 100 局,平均每 100 局仅输 1-2 局,接近顶级人类水平。
TD-Gammon 是强化学习第一次在复杂策略游戏中达到人类顶级水平,为 2015 年 DeepMind DQN、2016 年 AlphaGo 铺平道路。
timeline.source_name: Tesauro, G. (1989) Computer Olympiad; (1990) IJCNN; (1992) AAAI Fall Symposium; (1995) Communications of the ACM 38(3):58-68; (1995) Machine Learning 15(3):205-230; Robertie, B. (1998) Inside Backgammon
timeline.summary_en: At IJCNN in 1990, Gerald Tesauro of the IBM Thomas J. Watson Research Center published "Neurogammon: A Neural Network Backgammon Program"—the first system to use neural networks and supervised learning to reach intermediate-level play, which also won the backgammon division at the inaugural 1989 Computer Olympiad. In August 1992, Tesauro presented TD-Gammon 1.0 at the AAAI Fall Symposium; using the TD(λ) temporal difference learning rule from Sutton’s 1984 PhD thesis, its two-layer, 80-hidden-unit neural network played about 300,000 self-play games to match human experts for the first time (WR 0.81), a benchmark later elevated by 1993's world-class TD-Gammon 2.0 (which added supervised pre-training) and 1996's TD-Gammon 3.0, which approached top human levels by losing just 1–2 games per 100 on average against world champion Bill Robertie. As the first instance of reinforcement learning achieving top-tier human performance in a complex strategy game, TD-Gammon paved the way for DeepMind's DQN in 2015 and AlphaGo in 2016.

timeline.title_zh: Loebner Prize 首届图灵测试竞赛
timeline.title_en: First Loebner Prize Turing Test Competition
timeline.summary_zh:
1991 年 11 月 8 日,首届 Loebner Prize 在波士顿计算机博物馆举办。
Hugh Loebner 赞助 10 万美元奖金,目标找一台能在文字对话中骗过人类裁判的机器。
首届冠军是 Joseph Weintraub 的 PC Therapist,靠“心理治疗师”设定回避实质问题,在“陌生人聊天”里骗到 5 名裁判中的 3 名。
Loebner Prize 之后每年举办直到 2019 年,从未有机器达到 Loebner 定义的“完全通过图灵测试”标准。
timeline.source_name: Loebner, H. (1991). Communications of the ACM 34(2); Shieber, S. (1994) AI Magazine 15(3)
timeline.summary_en: On November 8, 1991, the inaugural Loebner Prize was held at the Boston Computer Museum, offering a $100,000 prize sponsored by Hugh Loebner to find a machine that could fool human judges in text-based conversations. The first winner was Joseph Weintraub's PC Therapist, which avoided substantive issues by adopting a "therapist" persona, fooling three out of five judges in a "stranger chat." The competition ran annually until 2019, but no machine ever met Loebner's criteria for "completely passing the Turing test."

timeline.title_zh: Mosaic 1.0 发布:Web 走出学术圈
timeline.title_en: Mosaic 1.0 Released: Web Goes Beyond Academia
timeline.summary_zh:
1993 年 4 月 22 日,NCSA 发布 Mosaic 1.0 for Windows 浏览器,由 Marc Andreessen 和 Eric Bina 在伊利诺伊大学开发。
Mosaic 是第一个支持图文混排、跨平台(Windows/Mac/Unix)、易安装的图形浏览器,把 Web 从 CERN 学术工具变成大众消费品。
1994 年 Andreessen 离开 NCSA 创办 Netscape,1994 年 12 月 Netscape Navigator 1.0 发布,1995 年 8 月 Netscape 上市,Internet 时代正式开启。
timeline.source_name: NCSA Mosaic 1.0 announcement (1993-04-22); Andreessen interviews
timeline.summary_en: On April 22, 1993, NCSA released the Mosaic 1.0 for Windows browser, developed by Marc Andreessen and Eric Bina at the University of Illinois. As the first easy-to-install, cross-platform (Windows/Mac/Unix) graphical browser to support inline text and images, Mosaic transformed the Web from a CERN academic tool into a mass consumer product. In 1994, Andreessen left NCSA to found Netscape, which released Netscape Navigator 1.0 in December 1994 and went public in August 1995, officially ushering in the Internet era.

timeline.title_zh: FERET 推动人脸识别评测基准
timeline.title_en: FERET Database Establishes Face Recognition Evaluation
timeline.summary_zh:
1993-1996 年,美国 DARPA 资助的 FERET(Facial Recognition Technology)项目在 Army Research Lab 收集 14126 张人脸图像,覆盖 1199 人,用于建立人脸识别算法的标准化评测基准。
1996 年 FERET Evaluation Protocol 定义了训练集 / Gallery / Probe 三段评测流程,成为后续 NIST FRVT 评测的母版。
FERET 直接催生 Eigenface、Fisherface、LBP 等经典人脸识别算法,并在 2000 年代演化为 FRGC、FRVT、MegaFace 等大规模评测。
timeline.source_name: Phillips, P. J. et al. (2000). FERET Database; NIST FRVT reports 2002-2024
timeline.summary_en: Between 1993 and 1996, the DARPA-funded FERET (Facial Recognition Technology) program collected 14,126 facial images of 1,199 individuals at the Army Research Lab to establish a standardized benchmark for facial recognition. In 1996, the FERET Evaluation Protocol introduced a three-stage evaluation workflow—Training Set, Gallery, and Probe—which served as the blueprint for subsequent NIST FRVT evaluations. This initiative directly catalyzed classic algorithms like Eigenface, Fisherface, and LBP, before evolving into massive 2000s-era benchmarks such as FRGC, FRVT, and MegaFace.

timeline.title_zh: Schmidhuber 长期记忆网络:神经网络记忆机制探索
timeline.title_en: Schmidhuber Long-Term Memory Network Exploration
timeline.summary_zh:
1995 年前后,Jürgen Schmidhuber 在 IDSIA 团队探索神经网络的长期记忆机制,包括 1991 年 Hochreiter 在他指导下发现梯度消失问题,1995-1997 年 Hochreiter-Schmidhuber 提出 LSTM,1995 年 Schmidhuber 还提出“自指网络(Self-Referential RNN)”让网络能写自己的权重。
Schmidhuber 团队在 90 年代是 RNN 研究的核心之一,和 Sutton、Jordan、Pearlmutter 等少数研究者共同支撑了 RL 和 RNN 的早期工作。
timeline.source_name: Schmidhuber, J. (1992-1997). IDSIA technical reports; Hochreiter master thesis 1991
timeline.summary_en: Around 1995, Jürgen Schmidhuber’s team at IDSIA explored the long-term memory mechanisms of neural networks, which included Hochreiter’s 1991 discovery of the vanishing gradient problem under his guidance, Hochreiter and Schmidhuber's proposal of LSTM from 1995 to 1997, and Schmidhuber’s 1995 introduction of the "Self-Referential RNN" that allowed networks to write their own weights. In the 1990s, Schmidhuber's team was a core hub for RNN research, anchoring early work in RL and RNNs alongside a few other researchers like Sutton, Jordan, and Pearlmutter.

timeline.title_zh: Cortes-Vapnik SVM:统计学习的核心算法
timeline.title_en: Cortes-Vapnik Support Vector Machine
timeline.summary_zh:
1995 年 9 月,Corinna Cortes 和 Vladimir Vapnik 在 Machine Learning 20(3):273-297 发表《Support-Vector Networks》。
SVM 在特征空间中找一个最大间隔超平面分割两类,由距离边界最近的少数“支持向量”决定分类器。
通过核函数(kernel trick)把数据映射到高维空间,SVM 可以处理线性不可分问题。
常用核:线性、多项式、RBF(Gaussian)。
SVM 在 1996-2010 年是机器学习的主力算法,广泛应用于文本分类、生物信息、图像识别、金融风控。
timeline.source_name: Cortes, C. & Vapnik, V. (1995). Machine Learning 20(3):273-297; Vapnik (1995) The Nature of Statistical Learning Theory
timeline.summary_en: In September 1995, Corinna Cortes and Vladimir Vapnik published "Support-Vector Networks" in *Machine Learning* 20(3):273-297, introducing a classifier defined by a few boundary-adjacent "support vectors" that separate two classes using a maximum-margin hyperplane in a feature space. By leveraging the kernel trick—typically using linear, polynomial, or Gaussian RBF kernels—to map data into a high-dimensional space, SVM could successfully resolve linearly inseparable problems. This made SVM the workhorse algorithm of machine learning from 1996 to 2010, finding wide application in text classification, bioinformatics, image recognition, and financial risk control.

timeline.title_zh: Freund-Schapire Boosting:让弱学习器变强
timeline.title_en: Freund-Schapire Boosting Algorithm
timeline.summary_zh:
1996 年 Yoav Freund 和 Robert Schapire 在 COLT 上发表《Game Theory, On-line Prediction and Boosting》,期刊版 1999 年见诸 Games and Economic Behavior 29(1):79-103。
Boosting 算法的核心思想:训练多个“略好于随机”的弱学习器,按错误率加权组合成强学习器。
1997 年 Freund-Schapire 推出 AdaBoost(Adaptive Boosting),论文发表于 Journal of Computer and System Sciences 55(1):119-139。
Viola-Jones 2001 把 AdaBoost 用在人脸检测上,成为 2000-2010 年人脸检测的工业标准。
timeline.source_name: Freund, Y. & Schapire, R. (1996) COLT; (1997) JCSS 55(1):119-139; (1999) Games and Economic Behavior 29(1):79-103
timeline.summary_en: Following Yoav Freund and Robert Schapire's 1996 COLT paper "Game Theory, On-line Prediction and Boosting" (journal version in *Games and Economic Behavior* 29(1):79-103, 1999), which defined "boosting" as combining multiple "slightly better than random" weak learners into a strong learner weighted by error rate, the duo debuted AdaBoost (Adaptive Boosting) in 1997 in the *Journal of Computer and System Sciences* 55(1):119-139. In 2001, Viola-Jones applied AdaBoost to face detection, cementing it as the industry standard for face detection from 2000 to 2010.

timeline.title_zh: IBM 深蓝击败卡斯帕罗夫:AI 的第一次大众胜利
timeline.title_en: IBM Deep Blue Defeats Kasparov
timeline.summary_zh:
1997 年 5 月 11 日,IBM 深蓝(Deep Blue)在纽约衡平中心(Equitable Center)6 局对抗赛中,以 3.5:2.5(2 胜 1 负 3 和)击败国际象棋世界冠军 Garry Kasparov。
深蓝由 Feng-hsiung Hsu、Joe Hoane、Murray Campbell 团队设计,运行在 IBM RS/6000 SP 超级计算机上(30 个节点,480 个专用 VLSI 象棋芯片),每秒搜索 2 亿个局面。
深蓝是“暴力搜索 + 人工评估函数”的极致,不学习,不适应,只靠算力碾压。
timeline.source_name: Hsu, F.-h. (2002). Behind Deep Blue; Campbell, M. et al. (2002) AI Journal 134(1-2):57-83
timeline.summary_en: On May 11, 1997, IBM's Deep Blue defeated world chess champion Garry Kasparov 3.5 to 2.5 (with 2 wins, 1 loss, and 3 draws) in a six-game match at the Equitable Center in New York. Designed by the team of Feng-hsiung Hsu, Joe Hoane, and Murray Campbell, the system ran on an IBM RS/6000 SP supercomputer (configured with 30 nodes and 480 custom VLSI chess chips) that searched 200 million positions per second. As the ultimate realization of brute-force search and hand-crafted evaluation functions, Deep Blue did not learn or adapt, relying entirely on raw computing power to crush its opponent.

timeline.title_zh: IBM ViaVoice:连续语音识别进入消费市场
timeline.title_en: IBM ViaVoice Brings Continuous Speech Recognition to Consumers
timeline.summary_zh:
1997 年 10 月,IBM 发布 ViaVoice Gold,是最早一批面向消费市场的大词汇量连续语音识别(SLVCSR)产品之一(与同年 6–7 月上市的 Dragon NaturallySpeaking 并列,ViaVoice Gold 略晚于 Dragon)。
用户用普通语速说话,无需“字-字-停顿”,ViaVoice 在 Pentium 200MHz PC 上做到每分钟识别 100-140 词,错误率 5-10%(需 5 分钟声纹注册)。
ViaVoice 基于 IBM 30 年 HMM 语音识别积累,从 1971 年 DARPA Speech Understanding Research 项目继承下来。
1999 年 ViaVoice 在中国推出中文版本,是国内第一代语音输入法、银行电话客服的基础。
timeline.source_name: IBM ViaVoice Gold (1997); Jelinek, F. (1997) Statistical Methods for Speech Recognition
timeline.summary_en: In October 1997, IBM released ViaVoice Gold, arriving slightly after Dragon NaturallySpeaking's June–July debut to become one of the first consumer-market large vocabulary continuous speech recognition (SLVCSR) products. Powered by IBM’s 30 years of HMM speech recognition research tracing back to the 1971 DARPA Speech Understanding Research project, it enabled users to speak at normal speeds without pausing between words, delivering 100-140 words per minute with a 5-10% error rate on a Pentium 200MHz PC after a 5-minute voice enrollment. In 1999, IBM launched a Chinese version in China, which became the foundation for the country's first-generation voice input methods and bank telephone customer service systems.

timeline.title_zh: Hochreiter-Schmidhuber LSTM:序列建模的支柱
timeline.title_en: Hochreiter-Schmidhuber LSTM
timeline.summary_zh:
1997 年 11 月 15 日,Sepp Hochreiter 和 Jürgen Schmidhuber 在Neural Computation 9(8):1735-1780 发表《Long Short-Term Memory》。
LSTM 引入“细胞状态 + 输入门 + 输出门 + 恒定误差传送带(CEC)”的结构,解决 RNN 在反向传播中梯度消失问题,让网络能学习跨数百个时间步的长期依赖(1997 年原版只有输入门和输出门;遗忘门由 Gers、Schmidhuber、Cummins 在 2000 年《Learning to Forget》中补充,才形成今天的三门结构)。
LSTM 在 2009-2017 年是序列建模的主力,Google 翻译、Apple Siri、Amazon Alexa 第一代都跑在 LSTM 上,直到 2017 年 Transformer 出现才被替代。
timeline.source_name: Hochreiter, S. & Schmidhuber, J. (1997). Neural Computation 9(8):1735-1780
timeline.summary_en: On November 15, 1997, Sepp Hochreiter and Jürgen Schmidhuber published "Long Short-Term Memory" in *Neural Computation* 9(8):1735-1780, introducing a "cell state + input gate + output gate + Constant Error Carousel (CEC)" structure that solved the vanishing gradient problem in RNN backpropagation and allowed networks to learn long-term dependencies across hundreds of time steps (the 1997 original had only input and output gates, with the forget gate added by Gers, Schmidhuber, and Cummins in the 2000 paper "Learning to Forget" to form today's three-gate architecture). From 2009 to 2017, LSTM served as the workhorse of sequence modeling, powering the first generation of Google Translate, Apple Siri, and Amazon Alexa until the Transformer arrived in 2017 to replace it.

timeline.title_zh: COMPAS 算法上线:算法治理最早典型案例
timeline.title_en: COMPAS Deployed: Earliest Landmark of Algorithmic Governance
timeline.summary_zh:
1998 年 4 月,Northpointe(后改 Equivant)推出COMPAS(Correctional Offender Management Profiling for Alternative Sanctions),用于美国法院量刑建议和假释风险评估。
COMPAS 用 137 个调查问题,把被告分为低/中/高三档再犯风险,法官在量刑时参考 COMPAS 分数。
2013 年 Eric Loomis 案首次把 COMPAS 推上法庭,2016 年 ProPublica 调查报告指出 COMPAS 对黑人被告的误判率是白人的 2 倍,引爆“算法歧视”全球讨论。
timeline.source_name: ProPublica (2016) Machine Bias; Loomis v. Wisconsin (2017) SCOTUS; Equivant COMPAS
timeline.summary_en: In April 1998, Northpointe (later Equivant) launched COMPAS (Correctional Offender Management Profiling for Alternative Sanctions) for sentencing recommendations and parole risk assessments in US courts. Using 137 survey questions, the system categorized defendants into low, medium, or high recidivism risks for judges to reference during sentencing. The Eric Loomis case first brought COMPAS to court in 2013, and a 2016 ProPublica investigative report revealing that its error rate for Black defendants was twice that of white defendants ignited a global debate on "algorithmic bias."

timeline.title_zh: Brin-Page Google:搜索 + 机器学习早期范式
timeline.title_en: Brin-Page Google: Early Search + Machine Learning
timeline.summary_zh:
1998 年 9 月 4 日,Larry Page 和 Sergey Brin 在加州 Menlo Park 车库注册 Google Inc。
Google 核心算法 PageRank 来自两人 1998 年 WWW7 会议论文《The Anatomy of a Large-Scale Hypertextual Web Search Engine》。
PageRank 把网页重要性建模为马尔可夫链的稳态分布,通过迭代计算得到每个页面的“权威度”。
1999-2004 年 Google 把 PageRank + 文本匹配 + 用户行为日志结合,构建了第一个工业级大规模搜索排序系统,直接定义了“机器学习 + 大规模数据 + 在线服务”的工程范式。
timeline.source_name: Brin, S. & Page, L. (1998). WWW7; Google IPO S-1 (2004)
timeline.summary_en: On September 4, 1998, Larry Page and Sergey Brin incorporated Google Inc. in a Menlo Park, California garage, utilizing their core PageRank algorithm from their 1998 WWW7 paper, "The Anatomy of a Large-Scale Hypertextual Web Search Engine." PageRank modeled webpage importance as the stationary distribution of a Markov chain, iteratively calculating each page's "authority." From 1999 to 2004, Google combined PageRank with text matching and user behavior logs to build the first industrial-scale search ranking system, establishing the engineering paradigm of "machine learning + large-scale data + online services."

timeline.title_zh: LeNet-5 论文:卷积网络的工程化文档
timeline.title_en: LeNet-5 Paper: Engineering Documentation of CNNs
timeline.summary_zh:
1998 年 11 月,Yann LeCun、Léon Bottou、Yoshua Bengio、Patrick Haffner 在Proceedings of the IEEE 86(11):2278-2324 发表《Gradient-Based Learning Applied to Document Recognition》。
论文系统化描述 LeNet-5 结构(7 层:Conv-Pool-Conv-Pool-FC-FC-Output),用反向传播端到端训练,直接吃原始像素,用于 MNIST 手写数字识别(错误率 0.95%)和银行支票金额识别。
LeNet-5 论文是 CNN 的工程化教科书,定义了 Conv→Pool→FC 的标准范式,2012 年 AlexNet 本质上是 LeNet-5 放大版 + GPU 训练 + ReLU 激活。
timeline.source_name: LeCun, Y. et al. (1998). Proc. IEEE 86(11):2278-2324; MNIST dataset
timeline.summary_en: In November 1998, Yann LeCun, Léon Bottou, Yoshua Bengio, and Patrick Haffner published "Gradient-Based Learning Applied to Document Recognition" in *Proceedings of the IEEE* 86(11):2278-2324, systematically describing the 7-layer LeNet-5 architecture (Conv-Pool-Conv-Pool-FC-FC-Output) trained end-to-end via backpropagation to process raw pixels directly for MNIST handwritten digit recognition (0.95% error rate) and bank check amount recognition. As the engineering textbook for CNNs, the paper defined the standard Conv→Pool→FC paradigm; 2012's AlexNet was essentially a scaled-up LeNet-5 utilizing GPU training and ReLU activation.

timeline.title_zh: NIST MNIST 数据集:机器学习标准基准
timeline.title_en: NIST MNIST Dataset: Standard ML Benchmark
timeline.summary_zh:
1999 年 9 月,Yann LeCun、Corinna Cortes、Christopher J.C. Burges 发布 MNIST 数据集,源自 NIST SD-3 和 SD-1 手写数字数据,经过混洗、归一化、居中处理,得到 60000 张训练图 + 10000 张测试图,28x28 灰度。
MNIST 把 LeCun 1998 LeNet-5 论文的实验数据集正式独立发布,成为 1999-2015 年机器学习算法的标准入门基准。
MNIST 错误率从 1998 年 LeNet 的 0.95% 一路降到 2012 年 CNN+dropout 的 0.23%,再到 2018 年 Rodriquez-Bengio 团队 0.18%,今天主流模型基本达到 0.20% 以下,MNIST 已基本被“解决”。
timeline.source_name: LeCun, Y. et al. (1998) Proc IEEE 86(11); MNIST database, LeCun.com
timeline.summary_en: In September 1999, Yann LeCun, Corinna Cortes, and Christopher J.C. Burges released the MNIST dataset, which shuffled, normalized, and centered handwritten digit data from NIST SD-3 and SD-1 to produce 60,000 training and 10,000 testing 28x28 grayscale images. This formal, independent release of the experimental dataset from LeCun's 1998 LeNet-5 paper went on to serve as the standard introductory benchmark for machine learning algorithms from 1999 to 2015. Over the years, the MNIST error rate plummeted from LeNet's 0.95% in 1998 to 0.23% using CNN+dropout in 2012, and reached 0.18% by the Rodriquez-Bengio team in 2018; today, with mainstream models consistently scoring below 0.20%, the dataset is considered essentially "solved."

timeline.title_zh: NVIDIA GeForce 256:GPU 时代开启
timeline.title_en: NVIDIA GeForce 256: GPU Era Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
1999 年 10 月 11 日,NVIDIA 发布 GeForce 256,售价 199 美元。
NVIDIA 把它宣传为“世界第一款 GPU(Graphics Processing Unit)”,首次把 Transform、Lighting、Setup、Rendering 四阶段整合到单芯片,支持硬件 T&L,集成 2300 万晶体管,核心 120MHz,显存 64MB DDR。
GeForce 256 同时是消费级显卡和并行计算硬件的开端,为 2006 年 CUDA、2012 年 AlexNet GPU 训练、2017 年 Transformer 大模型奠定算力基础。
timeline.source_name: NVIDIA GeForce 256 press release (1999-10-11); Buck, I. (2004) Stanford PhD
timeline.summary_en: On October 11, 1999, NVIDIA released the GeForce 256 for $199, marketing it as the "world's first GPU (Graphics Processing Unit)" for integrating the four stages of Transform, Lighting, Setup, and Rendering onto a single chip for the first time. Packing 23 million transistors, a 120MHz core, 64MB DDR memory, and hardware T&L support, it marked the beginning of both consumer graphics cards and parallel computing hardware. This breakthrough laid the computational foundation for CUDA in 2006, AlexNet GPU training in 2012, and Transformer large models in 2017.

timeline.title_zh: Nuance Dragon + Google 搜索:语音与机器学习进入消费市场
timeline.title_en: Nuance Dragon + Google Search: Speech and ML Enter Consumer Market
timeline.summary_zh:
2001 年前后,语音识别和搜索排序两条机器学习路线同时进入消费市场。
Nuance Dragon NaturallySpeaking 5.0 在 Pentium 4 PC 上做到连续语音听写,错误率 5-8%(英语),售价 199 美元。
Google 2001 年引入 PageRank + 链接分析的机器学习排序,配合 AdWords(2000-10)开始构建数据驱动广告系统,为后续 2011 年 Google Brain 团队铺路。
2001 年也是 MIT OpenCourseWare 启动的年份,AI 教育资源开始大规模开放,推动后续十年 AI 人才扩张。
timeline.source_name: Nuance Dragon NaturallySpeaking 5.0 (2001); Google AdWords (2000-10); MIT OCW (2001-04)
timeline.summary_en: Around 2001, machine learning entered the consumer market via two parallel tracks: speech recognition—with Nuance Dragon NaturallySpeaking 5.0 delivering continuous English dictation on Pentium 4 PCs with a 5-8% error rate for $199—and search ranking. That same year, Google introduced machine learning ranking combining PageRank and link analysis, pairing it with AdWords (2000-10) to build a data-driven advertising system that paved the way for the Google Brain team in 2011. 2001 also marked the launch of MIT OpenCourseWare, initiating the large-scale opening of AI educational resources that fueled the expansion of AI talent over the following decade.

timeline.title_zh: iRobot Roomba 上市:家用机器人零时刻
timeline.title_en: iRobot Roomba Released: Home Robots Era Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2002 年 9 月 17 日,iRobot 公司推出 Roomba 自动扫地机器人,售价 199 美元。
Roomba 第一代 8 小时充电、1 小时清扫、覆盖 3-4 个房间,用简单的随机游走 + 局部 SLAM 算法 + 红外避障,不需要地图,不需要云端,完全本地决策。
首年销量 50 万台,2004 年突破 100 万台,成为第一款真正大规模进入家庭的机器人。
timeline.source_name: iRobot Roomba launch (2002-09-17); Brooks, R. (1986) IEEE J. Robotics Automation RA-2(1)
timeline.summary_en: On September 17, 2002, iRobot launched the $199 Roomba automatic vacuum cleaning robot, which could cover 3-4 rooms with 1 hour of cleaning on an 8-hour charge. The first-generation device operated entirely on local decision-making without needing maps or the cloud, relying on a simple random walk, a local SLAM algorithm, and infrared obstacle avoidance. Selling 500,000 units in its first year and surpassing 1 million in 2004, it became the first robot to truly enter homes on a massive scale.

timeline.title_zh: LinkedIn + Hinton RBM:社交数据与神经网络同时积累
timeline.title_en: LinkedIn + Hinton RBM: Social Data and Neural Networks Accumulate
timeline.summary_zh:
2003 年 5 月 5 日,Reid Hoffman 在 Mountain View 创办 LinkedIn,为 Web 2.0 时代的社交数据大爆发拉开序幕。
同年 Hinton 在多伦多发表论文《Modeling high-dimensional data with neural networks》,继续在第二次 AI 寒冬最深处坚持 Restricted Boltzmann Machine(RBM)研究。
Hinton 团队 2002-2006 年开发 Contrastive Divergence(CD)训练算法,为 2006 年 Deep Belief Network 突破做最后准备。
timeline.source_name: LinkedIn founding (2003-05-05); Hinton (2003) Modeling high-dimensional data
timeline.summary_en: On May 5, 2003, Reid Hoffman founded LinkedIn in Mountain View, ushering in the Web 2.0 social data explosion. That same year in Toronto, Hinton published the paper "Modeling high-dimensional data with neural networks," persisting with Restricted Boltzmann Machine (RBM) research in the depths of the second AI winter. From 2002 to 2006, Hinton's team developed the Contrastive Divergence (CD) training algorithm, making final preparations for the 2006 Deep Belief Network breakthrough.

timeline.title_zh: Caltech 101 数据集:ImageNet 的前身
timeline.title_en: Caltech 101 Dataset: Precursor to ImageNet
timeline.summary_zh: 李飞飞在加州理工学院创建 Caltech 101 数据集，包含 101 个类别、超 9000 张图像，首次证明数据规模大于算法复杂度。
timeline.summary_en: At Caltech, Fei-Fei Li created the Caltech 101 dataset, featuring 101 categories and over 9,000 images, proving for the first time that data scale outweighs algorithmic complexity.

timeline.title_zh: Spirit/Opportunity 火星车:AI 自主任务系统
timeline.title_en: Spirit/Opportunity Mars Rovers: AI Autonomous Systems
timeline.summary_zh:
2004 年 1 月 4 日,Spirit 火星车在 Gusev 陨石坑着陆,1 月 25 日 Opportunity 在 Meridiani Planum 着陆。
两台火星车设计寿命 90 个火星日,实际运行 6 年(Spirit)和 14 年(Opportunity)。
火星车搭载 NASA JPL 开发的 AI 自主任务系统,包括视觉里程计(Visual Odometry)、自动目标识别(AutoNav)、地形评估和路径规划,能在地球-火星 4-24 分钟通信延迟下自主完成路径选择和科学目标识别。
timeline.source_name: NASA JPL Mars Exploration Rovers Mission; Maimone, M. et al. (2007) J. Field Robotics 24(3)
timeline.summary_en: On January 4, 2004, the Spirit rover landed in Gusev Crater, followed by Opportunity in Meridiani Planum on January 25. While designed for a lifespan of just 90 Martian days, the rovers ultimately operated for 6 years (Spirit) and 14 years (Opportunity). Both were powered by an AI autonomous mission system developed by NASA JPL—incorporating Visual Odometry, automatic target recognition (AutoNav), terrain assessment, and path planning—which allowed them to autonomously select paths and identify scientific targets despite a 4-to-24-minute Earth-Mars communication delay.

timeline.title_zh: Facebook 上线:社交数据基础设施启动
timeline.title_en: Facebook Launched: Social Data Infrastructure Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2004 年 2 月 4 日,Mark Zuckerberg 在哈佛大学宿舍上线 TheFacebook.com,最初限制哈佛学生注册。
2005-2006 年扩展到 Ivy League、所有大学、所有 13 岁以上人群,2006 年 9 月 News Feed 上线,社交数据流动从“主动浏览”转为“被动推送”。
2012 年 5 月 Facebook IPO,估值 1040 亿美元,成为 Web 2.0 时代最大社交数据基础设施。
timeline.source_name: Facebook founding (2004-02-04); Zuckerberg Harvard years
timeline.summary_en: On February 4, 2004, Mark Zuckerberg launched TheFacebook.com from his Harvard dorm room, initially restricting registration to Harvard students. Between 2005 and 2006, the platform expanded to the Ivy League, all universities, and everyone over 13, shifting the flow of social data from "active browsing" to "passive push" with the launch of the News Feed in September 2006. Following its May 2012 IPO at a $104 billion valuation, Facebook became the largest social data infrastructure of the Web 2.0 era.

timeline.title_zh: W3C OWL 标准:语义网的工程尝试
timeline.title_en: W3C OWL Standard: Semantic Web Engineering Attempt
timeline.summary_zh:
2004 年 2 月 10 日,W3C 发布 OWL(Web Ontology Language)推荐标准,由 Tim Berners-Lee 推动的语义网(Semantic Web)项目的核心组件。
OWL 用描述逻辑(Description Logic)在 RDF 三元组之上增加类、属性、约束、推理规则,目标让 Web 内容既能被人读,也能被机器理解。
OWL 2 在 2009 年发布,加入更复杂的表达力。
语义网在 2004-2012 年有过一波工业尝试(Google Rich Snippets、Facebook Open Graph),但大规模机器可读 Web 的愿景最终被 LLM 直接理解自然语言取代。
timeline.source_name: W3C OWL Recommendation (2004-02-10); Berners-Lee et al. (2001) Scientific American
timeline.summary_en: On February 10, 2004, the W3C released the OWL (Web Ontology Language) recommendation, the core component of Tim Berners-Lee's Semantic Web project. Designed to make Web content both human-readable and machine-understandable, OWL used Description Logic to add classes, properties, constraints, and reasoning rules on top of RDF triples, later gaining more complex expressivity with OWL 2 in 2009. While this sparked a wave of industry adoption from 2004 to 2012 through initiatives like Google Rich Snippets and Facebook Open Graph, the vision of a large-scale machine-readable Web was ultimately superseded by LLMs directly understanding natural language.

timeline.title_zh: DARPA Grand Challenge 2004:无人驾驶第一次公开挑战
timeline.title_en: DARPA Grand Challenge 2004: First Public Autonomous Driving Challenge
timeline.summary_zh:
2004 年 3 月 13 日,DARPA 在 Mojave 沙漠举办第一届 Grand Challenge。
赛道 240 公里,奖金 100 万美元,要求无人驾驶车辆 10 小时内完成。
15 支队伍参赛,无人完成,最远的 Carnegie Mellon Sandstorm 跑了 11.78 公里就翻车。
但这次比赛第一次把"无人驾驶"从研究室推到公开竞技场,直接催生 2005 年 Grand Challenge(Stanford Stanley 夺冠,约 6 小时 54 分跑完 132 英里/约 212 公里)和 2007 年 Urban Challenge(CMU Boss 夺冠)。
timeline.source_name: DARPA Grand Challenge 2004 official report; Thrun et al. (2006) Journal of Field Robotics 23(9)
timeline.summary_en: On March 13, 2004, DARPA hosted the inaugural Grand Challenge in the Mojave Desert, offering a $1 million prize for autonomous vehicles to complete a 240-kilometer course within 10 hours. Though 15 teams competed and none finished—with the furthest contender, Carnegie Mellon's Sandstorm, rolling over after just 11.78 kilometers—the race successfully thrust "autonomous driving" from the lab into the public arena for the first time. This landmark event directly catalyzed the 2005 Grand Challenge (won by Stanford's Stanley, which completed the 132-mile/approx. 212-kilometer course in about 6 hours and 54 minutes) and the 2007 Urban Challenge (won by CMU's Boss).

timeline.title_zh: Boston Dynamics BigDog:动态四足机器人突破
timeline.title_en: Boston Dynamics BigDog: Dynamic Quadruped Breakthrough
timeline.summary_zh:
2004 年 12 月,Boston Dynamics 在 DARPA 资助下首次演示 BigDog 四足机器人。
BigDog 重 109 公斤,长 1 米,高 0.7 米,由 Marc Raibert 团队设计(Raibert 1986 年 MIT Leg Lab 创办)。
BigDog 用液压驱动 + 16 个关节 + 姿态控制算法,能携带 50 公斤负载在雪地、碎石、冰面、楼梯上行走,被人侧踢后能恢复平衡。
2008 年 BigDog YouTube 视频超过 1500 万次观看,是 AI 机器人史上第一个 viral 视频。
timeline.source_name: Raibert, M. et al. (2008) BigDog; Boston Dynamics press releases; Raibert (1986) Legged Robots That Balance
timeline.summary_en: In December 2004, DARPA-funded Boston Dynamics first demonstrated the BigDog quadruped robot—a 109 kg, 1-meter-long, and 0.7-meter-tall machine designed by Marc Raibert’s team (Raibert founded the MIT Leg Lab in 1986). Driven by hydraulics, 16 joints, and attitude control algorithms, BigDog could carry a 50 kg payload across snow, gravel, ice, and stairs, and even recover its balance after being kicked from the side. In 2008, a YouTube video of the robot surpassed 15 million views, cementing it as the first viral video in AI robotics history.

timeline.title_zh: Amazon/Netflix 推荐系统:协同过滤的工业高峰
timeline.title_en: Amazon/Netflix Recommender Systems: Industrial Peak of Collaborative Filtering
timeline.summary_zh:
2005 年前后,Amazon 推荐系统和 Netflix Cinematch 推荐系统同时达到工业高峰。
Amazon 用 item-based 协同过滤(Linden et al. 2003 IEEE Internet Computing),在 2005 年处理 2900 万活跃用户 + 数百万商品,推荐贡献 35% 销售额。
Netflix Cinematch 用 100M+ 用户评分预测用户对未看电影的评分,2006 年 Netflix Prize 比赛要求把 RMSE 从 0.9514 降到 0.8563,冠军 100 万美元。
timeline.source_name: Linden, G. et al. (2003) IEEE Internet Computing 7(3); Netflix Prize (2006-2009)
timeline.summary_en: Around 2005, the recommendation systems of Amazon and Netflix's Cinematch simultaneously hit their industrial peaks. Amazon utilized item-based collaborative filtering (Linden et al. 2003 IEEE Internet Computing) to process 29 million active users and millions of products in 2005, with recommendations driving 35% of its sales. Meanwhile, Netflix Cinematch leveraged 100M+ user ratings to predict ratings for unseen movies, culminating in the 2006 Netflix Prize competition, which offered $1 million to the winner who could reduce the RMSE from 0.9514 to 0.8563.

timeline.title_zh: EPFL Blue Brain:脑模拟的长期工程启动
timeline.title_en: EPFL Blue Brain Project: Long-term Brain Simulation Launched
timeline.summary_zh:
2005 年 6 月 15 日,EPFL 神经科学家 Henry Markram 启动 Blue Brain Project,在 IBM Blue Gene 超算上模拟大鼠大脑皮层柱(Cortical Column)。
2005-2015 年项目模拟了约 1 万个神经元、3000 万个突触的皮层柱,2013 年扩展为欧盟 Human Brain Project(HBP),10 亿欧元预算。
HBP 在 2013-2023 年大规模模拟和神经信息基础设施上争议不断,Markram 2018 年离开 HBP,但 Blue Brain 至今仍在 EPFL 运行。
timeline.source_name: Markram, H. (2006) Nature Reviews Neuroscience 7(2); HBP 2013-2023 reports
timeline.summary_en: On June 15, 2005, EPFL neuroscientist Henry Markram launched the Blue Brain Project, simulating a rat cortical column on an IBM Blue Gene supercomputer. From 2005 to 2015, the project simulated a cortical column of about 10,000 neurons and 30 million synapses, expanding in 2013 into the European Union's €1 billion Human Brain Project (HBP). While the HBP was mired in controversy over its large-scale simulations and neuroinformatics infrastructure from 2013 to 2023—leading to Markram's departure in 2018—the Blue Brain Project continues to run at EPFL today.

timeline.title_zh: Dartmouth AI@50 大会:AI 半世纪集体盘点
timeline.title_en: Dartmouth AI@50 Conference: Half-Century Collective Retrospective
timeline.summary_zh:
2006 年 7 月 13-15 日,Dartmouth College 举办 AI@50 大会,纪念 1956 年达特茅斯会议 50 周年。
会议邀请 McCarthy、Minsky、Simon、Newell 等 1956 原班人马,加上 Hinton、LeCun、Bengio、Russell、Norvig 等新一代领军,回顾 AI 50 年的命名、热潮、寒冬、专家系统、统计学习、机器人和重新升温。
会议讨论重点包括:深度学习是否可信、概率 AI vs 符号 AI、AI 伦理、AI 寒冬周期律等。
timeline.source_name: Dartmouth AI@50 Conference (2006-07); McCarthy et al. (2006) AI Magazine 27(4)
timeline.summary_en: From July 13 to 15, 2006, Dartmouth College hosted the AI@50 conference to commemorate the 50th anniversary of the 1956 Dartmouth conference. The event brought together the original 1956 cohort, including McCarthy, Minsky, Simon, and Newell, alongside a new generation of leaders like Hinton, LeCun, Bengio, Russell, and Norvig to reflect on 50 years of AI's naming, hypes, winters, expert systems, statistical learning, robotics, and resurgence. Key discussions focused on the trustworthiness of deep learning, probabilistic AI vs. symbolic AI, AI ethics, and the cyclical patterns of AI winters.

timeline.title_zh: Hinton-Salakhutdinov DBN:深度学习复兴起点
timeline.title_en: Hinton-Salakhutdinov DBN: Deep Learning Revival
timeline.summary_zh:
2006 年 7 月 28 日,Geoffrey Hinton 和 Ruslan Salakhutdinov 在Science 313(5786):504-507 发表《Reducing the Dimensionality of Data with Neural Networks》。
论文用 Restricted Boltzmann Machine 预训练 + 反向传播微调,在 MNIST 上把自编码器降维错误率从 PCA 的 14.8% 降到 6.4%。
这是 Deep Belief Network(DBN)的工程化论文,重新证明多层神经网络可以训练,也正式让“deep learning”一词进入主流。
同年 Hinton 在 NIPS 发表《A Fast Learning Algorithm for Deep Belief Nets》,进一步推广 DBN 训练方法。
timeline.source_name: Hinton, G. E. & Salakhutdinov, R. (2006) Science 313(5786):504-507; Hinton et al. (2006) NIPS
timeline.summary_en: On July 28, 2006, Geoffrey Hinton and Ruslan Salakhutdinov published "Reducing the Dimensionality of Data with Neural Networks" in *Science* 313(5786):504-507, using Restricted Boltzmann Machine pre-training and backpropagation fine-tuning to slash the autoencoder dimensionality reduction error rate on MNIST from PCA's 14.8% to 6.4%. As the engineering paper for Deep Belief Networks (DBN), it proved once again that multi-layer neural networks could be trained, officially pushing the term "deep learning" into the mainstream. That same year, Hinton further popularized the DBN training method by publishing "A Fast Learning Algorithm for Deep Belief Nets" at NIPS.

timeline.title_zh: Netflix Prize 启动:机器学习众包比赛范式
timeline.title_en: Netflix Prize Launched: Crowdsourced ML Competition Paradigm
timeline.summary_zh:
2006 年 10 月 2 日,Netflix 启动 Netflix Prize,公开 1 亿条匿名电影评分(48 万用户 × 1.8 万电影),目标把 Cinematch 的 RMSE 0.9514 降低 10%(到 0.8563),冠军奖金 100 万美元。
比赛历时 3 年,吸引 5169 支队伍、186 个国家 4.1 万参与者,提交 4.4 万次预测。
2009 年 7 月 26 日 BellKor's Pragmatic Chaos 团队(Yehuda Koren、Robert Bell、Chris Volinsky + Martin Chabbert)以 0.8567 RMSE 险胜 The Ensemble,赢得 100 万美元。
timeline.source_name: Netflix Prize (2006-10-02 to 2009-09-21); Bell, Koren, Volinsky (2009) IEEE Computer 42(8)
timeline.summary_en: On October 2, 2006, Netflix launched the Netflix Prize, releasing 100 million anonymous movie ratings (480,000 users × 18,000 movies) and offering a $1 million grand prize to anyone who could improve its Cinematch algorithm's RMSE of 0.9514 by 10% (to 0.8563). The three-year competition attracted 41,000 participants across 5,169 teams from 186 countries, yielding 44,000 prediction submissions. On July 26, 2009, the BellKor's Pragmatic Chaos team (Yehuda Koren, Robert Bell, Chris Volinsky, and Martin Chabbert) narrowly defeated The Ensemble with an RMSE of 0.8567 to claim the $1 million reward.

timeline.title_zh: NVIDIA CUDA 预览:GPU 通用计算开放给开发者
timeline.title_en: NVIDIA CUDA Preview: GPU General Computing Opens to Developers
timeline.summary_zh:
2006 年 11 月 8 日,NVIDIA 在 G80 芯片(GeForce 8800 GTX)发布时同步推出 CUDA(Compute Unified Device Architecture)预览版,让开发者用 C 语言直接编程 GPU 通用计算。
GeForce 8800 GTX 集成 128 个流处理器,核心 575MHz,显存 768MB GDDR3,是第一代支持 CUDA 的硬件。
CUDA 1.0 正式版 2007 年 2 月发布,配合 NVIDIA cuBLAS、cuFFT、cuDNN 等库逐步成熟,成为深度学习算力基础设施。
timeline.source_name: NVIDIA CUDA announcement (2006-11-08); Buck, I. (2004) Stanford PhD BrookGPU
timeline.summary_en: On November 8, 2006, NVIDIA launched a preview of CUDA (Compute Unified Device Architecture) alongside its G80 chip (GeForce 8800 GTX), allowing developers to program GPUs directly for general-purpose computing using C. Packing 128 stream processors, a 575MHz core, and 768MB of GDDR3 memory, the GeForce 8800 GTX was the first-generation hardware to support CUDA. Following the official release of CUDA 1.0 in February 2007, the platform matured alongside libraries like NVIDIA cuBLAS, cuFFT, and cuDNN to become the foundational infrastructure for deep learning compute.

timeline.title_zh: ImageNet 项目启动:1400 万张图像的赌注
timeline.title_en: ImageNet Project Launched: 14M Images Bet
timeline.summary_zh: 2007 年李飞飞在普林斯顿大学启动 ImageNet 项目,计划构建 2.2 万个类别、1400 万张图像的巨型数据集,2009 年在 CVPR 正式发表论文。
timeline.summary_en: In 2007, Fei-Fei Li launched the ImageNet project at Princeton University, aiming to build a massive dataset of 14 million images across 22,000 categories. The paper was officially published at CVPR in 2009.

timeline.title_zh: iPhone 发布:移动互联网与移动 AI 的起点
timeline.title_en: iPhone Launched: Mobile Internet and Mobile AI Era Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2007 年 1 月 9 日,Steve Jobs 在 Macworld 发布 iPhone,6 月 29 日正式上市。
初代 iPhone 集成多点触控、3.5 英寸屏、Wi-Fi、EDGE、200 万像素相机、iOS 1(基于 Mac OS X),售价 499 美元(4GB)/599 美元(8GB)。
2008 年 7 月 App Store 上线,2010 年 iPhone 4 + Retina 屏,iPhone 成为移动互联网时代标准终端。
iPhone 对 AI 的意义在“移动 AI 推理”和“移动端数据采集”两件事:2017 年 Apple A11 仿生芯片集成 Neural Engine,2018 年 Core ML 让 iOS 开发者可以直接跑深度学习模型。
timeline.source_name: Apple iPhone announcement (2007-01-09); Apple A11 Bionic Neural Engine (2017)
timeline.summary_en: On January 9, 2007, Steve Jobs unveiled the iPhone at Macworld before its official release on June 29, packing multi-touch, a 3.5-inch screen, Wi-Fi, EDGE, a 2-megapixel camera, and iOS 1 (based on Mac OS X) for $499 (4GB)/$599 (8GB). The July 2008 launch of the App Store and 2010's iPhone 4 with a Retina display solidified it as the standard terminal of the mobile internet era.
