The iPhone's significance to AI lies in "mobile AI inference" and "on-device data collection"—driven by the Apple A11 Bionic chip integrating the Neural Engine in 2017, and the release of Core ML in 2018, which allowed iOS developers to run deep learning models directly.

timeline.title_zh: NVIDIA CUDA 1.0 正式发布:GPU 走入通用计算
timeline.title_en: NVIDIA CUDA 1.0 Released: GPU Goes General Purpose
timeline.summary_zh:
2007 年 2 月 14 日,NVIDIA 发布 CUDA 1.0 正式版,支持 GeForce 8 系列、Quadro FX 4600/5600、Tesla C870/G80 等硬件。
CUDA 1.0 包含 nvcc 编译器、CUDA Runtime、cuBLAS、cuFFT、CUDA GDB,让 C 语言开发者可以直接在 GPU 上编程矩阵乘、卷积、FFT 等高并行计算。
2007 年也是 NVIDIA Tesla GPU 计算品牌启动的年份,面向 HPC 和 AI 工作负载的专用产品线开始独立。
2007-2010 年 CUDA SDK 逐步完善,2010 年 cuDNN 前身 cuBLAS-XT、2014 年 cuDNN 1.0,成为深度学习框架的底层依赖。
timeline.source_name: NVIDIA CUDA 1.0 release (2007-02-14); NVIDIA Tesla brand launch (2007)
timeline.summary_en: On February 14, 2007, NVIDIA officially released CUDA 1.0—supporting GeForce 8 series, Quadro FX 4600/5600, and Tesla C870/G80 hardware—which featured the nvcc compiler, CUDA Runtime, cuBLAS, cuFFT, and CUDA GDB to let C developers program highly parallel computations like matrix multiplication, convolution, and FFT directly on the GPU. That same year, NVIDIA also launched its Tesla GPU computing brand, establishing a dedicated, independent product line for HPC and AI workloads. As the CUDA SDK was gradually refined between 2007 and 2010, it set the stage for cuDNN's predecessor cuBLAS-XT in 2010 and cuDNN 1.0 in 2014, both of which became the foundational dependencies of deep learning frameworks.

timeline.title_zh: DARPA Urban Challenge:无人驾驶进入城市环境
timeline.title_en: DARPA Urban Challenge: Autonomous Driving Enters Urban Environment
timeline.summary_zh:
2007 年 11 月 3 日,DARPA 在加州 Victorville 举办 Urban Challenge。
赛道 96 公里城市道路,要求无人车遵守交通规则,在路口、环形交叉、并道、超车场景下与其他车辆和人类司机互动。
11 支队伍进入决赛,CMU Boss(Tartan Racing)第一,Stanford Junior 第二,Virginia Tech Odin 第三,MIT Talos 第六。
Boss 用 6 小时 53 分完成 96 公里,平均时速 14 公里。
这是无人车第一次在城市环境跑通完整交通规则。
timeline.source_name: DARPA Urban Challenge 2007 official report; Urmson et al. (2008) J. Field Robotics 25(10)
timeline.summary_en: On November 3, 2007, DARPA held the Urban Challenge in Victorville, California, requiring autonomous vehicles to navigate a 96-kilometer urban course, obey traffic rules, and interact with other vehicles and human drivers at intersections, roundabouts, merging, and overtaking. Out of 11 finalist teams, CMU Boss (Tartan Racing) took first place—completing the 96 km in 6 hours and 53 minutes at an average speed of 14 km/h—followed by Stanford Junior in second, Virginia Tech Odin in third, and MIT Talos in sixth. This marked the first time autonomous vehicles successfully navigated a complete set of traffic rules in an urban environment.

timeline.title_zh: Hadoop + MapReduce + 机器学习:大数据工程范式成熟
timeline.title_en: Hadoop + MapReduce + ML: Big Data Engineering Paradigm Matures
timeline.summary_zh:
2008 年 4 月 Yahoo 发布 Hadoop 0.16,Apache Hadoop 项目正式独立;9 月 Hadoop 0.18 完善 HDFS + MapReduce,成为大数据处理标准。
同年 Google 在 CACM 51(1):107-113 发表 MapReduce 论文工程回顾,Cloudera(2009)、Hortonworks(2011)、MapR(2009)基于 Hadoop 创业,形成完整的大数据生态。
2008-2012 年 Hadoop + Hive + Pig + Mahout + Spark(2010) 让“大规模数据 + 简单机器学习算法”工程范式在互联网公司普及,Google、Facebook、LinkedIn、Twitter、Amazon 都跑着千节点 Hadoop 集群。
timeline.source_name: Dean, J. & Ghemawat, S. (2008) CACM 51(1):107-113; Apache Hadoop 0.18 (2008-09)
timeline.summary_en: In April 2008, Yahoo released Hadoop 0.16 as the Apache Hadoop project officially became independent, followed in September by Hadoop 0.18, which refined HDFS + MapReduce into the standard for big data processing. That same year, Google published its MapReduce paper engineering retrospective in CACM 51(1):107-113, while Cloudera (2009), Hortonworks (2011), and MapR (2009) launched startups based on Hadoop to form a complete big data ecosystem. Between 2008 and 2012, Hadoop + Hive + Pig + Mahout + Spark (2010) popularized the "massive data + simple machine learning algorithms" engineering paradigm across internet companies, with Google, Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter, and Amazon all running thousand-node Hadoop clusters.

timeline.title_zh: Google Chrome 发布:Web 浏览器再革命
timeline.title_en: Google Chrome Released: Web Browser Revolution
timeline.summary_zh:
2008 年 9 月 2 日,Google 发布 Chrome 1.0 浏览器。
Chrome 用 V8 JavaScript 引擎(2010 年引入 Crankshaft JIT 优化编译器)突破 JS 性能瓶颈,用多进程架构隔离 Tab,用 Webkit(2013 年改 Blink)渲染引擎提高兼容性。
Chrome 2009 年 12 月超越 Safari,2010-2012 年超越 Firefox,2016 年超越 IE,2024 年全球市场份额 65%。
Chrome 对 AI 的意义是“Web 作为应用平台 + 数据采集层”:Web 应用从“静态页面”演化到“SPA + 持久化客户端”,为后续 LLM 圈的 Web Agent、ChatGPT Web 客户端、Notion AI 等基于 Web 的 AI 应用提供工程基础。
timeline.source_name: Google Chrome 1.0 release (2008-09-02); V8 engine (2008)
timeline.summary_en: On September 2, 2008, Google released Chrome 1.0, breaking JS performance bottlenecks with its V8 JavaScript engine (which added the Crankshaft JIT optimizing compiler in 2010), isolating tabs via a multi-process architecture, and leveraging the Webkit rendering engine (switched to Blink in 2013) to improve compatibility. The browser went on to overtake Safari in December 2009, Firefox between 2010 and 2012, and IE in 2016, ultimately commanding a 65% global market share by 2024. For AI, Chrome’s true significance lies in establishing "the Web as an application platform + data collection layer," driving the evolution of web apps from "static pages" to "SPAs + persistent clients" and paving the engineering foundation for LLM-era Web Agents, the ChatGPT web client, and Notion AI.

timeline.title_zh: Google Project Chauffeur:工业级自动驾驶启动
timeline.title_en: Google Project Chauffeur: Industrial Autonomous Driving Launched
timeline.summary_zh:
2009 年 1 月 17 日,Google X 启动 Project Chauffeur 自动驾驶项目,Sebastian Thrun(Stanford Junior 团队领军)和 Chris Urmson(CMU Boss 团队领军)共同主导。
团队最初 10 人,包括 DARPA Grand Challenge 老将 Mike Montemerlo、Anthony Levandowski、Bryan Salesky 等。
2010 年 10 月第一代无人车 Toyota Prius 改装版在旧金山公开路测,2012 年 5 月 Nevada 颁发第一张无人车牌照。
2016 年 12 月项目分拆为 Waymo 独立子公司,John Krafcik 任 CEO。
timeline.source_name: Google Project Chauffeur (2009-01); Waymo 2016 spin-off; Thrun interviews
timeline.summary_en: On January 17, 2009, Google X launched its Project Chauffeur self-driving project, co-led by Sebastian Thrun (leader of the Stanford Junior team) and Chris Urmson (leader of the CMU Boss team) with an initial 10-person crew including DARPA Grand Challenge veterans Mike Montemerlo, Anthony Levandowski, and Bryan Salesky. After public road tests of its first-generation modified Toyota Prius in San Francisco in October 2010, the project secured Nevada's first-ever autonomous vehicle license plate in May 2012. In December 2016, the project spun off into the independent subsidiary Waymo, with John Krafcik serving as CEO.

timeline.title_zh: Fei-Fei Li ImageNet:视觉识别的标准基准
timeline.title_en: Fei-Fei Li ImageNet: Standard Benchmark for Visual Recognition
timeline.summary_zh:
2009 年 6 月 20 日,Fei-Fei Li 团队在 CVPR 2009 发表《ImageNet: A Large-Scale Hierarchical Image Database》,正式发布 ImageNet 数据集。
数据集基于 WordNet 名词层级,通过 Amazon Mechanical Turk 众包标注,最终收录 1400 万张图像、21841 个类别,每类约 500-1000 张。
2010 年 ILSVRC(ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge)启动,用 1000 类 + 120 万训练图 + 5 万验证图 + 15 万测试图,成为视觉识别的标准基准。
timeline.source_name: Deng, J. et al. (2009) CVPR; Russakovsky et al. (2015) IJCV 115(3):211-252
timeline.summary_en: On June 20, 2009, Fei-Fei Li's team officially released the ImageNet dataset at CVPR 2009, publishing the paper "ImageNet: A Large-Scale Hierarchical Image Database." Built on the WordNet noun hierarchy and annotated via Amazon Mechanical Turk crowdsourcing, the dataset ultimately compiled 14 million images across 21,841 categories, with about 500-1000 images per category. In 2010, the ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge (ILSVRC) launched with 1,000 categories, 1.2 million training images, 50,000 validation images, and 150,000 test images, becoming the standard benchmark for visual recognition.

timeline.title_zh: Rajat Raina + Andrew Ng:GPU 训练深度信念网络
timeline.title_en: Rajat Raina + Andrew Ng: GPU-Trained Deep Belief Networks
timeline.summary_zh:
2009 年 6 月,Stanford 的 Rajat Raina、Anand Madhavan、Andrew Ng 在 ICML 2009(第 26 届国际机器学习大会,6 月 14-18 日)发表论文《Large-scale Deep Unsupervised Learning using Graphics Processors》。
论文用 NVIDIA GTX 280 GPU(1GB 显存)训练 Deep Belief Network,在 MNIST 上把训练时间从 CPU 的约 19 天降到 GPU 的约 1 天,加速约 14 倍。
在稀疏编码/自编码器上加速最高约 70 倍量级。
这是"GPU 训练深度网络"最早的工程化论文,直接启发 2012 年 AlexNet 用 GTX 580 训练 ImageNet。
timeline.source_name: Raina, R., Madhavan, A., Ng, A. Y. (2009). ICML 2009: Proceedings of the 26th International Conference on Machine Learning; Google Brain cat neuron (2012 NYT)
timeline.summary_en: In June 2009, Stanford’s Rajat Raina, Anand Madhavan, and Andrew Ng presented their paper "Large-scale Deep Unsupervised Learning using Graphics Processors" at ICML 2009 (the 26th International Conference on Machine Learning, June 14-18). Using an NVIDIA GTX 280 GPU with 1GB of memory to train a Deep Belief Network, they slashed training time on MNIST from about 19 days on CPU to roughly one day on GPU—a 14x speedup—while accelerating sparse coding/autoencoders by up to about 70x. As the earliest engineering paper on training deep networks with GPUs, this work directly inspired AlexNet to train ImageNet using the GTX 580 in 2012.

timeline.title_zh: Apple 收购 Siri:语音助手进入大厂战略
timeline.title_en: Apple Acquires Siri: Voice Assistants Enter Big Tech Strategy
timeline.summary_zh:
2010 年 4 月 28 日,Apple 以约 2 亿美元收购 Siri Inc.。
Siri 原本是 SRI International 基于 CALO 项目(DARPA PAL 项目)开发的虚拟助手,2007 年独立为 Siri Inc.,2009 年 2 月发布 iOS 助手 App。
Apple 2011 年 10 月 4 日在 iPhone 4S 发布会正式推出 Siri 语音助手,成为第一款大规模消费级 AI 语音助手。
Siri 开启了 Amazon Alexa(2014)、Google Assistant(2016)、Microsoft Cortana(2014)、Samsung Bixby(2017)、Apple Intelligence(2024)等大厂语音助手竞争。
timeline.source_name: Apple Siri acquisition (2010-04-28); SRI CALO project history
timeline.summary_en: On April 28, 2010, Apple acquired Siri Inc. for approximately $200 million, taking over a virtual assistant originally developed by SRI International under the CALO project (DARPA PAL project) that spun off as Siri Inc. in 2007 and released an iOS assistant app in February 2009. Apple officially launched the Siri voice assistant at the iPhone 4S event on October 4, 2011, making it the first large-scale consumer AI voice assistant. This sparked a wave of voice assistant competition among tech giants, paving the way for Amazon Alexa (2014), Microsoft Cortana (2014), Google Assistant (2016), Samsung Bixby (2017), and Apple Intelligence (2024).

timeline.title_zh: ILSVRC 首届 ImageNet 挑战赛:深度学习的试炼场
timeline.title_en: First ILSVRC: ImageNet Challenge Launch
timeline.summary_zh:
首届 ImageNet 大规模视觉识别挑战赛（ILSVRC）举办。
150 个团队报名，仅 11 个提交算法。
timeline.summary_en: The inaugural ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge (ILSVRC) was held. Although 150 teams signed up, only 11 submitted algorithms.

timeline.title_zh: Microsoft Kinect:深度摄像头进入消费市场
timeline.title_en: Microsoft Kinect: Depth Cameras Enter Consumer Market
timeline.summary_zh:
2010 年 11 月 4 日,Microsoft 发布 Kinect for Xbox 360,售价 149 美元。
Kinect 集成红外 + RGB 相机 + 多阵列麦克风,用 PrimeSense Light Coding 技术实时生成 640×480 深度图(30fps)。
首 60 天销量 800 万台,吉尼斯世界纪录最快销售消费电子。
Kinect 把“深度感知 + 实时人体姿态识别”带入消费市场,为后续 ROS、机器人感知、HoloLens、Apple Vision Pro 铺路。
timeline.source_name: Microsoft Kinect launch (2010-11-04); PrimeSense acquisition by Apple (2013)
timeline.summary_en: On November 4, 2010, Microsoft launched the Kinect for Xbox 360 for $149, integrating infrared and RGB cameras with a multi-array microphone to generate 640×480 depth maps at 30fps using PrimeSense Light Coding technology. The device sold 8 million units in its first 60 days, earning the Guinness World Record for the fastest-selling consumer electronics device. By bringing depth sensing and real-time human pose recognition to the consumer market, Kinect paved the way for ROS, robotic perception, HoloLens, and Apple Vision Pro.

timeline.title_zh: IBM Watson 击败 Jeopardy! 冠军:问答 AI 高峰
timeline.title_en: IBM Watson Beats Jeopardy! Champions: QA AI Peak
timeline.summary_zh:
2011 年 2 月 14-16 日,IBM Watson 在 Jeopardy! 三集特别节目中以 77,147 美元击败卫冕冠军 Ken Jennings(24,000)和 Brad Rutter(21,600)。
Watson 由 David Ferrucci 2006-2011 年领导开发,用 DeepQA 架构:问题分析 + 候选生成 + 证据检索 + 置信度排序,在 200M 页结构化文档上做并行检索,3 秒内给出答案。
Watson 硬件是 90 台 IBM Power 750 服务器,2880 个 Power7 核心,16TB 内存。
timeline.source_name: IBM Watson Jeopardy! (2011-02-14-16); Ferrucci, D. (2012) AI Magazine 33(1)
timeline.summary_en: From February 14–16, 2011, IBM Watson defeated defending champions Ken Jennings ($24,000) and Brad Rutter ($21,600) with $77,147 on a three-episode *Jeopardy!* special. Developed under the leadership of David Ferrucci from 2006 to 2011, Watson utilized a DeepQA architecture—combining question analysis, candidate generation, evidence retrieval, and confidence ranking—to perform parallel retrieval across 200M pages of structured documents and deliver answers within 3 seconds. The system ran on 90 IBM Power 750 servers, boasting 2880 Power7 cores and 16TB of RAM.

timeline.title_zh: Apple Siri 在 iPhone 4S 发布:消费级语音助手诞生
timeline.title_en: Apple Siri Launched on iPhone 4S: Consumer Voice Assistant Born
timeline.summary_zh:
2011 年 10 月 4 日,Apple 在 iPhone 4S 发布会推出 Siri 语音助手,10 月 14 日 iPhone 4S 上市,Siri 正式面向消费者。
Siri 1.0 用 Nuance 语音识别 + 自研自然语言理解 + 25 类内置服务(短信、电话、日历、地图、Wolfram Alpha),用户用自然语言对话,Siri 返回结果或调用 App。
Siri 开启了 Alexa(2014)、Google Assistant(2016)、Cortana(2014)、Bixby(2017)的语音助手时代。
timeline.source_name: Apple Siri on iPhone 4S launch (2011-10-04); Siri Inc. acquisition (2010-04-28)
timeline.summary_en: On October 4, 2011, Apple unveiled the Siri voice assistant at its iPhone 4S launch event, officially bringing it to consumers when the device went on sale on October 14. Siri 1.0 combined Nuance speech recognition, proprietary natural language understanding, and 25 categories of built-in services (including SMS, phone, calendar, maps, and Wolfram Alpha), allowing users to converse naturally while Siri returned results or invoked apps. Ultimately, Siri ushered in the voice assistant era of Alexa (2014), Google Assistant (2016), Cortana (2014), and Bixby (2017).

timeline.title_zh: GPU 训练深网成共识
timeline.title_en: GPU Training Goes Mainstream
timeline.summary_zh:
2012 年后，AlexNet 等结果让 GPU 成为深度网络训练的核心基础设施。
深层网络要做大量矩阵计算，CPU 像少数工人慢慢算，GPU 像一排工位同时开工。
研究者发现，模型能不能变大、训练能不能跑完，越来越依赖显卡、内存、互联和软件栈。
从这时开始，算力从背景条件走到台前，成为 AI 竞赛里的核心资源。
timeline.source_name: NeurIPS AlexNet paper
timeline.summary_en: After 2012, breakthroughs like AlexNet established the GPU as the core infrastructure for deep network training. To handle the massive matrix calculations required, a CPU behaves like a few workers slowly plugging away, whereas a GPU functions like a row of workstations firing up simultaneously. As researchers realized that scaling models and completing training depended heavily on graphics cards, memory, interconnects, and software stacks, compute stepped out of the background to become the defining resource in the AI race.

timeline.title_zh: AlexNet 引爆现代深度学习
timeline.title_en: AlexNet Ignites Modern Deep Learning
timeline.summary_zh:
2012 年，AlexNet 在 ImageNet 图像识别竞赛中大幅领先，把深度学习重新推到世界面前。
这次胜利真正震撼的地方，是三件事第一次强力合流。
ImageNet 给了大规模带标签数据，神经网络给了算法路线，GPU 给了能把深层网络跑起来的算力。
很多人从这时才真正意识到，deep and large 有了清晰证据。
只要数据、算法和算力一起到位，AI 能力会突然跃迁。
timeline.source_name: 英伟达的编年史和城墙整理材料
timeline.summary_en: In 2012, AlexNet dominated the ImageNet image recognition competition, thrusting deep learning back into the global spotlight. The true shock of this victory was the powerful, first-time convergence of three forces: ImageNet's large-scale labeled data, the algorithmic path of neural networks, and the GPU compute required to run deep networks. For many, this was the first clear evidence that "deep and large" worked, proving that when data, algorithms, and compute align, AI capabilities make a sudden leap.

timeline.title_zh: 协作机器人Baxter发布——机器与人并肩工作
timeline.title_en: Collaborative Robot Baxter Released
timeline.summary_zh:
2012年，罗德尼·布鲁克斯的Rethink Robotics公司发布了巴克斯特（Baxter）双臂协作机器人。
它被设计成与人类工人安全协作的伙伴——不是取代。
人类可以简单地抓住它的手臂教它动作——它记住后自动重复。
这代表了一种与「取代人类」完全不同的机器人路线。
布鲁克斯是MIT AI Lab的前主任，也是著名机器人学家。
他公开反对把机器人做成取代人类工人的自动化机器——他认为机器人的正确方向是和人类一起工作，做人类不想做的枯燥重复劳动，把创造性留给人类。
Baxter就是这条理念的产物——它有安全传感器，碰到人会立刻停下来。
timeline.summary_en: In 2012, Rethink Robotics, founded by renowned roboticist and former MIT AI Lab director Rodney Brooks, released Baxter, a dual-armed collaborative robot designed to work safely alongside human workers rather than replace them. Embodying Brooks’ philosophy that robots should handle dull, repetitive tasks while leaving creativity to humans, Baxter could be programmed simply by guiding its arms to make it memorize and repeat movements, stopping instantly upon contact thanks to built-in safety sensors. This cooperative design represented a robotics paradigm entirely different from the traditional industry drive to replace human labor with automation.

timeline.title_zh: Google Brain 猫神经元:大规模无监督学习首次成功
timeline.title_en: Google Brain Cat Neuron: First Large-Scale Unsupervised Learning Success
timeline.summary_zh:
2012 年 6 月 26 日,Quoc Le、Marc'Aurelio Ranzato、Rajat Monga、Matthieu Devin、Kai Chen、Greg Corrado、Jeff Dean、Andrew Ng 在 ICML 2012 发表论文《Building High-level Features Using Large Scale Unsupervised Learning》。
团队用 1000 台服务器 + 16,000 个 CPU 核心训练 9 层稀疏自编码器,在 1000 万张 YouTube 视频帧上做无监督学习,网络自发形成“猫脸神经元”,人脸识别准确率 81.7%,猫脸识别准确率 74.8%。
2012 年 6 月 26 日 NYT 头版报道,Google Brain 项目正式公开。
timeline.source_name: Le, Q. et al. (2012) ICML 2012; NYT report (2012-06-26)
timeline.summary_en: On June 26, 2012, Quoc Le, Marc'Aurelio Ranzato, Rajat Monga, Matthieu Devin, Kai Chen, Greg Corrado, Jeff Dean, and Andrew Ng published the paper "Building High-level Features Using Large Scale Unsupervised Learning" at ICML 2012. That same day, a June 26, 2012 front-page NYT report officially made the Google Brain project public. Training a 9-layer sparse autoencoder on 1,000 servers and 16,000 CPU cores using unsupervised learning on 10 million YouTube video frames, the team watched the network spontaneously form a "cat face neuron" while achieving a human face recognition accuracy of 81.7% and a cat face recognition accuracy of 74.8%.

timeline.title_zh: AlexNet 在 NIPS 2012 引爆:深度学习时代起点
timeline.title_en: AlexNet at NIPS 2012: Deep Learning Era Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2012 年 12 月,Alex Krizhevsky、Ilya Sutskever、Geoffrey Hinton 在 NIPS 2012 论文集发表论文《ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks》(ILSVRC 2012 结果于 10 月公布,top-5 错误率 15.3% vs 第二名 26.2%)。
AlexNet 在 ImageNet ILSVRC 2012 把 top-5 错误率从 26.2%(传统 CV)降到 15.3%,领先第二名 10.8 个百分点。
AlexNet 用 8 层 CNN(5 卷积 + 3 全连接)、650K 神经元、60M 参数、630M 连接,在 2 块 NVIDIA GTX 580 GPU 上训练 5-6 天。
关键创新:ReLU 激活、Dropout 正则化、数据增强、GPU 并行训练。
timeline.source_name: Krizhevsky, A., Sutskever, I., Hinton, G. (2012) NIPS; ILSVRC 2012 results
timeline.summary_en: In December 2012, Alex Krizhevsky, Ilya Sutskever, and Geoffrey Hinton published "ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks" in the NIPS 2012 proceedings, detailing how AlexNet dominated ILSVRC 2012 (results announced in October) by slashing the top-5 error rate from 26.2% (traditional CV) to 15.3%, leading the second-place entry by 10.8 percentage points. This 8-layer CNN—consisting of 5 convolutional and 3 fully connected layers, 650K neurons, 60M parameters, and 630M connections—was trained on 2 NVIDIA GTX 580 GPUs for 5-6 days. Its landmark success relied on key innovations: ReLU activation, Dropout regularization, data augmentation, and GPU parallel training.

timeline.title_zh: 谷歌大规模收购AI与机器人公司——帝国的构建
timeline.title_en: Google's Massive AI and Robotics Acquisitions
timeline.summary_zh:
2013年，在安卓之父安迪·鲁宾的主导下，谷歌秘密收购了八家顶尖机器人公司——包括波士顿动力（大狗机器人）、日本Schaft、Industrial Perception等。
这是AI史上最大规模的集中机器人收购——谷歌试图在下一波AI和机器人浪潮中建立统治地位。（注：Google 收购 DeepMind 是 2014 年 1 月，见 #16，不属本条。）
timeline.summary_en: In 2013, spearheaded by the "father of Android" Andy Rubin, Google secretly acquired eight leading robotics companies—including Boston Dynamics (maker of the BigDog robot), Japan's Schaft, and Industrial Perception. This marked the largest concentrated robotics acquisition in AI history, representing Google's bid to establish dominance in the next wave of AI and robotics. (Note: Google's acquisition of DeepMind occurred in January 2014, see #16, and is not covered in this entry.)

timeline.title_zh: Mikolov word2vec:词向量与分布式表示普及
timeline.title_en: Mikolov word2vec: Word Embeddings Popularized
timeline.summary_zh:
2013 年 1 月 16 日,Tomas Mikolov、Kai Chen、Greg Corrado、Jeff Dean 在 arXiv 发表论文《Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space》,后发表于 ICLR 2013。
word2vec 用 100 维向量表示词,在 1000 亿词 Google News 语料上训练,CBOW 和 Skip-gram 两种模型 + Hierarchical Softmax + Negative Sampling 两种训练技巧,训练时间从 RNNLM 的几周降到几小时。
word2vec 的“king - man + woman = queen”类比实验,让“分布式表示 + 向量算术”成为 NLP 标准工具,为 2018 BERT、2020 GPT-3、2022 ChatGPT 的词嵌入层铺路。
timeline.source_name: Mikolov, T. et al. (2013) ICLR 2013; arXiv:1301.3781
timeline.summary_en: On January 16, 2013, Tomas Mikolov, Kai Chen, Greg Corrado, and Jeff Dean published the paper "Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space" on arXiv, which was later published at ICLR 2013. Representing words as 100-dimensional vectors trained on a 100-billion-word Google News corpus, word2vec combined two models (CBOW and Skip-gram) with two training techniques (Hierarchical Softmax and Negative Sampling) to slash training times from RNNLM's weeks to just hours. The model's famous "king - man + woman = queen" analogy experiment established "distributed representations + vector arithmetic" as standard NLP tools, paving the way for the word embedding layers of 2018 BERT, 2020 GPT-3, and 2022 ChatGPT.

timeline.title_zh: NVIDIA 全面转向深度学习:Huang 的 10 年战略
timeline.title_en: NVIDIA Pivots to Deep Learning: Huang's 10-Year Strategy
timeline.summary_zh:
2013 年 3 月 19 日,NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang 在 GPU Technology Conference (GTC) 2013 首次公开把 NVIDIA 定位为“AI 计算公司”,而非“游戏显卡公司”。
2013-2016 年 Huang 主导 NVIDIA 三件事:(1) 把 CUDA 生态深度绑定深度学习框架;(2) 2014 年 cuDNN 1.0 + 2015 年 TensorRT 推出;(3) 2016 年 DGX-1 + 2016 年 Tegra Parker 面向自动驾驶。
2017 年 NVIDIA 数据中心营收 19 亿美元,2023 年 475 亿美元,2024 年 1150 亿美元,Huang 2013 年的“AI 计算公司”定位彻底兑现。
timeline.source_name: NVIDIA GTC 2013 keynote (2013-03-19); NVIDIA annual reports 2013-2024
timeline.summary_en: On March 19, 2013, at the GPU Technology Conference (GTC) 2013, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang first publicly positioned the firm as an "AI computing company" rather than a "gaming graphics card company." Between 2013 and 2016, Huang steered NVIDIA through three key initiatives: deeply binding the CUDA ecosystem with deep learning frameworks; launching cuDNN 1.0 in 2014 and TensorRT in 2015; and debuting the DGX-1 and Tegra Parker for autonomous driving in 2016. That pivot was fully realized as NVIDIA’s data center revenue surged from $1.9 billion in 2017 to $47.5 billion in 2023, and $115 billion in 2024, completely delivering on Huang’s 2013 vision.

timeline.title_zh: DeepMind DQN:深度强化学习首次成功
timeline.title_en: DeepMind DQN: First Deep Reinforcement Learning Success
timeline.summary_zh:
2013 年 12 月 19 日,DeepMind 团队(Volodymyr Mnih、Koray Kavukcuoglu、David Silver、Alex Graves、Ioannis Antonoglou、Daan Wierstra、Martin Riedmiller)在 NIPS 2013 Deep Learning Workshop 发表论文《Playing Atari with Deep Reinforcement Learning》。
DQN 用 CNN + Q-learning,从原始像素输入学习 49 种 Atari 游戏,其中 29 种超过人类专家水平。
DQN 关键创新:Experience Replay + Target Network,解决 Q-learning 在深度网络上的训练不稳定问题。
2015 年 2 月 Nature 518:529-533 完整版发表,DQN 在 49 种 Atari 游戏中 22 种超人类。
timeline.source_name: Mnih, V. et al. (2013) NIPS Deep Learning Workshop; (2015) Nature 518:529-533
timeline.summary_en: On December 19, 2013, the DeepMind team (Volodymyr Mnih, Koray Kavukcuoglu, David Silver, Alex Graves, Ioannis Antonoglou, Daan Wierstra, Martin Riedmiller) published the paper "Playing Atari with Deep Reinforcement Learning" at the NIPS 2013 Deep Learning Workshop. By using CNN + Q-learning to master 49 Atari games directly from raw pixel inputs, DQN outperformed human experts in 29 of them, utilizing the key innovations of Experience Replay and Target Network to solve the training instability of Q-learning on deep networks. In February 2015, the full version was published in Nature 518:529-533, demonstrating DQN outperforming humans in 22 of the 49 Atari games.

timeline.title_zh: 对抗样本风险显现
timeline.title_en: Adversarial Examples Gain Attention
timeline.summary_zh:
2014 年前后，研究显示深度模型会被很小的扰动误导，暴露出脆弱性。
一张图片在人眼看来几乎没变，模型可能突然认错。
这个现象像给深度学习泼了一盆冷水：模型表现很强，也会在奇怪角落里显得非常脆。
能力上升以后，安全、鲁棒性和评测边界开始变成实打实的技术问题。
timeline.source_name: General AI history references
timeline.summary_en: Around 2014, research revealed that deep models could be misled by tiny perturbations, exposing a vulnerability where an image virtually unchanged to the human eye could suddenly be misclassified. This phenomenon poured cold water on the deep learning hype, proving that even highly capable models could be incredibly fragile in unexpected corners. As AI capabilities grew, safety, robustness, and evaluation boundaries transitioned into pressing, real-world technical challenges.

timeline.title_zh: Google 6.5 亿美元收购 DeepMind:AI 军备竞赛开始
timeline.title_en: Google Acquires DeepMind for $650M: AI Arms Race Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2014 年 1 月 26 日,Google 以约 6.5 亿美元收购英国 AI 公司 DeepMind,由 Demis Hassabis、Shane Legg、Mustafa Suleyman 2010 年在伦敦创办。
DeepMind 收购时只有 75 人,主要做 DRL(深度强化学习),没有商业化产品,但 Google 看重其“通用 AI”研究能力。
DeepMind 收购后保持独立运营,2014-2024 年取得多项突破:DQN(2015)、AlphaGo(2016)、AlphaZero(2018)、MuZero(2019)、AlphaFold(2020/2021)、Gemini(2023)、AlphaProof(2024)。
timeline.source_name: Google acquisition of DeepMind (2014-01-26); DeepMind 2010 founding
timeline.summary_en: On January 26, 2014, Google acquired DeepMind, a British AI company founded in London in 2010 by Demis Hassabis, Shane Legg, and Mustafa Suleyman, for about $650 million. At the time of the acquisition, DeepMind had just 75 employees, no commercial products, and focused primarily on DRL (deep reinforcement learning), but Google valued its "general AI" research capabilities. Operating independently post-acquisition, DeepMind achieved a string of breakthroughs from 2014 to 2024: DQN (2015), AlphaGo (2016), AlphaZero (2018), MuZero (2019), AlphaFold (2020/2021), Gemini (2023), and AlphaProof (2024).

timeline.title_zh: Goodfellow GAN:生成式 AI 的早期突破
timeline.title_en: Goodfellow GAN: Early Generative AI Breakthrough
timeline.summary_zh:
2014 年 6 月 10 日,Ian Goodfellow 等人在 NIPS 2014 发表论文《Generative Adversarial Nets》。
GAN 用 Generator + Discriminator 对抗训练,Generator 从噪声生成图像,Discriminator 判断图像真伪,两者博弈达到 Nash 均衡时 Generator 能生成逼真图像。
GAN 在 MNIST、TFD、CIFAR-10 上生成质量超过 VAE 和 Boltzmann Machine,为后续 2015 DCGAN、2017 CycleGAN、2018 StyleGAN、2019 BigGAN、2021 StyleGAN-ADA、2024 GAN+Diffusion 混合路线铺路。
timeline.source_name: Goodfellow, I. et al. (2014) NIPS 2014; arXiv:1406.2661
timeline.summary_en: On June 10, 2014, Ian Goodfellow et al. published the paper "Generative Adversarial Nets" at NIPS 2014, introducing an adversarial framework where a Generator creates images from noise and a Discriminator judges their authenticity, pitting the two in a game to reach a Nash equilibrium where the Generator can produce realistic images. Having outperformed VAE and Boltzmann Machine in generation quality on MNIST, TFD, and CIFAR-10, GAN paved the way for subsequent developments: 2015 DCGAN, 2017 CycleGAN, 2018 StyleGAN, 2019 BigGAN, 2021 StyleGAN-ADA, and the 2024 GAN+Diffusion hybrid approach.

timeline.title_zh: GoogLeNet 夺冠 ImageNet:企业算力碾压学术界的信号
timeline.title_en: GoogLeNet Wins ImageNet: Corporate Compute Dominance
timeline.summary_zh: 谷歌 GoogLeNet 以 6.67% 错误率夺得 ImageNet 冠军，人类水平约 5.1%，差距只剩 1.5 个百分点。
timeline.summary_en: Google’s GoogLeNet won the ImageNet championship with a 6.67% error rate. With the human level at about 5.1%, the gap has shrunk to just 1.5 percentage points.

timeline.title_zh: Sutskever Seq2Seq:端到端机器翻译范式确立
timeline.title_en: Sutskever Seq2Seq: End-to-End Translation Paradigm Established
timeline.summary_zh:
2014 年 9 月 10 日,Ilya Sutskever、Oriol Vinyals、Quoc Le 在 NeurIPS 2014 发表论文《Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks》。
Seq2Seq 用 2 个 LSTM(Encoder + Decoder)做端到端机器翻译,在 WMT-14 英法翻译上 BLEU 34.8,超过传统统计机器翻译 33.3(SMT)。
Seq2Seq 关键创新:(1) 端到端训练;(2) Encoder 把输入序列编码为固定长度向量;(3) Decoder 从该向量生成输出序列;(4) 输入序列逆序 + 4 层 LSTM + beam search。
timeline.source_name: Sutskever, I., Vinyals, O., Le, Q. (2014) NeurIPS 2014; WMT-14 results
timeline.summary_en: On September 10, 2014, Ilya Sutskever, Oriol Vinyals, and Quoc Le published the paper "Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks" at NeurIPS 2014. By using two LSTMs (an Encoder and a Decoder) for end-to-end machine translation, Seq2Seq achieved a BLEU score of 34.8 on WMT-14 English-to-French translation, surpassing the 33.3 of traditional statistical machine translation (SMT). The model's key innovations included: (1) end-to-end training; (2) an Encoder encoding the input sequence into a fixed-length vector; (3) a Decoder generating the output sequence from that vector; and (4) reversing the input sequence, using a 4-layer LSTM, and employing beam search.

timeline.title_zh: AI 风险公开信
timeline.title_en: Open Letter on AI Safety
timeline.summary_zh:
2015 年，科技界公开呼吁重视 AI 对社会和安全的潜在影响。
深度学习能力快速上升后，问题开始从“能不能做出来”扩展到“应该怎样使用”。
研究者、企业和公众都需要讨论风险、责任、治理和长期影响。
这封公开信像一次提醒：AI 的发展速度越快，安全和社会边界越需要提前进入议程。
timeline.source_name: Timeline of Artificial Intelligence
timeline.summary_en: In 2015, the tech community issued a public call to confront the potential impacts of AI on society and safety. As deep learning capabilities skyrocketed, the core question shifted from "can we build it" to "how should we use it," forcing researchers, corporations, and the public to grapple with risk, responsibility, governance, and long-term consequences. This open letter served as a stark reminder: the faster AI advances, the sooner safety and societal guardrails must be put on the agenda.

timeline.title_zh: Redmon YOLO:实时目标检测突破
timeline.title_en: Redmon YOLO: Real-Time Object Detection Breakthrough
timeline.summary_zh:
2015 年 6 月 8 日,Joseph Redmon、Santosh Divvala、Ross Girshick、Ali Farhadi 在 CVPR 2016 发表论文《You Only Look Once: Unified, Real-Time Object Detection》。
YOLO 把目标检测从“两阶段(区域提议 + 分类)”改为“单阶段(直接回归 bbox + class)”,在 PASCAL VOC 2007 上 mAP 63.4,推理速度 45 FPS(YOLO Fast 155 FPS),比 R-CNN(2 FPS)快 22 倍。
YOLO 后续版本:YOLOv2(2017)、YOLOv3(2018)、YOLOv4(2020,Alexey Bochkovskiy 接手)、YOLOv5(2020,Ultralytics)、YOLOv8(2023)、YOLOv9(2024)、YOLOv10(2024,清华大学)。
timeline.source_name: Redmon, J. et al. (2015) CVPR 2016; arXiv:1506.02640
timeline.summary_en: On June 8, 2015, Joseph Redmon, Santosh Divvala, Ross Girshick, and Ali Farhadi published the paper "You Only Look Once: Unified, Real-Time Object Detection" at CVPR 2016. YOLO shifted object detection from a "two-stage (region proposal + classification)" process to a "single-stage (direct regression of bbox + class)" pipeline, achieving a 63.4 mAP on PASCAL VOC 2007 at an inference speed of 45 FPS (155 FPS for YOLO Fast)—making it 22 times faster than R-CNN (2 FPS). This breakthrough paved the way for subsequent versions: YOLOv2 (2017), YOLOv3 (2018), YOLOv4 (2020, taken over by Alexey Bochkovskiy), YOLOv5 (2020, Ultralytics), YOLOv8 (2023), YOLOv9 (2024), and YOLOv10 (2024, Tsinghua University).

timeline.title_zh: AlphaGo 胜樊麾:围棋 AI 首次击败职业棋手
timeline.title_en: AlphaGo Beats Fan Hui: Go AI Beats Professional for the First Time
timeline.summary_zh:
2015 年 10 月 9 日,DeepMind AlphaGo 在伦敦闭门比赛中以 5:0 击败欧洲围棋冠军樊麾二段,这是围棋 AI 首次击败职业棋手。
AlphaGo 用 CNN + MCTS(蒙特卡洛树搜索)+ RL(强化学习),训练分两阶段:(1) 监督学习模仿人类专家走子,达到业余强手水平;(2) 自我对弈强化学习,超过人类专家水平。
2016 年 1 月 27 日 Nature 529:484-489 论文正式发表,2016 年 3 月 AlphaGo 在首尔 4:1 击败李世石九段。
timeline.source_name: Silver, D. et al. (2016) Nature 529:484-489; AlphaGo vs Fan Hui (2015-10)
timeline.summary_en: On October 9, 2015, DeepMind’s AlphaGo defeated European Go champion Fan Hui 2-dan 5-0 in a closed-door London match, marking the first time a Go AI beat a professional player. AlphaGo utilized CNN + MCTS (Monte Carlo Tree Search) + RL (Reinforcement Learning) in a two-stage training process: first, mimicking human expert moves via supervised learning to reach a strong amateur level, and second, using self-play reinforcement learning to surpass human experts. Following the official publication of its paper in Nature 529:484-489 on January 27, 2016, AlphaGo went on to defeat Lee Sedol 9-dan 4-1 in Seoul in March 2016.

timeline.title_zh: He ResNet:超深网络训练突破
timeline.title_en: He ResNet: Ultra-Deep Network Training Breakthrough
timeline.summary_zh:
2015 年 12 月 10 日,Kaiming He、Xiangyu Zhang、Shaoqing Ren、Jian Sun 在 CVPR 2016 发表论文《Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition》。
ResNet 用“残差连接(Skip Connection)”让 152 层 CNN 可训练,在 ImageNet 上 top-5 错误率 3.57%,首次超过人类(5.1%)。
ResNet 关键创新:(1) 残差块 y = F(x) + x,让梯度直接流过 Skip Connection;(2) 152 层 vs VGG 19 层,参数更少但精度更高;(3) BatchNorm + He 初始化让训练稳定。
ResNet 至今仍是视觉 + NLP + 语音 + RL 的标准组件。
timeline.summary_en: On December 10, 2015, Kaiming He, Xiangyu Zhang, Shaoqing Ren, and Jian Sun published the paper "Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition" at CVPR 2016. ResNet used "Skip Connections" to make a 152-layer CNN trainable, achieving a 3.57% top-5 error rate on ImageNet and surpassing human performance (5.1%) for the first time. Its key innovations—the $y = F(x) + x$ residual block that lets gradients flow directly through skip connections, a 152-layer architecture vs. VGG's 19 layers that had fewer parameters but higher accuracy, and BatchNorm plus He initialization for stable training—ensure ResNet remains a standard component in vision, NLP, speech, and RL to this day.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI 成立:非营利 AI 研究实验室启动
timeline.title_en: OpenAI Founded: Nonprofit AI Research Lab Launched
timeline.summary_zh:
2015 年 12 月 11 日,OpenAI 在旧金山成立,由 Sam Altman、Elon Musk、Greg Brockman、Ilya Sutskever、Wojciech Zaremba、John Schulman 联合创办。
初始承诺 10 亿美元资金,实际到位约 1.3 亿美元。
OpenAI 宣称目标“构建安全有益的通用人工智能(AGI),为全人类而非单一公司服务”,以非营利形式运营。
2019 年 OpenAI 转型为“有限利润(capped-profit)”公司 OpenAI LP,Microsoft 2019-2023 年累计投资 130 亿美元,OpenAI 从非营利实验室变成 Microsoft 旗下 AI 子公司。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI founding announcement (2015-12-11); OpenAI LP structure (2019-03)
timeline.summary_en: On December 11, 2015, OpenAI was founded in San Francisco by Sam Altman, Elon Musk, Greg Brockman, Ilya Sutskever, Wojciech Zaremba, and John Schulman as a non-profit dedicated to "building safe and beneficial artificial general intelligence (AGI)" for all humanity rather than a single company. While the organization launched with $1 billion in pledged funding, only about $130 million was actually received. In 2019, OpenAI transitioned into a "capped-profit" company, OpenAI LP, and following a cumulative $13 billion investment from Microsoft between 2019 and 2023, the former non-profit lab effectively became a Microsoft AI subsidiary.

timeline.title_zh: AlphaGo 4:1 胜李世石:围棋 AI 越过职业九段
timeline.title_en: AlphaGo 4:1 Beats Lee Sedol: Go AI Crosses Pro 9-Dan
timeline.summary_zh:
2016 年 3 月 9-15 日,DeepMind AlphaGo 在首尔四季酒店 5 局比赛中以 4:1 击败韩国职业九段李世石(Lee Sedol),李世石在第 4 局(3 月 13 日)唯一胜局被称为“神之一手”(Move 78)。
AlphaGo 用 MCTS + 深度策略网络 + 深度价值网络,176 个 GPU + 1202 个 CPU,每步搜索 0.2 秒。
Nature 2016 年 1 月 28 日论文《Mastering the game of Go with deep neural networks and tree search》预演结果,3 月正式对弈震惊全球。
timeline.source_name: Silver, D. et al. (2016) Nature 529:484-489; AlphaGo vs Lee Sedol match record
timeline.summary_en: From March 9 to 15, 2016, DeepMind’s AlphaGo defeated Korean professional 9-dan Lee Sedol 4:1 in a five-game match at the Four Seasons Hotel in Seoul, with Lee’s sole victory in Game 4 (March 13) dubbed the "divine move" (Move 78). AlphaGo utilized MCTS, deep policy networks, and deep value networks running on 176 GPUs and 1202 CPUs, searching for 0.2 seconds per move. While the results were previewed in the January 28, 2016 *Nature* paper *Mastering the game of Go with deep neural networks and tree search*, the official March showdown shocked the world.

timeline.title_zh: Google TPU v1:AI 专用芯片公开
timeline.title_en: Google TPU v1: AI-Specific Chip Public
timeline.summary_zh:
2016 年 5 月 18 日,Google 在 Google I/O 2016 主题演讲公开 TPU(Tensor Processing Unit)。
TPU v1 是 Google 2013 年内部立项、2015 年数据中心部署的 ASIC,专为矩阵乘法优化,8-bit 整数 Systolic Array 架构,28nm 工艺,700MHz,92 TOPS,28W TDP。
TPU 在 AlphaGo 与李世石对弈(2016-03)中担任推理硬件,在 RankBrain 搜索排序中已运行 3 年。
2017 年 4 月 Norman Jouppi 等在 ISCA 2017 发表论文《In-Datacenter Performance Analysis of a Tensor Processing Unit》。
timeline.source_name: Jouppi et al. (2017) ISCA; Google I/O 2016 keynote
timeline.summary_en: At the Google I/O 2016 keynote on May 18, 2016, Google officially unveiled the Tensor Processing Unit (TPU), a custom ASIC initiated internally in 2013 and deployed in datacenters by 2015. Optimized for matrix multiplication, the TPU v1 leveraged an 8-bit integer Systolic Array architecture, a 28nm process, 700MHz clock speed, 92 TOPS, and a 28W TDP, having already run for 3 years in RankBrain search ranking and served as the inference hardware during AlphaGo's match against Lee Sedol (2016-03). In April 2017, Norman Jouppi et al. published the landmark paper "In-Datacenter Performance Analysis of a Tensor Processing Unit" at ISCA 2017.

timeline.title_zh: Google Magenta 与 AI 艺术开源
timeline.title_en: Google Magenta: AI Art Goes Open Source
timeline.summary_zh:
2016 年 6 月 1 日,Google Brain 团队 Doug Eck、Mike Liang 公开 Magenta 项目,目标是用深度学习生成音乐、绘画、文字。
Magenta 第一篇博文《Welcome to Magenta》发布在 Google Research Blog。
Magenta 后续开源工具包括 NSynth(2017 音色合成)、SketchRNN(2017 草图生成)、MusicVAE(2018 音乐序列)。
Magenta 是 Google 在生成式 AI 艺术方向的第一笔投资,直接催生 2021 年 Imagen、2022 年 MusicLM。
timeline.source_name: Google Magenta launch (2016-06-01); Magenta GitHub
timeline.summary_en: On June 1, 2016, Doug Eck and Mike Liang of the Google Brain team introduced Project Magenta in a Google Research Blog post titled "Welcome to Magenta," aiming to use deep learning to generate music, drawings, and text. The project subsequently released open-source tools including NSynth (2017 timbre synthesis), SketchRNN (2017 sketch generation), and MusicVAE (2018 music sequences). As Google's first investment in generative AI art, Magenta directly spawned 2021's Imagen and 2022's MusicLM.

timeline.title_zh: DeepMind WaveNet:神经网络生成原始音频波形
timeline.title_en: DeepMind WaveNet: Neural Network Generates Raw Audio Waveform
timeline.summary_zh:
2016 年 9 月 8 日,DeepMind 在 arXiv:1609.03499 发表《WaveNet: A Generative Model for Raw Audio》。
WaveNet 用 Causal Dilated Convolution(因果膨胀卷积,膨胀系数 1,2,4,...,512),把音频波形作为时间序列自回归预测下一采样点。
WaveNet 在 TTS(文本转语音)上达到人类级 MOS 评分(4.21 vs 人类 4.55),在钢琴、语音生成上接近真实。
timeline.source_name: van den Oord, A. et al. (2016) arXiv:1609.03499
timeline.summary_en: On September 8, 2016, DeepMind published "WaveNet: A Generative Model for Raw Audio" on arXiv:1609.03499. WaveNet utilized causal dilated convolutions (with dilation coefficients of 1, 2, 4, ..., 512) to treat audio waveforms as a time series, autoregressively predicting the next sample point. The model achieved a human-level MOS score of 4.21 in TTS (text-to-speech) versus 4.55 for humans, and came close to reality in piano and speech generation.

timeline.title_zh: Google GNMT:神经机器翻译全面替代 SMT
timeline.title_en: Google GNMT: Neural Machine Translation Replaces SMT
timeline.summary_zh:
2016 年 9 月 27 日,Google 发表论文《Google's Neural Machine Translation System: Bridging the Gap between Human and Machine Translation》(arXiv:1609.08144)。
GNMT 用 8 层 LSTM Encoder-Decoder + Attention,128 个 GPU 训练 6 天,在 Google 翻译中把中英翻译错误率降低 58%,接近人类水平。
GNMT 上线后 Google 翻译一夜之间提升一个版本号,2016 年 11 月 Google 翻译完全切换到 GNMT。
timeline.summary_en: On September 27, 2016, Google published the paper "Google's Neural Machine Translation System: Bridging the Gap between Human and Machine Translation" (arXiv:1609.08144). Driven by an 8-layer LSTM Encoder-Decoder + Attention and trained on 128 GPUs for 6 days, GNMT reduced Chinese-to-English translation error rates in Google Translate by 58%, approaching human-level performance. Following its launch, Google Translate upgraded by a version number overnight, and by November 2016, Google Translate had completely switched to GNMT.

timeline.title_zh: PyTorch 开源:动态图框架进入主流
timeline.title_en: PyTorch Open-Sourced: Dynamic Graph Framework Goes Mainstream
timeline.summary_zh:
2017 年 1 月 18 日,Facebook AI Research(FAIR)发布 PyTorch 0.1,Adam Paszke、Sam Gross、Soumith Chintala 主导开发。
PyTorch 基于 Torch7,核心创新是动态计算图(Define-by-Run),比 TensorFlow 1.x 静态图更易调试,Python 原生语法接近 NumPy。
2017 年 8 月 PyTorch 0.2 分布式训练,2018 年 4 月 0.4 合并 Variable 与 Tensor,2018 年 12 月 1.0 稳定版。
2019 年 PyTorch 在顶级会议论文使用率超过 TensorFlow,2020 年 HuggingFace 全面转向 PyTorch。
timeline.source_name: Paszke, A. et al. (2017) PyTorch 0.1 release; NeurIPS 2019 autodiff workshop
timeline.summary_en: On January 18, 2017, Facebook AI Research (FAIR) released PyTorch 0.1, a Torch7-based framework led by Adam Paszke, Sam Gross, and Soumith Chintala that featured a dynamic computation graph (Define-by-Run) and a NumPy-like Python-native syntax, making it far easier to debug than TensorFlow 1.x's static graphs. PyTorch 0.2 introduced distributed training in August 2017, version 0.4 merged Variable and Tensor in April 2018, and the stable 1.0 version arrived in December 2018. By 2019, PyTorch’s usage rate in top conference papers surpassed TensorFlow’s, and HuggingFace fully pivoted to PyTorch in 2020.

timeline.title_zh: Asilomar AI 原则:23 条 AI 伦理基准
timeline.title_en: Asilomar AI Principles: 23 AI Ethics Baselines
timeline.summary_zh:
2017 年 1 月 23 日,Future of Life Institute 在加州 Asilomar 会议中心召集 23 位 AI 专家(Stuart Russell、Demis Hassabis、Yann LeCun、Fei-Fei Li 等),发布《Asilomar AI Principles》23 条原则,涵盖研究问题(5 条)、伦理价值(13 条)、长期问题(5 条)。
原则包括:AI 目标应与人类价值对齐、AI 设计应可审计、AI 应避免军备竞赛等。
截至 2017 年底,1275 名 AI 研究者签署原则。
timeline.source_name: Future of Life Institute (2017) Asilomar AI Principles
timeline.summary_en: On January 23, 2017, the Future of Life Institute convened 23 AI experts (including Stuart Russell, Demis Hassabis, Yann LeCun, and Fei-Fei Li) at California's Asilomar Conference Center to release the 23 "Asilomar AI Principles," covering research issues (5), ethical values (13), and longer-term issues (5). These guidelines dictate that AI goals should align with human values, AI designs must be auditable, and an AI arms race should be avoided. By the end of 2017, 1,275 AI researchers had signed onto the principles.

timeline.title_zh: TensorFlow 1.0:Google ML 框架成工业主流
timeline.title_en: TensorFlow 1.0: Google ML Framework Becomes Industry Mainstream
timeline.summary_zh:
2017 年 2 月 15 日,Google 在 TensorFlow Dev Summit 2017 发布 TensorFlow 1.0。
TF 1.0 提供 Python/C++/Java API、分布式训练、TensorBoard 可视化、TF Serving 部署、移动端 TF Lite。
TF 1.0 在工业部署占主导(2017-2020),Pinterest、Airbnb、Snapchat、Uber、Twitter 都用 TF 生产。
但 TF 1.x 静态图 + Session.run 模型在学术界被 PyTorch 蚕食,2019 年 Google 推出 TF 2.0 + Keras 整合转向动态图。
timeline.source_name: Abadi, M. et al. (2016) TensorFlow 1.0; TF Dev Summit 2017
timeline.summary_en: On February 15, 2017, Google launched TensorFlow 1.0 at the TensorFlow Dev Summit 2017, providing Python/C++/Java APIs, distributed training, TensorBoard visualization, TF Serving deployment, and mobile TF Lite. While TF 1.0 dominated industrial deployment from 2017 to 2020—powering production at Pinterest, Airbnb, Snapchat, Uber, and Twitter—its static graph and Session.run model were steadily eroded in academia by PyTorch, prompting Google to transition to dynamic graphs in 2019 by integrating Keras into TF 2.0.

timeline.title_zh: AlphaGo 3:0 战胜柯洁:围棋 AI 退役战
timeline.title_en: AlphaGo 3:0 Beats Ke Jie: Go AI Retirement Match
timeline.summary_zh:
2017 年 5 月 23-27 日,DeepMind AlphaGo Master 在中国乌镇未来围棋峰会上 3:0 击败中国职业九段柯洁。
AlphaGo Master 用 1 个 TPU v2 单机运行,远少于 2016 年李世石版的 176 GPU。
比赛中 AlphaGo 评分约 4800 ELO,柯洁约 3600 ELO。
赛后 DeepMind 宣布 AlphaGo 退役,不再参加围棋比赛,转而研发 AlphaGo Zero 与 AlphaZero。
timeline.source_name: DeepMind (2017) Future of Go Summit Wuzhen; AlphaGo Master matches
timeline.summary_en: Between May 23 and 27, 2017, DeepMind's AlphaGo Master defeated Chinese professional 9-dan Ke Jie 3-0 at the Future of Go Summit in Wuzhen, China. Running on a single machine with just 1 TPU v2—a massive reduction from the 176 GPUs used in the 2016 Lee Sedol version—AlphaGo boasted an ELO rating of approximately 4800 during the match, compared to Ke Jie's 3600. Following the victory, DeepMind announced AlphaGo's retirement from Go competition, shifting its focus to developing AlphaGo Zero and AlphaZero.

timeline.title_zh: Transformer 论文:Attention Is All You Need
timeline.title_en: Transformer Paper: Attention Is All You Need
timeline.summary_zh:
2017 年 6 月 12 日,Ashish Vaswani 等 8 位 Google Brain/Google Research 研究员在 NeurIPS 2017 发表《Attention Is All You Need》(arXiv:1706.03762)。
Transformer 抛弃 RNN/CNN,只用 Self-Attention(Q/K/V 点积注意力) + Positional Encoding + Feed-Forward 层 + 残差连接 + LayerNorm。
原论文在 WMT 2014 英德/英法翻译上达到 SOTA,训练成本是当时最好的 RNN 模型的 1/10。
timeline.source_name: Vaswani, A. et al. (2017) NeurIPS; arXiv:1706.03762
timeline.summary_en: On June 12, 2017, Ashish Vaswani and 8 other Google Brain/Google Research researchers published "Attention Is All You Need" (arXiv:1706.03762) at NeurIPS 2017. The Transformer ditched RNN/CNN, relying only on Self-Attention (Q/K/V dot-product attention), Positional Encoding, Feed-Forward layers, residual connections, and LayerNorm. The original paper achieved SOTA on WMT 2014 English-German/English-French translation, at just 1/10 the training cost of the best RNN models at the time.

timeline.title_zh: fast.ai 成立:深度学习教育平民化
timeline.title_en: fast.ai Founded: Democratizing Deep Learning Education
timeline.summary_zh:
2017 年 8 月 3 日,Jeremy Howard、Rachel Thomas 创办 fast.ai(非营利,旧金山大学 USF Data Institute)。
fast.ai 推出「Practical Deep Learning for Coders」免费 MOOC,7 周 8 节课用 PyTorch + fastai 库教零基础程序员做图像分类、NLP、推荐、表格学习。
fast.ai 2018-2020 年学员超 50 万,2020 年学员 ULMFiT、AWD-LSTM 影响 HuggingFace、Stability AI。
timeline.source_name: Howard, J. & Thomas, R. (2017) fast.ai launch; Practical Deep Learning MOOC
timeline.summary_en: On August 3, 2017, Jeremy Howard and Rachel Thomas founded fast.ai (a non-profit at the USF Data Institute) and launched "Practical Deep Learning for Coders," a free, 7-week, 8-lesson MOOC using PyTorch and the fastai library to teach zero-background programmers image classification, NLP, recommendation, and tabular learning. Between 2018 and 2020, fast.ai amassed over 500,000 students, and by 2020, its students, ULMFiT, and AWD-LSTM had influenced HuggingFace and Stability AI.

timeline.title_zh: AlphaGo Zero:从零自学击败旧版 AlphaGo
timeline.title_en: AlphaGo Zero: Self-Play Beats Old AlphaGo from Scratch
timeline.summary_zh:
2017 年 10 月 18 日,DeepMind 在 Nature 550:354-359 发表《Mastering the game of Go without human knowledge》。
AlphaGo Zero 完全不用人类棋谱,只用自我对弈 + RL,从随机落子开始 3 天击败 2016 年胜李世石的 AlphaGo Lee,21 天击败 2017 年 60 连胜 Master 版本,40 天训练达到超越所有人类围棋 AI 的水平。
AlphaGo Zero 用单一残差网络同时输出策略和价值,简化了原 AlphaGo 双网络结构。
timeline.source_name: Silver, D. et al. (2017) Nature 550:354-359; AlphaZero arXiv:1712.01815
timeline.summary_en: On October 18, 2017, DeepMind published "Mastering the game of Go without human knowledge" in Nature 550:354-359. Training solely on self-play and reinforcement learning without human game records, AlphaGo Zero started from random moves to defeat the 2016 Lee Sedol-beating AlphaGo Lee in 3 days, conquer the 60-win 2017 Master version in 21 days, and surpass all human and Go AI levels in 40 days. It simplified the original AlphaGo's dual-network structure by using a single residual network to simultaneously output policy and value.

timeline.title_zh: NVIDIA V100 Tensor Core:LLM 训练硬件主力
timeline.title_en: NVIDIA V100 Tensor Core: LLM Training Hardware Workhorse
timeline.summary_zh:
2018 年 3 月 27 日,NVIDIA 在 GTC 2018 推出 DGX-1 with V100。
V100 是 Volta 架构 GPU,16nm FFET 工艺,815mm² die,21.1B 晶体管,16GB/32GB HBM2,900 GB/s 显存带宽,640 个 Tensor Core(FP16 100 TFLOPS / FP32 15.7 TFLOPS)。
V100 引入 Tensor Core,用混合精度训练(Mixed Precision Training)把 LLM 训练成本降低 2-3 倍。
DGX-1 V100 8 卡版约 149,000 美元,2018-2020 年是 OpenAI、DeepMind、FAIR 训练主力。
timeline.source_name: NVIDIA Volta whitepaper (2017); NVIDIA DGX-1 V100 (2018)
timeline.summary_en: On March 27, 2018, NVIDIA introduced the DGX-1 with V100 at GTC 2018, featuring a Volta-architecture GPU with a 16nm FFET process, an 815mm² die, 21.1B transistors, 16GB/32GB HBM2, 900 GB/s memory bandwidth, and 640 Tensor Cores (FP16 100 TFLOPS / FP32 15.7 TFLOPS). The V100 introduced Tensor Cores, leveraging Mixed Precision Training to reduce LLM training costs by 2-3 times. Priced at approximately $149,000 for the 8-card version, the DGX-1 V100 served as the primary training workhorse for OpenAI, DeepMind, and FAIR from 2018 to 2020.

timeline.title_zh: GLUE 基准:NLP 任务评测标准化
timeline.title_en: GLUE Benchmark: NLP Evaluation Standardization
timeline.summary_zh:
2018 年 4 月 22 日,纽约大学 Alex Wang、Samuel Bowman 等在 arXiv:1804.07461 发表《GLUE: A Multi-Task Benchmark and Analysis Platform for Testing Natural Language Understanding Systems》。
GLUE 包含 9 个 NLU 任务:CoLA、SST-2、MRPC、STS-B、QQP、MNLI、QNLI、RTE、WNLI,涵盖情感、相似度、蕴含、问答。
GLUE 排行榜 2018-2019 年 BERT、RoBERTa、T5、ALBERT 接力刷新,2020 年 1 月 SuperGLUE 诞生,2021 年 GLUE 饱和(模型超过人类)。
timeline.source_name: Wang, A. et al. (2018) arXiv:1804.07461; GLUE benchmark
timeline.summary_en: On April 22, 2018, New York University’s Alex Wang, Samuel Bowman, and others published "GLUE: A Multi-Task Benchmark and Analysis Platform for Testing Natural Language Understanding Systems" on arXiv:1804.07461. The benchmark comprises 9 NLU tasks—CoLA, SST-2, MRPC, STS-B, QQP, MNLI, QNLI, RTE, and WNLI—covering sentiment, similarity, entailment, and question answering. After the GLUE leaderboard was successively shattered by BERT, RoBERTa, T5, and ALBERT between 2018 and 2019, SuperGLUE was born in January 2020, and GLUE reached saturation in 2021 as models surpassed human performance.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI GPT-1:预训练 + 微调范式确立
timeline.title_en: OpenAI GPT-1: Pre-training + Fine-tuning Paradigm Established
timeline.summary_zh:
2018 年 6 月 11 日,OpenAI 在论文《Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training》发布 GPT-1。
GPT-1 用 12 层 Transformer Decoder(768 维隐藏层,12 头,117M 参数),在 BookCorpus(7000+ 本未出版小说)上无监督预训练,然后在 12 个 NLP 任务上微调。
GPT-1 在 9/12 任务上达到 SOTA,证明“无监督预训练 + 有监督微调”范式可行。
timeline.source_name: Radford, A. et al. (2018) OpenAI blog; GPT-1 paper
timeline.summary_en: On June 11, 2018, OpenAI introduced GPT-1 in the paper "Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training." The model, featuring a 12-layer Transformer decoder (with a 768-dimensional hidden layer, 12 heads, and 117M parameters), underwent unsupervised pre-training on BookCorpus (7000+ unpublished novels) before being fine-tuned on 12 NLP tasks. By achieving SOTA on 9/12 tasks, GPT-1 proved the viability of the "unsupervised pre-training + supervised fine-tuning" paradigm.

timeline.title_zh: 李飞飞国会作证:以人为本 AI 的政策时刻
timeline.title_en: Fei-Fei Li Testifies to Congress: Human-Centered AI
timeline.summary_zh: 李飞飞赴美国国会就「以人为本 AI」作证，母亲病危中坚持出席，提出 AI 发展的动机永远应该是以人为本。
timeline.summary_en: Insisting on testifying before the U.S. Congress on "human-centered AI" even while her mother was critically ill, Fei-Fei Li argued that the motivation behind AI development must always be human-centered.

timeline.title_zh: HuggingFace 创立:NLP 开源社区中心
timeline.title_en: HuggingFace Founded: NLP Open Source Community Hub
timeline.summary_zh:
2018 年 10 月 10 日,HuggingFace(2016 年由 Clément Delangue、Julien Chaumond、Thomas Wolf 在纽约创立,最初做面向青少年的聊天机器人 App)发布 pytorch-pretrained-bert 库(后改名 transformers),把 BERT/GPT 等预训练模型整合为统一接口。
2019-04 与 OpenAI GPT-2、Google BERT 整合。
2020 年 Model Hub 上线,2021 年 5 月 4000 万美元 A 轮,2023 年 2.35 亿美元 D 轮估值 45 亿美元,Google、Amazon、NVIDIA、Salesforce、IBM 全部参投。
timeline.source_name: HuggingFace founding (2018-10); transformers library (2018-11)
timeline.summary_en: On October 10, 2018, Hugging Face—founded in New York in 2016 by Clément Delangue, Julien Chaumond, and Thomas Wolf as a teenage chatbot app—released the pytorch-pretrained-bert library (later renamed transformers), unifying pre-trained models like BERT and GPT into a single interface. After integrating OpenAI GPT-2 and Google BERT in April 2019, the company launched its Model Hub in 2020. This set the stage for a $40 million Series A in May 2021 and a $235 million Series D in 2023 at a $4.5 billion valuation, with Google, Amazon, NVIDIA, Salesforce, and IBM all participating.

timeline.title_zh: Google BERT:双向预训练 NLP 范式确立
timeline.title_en: Google BERT: Bidirectional Pre-training NLP Paradigm Established
timeline.summary_zh:
2018 年 10 月 11 日,Google AI 在 arXiv:1810.04805 发表《BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding》。
BERT 用 24 层 Transformer Encoder(340M 参数),在 BookCorpus + English Wikipedia(3.3B 词)上用 Masked Language Model(MLM) + Next Sentence Prediction(NSP)预训练。
BERT 在 11 个 NLP 任务上刷新 SOTA,包括 GLUE(7.7% 提升)、SQuAD v1.1(1.5% F1)、SQuAD v2.0(4.6% F1)。
timeline.source_name: Devlin, J. et al. (2018) arXiv:1810.04805; NAACL 2019
timeline.summary_en: On October 11, 2018, Google AI published "BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding" on arXiv:1810.04805. The model, featuring a 24-layer Transformer Encoder with 340M parameters, was pre-trained on BookCorpus and English Wikipedia (3.3B words) using Masked Language Model (MLM) and Next Sentence Prediction (NSP). BERT went on to set new state-of-the-art benchmarks across 11 NLP tasks, including GLUE (7.7% improvement), SQuAD v1.1 (1.5% F1), and SQuAD v2.0 (4.6% F1).

timeline.title_zh: AlphaFold 1:CASP13 蛋白质结构预测初突破
timeline.title_en: AlphaFold 1: CASP13 Protein Structure Prediction Breakthrough
timeline.summary_zh:
2018 年 12 月 3-7 日,CASP13(第 13 届 Critical Assessment of Protein Structure Prediction)会议在墨西哥 Cancun 举办,DeepMind AlphaFold 1 在 13 届比赛中第一次达到“实验级精度”。
AlphaFold 1 用 Deep Learning 预测蛋白质距离矩阵 + 梯度下降优化 3D 结构。
CASP13 中 AlphaFold 在 GDT_TS 评分中位 60,远超第二名 40。
timeline.source_name: Senior, A. et al. (2019) Nature 577:706-710; CASP13 results
timeline.summary_en: At the CASP13 (13th Critical Assessment of Protein Structure Prediction) conference in Cancun, Mexico, from December 3–7, 2018, DeepMind’s AlphaFold 1 reached "experimental accuracy" for the first time in the 13th competition. By using deep learning to predict protein distance matrices and gradient descent to optimize 3D structures, AlphaFold achieved a median GDT_TS score of 60 at CASP13, far outstripping the runner-up's score of 40.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI GPT-2:大规模生成预训练首次披露
timeline.title_en: OpenAI GPT-2: Large-Scale Generative Pre-training Disclosed
timeline.summary_zh:
2019 年 2 月 14 日,OpenAI 在博客《Better Language Models and Their Implications》发布 GPT-2 论文《Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners》(Radford 等)。
GPT-2 用 48 层 Transformer Decoder,1.5B 参数,在 WebText(4500 万网页,40GB)上训练。
GPT-2 在零样本(zero-shot)下完成翻译、问答、摘要、写作等 7 个任务。
OpenAI 以“恶意使用风险”为由,分阶段发布:2019-02-14 发布 117M 小模型,2019-05 发布 345M,2019-08 发布 774M,2019-11-05 发布完整 1.5B 模型。
timeline.source_name: Radford, A. et al. (2019) GPT-2 paper; OpenAI blog
timeline.summary_en: On February 14, 2019, OpenAI published the GPT-2 paper "Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners" (Radford et al.) alongside its blog post "Better Language Models and Their Implications." Built with a 48-layer Transformer decoder and 1.5B parameters, GPT-2 was trained on WebText (45 million webpages, 40GB) and demonstrated the ability to perform seven zero-shot tasks, including translation, Q&A, summarization, and writing. Citing "malicious use risks," OpenAI opted for a staged rollout: releasing the 117M model on February 14, 2019, the 345M in May 2019, the 774M in August 2019, and the complete 1.5B model on November 5, 2019.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI LP 设立: capped-profit 转型
timeline.title_en: OpenAI LP: Capped-Profit Transition
timeline.summary_zh:
2019 年 3 月 11 日,OpenAI 宣布成立 OpenAI LP(Limited Partnership),从非营利转为“capped-profit”架构。
原 OpenAI Inc.(非营利)成为 OpenAI LP 的唯一控制方,Microsoft 投 10 亿美元,投资回报上限 100 倍。
架构设计:投资者回报达到上限后,剩余利润归原 OpenAI Inc.(非营利)。
理由是“训练大模型需要超大规模资本,纯非营利无法支撑”。
2019-2023 年 Microsoft 累计投资 130 亿美元。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI (2019) OpenAI LP announcement; Microsoft investment
timeline.summary_en: On March 11, 2019, OpenAI announced the creation of OpenAI LP (Limited Partnership), transitioning from a non-profit to a “capped-profit” structure because training large models requires massive capital that a pure non-profit cannot sustain. Solely controlled by the original non-profit OpenAI Inc., the new entity secured a $1 billion investment from Microsoft with returns capped at 100x, after which any remaining profits revert to OpenAI Inc. Between 2019 and 2023, Microsoft’s cumulative investment reached $13 billion.

timeline.title_zh: NVIDIA Megatron-LM:大模型并行训练范式
timeline.title_en: NVIDIA Megatron-LM: Large Model Parallel Training Paradigm
timeline.summary_zh:
2019 年 9 月 19 日,NVIDIA 在 arXiv:1909.08053 发表《Megatron-LM: Training Multi-Billion Parameter Language Models Using Model Parallelism》。
Megatron-LM 用 Tensor Parallelism(把每层 Attention/FFN 矩阵切到多 GPU)+ Pipeline Parallelism(把不同层放到不同 GPU),在 512 个 V100 GPU 上训练 8.3B 参数 GPT-2,达到 52% 单 GPU 训练效率。
Megatron-LM 直接催生 NVIDIA NeMo Megatron、Microsoft DeepSpeed、Megatron-DeepSpeed。
timeline.source_name: Shoeybi, M. et al. (2019) arXiv:1909.08053
timeline.summary_en: On September 19, 2019, NVIDIA published "Megatron-LM: Training Multi-Billion Parameter Language Models Using Model Parallelism" on arXiv (arXiv:1909.08053). By combining Tensor Parallelism (splitting each layer's Attention/FFN matrices across multiple GPUs) and Pipeline Parallelism (placing different layers on different GPUs), Megatron-LM trained an 8.3B parameter GPT-2 on 512 V100 GPUs, achieving a 52% single-GPU training efficiency. This breakthrough directly spawned NVIDIA NeMo Megatron, Microsoft DeepSpeed, and Megatron-DeepSpeed.

timeline.title_zh: Google T5:Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer
timeline.title_en: Google T5: Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer
timeline.summary_zh:
2019 年 10 月 10 日,Google 在 JMLR 21 发表《Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer》(arXiv:1910.10683)。
T5(Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer)用 Encoder-Decoder Transformer,把所有 NLP 任务统一为“文本输入 → 文本输出”格式。
T5 11B 在 GLUE、SuperGLUE、SQuAD、CNN-DM 等 30+ 任务上达到 SOTA。
T5 论文同时发布 C4(Colossal Clean Crawled Corpus)750GB 预训练数据集。
timeline.source_name: Raffel, C. et al. (2019) arXiv:1910.10683; JMLR 21
timeline.summary_en: On October 10, 2019, Google published "Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer" (arXiv:1910.10683) in JMLR 21, introducing T5 (Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer) to unify all NLP tasks into a "text input → text output" format using an Encoder-Decoder Transformer. T5 11B achieved SOTA on 30+ tasks, including GLUE, SuperGLUE, SQuAD, and CNN-DM. The paper also released the 750GB C4 (Colossal Clean Crawled Corpus) pre-training dataset.

timeline.title_zh: DeepMind AlphaStar:星际争霸 II 超大师级
timeline.title_en: DeepMind AlphaStar: StarCraft II Grandmaster Level
timeline.summary_zh:
2019 年 10 月 30 日,DeepMind 在 Nature 575:350-354 发表《Grandmaster level in StarCraft II using multi-agent reinforcement learning》。
AlphaStar 用 Transformer + Pointer Network + LSTM + Multi-Agent RL,在 StarCraft II Battle.net 上达到大师级(欧洲服务器前 0.2%)。
AlphaStar 训练用 200 年人类游戏 + 14 天自我对弈,League 训练模式让智能体互相竞争进化。
timeline.source_name: Vinyals, O. et al. (2019) Nature 575:350-354; AlphaStar blog
timeline.summary_en: On October 30, 2019, DeepMind published "Grandmaster level in StarCraft II using multi-agent reinforcement learning" in *Nature* (575:350-354). By combining Transformers, Pointer Networks, LSTMs, and multi-agent reinforcement learning, AlphaStar achieved Grandmaster status on StarCraft II's Battle.net, ranking in the top 0.2% of the European server. The agent was trained on 200 years of human gameplay followed by 14 days of self-play, utilizing a "League" training mode where agents competed to drive their own evolution.

timeline.title_zh: NVIDIA A100:LLM 训练硬件主力 4 年
timeline.title_en: NVIDIA A100: LLM Training Hardware Workhorse for 4 Years
timeline.summary_zh:
2020 年 5 月 14 日,NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang 在 GTC 2020 Keynote(厨房录制,COVID 期间)发布 A100 GPU。
A100 是 Ampere 架构,7nm 工艺,826mm² die,54.2B 晶体管,40GB/80GB HBM2e,1.55TB/s 显存带宽,108 个 SM,432 个 Tensor Core(FP16 312 TFLOPS / TF32 156 TFLOPS / BF16 312 TFLOPS)。
DGX A100 8 卡版约 199,000 美元,2020-2024 年是 GPT-3、PaLM、LLaMA、GPT-4 训练主力。
timeline.source_name: NVIDIA Ampere whitepaper (2020); NVIDIA GTC 2020 keynote
timeline.summary_en: On May 14, 2020, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang unveiled the A100 GPU during his GTC 2020 Keynote, which was recorded in his kitchen during the COVID pandemic. Built on the Ampere architecture, the 7nm chip features an 826mm² die, 54.2B transistors, 40GB/80GB HBM2e with 1.55TB/s memory bandwidth, 108 SMs, and 432 Tensor Cores (FP16 312 TFLOPS / TF32 156 TFLOPS / BF16 312 TFLOPS). The 8-card DGX A100 version, priced at around $199,000, served as the primary training workhorse for GPT-3, PaLM, LLaMA, and GPT-4 from 2020 to 2024.

timeline.title_zh: Lewis RAG:检索增强生成范式提出
timeline.title_en: Lewis RAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation Paradigm Proposed
timeline.summary_zh:
2020 年 5 月 22 日,Facebook AI Research Patrick Lewis 等在 NeurIPS 2020 发表《Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks》(arXiv:2005.11401)。
RAG 用「检索器(Dense Passage Retrieval)+ 生成器(BART)」两阶段:检索器从知识库召回 top-k 文档,生成器基于检索文档生成答案。
RAG 在 OpenQA、Jeopardy QG、TriviaQA 上达到 SOTA,且知识库可热更新。
timeline.source_name: Lewis, P. et al. (2020) arXiv:2005.11401; NeurIPS 2020
timeline.summary_en: On May 22, 2020, Patrick Lewis and others at Facebook AI Research published "Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks" (arXiv:2005.11401) at NeurIPS 2020. RAG uses a two-stage process pairing a retriever (Dense Passage Retrieval) and a generator (BART), where the retriever recalls top-k documents from a knowledge base and the generator generates answers based on those retrieved documents. The framework achieved SOTA on OpenQA, Jeopardy QG, and TriviaQA, while allowing the underlying knowledge base to be hot-updated.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI GPT-3 175B:Scaling Laws 验证
timeline.title_en: OpenAI GPT-3 175B: Scaling Laws Validated
timeline.summary_zh:
2020 年 5 月 28 日,OpenAI 在 arXiv:2005.14165 发表《Language Models are Few-Shot Learners》。
GPT-3 用 96 层 Transformer Decoder,175B 参数,在 Common Crawl(499B token)+ WebText2 + Books1 + Books2 + Wikipedia 上训练。
GPT-3 首次展示“in-context learning”:不需微调,只在 prompt 中给 0/few-shot 示例就能完成翻译、问答、编程、推理等 50+ 任务。
GPT-3 论文引用 2024 年超 3 万次,是 LLM 时代奠基论文。
timeline.source_name: Brown, T. et al. (2020) arXiv:2005.14165; NeurIPS 2020
timeline.summary_en: On May 28, 2020, OpenAI published "Language Models are Few-Shot Learners" on arXiv:2005.14165, introducing GPT-3, a model trained on Common Crawl (499B tokens), WebText2, Books1, Books2, and Wikipedia using a 96-layer Transformer Decoder and 175B parameters. GPT-3 first demonstrated "in-context learning," performing over 50 tasks like translation, Q&A, programming, and reasoning without fine-tuning, using only zero- or few-shot examples in the prompt. With over 30,000 citations by 2024, it remains a foundational paper of the LLM era.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI API:LLM-as-a-Service 商业模式启动
timeline.title_en: OpenAI API: LLM-as-a-Service Business Model Launched
timeline.summary_zh:
2020 年 6 月 11 日,OpenAI 发布《OpenAI API》博客,推出 GPT-3 商用 API(private beta)。
API 端点统一为「text-in text-out」,价格按 token 计费(初期 0.06 美元/1K token)。
API 不卖模型权重,只卖推理服务,这是 LLM 时代「LLM-as-a-Service」商业模式起点。
2021-09 公测,2022-08 Codex API(GitHub Copilot),2022-11-30 ChatGPT 上线,2023-03 GPT-4 API。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI (2020-06-11) OpenAI API blog; private beta launch
timeline.summary_en: On June 11, 2020, OpenAI published its "OpenAI API" blog post to launch the commercial GPT-3 API in private beta, featuring a unified "text-in, text-out" endpoint priced initially at $0.06 per 1K tokens. By selling only inference services rather than model weights, this move marked the beginning of the LLM era's "LLM-as-a-Service" business model, which paved the way for a public beta in September 2021, the Codex API (GitHub Copilot) in August 2022, the launch of ChatGPT on November 30, 2022, and the GPT-4 API in March 2023.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI iGPT:图像自回归预训练探索
timeline.title_en: OpenAI iGPT: Image Autoregressive Pre-training Exploration
timeline.summary_zh:
2020 年 6 月 24 日,OpenAI 在 arXiv:2012.12656 发表《Generative Pretraining from Pixels》(实际 2020-06 公开 blog)。
iGPT(Image GPT)把 GPT-2 自回归架构扩展到图像:把 32×32 图像展开为 1024 序列,用 Transformer Decoder 自回归预测下一个像素。
iGPT-XL(6.8B 参数)在 ImageNet 上半监督分类达 72.0% top-1,接近 SimCLR 等 contrastive 路线。
timeline.source_name: Chen, M. et al. (2020) arXiv:2012.12656; OpenAI iGPT blog
timeline.summary_en: On June 24, 2020, OpenAI published "Generative Pretraining from Pixels" on arXiv:2012.12656 (having originally debuted the work in a June 2020 blog post), introducing iGPT (Image GPT) to adapt the autoregressive architecture of GPT-2 for computer vision by flattening 32×32 images into a sequence of 1024 and using a Transformer Decoder to predict the next pixel. The model's largest variant, iGPT-XL (6.8B parameters), achieved a 72.0% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet under semi-supervised classification, bringing it close to contrastive learning approaches like SimCLR.

timeline.title_zh: AlphaFold2:CASP14 蛋白质结构预测达到实验级精度
timeline.title_en: AlphaFold2: CASP14 Protein Structure Prediction Reaches Experimental Accuracy
timeline.summary_zh:
2020 年 11 月 30 日,CASP14(第 14 届 Critical Assessment of Protein Structure Prediction)会议公布结果,DeepMind AlphaFold2 在 GDT_TS 中位 92.4,远超第二名 75.6,首次达到实验级精度(X-ray 晶体学误差范围内)。
AlphaFold2 用 Evoformer + Structure Module,用 MSA(Multiple Sequence Alignment)+ Pair Representation 联合表征。
Nature 2021-07 15 发表 AlphaFold2 论文《Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold》。
timeline.source_name: Jumper, J. et al. (2021) Nature 596:583-589; CASP14 results (2020-11)
timeline.summary_en: On November 30, 2020, the results of the 14th Critical Assessment of Protein Structure Prediction (CASP14) were announced, showing DeepMind’s AlphaFold2 achieving a median GDT_TS of 92.4—far outstripping the runner-up's 75.6—to reach experimental-grade accuracy (within the margin of error of X-ray crystallography) for the first time. AlphaFold2 utilizes Evoformer and Structure Module, employing MSA (Multiple Sequence Alignment) and Pair Representation for joint representation. On July 15, 2021, *Nature* published the AlphaFold2 paper, "Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold."

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI CLIP + DALL·E:多模态预训练范式确立
timeline.title_en: OpenAI CLIP + DALL·E: Multimodal Pre-training Paradigm Established
timeline.summary_zh:
2021 年 1 月 5 日,OpenAI 同时发布 CLIP(Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training,arXiv:2103.00020,实际 2021-02-26 arXiv)和 DALL·E(arXiv:2102.12092,2021-01-05 blog)。
CLIP 用 4 亿图文对训练双塔模型,把图像和文本映射到同一 512 维空间,在 30+ 视觉分类任务上 zero-shot 接近监督 SOTA。
DALL·E 用 120 亿参数 dVAE + Transformer,文本生成图像。
两篇论文奠定「多模态统一表征」路线。
timeline.source_name: Radford, A. et al. (2021) CLIP arXiv:2103.00020; Ramesh, A. et al. DALL·E arXiv:2102.12092
timeline.summary_en: On January 5, 2021, OpenAI simultaneously released CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training, arXiv:2103.00020, actually 2021-02-26 arXiv) and DALL·E (arXiv:2102.12092, 2021-01-05 blog). CLIP trained a dual-tower model on 400 million image-text pairs to map images and text into the same 512-dimensional space, approaching supervised SOTA on 30+ visual classification tasks via zero-shot learning, while DALL·E employed a 12-billion-parameter dVAE + Transformer for text-to-image generation. Together, these two papers laid the foundation for the "unified multimodal representation" pathway.

timeline.title_zh: Hu LoRA:低秩适配器开启高效微调时代
timeline.title_en: Hu LoRA: Low-Rank Adapters Enable Efficient Fine-tuning Era
timeline.summary_zh:
2021 年 6 月 17 日,Microsoft Edward Hu 等在 arXiv:2106.09685 发表《LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models》。
LoRA 把权重更新 ΔW 分解为两个低秩矩阵 BA(B∈r×d,A∈d×r,r≪d),只训练 BA 不动原权重,可训练参数降低 1000-10000 倍。
LoRA 在 GPT-3 175B 上把微调参数从 175B 降到 4.7M(0.003%),性能持平或略优。
timeline.summary_en: On June 17, 2021, Microsoft’s Edward Hu and others published "LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models" on arXiv:2106.09685. LoRA decomposes the weight update ΔW into two low-rank matrices BA (B∈r×d, A∈d×r, r≪d), training only BA while keeping the original weights frozen, which slashes trainable parameters by 1,000 to 10,000 times. On GPT-3 175B, this method reduced fine-tuning parameters from 175B to just 4.7M (0.003%) while delivering comparable or slightly superior performance.

timeline.title_zh: GitHub Copilot 公测:AI 编程助手进入主流
timeline.title_en: GitHub Copilot Public Beta: AI Coding Assistant Goes Mainstream
timeline.summary_zh:
2021 年 6 月 29 日,GitHub 与 OpenAI 联合宣布 GitHub Copilot Technical Preview 公测。
Copilot 基于 OpenAI Codex(GPT-3 微调版,代码训练 159GB GitHub 代码),在 VS Code 中提供行级 / 函数级代码补全,月费 10 美元。
2022-06-21 正式版上线,2023-03 推出 Copilot X(GPT-4 + Chat),2024-12 推出 Copilot Workspace(任务级 Agent)。
timeline.source_name: GitHub (2021-06-29) Copilot preview announcement; OpenAI Codex
timeline.summary_en: On June 29, 2021, GitHub and OpenAI jointly announced the public beta of GitHub Copilot Technical Preview. Powered by OpenAI Codex—a fine-tuned version of GPT-3 trained on 159GB of GitHub code—Copilot provides line-level and function-level code completion in VS Code for $10 a month. It officially launched on June 21, 2022, followed by the debuts of Copilot X (GPT-4 + Chat) in March 2023 and Copilot Workspace (a task-level Agent) in December 2024.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI Codex API:代码 LLM 商业化
timeline.title_en: OpenAI Codex API: Code LLM Commercialization
timeline.summary_zh:
2021 年 8 月 10 日,OpenAI 发布 Codex API 私测。
Codex 是 GPT-3 的代码专精版,在 OpenAI 收集的 159GB GitHub 公开代码(2021 年论文)上微调,支持 Python、JavaScript、Go、C++ 等 12+ 语言。
Codex API 端点 /v1/completions(code-davinci-001 模型),按 token 计费 0.06 美元/1K。
Codex 是 GitHub Copilot 背后模型,2022-08 Codex 退役,被 GPT-3.5 / GPT-4 取代。
timeline.source_name: Chen, M. et al. (2021) arXiv:2107.03374; OpenAI Codex API blog
timeline.summary_en: On August 10, 2021, OpenAI launched the private beta of its Codex API, a code-specialized version of GPT-3 fine-tuned on 159GB of public GitHub code (from its 2021 paper) that supports 12+ languages including Python, JavaScript, Go, and C++. The API endpoint `/v1/completions` (using the code-davinci-001 model) was priced at $0.06/1K tokens. Serving as the underlying model for GitHub Copilot, Codex was retired in August 2022 and replaced by GPT-3.5 and GPT-4.

timeline.title_zh: InstructGPT 论文:RLHF 路线工业落地
timeline.title_en: InstructGPT Paper: RLHF Industrialized
timeline.summary_zh:
2022 年 3 月 4 日,OpenAI 在 arXiv:2203.02155 发表《Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback》。
InstructGPT 用三阶段训练:1) SFT(监督微调,演示数据) 2) RM(奖励模型,偏好数据) 3) PPO(强化学习优化)。
1.3B InstructGPT 输出优于 175B GPT-3,证明 RLHF 比 scaling 更有效。
timeline.source_name: Ouyang, L. et al. (2022) arXiv:2203.02155; NeurIPS 2022
timeline.summary_en: On March 4, 2022, OpenAI published "Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback" on arXiv:2203.02155, training InstructGPT via three stages: 1) SFT (supervised fine-tuning, demonstration data), 2) RM (reward model, preference data), and 3) PPO (reinforcement learning optimization). The resulting 1.3B InstructGPT outperformed the 175B GPT-3, proving that RLHF is more effective than scaling.

timeline.title_zh: LAION-5B:58 亿图文对开源数据集发布
timeline.title_en: LAION-5B: 5.8B Image-Text Pairs Open Dataset Released
timeline.summary_zh:
2022 年 3 月 31 日,德国非营利组织 LAION(Large-scale Artificial Intelligence Open Network)在 arXiv:2210.08402 发表 LAION-5B 数据集。
LAION-5B 包含 58.5 亿英文 / 多语种图文对(2.3B 英文 + 2.3B 多语种 + 1.2B 未知语言),240TB 数据,从 Common Crawl 抓取,CLIP 过滤。
LAION-5B 直接训练 Stable Diffusion 1.x / 2.x,是 2022-2024 年开源文生图模型基础。
timeline.source_name: Schuhmann, C. et al. (2022) arXiv:2210.08402; LAION-5B
timeline.summary_en: On March 31, 2022, the German non-profit LAION (Large-scale Artificial Intelligence Open Network) published the LAION-5B dataset on arXiv:2210.08402. Scraped from Common Crawl and filtered using CLIP, the 240TB dataset contains 5.85 billion English/multilingual image-text pairs (comprising 2.3B English, 2.3B multilingual, and 1.2B unknown language pairs). LAION-5B directly trained Stable Diffusion 1.x / 2.x, serving as the foundation for open-source text-to-image models from 2022 to 2024.

timeline.title_zh: Google PaLM 540B:Pathways 大模型训练框架
timeline.title_en: Google PaLM 540B: Pathways Large Model Training Framework
timeline.summary_zh:
2022 年 4 月 4 日,Google 在 arXiv:2204.02311 发表《PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways》。
PaLM 540B 用 6144 个 TPU v4 训练,780B token(社交媒体 + 网页 + 代码 + 多语种)。
PaLM 在 BIG-bench 上 144 任务超越人类平均,在多语种、推理、代码任务上达 SOTA。
PaLM 是 Pathways 系统首次大规模应用,支持跨 TPU Pod 训练。
timeline.source_name: Chowdhery, A. et al. (2022) arXiv:2204.02311; PaLM 540B
timeline.summary_en: On April 4, 2022, Google published "PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways" on arXiv:2204.02311, detailing PaLM 540B, which was trained on 6144 TPU v4 chips across 780B tokens of social media, web pages, code, and multilingual data. Representing the first large-scale deployment of the Pathways system to support training across TPU Pods, the model achieved SOTA results in multilingual, reasoning, and coding tasks while beating the human average on 144 BIG-bench tasks.

timeline.title_zh: DeepMind Chinchilla:数据-参数标度律修正
timeline.title_en: DeepMind Chinchilla: Data-Parameter Scaling Law Correction
timeline.summary_zh:
2022 年 4 月 12 日,DeepMind 在 arXiv:2203.15556 发表《Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models》。
Chinchilla 70B(70B 参数 + 1.4T token 训练)在 MMLU、BIG-bench、阅读理解上击败 GPT-3 175B(175B 参数 + 300B token)。
Chinchilla 论文核心结论:Kaplan 2020 Scaling Laws 高估参数、低估数据,最优 compute-optimal 训练是「token 数 ≈ 20 × 参数数」。
timeline.source_name: Hoffmann, J. et al. (2022) arXiv:2203.15556; NeurIPS 2022
timeline.summary_en: On April 12, 2022, DeepMind published "Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models" on arXiv:2203.15556, demonstrating that Chinchilla 70B (70B parameters + 1.4T tokens training) beat GPT-3 175B (175B parameters + 300B tokens) on MMLU, BIG-bench, and reading comprehension. The paper's core conclusion is that the Kaplan 2020 Scaling Laws overestimated parameters and underestimated data, asserting that compute-optimal training requires "number of tokens ≈ 20 × number of parameters."

timeline.title_zh: Tri Dao FlashAttention:注意力 IO 优化奠基
timeline.title_en: Tri Dao FlashAttention: Attention IO Optimization Foundation
timeline.summary_zh:
2022 年 5 月 27 日,Tri Dao、Daniel Fu 在 arXiv:2205.14135 发表《FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness》(后 NeurIPS 2022 接收)。
FlashAttention 用 tiling + recomputation 优化 GPU SRAM/HBM IO,把 attention 计算从 O(N²) 显存降到 O(N),速度提升 2-4 倍,支持 16K+ 长上下文训练。
FlashAttention 开源后 2023 年成所有 LLM 训练标配。
timeline.source_name: Dao, T. & Fu, D. (2022) arXiv:2205.14135; NeurIPS 2022
timeline.summary_en: On May 27, 2022, Tri Dao and Daniel Fu published "FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness" on arXiv (arXiv:2205.14135), which was later accepted by NeurIPS 2022. By optimizing GPU SRAM/HBM IO through tiling and recomputation, FlashAttention slashed attention memory consumption from O(N²) to O(N), delivered a 2- to 4-fold speedup, and enabled 16K+ long-context training. Following its open-source release, FlashAttention became the standard for all LLM training in 2023.

timeline.title_zh: Midjourney v3 公测:订阅制文生图商业化
timeline.title_en: Midjourney v3 Beta: Subscription Text-to-Image Commercialization
timeline.summary_zh:
2022 年 7 月 12 日,David Holz 创立的 Midjourney 推出 v3 公测,通过 Discord 订阅(10/30/60 美元/月)。
Midjourney v3 用 Latent Diffusion + 自有数据集,在艺术风格、人脸、构图上优于 Stable Diffusion 1.x。
2022-08 OpenAI DALL·E 2、Stability SD 1.4、Midjourney v3 三家在 1 个月内集中发布,2022 年成「文生图元年」。
timeline.source_name: Midjourney (2022-07) v3 beta launch; David Holz interviews
timeline.summary_en: On July 12, 2022, David Holz’s Midjourney launched its v3 public beta via Discord subscriptions ($10/$30/$60 per month), using Latent Diffusion and a proprietary dataset to outperform Stable Diffusion 1.x in artistic style, faces, and composition. In August 2022, the concentrated release of OpenAI’s DALL·E 2, Stability’s SD 1.4, and Midjourney v3 within a single month cemented 2022 as the inaugural year of text-to-image generation.

timeline.title_zh: Stability AI Stable Diffusion 1.4:开源文生图爆发
timeline.title_en: Stability AI Stable Diffusion 1.4: Open Text-to-Image Era Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2022 年 8 月 22 日,Stability AI 在 GitHub / HuggingFace 发布 Stable Diffusion 1.4 模型权重(CreativeML Open RAIL-M 许可)。
SD 1.4 用 Latent Diffusion(Rombach 2022 CVPR)+ CLIP text encoder,在 LAION-5B 子集上训练,512×512 图像生成,可在消费级 GPU(8GB VRAM)运行。
SD 1.4 上线 1 周内 HuggingFace 下载超 10 万次,2022-10 SD 1.5 改进版发布。
timeline.source_name: Rombach, R. et al. (2022) arXiv:2112.10752; Stability AI SD 1.4 release
timeline.summary_en: On August 22, 2022, Stability AI released the Stable Diffusion 1.4 model weights on GitHub / HuggingFace under the CreativeML Open RAIL-M license. Built on Latent Diffusion (Rombach 2022 CVPR) and a CLIP text encoder, SD 1.4 was trained on a subset of LAION-5B for 512×512 image generation and could run on consumer-grade GPUs with 8GB VRAM. Within one week of its launch, SD 1.4 surpassed 100,000 downloads on HuggingFace, followed by the release of the improved SD 1.5 in October 2022.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI Whisper:开源语音识别奠基
timeline.title_en: OpenAI Whisper: Open-Source Speech Recognition Foundation
timeline.summary_zh:
2022 年 9 月 21 日,OpenAI 在 arXiv:2212.04356 发表《Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision》。
Whisper 用 68 万小时多语种音频训练(65% 英文 + 17% 非英文 + 18% 翻译对),Encoder-Decoder Transformer,在 0-shot 跨语种语音识别上接近监督 SOTA。
Whisper 模型权重开源( MIT 许可),tiny / base / small / medium / large 5 个版本。
timeline.source_name: Radford, A. et al. (2022) arXiv:2212.04356; Whisper GitHub
timeline.summary_en: On September 21, 2022, OpenAI published "Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision" on arXiv:2212.04356. Trained on 680,000 hours of multilingual audio (65% English, 17% non-English, and 18% translation pairs), the Encoder-Decoder Transformer-based Whisper approached supervised SOTA in zero-shot cross-lingual speech recognition. Its model weights were open-sourced under the MIT license in five versions: tiny, base, small, medium, and large.

timeline.title_zh: LangChain 开源:LLM 应用框架奠基
timeline.title_en: LangChain Open-Sourced: LLM Application Framework Foundation
timeline.summary_zh:
2022 年 10 月 20 日,Harrison Chase 在 GitHub 开源 LangChain v0.0.1。
LangChain 提供 Prompt 模板、Memory、Chains、Agents、Tools、VectorStores 抽象,让开发者用 Python / JS 构建端到端 LLM 应用。
LangChain 2023 年成 LLM 应用框架事实标准,2023-07 LangChain + LangSmith + LangServe 三件套,2024 年 ARR 5000 万美元,估值 11 亿美元。
timeline.source_name: Chase, H. (2022) LangChain v0.0.1 GitHub release
timeline.summary_en: On October 20, 2022, Harrison Chase open-sourced LangChain v0.0.1 on GitHub, offering abstractions for Prompt templates, Memory, Chains, Agents, Tools, and VectorStores to let developers build end-to-end LLM applications using Python / JS. LangChain became the de facto standard LLM application framework in 2023—introducing its LangChain + LangSmith + LangServe trio in July 2023—before reaching a $50 million ARR and a $1.1 billion valuation in 2024.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI ChatGPT:AI 的 iPhone 时刻
timeline.title_en: OpenAI ChatGPT: AI's iPhone Moment
timeline.summary_zh:
