2022 年 11 月 30 日,OpenAI 在 blog 发布 ChatGPT(chat.openai.com),免费公测。
ChatGPT 基于 GPT-3.5(2020 年 GPT-3 + 2022 年 InstructGPT RLHF 微调),支持多轮对话、上下文记忆、代码生成、写作、翻译。
5 天用户破 100 万(史上最快),2 个月 MAU 1 亿(TikTok 9 个月、Instagram 2.5 年),2023-01 月估值 290 亿美元,2023-04 ChatGPT Plus 上线,2024 年 ARR 超 30 亿美元。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI (2022-11-30) ChatGPT launch blog
timeline.summary_en: On November 30, 2022, OpenAI released ChatGPT (chat.openai.com) on its blog for a free public beta. Powered by GPT-3.5 (combining 2020's GPT-3 and 2022's InstructGPT RLHF fine-tuning), the chatbot supports multi-turn conversation, contextual memory, code generation, writing, and translation. It quickly became the fastest-growing service in history, hitting 1 million users in 5 days and 100 million MAUs in 2 months (compared to TikTok's 9 months and Instagram's 2.5 years), leading to a $29 billion valuation in January 2023, the launch of ChatGPT Plus in April 2023, and an ARR exceeding $3 billion by 2024.

timeline.title_zh: ElevenLabs 推出商业化语音合成
timeline.title_en: ElevenLabs Commercial Speech Synthesis Launch
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 1 月 23 日,ElevenLabs 公测语音合成平台 Beta。
ElevenLabs 用 60 秒参考音频克隆任意说话人音色,生成接近真人的多语种语音。
2023-01 Beta 上线后,语音合成质量超过 Google Wavenet、Amazon Polly、Microsoft Azure TTS。
ElevenLabs 支持 29 种语言,1 分钟参考音频即可克隆音色,5 分钟参考音频达到声音难以区分。
timeline.source_name: ElevenLabs (2023-01-23) Beta launch; TechCrunch coverage
timeline.summary_en: On January 23, 2023, ElevenLabs launched the public beta of its speech synthesis platform, cloning any speaker's voice with just 60 seconds of reference audio to generate near-human, multilingual speech. Following its January 2023 launch, the platform's synthesis quality surpassed Google Wavenet, Amazon Polly, and Microsoft Azure TTS. Supporting 29 languages, ElevenLabs can clone a voice with a 1-minute reference sample, making the voice virtually indistinguishable with 5 minutes of audio.

timeline.title_zh: 微软 Bing Chat:GPT-4 进入搜索引擎
timeline.title_en: Microsoft Bing Chat: GPT-4 in Search Engine
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 2 月 7 日,微软在 Redmond 发布 Bing Chat(新版 Bing + Edge),集成 GPT-4(内部代号 Sydney)。
Bing Chat 把 LLM 接入搜索引擎,用户问题先由 LLM 答 + 引用网页,再列出搜索结果。
Bing Chat 上线 48 小时内 waitlist 排到 100 万人,2 个月内 1 亿次对话。
微软 2023-03 把 Bing Chat 嵌入 Windows 11 任务栏,2023-07 改名 Microsoft Copilot。
timeline.source_name: Microsoft (2023-02-07) Bing Chat launch; The Verge coverage
timeline.summary_en: On February 7, 2023, Microsoft launched Bing Chat (the new Bing + Edge) in Redmond, integrating GPT-4 (internally codenamed Sydney) to connect an LLM to its search engine so user queries are first answered by the LLM with web citations before search results are listed. The service saw its waitlist swell to 1 million people within 48 hours of launch and reached 100 million conversations within two months. Microsoft embedded Bing Chat into the Windows 11 taskbar in March 2023, before rebranding it as Microsoft Copilot in July 2023.

timeline.title_zh: Meta LLaMA 泄露:开源大模型起点
timeline.title_en: Meta LLaMA Leak: Open-Source LLM Beginning
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 2 月 24 日,Meta AI 在 arXiv:2302.13971 发布《LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models》。
LLaMA 包括 7B/13B/33B/65B 四档,训练数据 1.4T tokens(Common Crawl + Wikipedia + Github + Books)。
LLaMA 论文宣称「研究专用」,权重需申请。
但 2023-03-03 权重通过 4chan 泄露到 GitHub,3 天内遍布 BitTorrent。
开源社区立刻基于 LLaMA 衍生:Alpaca(Stanford,$600 微调)、Vicuna(LMSYS)、WizardLM、Guanaco、ChatLLaMA。
timeline.source_name: Touvron, H. et al. (2023) arXiv:2302.13971; Meta AI blog
timeline.summary_en: On February 24, 2023, Meta AI published "LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models" on arXiv:2302.13971, featuring 7B/13B/33B/65B models trained on 1.4T tokens (Common Crawl + Wikipedia + GitHub + Books). Although the paper claimed LLaMA was for "research only" with weights requiring an application, the weights were leaked via 4chan to GitHub on March 3, 2023, spreading across BitTorrent within three days. The open-source community immediately began building LLaMA-based derivatives, including Alpaca (Stanford, $600 fine-tuning), Vicuna (LMSYS), WizardLM, Guanaco, and ChatLLaMA.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI GPT-4 发布:多模态 + 推理提升
timeline.title_en: OpenAI GPT-4 Release: Multimodal + Reasoning
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 3 月 14 日,OpenAI 发布 GPT-4(内部代号 GPT-4-base + GPT-4-turbo)。
GPT-4 在 MMLU 86.4%(GPT-3.5 70.0%)、HumanEval 67%、GSM8K 92%。
GPT-4 支持图像输入(GPT-4V),32K 上下文(后续 128K)。
GPT-4 在律师资格考试 BAR 上前 10%,在 SAT 1410/1600,在 AP 考试多门 5 分。
GPT-4 API 2023-03-14 waitlist,2023-07-06 全面开放。
GPT-4 是 2023 年所有前沿模型的基准线。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI (2023-03-14) GPT-4 Release blog; GPT-4 Technical Report
timeline.summary_en: On March 14, 2023, OpenAI released GPT-4 (internally codenamed GPT-4-base + GPT-4-turbo), which became the benchmark for all frontier models in 2023. The model featured image input (GPT-4V) and a 32K context window (later 128K), scoring 86.4% on MMLU (vs. GPT-3.5's 70.0%), 67% on HumanEval, and 92% on GSM8K, while placing in the top 10% on the BAR, scoring 1410/1600 on the SAT, and earning a 5 on multiple AP exams. Its API launched with a waitlist on March 14, 2023, and was fully opened on July 6, 2023.

timeline.title_zh: Anthropic Claude 1 发布:Anthropic 商业化起点
timeline.title_en: Anthropic Claude 1 Launch: Anthropic Commercialization Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 3 月 14 日,Anthropic 发布 Claude 1(同年 GPT-4 同日发布)。
Claude 1 上下文 9K,在 Cohere 多项任务上接近 GPT-3.5。
Claude 1 强调 Constitutional AI(AI 通过「宪法」原则自我修正),避免 GPT 的 RLHF 失控。
Claude 1 商用 API 2023-03-14,2023-07-11 Claude 2(100K 上下文,首次突破 LLM 上下文上限)。
Claude 路线:Claude 1(2023-03) → Claude 2(2023-07) → Claude Instant(2023-08) → Claude 3(2024-03) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet(2024-06) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2(2024-10) → Claude 3.7 Sonnet(2025-02) → Claude 4 Opus(2025-05)。
timeline.source_name: Anthropic (2023-03-14) Claude launch; Constitutional AI paper
timeline.summary_en: On March 14, 2023, Anthropic released Claude 1 (the same day GPT-4 debuted), featuring a 9K context window, approaching GPT-3.5 on multiple Cohere tasks, and emphasizing "Constitutional AI" (AI self-correction via "constitutional" principles) to avoid GPT's runaway RLHF issues. Following its commercial API launch on 2023-03-14, Claude 2 arrived on 2023-07-11 with a 100K context window, breaking the LLM context limit for the first time. This established Anthropic’s product roadmap: Claude 1 (2023-03) → Claude 2 (2023-07) → Claude Instant (2023-08) → Claude 3 (2024-03) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet (2024-06) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2 (2024-10) → Claude 3.7 Sonnet (2025-02) → Claude 4 Opus (2025-05).

timeline.title_zh: 百度文心一言:中国大模型产品化第一波
timeline.title_en: Baidu ERNIE Bot: China's First Wave of LLM Products
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 3 月 16 日,百度在北京总部发布文心一言(ERNIE Bot)。
文心一言基于 ERNIE 3.0+,支持文本、图像、代码生成。
文心一言发布演示为「录播」(预录视频),Robin Li 解释「出于安全考虑」。
文心一言 2023-08-31 公测,2023 年底 MAU 1.3 亿。
文心一言后,2023-03-阿里通义千问、2023-08-华为盘古、2023-10-讯飞星火、2023-10-智谱 ChatGLM 接连发布。
timeline.source_name: 百度 (2023-03-16) 文心一言发布会
timeline.summary_en: On March 16, 2023, Baidu unveiled ERNIE Bot—an ERNIE 3.0+-based model supporting text, image, and code generation—at its Beijing headquarters, opting for a pre-recorded demonstration that Robin Li explained was "for safety reasons." Following ERNIE Bot’s debut, a wave of competitors rolled out, including Alibaba’s Tongyi Qianwen in March 2023, Huawei’s Pangu in August 2023, and both iFlytek’s Spark and Zhipu AI’s ChatGLM in October 2023; ERNIE Bot itself entered public testing on August 31, 2023, reaching an MAU of 130 million by the end of the year.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI Evals 开源:LLM 评测框架标准化
timeline.title_en: OpenAI Evals Open-Sourced: LLM Evaluation Framework Standardization
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 3 月 23 日,OpenAI 在 GitHub 开源 Evals(框架用于评估 LLM)。
Evals 定义标准化评测协议:任务定义、prompt、参考答案、评分函数、数据集。
Evals 内置 MMLU、HellaSwag、GSM8K、HumanEval、TruthfulQA 等。
Evals 开源后 lm-evaluation-harness(EleutherAI)、lighteval(HuggingFace)、OpenCompass(上海AI实验室) 都基于其协议。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI (2023-03-23) Evals GitHub
timeline.summary_en: On March 23, 2023, OpenAI open-sourced Evals on GitHub, a framework for evaluating LLMs that defines a standardized protocol covering task definitions, prompts, reference answers, grading functions, and datasets. Featuring built-in benchmarks including MMLU, HellaSwag, GSM8K, HumanEval, and TruthfulQA, the release prompted EleutherAI's lm-evaluation-harness, HuggingFace's lighteval, and the Shanghai AI Laboratory's OpenCompass to base their own protocols on it.

timeline.title_zh: GPT-4 系统卡:前沿模型透明度范式
timeline.title_en: GPT-4 System Card: Frontier Model Transparency Paradigm
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 3 月 14 日,OpenAI 与 GPT-4 同步发布《GPT-4 System Card》(60 页)。
System Card 详述 GPT-4 的预训练、RLHF、红队测试、危险能力评估(生化武器、网络攻击、社会工程、自主复制)。
System Card 把「前沿模型透明度」变成行业标准,后续 Claude 3、Gemini 1.5、Llama 3、DeepSeek-R1 都发布 System Card。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI (2023-03-14) GPT-4 System Card
timeline.summary_en: On March 14, 2023, OpenAI launched its 60-page *GPT-4 System Card* alongside the model's debut, detailing its pre-training, RLHF, red teaming, and evaluations of dangerous capabilities like biological weapons, cyberattacks, social engineering, and autonomous replication. The document effectively turned "frontier model transparency" into an industry standard, with Claude 3, Gemini 1.5, Llama 3, and DeepSeek-R1 all following suit with their own System Cards.

timeline.title_zh: AutoGPT 引爆自主 Agent 开源热潮
timeline.title_en: AutoGPT Sparks Open-Source Autonomous Agent Trend
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 3 月 30 日,开发者 Toran Bruce Richards 在 GitHub 开源 AutoGPT。
AutoGPT 用 GPT-4 + Pinecone 做「目标驱动自主 Agent」:用户输入目标(如「研究并写一份量子计算报告」),AutoGPT 自动拆解、调用搜索、保存到 Pinecone、迭代生成。
AutoGPT 上线 7 天 GitHub stars 破 5 万,30 天破 10 万,2023 年 GitHub 第一热门仓库。
timeline.source_name: Richards, T. B. (2023-03-30) AutoGPT GitHub
timeline.summary_en: On March 30, 2023, developer Toran Bruce Richards open-sourced AutoGPT on GitHub. Utilizing GPT-4 and Pinecone to power a "goal-driven autonomous agent," the system takes a user-input goal (such as "research and write a report on quantum computing") and automatically breaks it down, executes searches, saves to Pinecone, and iteratively generates the output. AutoGPT surpassed 50,000 GitHub stars within 7 days of launch and topped 100,000 within 30 days, becoming the most popular repository on GitHub in 2023.

timeline.title_zh: DPO 论文:RLHF 替代方案
timeline.title_en: DPO Paper: RLHF Alternative
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 5 月 26 日,斯坦福 + CMU + Berkeley 在 arXiv:2305.18290 发表《Direct Preference Optimization》。
DPO 把 RLHF 从「训练 reward model + PPO 强化学习」简化为「直接用偏好数据微调 LLM」一步。
DPO 训练成本是 PPO 的 1/10,稳定性更高,质量接近。
DPO 后被 Llama 2 Chat、Mistral Instruct、Zephyr、Qwen 2 Instruct、DeepSeek-R1 全部采用。
timeline.source_name: Rafailov, R. et al. (2023) arXiv:2305.18290; NeurIPS 2023
timeline.summary_en: On May 26, 2023, Stanford, CMU, and Berkeley published "Direct Preference Optimization" on arXiv:2305.18290, simplifying RLHF from training a reward model and PPO reinforcement learning into a single step of directly fine-tuning the LLM with preference data. At just 1/10 the training cost of PPO, DPO offers higher stability and comparable quality. The breakthrough was later adopted by Llama 2 Chat, Mistral Instruct, Zephyr, Qwen 2 Instruct, and DeepSeek-R1.

timeline.title_zh: Meta Llama 2 商用开源:开源 LLM 商业化起点
timeline.title_en: Meta Llama 2 Commercial Open-Source: Open-Source LLM Commercialization Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 7 月 18 日,Meta 在 arXiv:2307.09288 发布《Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models》。
Llama 2 包括 7B/13B/70B,4K 上下文,商用许可(月活 7 亿以下免费)。
Llama 2-Chat 用 RLHF + Safety RLHF + Red Teaming 训练。
Llama 2 上线 1 周下载量 100 万次,3 个月内 AWS、Azure、Google Cloud、AWS Bedrock 全部上架。
timeline.source_name: Touvron, H. et al. (2023) arXiv:2307.09288; Meta blog
timeline.summary_en: On July 18, 2023, Meta published "Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models" on arXiv:2307.09288, offering 7B/13B/70B models with a 4K context window under a commercial license free for under 700 million monthly active users. Its dialogue-tuned counterpart, Llama 2-Chat, was trained using RLHF, Safety RLHF, and red teaming. Llama 2 racked up 1 million downloads in its first week of launch and was deployed on AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and AWS Bedrock within three months.

timeline.title_zh: 阿里通义千问开源:中国开源 LLM 旗舰起点
timeline.title_en: Alibaba Qwen Open-Source: China's Open-Source LLM Flagship Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 8 月 3 日,阿里云发布通义千问 Qwen-7B(2023-09-25 开源)。
Qwen-7B 在 C-Eval、MMLU、HumanEval 多项中文评测上超过 Llama 2 7B。
Qwen 后续路线:Qwen-7B(2023-08) → Qwen-14B(2023-09) → Qwen-72B(2023-12) → Qwen 1.5(2024-02) → Qwen 2(2024-06) → Qwen 2.5(2024-09) → Qwen 3(2025-04)。
timeline.source_name: Bai, J. et al. (2023) Qwen Technical Report; arXiv:2309.16609
timeline.summary_en: On August 3, 2023, Alibaba Cloud released Tongyi Qianwen Qwen-7B (open-sourced on September 25, 2023), which outperformed Llama 2 7B on multiple Chinese benchmarks including C-Eval, MMLU, and HumanEval. The subsequent Qwen roadmap progressed as follows: Qwen-7B (2023-08) → Qwen-14B (2023-09) → Qwen-72B (2023-12) → Qwen 1.5 (2024-02) → Qwen 2 (2024-06) → Qwen 2.5 (2024-09) → Qwen 3 (2025-04).

timeline.title_zh: Meta Code Llama:开源代码 LLM 起步
timeline.title_en: Meta Code Llama: Open-Source Code LLM Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 8 月 24 日,Meta 在 arXiv:2308.12950 发布《Code Llama》。
Code Llama 基于 Llama 2 用 500B code tokens 微调,包括 7B/13B/34B 三档 + Code Llama-Python 专门版 + Code Llama-Instruct。
Code Llama 34B 在 HumanEval 53.7%,超过 GPT-3.5(48.1%)。
Code Llama 用 Apache 2.0 + Llama 2 商用许可开源。
timeline.source_name: Rozière, B. et al. (2023) arXiv:2308.12950; Meta blog
timeline.summary_en: On August 24, 2023, Meta released "Code Llama" on arXiv:2308.12950, introducing a family of models fine-tuned from Llama 2 on 500B code tokens. The release spans 7B, 13B, and 34B sizes—along with specialized Code Llama-Python and Code Llama-Instruct versions—with Code Llama 34B scoring 53.7% on HumanEval to beat GPT-3.5's 48.1%. Code Llama is open-sourced under the Apache 2.0 and Llama 2 commercial licenses.

timeline.title_zh: ChatGPT 语音 + 视觉:多模态 LLM 落地
timeline.title_en: ChatGPT Voice + Vision: Multimodal LLM Goes Live
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 9 月 25 日,OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 上线 Voice(语音对话) + Vision(图像理解)。
Voice 用 Whisper + 自己的 TTS,接近真人对话延迟。
Vision 用 GPT-4V,支持用户上传图片提问。
ChatGPT Voice + Vision 让 ChatGPT 从「文本对话」走向「多模态助手」,直接催生 2024 年 GPT-4o(实时多模态)。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI (2023-09-25) ChatGPT Voice + Vision blog
timeline.summary_en: On September 25, 2023, OpenAI rolled out Voice and Vision for ChatGPT: Voice paired Whisper with proprietary TTS for near-human conversational latency, while Vision used GPT-4V to let users upload images and ask questions. Evolving ChatGPT from a text chatbot into a multimodal assistant, this update directly spawned the real-time multimodal GPT-4o in 2024.

timeline.title_zh: Mistral 7B 发布:欧洲开源大模型旗舰起点
timeline.title_en: Mistral 7B Release: European Open LLM Flagship
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 9 月 27 日,Mistral AI 在 arXiv:2310.06825 发布《Mistral 7B》。
Mistral 7B 用 7.3B 参数在所有评测上超过 Llama 2 13B,代码任务上超过 Llama 2 34B。
关键创新:Grouped Query Attention(GQA)、Sliding Window Attention(SWA,4096)、Rolling Buffer Cache。
Mistral 7B 用 Apache 2.0 许可开源权重,首次让欧洲团队进入全球开源 LLM 第一梯队。
timeline.source_name: Jiang, A. Q. et al. (2023) arXiv:2310.06825; Mistral AI blog
timeline.summary_en: On September 27, 2023, Mistral AI released "Mistral 7B" on arXiv:2310.06825, presenting a 7.3B-parameter model that outperformed Llama 2 13B on all benchmarks and beat Llama 2 34B on coding tasks. Built on key innovations like Grouped Query Attention (GQA), Sliding Window Attention (SWA, 4096), and Rolling Buffer Cache, the model open-sourced its weights under the Apache 2.0 license, marking the first time a European team entered the top tier of global open-source LLMs.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI DevDay:GPTs + Assistants API + GPT-4 Turbo
timeline.title_en: OpenAI DevDay: GPTs + Assistants API + GPT-4 Turbo
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 11 月 6 日,OpenAI 在 San Francisco 举办首届 DevDay。
发布:1) GPT-4 Turbo(128K 上下文,知识截至 2023-04,价格降 2.7 倍);2) GPTs(用户可视化搭建 GPT,无需代码);3) Assistants API(状态管理 + 工具调用 + 代码解释器 + 检索);4) DALL·E 3 API;5) Whisper v3;6) Custom Models 计划;7) 版权保护 Copyright Shield。
GPT Store 2024-01 上线。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI (2023-11-06) DevDay keynote
timeline.summary_en: At its inaugural DevDay in San Francisco on November 6, 2023, OpenAI debuted GPT-4 Turbo, boasting a 128K context window, knowledge cutoff of April 2023, and a 2.7x price reduction. The company also unveiled no-code GPTs for visual bot-building, the Assistants API (featuring state management, tool calling, a code interpreter, and retrieval), the DALL·E 3 API, Whisper v3, the Custom Models program, and Copyright Shield protection. Finally, OpenAI announced that the GPT Store would launch in January 2024.

timeline.title_zh: Google Gemini 1.0:原生多模态 LLM
timeline.title_en: Google Gemini 1.0: Native Multimodal LLM
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 12 月 6 日,Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini 1.0(Ultra/Pro/Nano 三档)。
Gemini 是首个原生多模态 LLM(图像/音频/视频/文本统一编码),非拼接。
Gemini Ultra 在 MMLU 90.0%(GPT-4 86.4%),首次反超 GPT-4。
Gemini Pro 集成到 Bard、Pixel 8 Pro、Google Search。
Gemini Nano 在 Pixel 8 Pro 本地运行。
timeline.source_name: Google DeepMind (2023-12-06) Gemini 1.0 blog; Technical Report
timeline.summary_en: On December 6, 2023, Google DeepMind launched Gemini 1.0 in three tiers (Ultra, Pro, and Nano) as the first natively multimodal LLM featuring unified encoding of image, audio, video, and text instead of a stitched-together system. Gemini Ultra scored 90.0% on MMLU, surpassing GPT-4 (86.4%) for the first time. While Gemini Pro was integrated into Bard, Pixel 8 Pro, and Google Search, Gemini Nano runs locally on the Pixel 8 Pro.

timeline.title_zh: Google Imagen 2:Google 文生图升级
timeline.title_en: Google Imagen 2: Google Text-to-Image Upgrade
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 12 月 7 日,Google DeepMind 在 Vertex AI 发布 Imagen 2。
Imagen 2 用扩散模型 + 文本理解 + RLHF,在图像质量、文字渲染、人脸生成上超过 Imagen 1。
Imagen 2 集成到 Bard、Google Slides、Google Ads。
Imagen 2 不开源权重,只 API。
timeline.source_name: Google DeepMind (2023-12-07) Imagen 2 blog
timeline.summary_en: On December 7, 2023, Google DeepMind launched Imagen 2 on Vertex AI, utilizing diffusion models, text understanding, and RLHF to outperform Imagen 1 in image quality, text rendering, and face generation. Now integrated into Bard, Google Slides, and Google Ads, the model's weights remain closed-source, with access offered only via API.

timeline.title_zh: Mixtral 8x7B:开源 MoE LLM 起步
timeline.title_en: Mixtral 8x7B: Open-Source MoE LLM Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 12 月 11 日,Mistral AI 在 arXiv:2401.04088 发布《Mixtral of Experts》。
Mixtral 8x7B 用 8 个专家(expert),每 token 路由到 2 个专家,总参 46.7B、激活 12.9B。
Mixtral 8x7B 在多数评测上超过 Llama 2 70B,GPT-3.5。
Mixtral 8x7B 用 Apache 2.0 商用开源。
Mixtral 路线:Mixtral 8x7B(2023-12) → Mixtral 8x7B Instruct(2023-12) → Mixtral 8x22B(2024-04) → Mistral Large 2(2024-07)。
timeline.source_name: Jiang, A. Q. et al. (2023) arXiv:2401.04088; Mistral blog
timeline.summary_en: On December 11, 2023, Mistral AI published "Mixtral of Experts" on arXiv:2401.04088, detailing Mixtral 8x7B, a model utilizing 8 experts (routing 2 per token) with 46.7B total and 12.9B active parameters. Commercially open-sourced under the Apache 2.0 license, it outperformed Llama 2 70B and GPT-3.5 on most benchmarks, paving the way for a roadmap that evolved from Mixtral 8x7B (2023-12) and Mixtral 8x7B Instruct (2023-12) to Mixtral 8x22B (2024-04) and Mistral Large 2 (2024-07).

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI Sora 公布:视频生成里程碑
timeline.title_en: OpenAI Sora Reveal: Video Generation Milestone
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年 2 月 15 日,OpenAI 公布 Sora(text-to-video 模型,最长 60 秒)。
Sora 用 DiT(Diffusion Transformer)架构,把视频生成从「U-Net 扩散」推向「Transformer 扩散」。
Sora 演示视频质量震惊业界,但 OpenAI 未开源 + 延迟发布。
Sora 2024-12 才开放给 ChatGPT Plus 用户,2024-12-09 Sora 2 发布。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI (2024-02-15) Sora reveal; Brooks-Peebles DiT paper
timeline.summary_en: On February 15, 2024, OpenAI unveiled Sora, a text-to-video model capable of generating clips up to 60 seconds long. Utilizing a DiT (Diffusion Transformer) architecture, Sora pushed video generation from "U-Net diffusion" to "Transformer diffusion." Although its stunning demo quality shocked the industry, OpenAI kept the model closed-source and delayed its release, only opening it to ChatGPT Plus users in December 2024, followed by the launch of Sora 2 on December 9, 2024.

timeline.title_zh: Anthropic Claude 3 发布:首次反超 GPT-4
timeline.title_en: Anthropic Claude 3: First to Surpass GPT-4
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年 3 月 4 日,Anthropic 发布 Claude 3(Haiku/Sonnet/Opus 三档)。
Claude 3 Opus 在 MMLU 86.8%(GPT-4 86.4%),首次反超 GPT-4。
Claude 3 Opus 200K 上下文,vision 多模态。
Claude 3 Sonnet 速度更快,价格更低,实际生产部署最多。
Claude 3 路线:Claude 3(2024-03) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet(2024-06-20) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2(2024-10-22) → Claude 3.7 Sonnet(2025-02-24) → Claude 4 Opus(2025-05-22)。
timeline.source_name: Anthropic (2024-03-04) Claude 3 launch; Model Card
timeline.summary_en: On March 4, 2024, Anthropic released its Claude 3 family—spanning the Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus tiers—with the flagship Claude 3 Opus scoring 86.8% on the MMLU to edge out GPT-4 (86.4%) for the first time. While the multimodal, vision-capable Opus boasted a 200K context window, the faster and cheaper Sonnet saw the most actual production deployments. This launched a rapid release cycle: Claude 3 (2024-03) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet (2024-06-20) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2 (2024-10-22) → Claude 3.7 Sonnet (2025-02-24) → Claude 4 Opus (2025-05-22).

timeline.title_zh: 欧盟 AI Act 通过:全球首部 AI 监管法
timeline.title_en: EU AI Act Passed: World's First AI Regulation Law
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年 3 月 13 日,欧洲议会通过《AI Act》。
AI Act 按风险分四档:不可接受(禁)、高风险(限)、有限风险(透明)、最小风险(自由)。
AI Act 对 General Purpose AI(GPAI) + Systemic Risk LLM(>=10^25 FLOPS) 设特殊义务:模型卡、版权披露、红队测试、严重事件报告。
AI Act 2024-08-01 生效,2026-08 全面执行,违规罚 3500 万欧元或营收 7%。
timeline.source_name: European Parliament (2024-03-13) AI Act adoption; Official Journal
timeline.summary_en: On March 13, 2024, the European Parliament passed the AI Act, which categorizes AI into four risk tiers: unacceptable (banned), high risk (restricted), limited risk (transparency), and minimal risk (free). The Act imposes special obligations on General Purpose AI (GPAI) and Systemic Risk LLM (>=10^25 FLOPS), requiring model cards, copyright disclosures, red-teaming, and serious incident reporting. Taking effect on August 1, 2024, and entering full enforcement by August 2026, the Act penalizes violations with fines of 35 million euros or 7% of revenue.

timeline.title_zh: Meta Llama 3 发布:开源 LLM 跨过 GPT-3.5
timeline.title_en: Meta Llama 3 Release: Open-Source LLM Crosses GPT-3.5
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年 4 月 18 日,Meta 发布 Llama 3(8B/70B)。
Llama 3 用 15T tokens 训练(比 Llama 2 多 7 倍),8K 上下文。
Llama 3 70B 在 MMLU 82.0%(GPT-4 86.4%),Llama 3 8B 在多数任务上超过 Llama 2 70B。
Llama 3 Instruct 用 SFT + DPO + RLHF 训练。
Llama 3 路线:Llama 3 8B/70B(2024-04) → Llama 3.1 405B(2024-07-23,首个 405B 开源) → Llama 3.2 1B/3B(2024-09,边缘) → Llama 3.3 70B(2024-12) → Llama 4(2025-04-05)。
timeline.source_name: Meta (2024-04-18) Llama 3 release; Meta AI blog
timeline.summary_en: On April 18, 2024, Meta launched Llama 3 (8B/70B)—trained on 15T tokens (7x more than Llama 2) with an 8K context window—employing SFT, DPO, and RLHF for its Instruct version. While Llama 3 70B hit 82.0% on MMLU (against GPT-4's 86.4%) and the 8B model beat Llama 2 70B on most tasks, it also kicked off an ambitious roadmap: Llama 3 8B/70B (2024-04) → Llama 3.1 405B (2024-07-23, the first open-source 405B) → Llama 3.2 1B/3B (2024-09, edge) → Llama 3.3 70B (2024-12) → Llama 4 (2025-04-05).

timeline.title_zh: DeepSeek-V2:中国开源 MoE + API 价格战起点
timeline.title_en: DeepSeek-V2: China's Open-Source MoE + API Price War Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年 5 月 7 日,DeepSeek 在 arXiv:2405.04434 发布《DeepSeek-V2: A Strong, Economical, and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Language Model》。
DeepSeek-V2 用 236B 总参、21B 激活的 MoE,创新 MLA(Multi-Head Latent Attention) + DeepSeekMoE。
DeepSeek-V2 API 价格 ¥1/1M input(同档 Llama 3 70B 的 1/100),直接引爆中国 LLM 价格战。
timeline.source_name: DeepSeek-AI (2024) arXiv:2405.04434; DeepSeek blog
timeline.summary_en: On May 7, 2024, DeepSeek published "DeepSeek-V2: A Strong, Economical, and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Language Model" on arXiv:2405.04434, introducing an MoE model with 236B total and 21B active parameters that features innovative MLA (Multi-Head Latent Attention) and DeepSeekMoE architectures. Priced at just ¥1/1M input—1/100 of the cost of the comparable Llama 3 70B—the DeepSeek-V2 API instantly ignited a price war in the Chinese LLM market.

timeline.title_zh: GPT-4o:实时多模态 LLM 起点
timeline.title_en: GPT-4o: Real-Time Multimodal LLM Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年 5 月 13 日,OpenAI 发布 GPT-4o(omni)。
GPT-4o 是首个原生多模态 LLM(文本+图像+音频统一编码),语音对话延迟 232ms(接近人类 200ms)。
GPT-4o 在 MMLU 88.7%(超过 GPT-4 Turbo 86.5%)。
GPT-4o 免费向所有 ChatGPT 用户开放,Plus 5 倍额度。
GPT-4o API 价格降 50%($5/1M input)。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI (2024-05-13) GPT-4o launch; System Card
timeline.summary_en: On May 13, 2024, OpenAI released GPT-4o (omni), the first native multimodal LLM featuring unified encoding for text, images, and audio, boasting a voice conversation latency of 232ms (nearing the human rate of 200ms). Scoring 88.7% on the MMLU to surpass GPT-4 Turbo's 86.5%, the model is available for free to all ChatGPT users, with Plus users receiving 5 times the limit. Additionally, the GPT-4o API price has been cut by 50% ($5/1M input).

timeline.title_zh: Claude 3.5 Sonnet:开源编程模型新基准
timeline.title_en: Claude 3.5 Sonnet: New Benchmark for Coding
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年 6 月 20 日,Anthropic 发布 Claude 3.5 Sonnet。
Claude 3.5 Sonnet 在编程(HumanEval 92.0%)、推理(GPQA 59.4%)、视觉(文档理解)上全面超越 GPT-4o。
Claude 3.5 Sonnet 价格是 GPT-4o 的 1/5。
Claude 3.5 Sonnet 推出 Artifacts(代码 + 文档实时渲染)。
timeline.source_name: Anthropic (2024-06-20) Claude 3.5 Sonnet launch
timeline.summary_en: On June 20, 2024, Anthropic released Claude 3.5 Sonnet, which outperforms GPT-4o in coding (HumanEval 92.0%), reasoning (GPQA 59.4%), and vision (document understanding) at one-fifth the price of GPT-4o. The release also introduces Artifacts, a feature enabling the real-time rendering of code and documents.

timeline.title_zh: Meta Llama 3.1 405B:首个 405B 开源模型
timeline.title_en: Meta Llama 3.1 405B: First 405B Open-Source Model
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年 7 月 23 日,Meta 发布 Llama 3.1(8B/70B/405B 三档)。
Llama 3.1 405B 是首个 405B 开源模型,在 MMLU 88.6%(超过 GPT-4o 88.7%)、GSM8K 96.8%。
Llama 3.1 405B 训练用 16K H100,54 天,15T tokens,成本约 6.5 亿美元。
Llama 3.1 把上下文从 8K 扩到 128K,工具调用 + 多语言(8 种)强化。
timeline.source_name: Meta (2024-07-23) Llama 3.1 release; arXiv:2407.21783
timeline.summary_en: On July 23, 2024, Meta released Llama 3.1 in three sizes (8B/70B/405B), featuring the first-ever 405B open-source model, which scored 88.6% on MMLU (surpassing GPT-4o's 88.7%) and 96.8% on GSM8K. Training the 405B model required 16K H100 GPUs, 54 days, and 15T tokens, costing approximately $650 million. Llama 3.1 expands the context window from 8K to 128K and features enhanced tool use and multilingual support across 8 languages.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI o1:推理模型时代起点
timeline.title_en: OpenAI o1: Reasoning Model Era Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年 9 月 12 日,OpenAI 发布 o1-preview + o1-mini。
o1 用 RL + Chain-of-Thought 训练,在数学(AIME 83.3%,GPT-4o 13.4%)、编程(Codeforces 89%)、博士级科学(GPQA 78%) 上大幅超越 GPT-4o。
o1 推理时输出长 CoT(几千-几万 token),延迟从 GPT-4o 1 秒到 o1 10-30 秒。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI (2024-09-12) o1 launch; Learning to Reason blog
timeline.summary_en: On September 12, 2024, OpenAI released o1-preview and o1-mini. Trained using reinforcement learning and Chain-of-Thought, o1 dramatically outperforms GPT-4o in mathematics (scoring 83.3% on AIME compared to GPT-4o's 13.4%), coding (89% on Codeforces), and PhD-level science (78% on GPQA). During inference, o1 generates a long Chain-of-Thought spanning thousands to tens of thousands of tokens, which increases latency from GPT-4o's 1 second to 10-30 seconds for o1.

timeline.title_zh: Hassabis 与 Jumper 获诺贝尔化学奖:AI for Science 里程碑
timeline.title_en: Hassabis & Jumper Nobel Chemistry Prize: AI for Science Milestone
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年 10 月 9 日,诺贝尔化学奖一半授予 Demis Hassabis 和 John Jumper(AlphaFold),另一半授予 David Baker(蛋白质设计)。
AlphaFold 2(2020-11) 解决蛋白质结构预测 50 年难题,AlphaFold 3(2024-05-08) 扩展到 DNA/RNA/配体。
Hassabis 是首位获诺贝尔奖的 AI 公司 CEO。
timeline.source_name: Nobel Prize (2024-10-09) Chemistry announcement; DeepMind AlphaFold
timeline.summary_en: On October 9, 2024, the Nobel Prize in Chemistry was awarded, with one half going to David Baker for protein design, and the other half to Demis Hassabis and John Jumper for AlphaFold, making Hassabis the first AI company CEO to win a Nobel Prize. AlphaFold 2 (2020-11) solved a 50-year challenge in protein structure prediction, while AlphaFold 3 (2024-05-08) expanded the model's capabilities to DNA, RNA, and ligands.

timeline.title_zh: Claude Computer Use:LLM 直接操作电脑
timeline.title_en: Claude Computer Use: LLM Directly Operates Computer
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年 10 月 22 日,Anthropic 在 Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2 同步推出 Computer Use API(beta)。
Claude Computer Use 让 LLM 通过截图 + 鼠标键盘控制直接操作电脑(浏览器、终端、文件)。
Claude Computer Use 是首个商用 Computer Use Agent,定义 2024-2025 年「GUI Agent」方向。
timeline.source_name: Anthropic (2024-10-22) Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2 + Computer Use
timeline.summary_en: On October 22, 2024, Anthropic launched the Computer Use API (beta) alongside Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2. Claude Computer Use allows LLMs to directly operate computers (browsers, terminals, files) via screenshots and mouse/keyboard control. As the first commercial Computer Use Agent, it defines the direction of "GUI Agents" for 2024-2025.

timeline.title_zh: NVIDIA H100:前沿大模型训练主力 GPU
timeline.title_en: NVIDIA H100: Main GPU for Frontier LLM Training
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年,NVIDIA H100 Hopper GPU 成前沿大模型训练主力。
H100 2022-03 GTC 发布,2023-03 出货,2024 年成为 OpenAI GPT-4o、Anthropic Claude 3、Google Gemini 1.5、Meta Llama 3.1 405B、xAI Grok 2 的训练主力。
H100 FP16 算力 1979 TFLOPS(A100 312 TFLOPS 6.3 倍)、HBM3 80GB、3.2TB/s 带宽。
H100 集群最大规模:xAI Colossus 10 万张 H100(2024-09)、Meta 6 万张、Google TPU v5p 8912 块等效。
timeline.source_name: NVIDIA (2022-03-22) H100 Hopper announcement; 2024 Q4 earnings
timeline.summary_en: Announced at GTC in March 2022 and shipped in March 2023, the NVIDIA H100 Hopper GPU became the dominant workhorse for training frontier AI in 2024, powering OpenAI’s GPT-4o, Anthropic’s Claude 3, Google’s Gemini 1.5, Meta’s Llama 3.1 405B, and xAI’s Grok 2. The silicon boasts 1,979 TFLOPS of FP16 compute (6.3 times the A100’s 312 TFLOPS), 80GB of HBM3 memory, and 3.2TB/s of bandwidth. The largest H100 clusters reached massive scales, led by xAI’s Colossus with 100,000 H100s in September 2024, Meta with 60,000, and Google’s equivalent deployment of 8,912 TPU v5p chips.

timeline.title_zh: 小模型蒸馏兴起:7B 反超 GPT-3.5 时代
timeline.title_en: Small Model Distillation: 7B Beats GPT-3.5 Era
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年,7B-14B 小模型通过蒸馏 + DPO 在多项任务上反超 GPT-3.5。
代表:Phi-3 mini 3.8B(Microsoft,2024-04)、Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct(2024-09)、Llama 3.2 1B/3B(2024-09)、Mistral NeMo 12B(2024-07)、Gemma 2 2B/9B/27B(Google,2024-06)。
这些模型可在手机、笔记本、边缘设备本地运行,质量超过 2023 年 GPT-3.5。
timeline.source_name: Microsoft Phi-3 (2024-04); Meta Llama 3.2 (2024-09); Apple Intelligence (2024-06)
timeline.summary_en: In 2024, small 7B-14B models leveraged distillation + DPO to surpass GPT-3.5 on multiple tasks, led by Microsoft's Phi-3 mini 3.8B (2024-04), Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct (2024-09), Llama 3.2 1B/3B (2024-09), Mistral NeMo 12B (2024-07), and Google's Gemma 2 2B/9B/27B (2024-06). Capable of running locally on phones, laptops, and edge devices, these models exceeded the quality of 2023's GPT-3.5.

timeline.title_zh: 长上下文竞争:1M token 时代
timeline.title_en: Long Context Race: 1M Token Era
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年,LLM 上下文从 32K 突破到 1M-2M。
代表:Gemini 1.5 Pro(2024-02,1M,后 2M)、Claude 3(2024-03,200K)、GPT-4 Turbo(2023-11,128K)、Llama 3.1 405B(2024-07,128K)、Qwen 2.5(2024-09,128K)。
长上下文让 LLM 一次性处理整本书、整个代码仓库、1 小时视频。
timeline.source_name: Google Gemini 1.5 (2024-02); Anthropic Claude 3 (2024-03)
timeline.summary_en: In 2024, LLM context windows surged from 32K to 1M-2M, headlined by Gemini 1.5 Pro (2024-02, 1M, later 2M), Claude 3 (2024-03, 200K), GPT-4 Turbo (2023-11, 128K), Llama 3.1 405B (2024-07, 128K), and Qwen 2.5 (2024-09, 128K). These massive context windows allow LLMs to process an entire book, a whole codebase, or 1 hour of video all at once.

timeline.title_zh: AI Factory 叙事成型:超大规模训练集群时代
timeline.title_en: AI Factory Narrative Forms: Massive Training Cluster Era
timeline.summary_zh:
2024-2025 年,AI Factory 叙事成型。
AI Factory 指 10 万+ GPU 量级 + 数据中心 + 能源 + 散热的「LLM 工厂」。
代表:xAI Colossus(10 万 H100,2024-09 建成,122 天)、Meta 6 万 H100、Microsoft + OpenAI 5 个 AI Factory、Amazon Trainium 2、Google TPU v5p Trillium、字节豆包 8 万 H100。
timeline.source_name: NVIDIA (2024-08) SIGGRAPH AI Factory; xAI Colossus (2024-09)
timeline.summary_en: During 2024–2025, the narrative of the "AI Factory" took shape, defined as LLM "factories" integrating 100,000+ GPUs with data centers, power, and cooling. Key examples include xAI Colossus (100,000 H100s, completed in September 2024 in 122 days), Meta's 60,000 H100s, Microsoft + OpenAI's 5 AI Factories, Amazon Trainium 2, Google TPU v5p Trillium, and ByteDance Doubao's 80,000 H100s.

timeline.title_zh: AI 办公全面嵌入
timeline.title_en: AI Embedded in Productivity Tools
timeline.summary_zh:
AI 助手全面嵌入搜索、办公、编程、设计与客服产品。
AI 不再只作为独立应用等用户打开，而是进入文档、邮件、会议、代码仓库、设计工具和客服系统。
用户开始在原来的工作流里遇到 AI。
timeline.source_name: General official product histories
timeline.summary_en: AI assistants have become deeply integrated across search, productivity, coding, design, and customer service products. No longer just standalone apps waiting to be opened, AI is moving directly into documents, emails, meetings, code repositories, design tools, and customer service systems. Users are now beginning to encounter AI right within their existing workflows.

timeline.title_zh: 推理模型竞赛升级
timeline.title_en: Reasoning Model Competition Escalates
timeline.summary_zh:
前沿模型竞争重点进一步转向可验证推理、工具调用和复杂任务完成率。
这件事把 industry、reasoning、agent 推到更显眼的位置。
它让研究者和产品团队重新安排下一步投入。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI / Google / Meta release histories
timeline.summary_en: The competitive focus for frontier models has shifted further toward verifiable reasoning, tool calling, and complex task completion rates. This shift has propelled "industry," "reasoning," and "agents" into the spotlight, prompting researchers and product teams to reallocate their next-phase investments.

timeline.title_zh: 本地模型部署扩散
timeline.title_en: Local Model Deployment Expands
timeline.summary_zh:
量化、小模型和端侧推理推动本地部署生态持续扩大。
这些节点讲的是大模型工程路线的变化。
模型变强之后，行业开始围绕成本、可控性、知识更新、上下文长度和部署位置做取舍。
timeline.source_name: Meta AI / open model ecosystem
timeline.summary_en: Quantization, small models, and on-device inference continue to expand the local deployment ecosystem. These milestones trace the shifting engineering pathways of large models. As these models grew more powerful, the industry began making trade-offs around cost, controllability, knowledge updates, context length, and deployment location.

timeline.title_zh: NVIDIA AI 硬件平台化
timeline.title_en: NVIDIA turns AI hardware into a full platform
timeline.summary_zh:
NVIDIA 从 GPU 厂商，逐步变成 AI 计算平台公司：芯片、CUDA、服务器、互联、软件库和开发者生态一起构成底座。
AI 能力看起来在模型层爆发，底下却是一条算力基础设施线。
CUDA、AlexNet 的 GPU 训练、V100、A100、H100、Blackwell 和 ProjectDIGITS，都应该放在 NVIDIA 二级时间线里看。
timeline.source_name: NVIDIA AI
timeline.summary_en: NVIDIA has evolved from a GPU manufacturer into an AI computing platform company, with chips, CUDA, servers, interconnects, software libraries, and a developer ecosystem forming its foundation. While AI capabilities appear to explode at the model layer, they are driven by this underlying compute infrastructure. Milestones like CUDA, GPU training for AlexNet, the V100, A100, H100, Blackwell, and ProjectDIGITS should all be viewed within this secondary NVIDIA timeline.

timeline.title_zh: DeepSeek-R1 发布及技术报告开源
timeline.title_en: DeepSeek-R1 Release & Technical Report Open-sourced
timeline.summary_zh:
2025 年 1 月 20 日,DeepSeek 发布 R1 推理模型;1 月 22 日公开技术报告,补充训练、强化学习、蒸馏与评测细节。
R1 以强推理表现和高关注度把推理模型竞争推到全球讨论中心:模型能不能把复杂问题拆开、检查、推演和修正。
它还带来一个更现实的刺激——如果更低成本也能做出强推理模型,前沿模型竞争的经济账就要重新算。
timeline.source_name: DeepSeek API Docs / Technical Report
timeline.summary_en: On January 20, 2025, DeepSeek launched the R1 reasoning model, following up on January 22 with a technical report detailing its post-training, reinforcement learning, distillation, and evaluation. Driven by strong reasoning performance and immense attention, R1 thrust the reasoning model race into the center of global discussion: can models deconstruct, verify, reason through, and correct complex problems? It also delivered a more pragmatic shock—if powerful reasoning models can be built at a lower cost, the economic math of the frontier model race must be recalculated.

timeline.title_zh: Vibe Coding 概念提出
timeline.title_en: Vibe Coding Coined
timeline.summary_zh:
2025 年 2 月 Andrej Karpathy 在 X 上发推提出 Vibe Coding——用自然语言描述需求让 LLM 写代码、不再手写。
你在跟 Cursor 或 Claude Code 对话，AI 替你写代码。
跑起来不满意继续描述继续改。
**背后现场**：Karpathy 自己说他的编程方式已经彻底变了——他不写代码了，只在 IDE 里跟 AI 对话。
这个词戳中了千万开发者的共同体验——2024 年以后写代码的方式真的变了。
**为何重要**：据 YC 对该届创业公司的调查统计,约 25% 的公司代码库中 95% 的代码由 AI 生成——这是 Vibe Coding 范式在早期创业团队渗透率的一个调查样本,并非 Vibe Coding 概念本身的定义。
编程的范式从手写转向了跟 AI 对话——Vibe Coding 是这个转变的名字。
**关联卡片**：Vibe Coding、Karpathy
timeline.summary_en: In February 2025, Andrej Karpathy tweeted on X to propose "Vibe Coding"—a paradigm shift from hand-coding to describing requirements in natural language so LLMs write the code, allowing developers to converse with tools like Cursor or Claude Code and iteratively modify the output. This struck a chord with millions of developers whose workflows transformed after 2024, with Karpathy himself stating he no longer writes code but only talks to AI in his IDE. Highlighting the paradigm's penetration in early startups rather than defining the concept itself, a YC survey of that batch revealed that about 25% of the companies had 95% of their codebase generated by AI (Related cards: Vibe Coding, Karpathy).

timeline.title_zh: GPT-4.5 研究预览
timeline.title_en: GPT-4.5 Research Preview
timeline.summary_zh:
OpenAI 于 2025 年 2 月 26 日发布 GPT-4.5 研究预览，并强调预训练与后训练继续扩展。
GPT-4.5 更像一次能力边界测试：继续扩大预训练能带来什么，后训练怎样改善聊天、写作、创造性和复杂任务表现。
前沿竞争仍在探索规模、数据和对齐之间的配比。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI - Introducing GPT-4.5
timeline.summary_en: On February 26, 2025, OpenAI released the GPT-4.5 research preview, emphasizing the continued scaling of both pre-training and post-training. The model serves as a test of capability boundaries, exploring what further pre-training can unlock and how post-training improves performance in chatting, writing, creativity, and complex tasks. Meanwhile, the frontier competition continues to search for the optimal mix of scale, data, and alignment.

timeline.title_zh: 4o 图像生成上线
timeline.title_en: 4o Image Generation
timeline.summary_zh:
OpenAI 于 2025 年 3 月 24 日推出 4o 图像生成，使图像生成进一步融入聊天工作流。
生成式 AI 的扩张已经扩展到文字里。
图像、视频、声音和文本逐步接到同一套模型能力上，创作工具和内容生产流程也跟着被重写。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI - Introducing 4o Image Generation
timeline.summary_en: On March 24, 2025, OpenAI launched 4o image generation, further embedding image creation into chat workflows. The expansion of generative AI has already stretched into text. As images, video, audio, and text are gradually hooked into the same set of model capabilities, creative tools and content production workflows are being rewritten.

timeline.title_zh: Llama 4 发布
timeline.title_en: Llama 4 Release
timeline.summary_zh:
Meta 于 2025 年 4 月 4 日发布 Llama 4 开源模型 Scout 和 Maverick，并强调原生多模态与超长上下文。
开放模型继续把战场推向多模态、长上下文和更复杂的任务执行。
Llama 4 的意义在于让开放生态继续参与最前沿的产品能力竞争。
timeline.source_name: Meta AI - Llama 4
timeline.summary_en: On April 4, 2025, Meta released its Llama 4 open-source models, Scout and Maverick, placing a heavy focus on native multimodality and ultra-long context. The release pushes the open-model battlefield further into multimodality, long contexts, and complex task execution. Ultimately, Llama 4's significance lies in keeping the open ecosystem competitive at the absolute frontier of product capabilities.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 Codex 云端编程 Agent
timeline.title_en: OpenAI Codex Cloud Coding Agent
timeline.summary_zh:
2025 年 4-5 月,OpenAI 把 Codex 从模型推进到完整的云端软件工程 Agent 产品线:读取仓库、规划改动、运行命令、改文件、验证结果,把模型、工具调用、沙箱、测试和人类审阅连成一条工程链路。
人提出目标和边界,Agent 读取项目、拆任务、动手改、跑检查,再把结果交回给人审阅。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI - Introducing Codex
timeline.summary_en: Between April and May 2025, OpenAI evolved Codex from a standalone model into a complete cloud-based software engineering agent product line, linking models, tool calls, sandboxes, testing, and human review into a unified engineering pipeline that reads repositories, plans changes, runs commands, modifies files, and verifies results. Under this workflow, humans define the goals and boundaries, while the agent ingests the project, breaks down tasks, executes the edits, and runs checks before handing the results back for human review.

timeline.title_zh: 2025 前沿模型与 Agent 集中显形
timeline.title_en: Frontier models and agents become unmistakable in 2025
timeline.summary_zh:
2025 年，前沿模型、推理模型和 Agent 产品密集出现，AI 从聊天窗口继续走向工作流执行。
这一年很多发布都围绕同一个方向展开：模型要更会推理，工具要更会协作，产品要更接近真实工作。
用户看到的变化，是 AI 开始从“回答问题”走向“接住任务”。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI / Google DeepMind / Qwen / Anthropic
timeline.summary_en: In 2025, a flurry of frontier models, reasoning models, and AI agents arrived, pushing AI past the chat window and into workflow execution. The year’s releases converged on a singular path: models that reason better, tools that collaborate more effectively, and products that mirror real-world work. For users, the shift was unmistakable—AI was moving from answering questions to taking on tasks.

timeline.title_zh: AlphaEvolve 发布
timeline.title_en: AlphaEvolve Announced
timeline.summary_zh:
2025 年 5 月，Google DeepMind 发布 AlphaEvolve，用 AI 辅助发现和改进算法。
它关注的是算法本身怎样被提出、测试和优化。
系统会生成候选方案，再通过评估筛掉弱结果，把更有希望的方案继续推进。
这个过程像把研究中的试错循环交给机器加速。
timeline.source_name: Google DeepMind - AlphaEvolve
timeline.summary_en: In May 2025, Google DeepMind released AlphaEvolve, using AI to help discover and refine algorithms by focusing on how they are proposed, tested, and optimized. The system generates candidate solutions, filters out weak results through evaluation, and advances the most promising options. This process is like handing the research trial-and-error loop over to machines for acceleration.

timeline.title_zh: 聊天转向工作流自动化
timeline.title_en: Shift to Workflow Automation
timeline.summary_zh:
到 2026 年，行业重点从单轮聊天转向能调用工具、读写文件、浏览网页、执行多步任务的工作流系统。
用户开始关心模型能不能接住一个真实任务：读资料、做计划、用工具、留记录、遇到问题再回来确认。
这条线把 Deep Research、Codex、Claude Code、Hermes、OpenClaw 等产品和社区线索放到同一张图里：AI 正在从聊天框，走向可执行的工作流。
timeline.source_name: Current frontier AI product direction
timeline.summary_en: By 2026, the industry's focus shifted from single-turn chat to workflow systems capable of calling tools, reading and writing files, browsing the web, and executing multi-step tasks. Users began to care whether a model could handle a real-world task: reading materials, making plans, using tools, keeping logs, and looping back to double-check when encountering problems. This trajectory connects products and community projects like Deep Research, Codex, Claude Code, Hermes, and OpenClaw into a single picture: AI is moving out of the chat box and into executable workflows.

timeline.title_zh: GLM-5.2 发布
timeline.title_en: GLM-5.2 Released
timeline.summary_zh:
智谱AI发布GLM-5.2——清华系国产大模型的最新旗舰。
在编程、多模态和Agent能力上全面升级，网上开发者评价普遍高于同期MiniMax-M3。
GLM系列一直走不同于GPT的双向注意力架构路线。
timeline.summary_en: Zhipu AI has released GLM-5.2, the latest flagship of the Tsinghua-affiliated domestic large models. Boasting comprehensive upgrades in coding, multimodal, and agent capabilities, its reception among online developers has generally surpassed that of its contemporary, MiniMax-M3. Unlike GPT, the GLM series has always carved out a different path by utilizing a bidirectional attention architecture.

timeline.title_zh: OpenClaw 进入开源个人 Agent 线索
timeline.title_en: OpenClaw enters the open personal-agent track
timeline.summary_zh:
OpenClaw 把个人 Agent 从聊天框推进到工作台。
以前你问一句，AI 回一句；
答案有用，最后还是你自己开网页、翻文件、接消息、跑流程。
龙虾之后，Agent 开始有手有脚。
它可以接消息入口，可以看你的电脑，可以连浏览器、文件、脚本和工具，把“我给你一个答案”推进到“我替你把这件事往前做”。
这指向生产力入口变化：AI 从对话窗口走进工作现场，连接资料、工具、任务和流程，帮人把事情继续往前推进。
timeline.source_name: 用户下载材料与本地快讯
timeline.summary_en: OpenClaw pushed personal agents out of the chat box and onto the workbench, moving past the era where AI merely answered questions while leaving the manual labor—opening web pages, digging through files, and running workflows—to the user. After Lobster, agents gained hands and feet, integrating with message feeds, reading screens, and connecting to browsers, files, scripts, and tools to transition from "here is your answer" to "let me get this done for you." This signals a shift in the productivity interface: AI is leaving the chat window to enter the actual workspace, linking data, tools, tasks, and workflows to keep projects moving forward.

timeline.title_zh: Hermes Agent 进入自我改进 Agent 线索
timeline.title_en: Hermes Agent enters the self-improving agent track
timeline.summary_zh:
Hermes Agent 代表一种长期协作型 Agent：工具调用、记忆、Skill 和自我改进不再分散，而是在一次次任务里形成循环。
普通 Agent 做完一次任务就结束。
Hermes 这类系统更关心另一件事：这次踩过的坑、形成的流程、用户确认过的偏好，能不能沉淀下来，下次少解释、少犯错、做得更顺。
这和词典里讲的 Learning Loop、Skill、Memory Consolidation 是同一条线。
AI 在长期协作里逐步沉淀工作习惯。
timeline.source_name: 本地 Hermes 资料与正式词典卡片
timeline.summary_en: Unlike ordinary agents that shut down after a single task, the Hermes Agent represents a long-term collaborative agent where tool calling, memory, Skill, and self-improvement form a continuous loop across tasks. Systems like Hermes focus on whether past pitfalls, established workflows, and user-confirmed preferences can be retained to minimize explanation, prevent mistakes, and run smoother next time—aligning with the concepts of a Learning Loop, Skill, and Memory Consolidation. Through this long-term collaboration, the AI gradually solidifies its own work habits.

timeline.title_zh: GPT-5.5 成为 OpenAI 当前主力模型线
timeline.title_en: GPT-5.5 becomes OpenAI’s current frontier model line
timeline.summary_zh:
GPT-5.5 是 OpenAI 在 GPT-5 系列之后继续推进的当前主力模型线，连接 ChatGPT、Codex、API、推理、编码和工具使用。
这条主轴不能停在 GPT-5。
GPT-5、5.1、5.2、5.4 更适合放进二级迭代线，GPT-5.5 才能代表当前 OpenAI 模型线的最新方向。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI
timeline.summary_en: GPT-5.5 is OpenAI's current flagship model line succeeding the GPT-5 series, linking ChatGPT, Codex, APIs, reasoning, coding, and tool use. This core trajectory cannot stop at GPT-5; while GPT-5, 5.1, 5.2, and 5.4 are better suited for secondary iteration lines, it is GPT-5.5 that represents the true frontier of OpenAI's current model lineup.

timeline.title_zh: Claude Opus 4.8 发布——Agent和长程编程再升级
timeline.title_en: Claude Opus 4.8 Released
timeline.summary_zh:
2026年5月Anthropic发布Claude Opus 4.8——在编码、Agent任务和长程工作流稳定性上进一步提升。
Opus 4.8特别优化了长时间多步骤任务中的一致性——减少中途丢失上下文和偏离任务的问题。
Opus 4.8的重点不在跑分——在稳定性。
Anthropic的客户反馈说之前的模型在短任务上表现很好但跑几个小时后容易跑偏。
4.8把长程一致性当作第一优先级——这正好是Agent应用最需要的东西——不是一次性的聪明——是持续好几个小时的可靠。
timeline.summary_en: In May 2026, Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.8, delivering further improvements in coding, agent tasks, and long-range workflow stability. Focusing on stability rather than benchmark scores, the update optimizes consistency in long, multi-step tasks to reduce context loss and mid-way task drift. This addresses customer feedback that previous models performed well on short tasks but drifted after running for hours, prioritizing the sustained, hours-long reliability that agent applications need over one-off cleverness.

timeline.title_zh: Co-Scientist 公开
timeline.title_en: Co-Scientist Announced
timeline.summary_zh:
Google DeepMind 于 2026 年 5 月公开 AI 科研协作系统（Co-Scientist），多智能体科研辅助系统方向已进入公开展示阶段。
Co-Scientist 这类系统把 AI 从单个助手推向科研流程里的多角色协作：提假设、查资料、设计实验、互相质疑。
它的意义是探索科研工作能否被拆成多个 Agent 可以辅助推进的环节。
timeline.source_name: Google DeepMind - Co-Scientist
timeline.summary_en: In May 2026, Google DeepMind unveiled Co-Scientist, an AI scientific collaboration system that brings multi-agent research assistants into the public demonstration phase. Rather than acting as a single assistant, systems like Co-Scientist push AI into multi-role collaboration across the research workflow—formulating hypotheses, searching literature, designing experiments, and challenging one another. Its significance lies in exploring whether scientific research can be broken down into discrete steps that multiple AI agents can help drive forward.

timeline.title_zh: MiniMax-M3 开源发布
timeline.title_en: MiniMax M3 Open Source Release
timeline.summary_zh:
MiniMax 发布并开源 M3——把编程能力、100万 token 长上下文和视觉理解放进同一个模型。
国产模型首次在单一开源模型中同时解决代码、长文和看图三个场景，不再需要为不同任务切换模型。
timeline.summary_en: MiniMax has released and open-sourced M3, packing coding capabilities, a 1-million-token long context, and visual understanding into a single model. This marks the first time a domestic model has tackled coding, long-text, and image-viewing scenarios within a single open-source model, eliminating the need to switch models for different tasks.

timeline.title_zh: Claude Fable 5 与 Mythos 5 发布
timeline.title_en: Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 released
timeline.summary_zh:
Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5 和 Claude Mythos 5，把 Mythos-class 能力带入两个不同访问层级。
Fable 5 是面向一般使用的公开版本，带有更保守的 safeguards；
Mythos 5 是同一底层模型的受限访问版本，先面向网络防御者和基础设施提供方，通过 Project Glasswing 推进。
最新补充：2026-06-13，据 The Verge 等媒体报道，Anthropic 在美国政府以国家安全为由发布出口管制指令后，暂停 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 对外国用户的访问；
这让这条新闻从“分层发布”进一步变成“高能力模型会被政策和安全边界迅速收紧”的案例。
这条线的重点不是多一个模型名，而是强模型发布方式变了：能力、安全护栏、访问资格、用途审计和政策边界开始被一起设计。
timeline.source_name: Anthropic / The Verge
timeline.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5, bringing Mythos-class capabilities to two distinct access tiers: Fable 5, a general-use public version with conservative safeguards, and Mythos 5, a restricted-access version of the same underlying model deployed initially to cyber defenders and infrastructure providers via Project Glasswing. However, on June 13, 2026, outlets including The Verge reported that Anthropic suspended foreign access to both models following a US national security export control directive, shifting the narrative from a tiered release to a case study in how policy and security boundaries are rapidly tightening around high-capability AI. The key takeaway is not just a new model name, but a fundamental shift in how powerful models are deployed, with capability, safeguards, access credentials, usage audits, and policy boundaries now being designed in unison.

timeline.title_zh: 图灵发表《论可计算数》——计算机的理论蓝图
timeline.title_en: Turing's On Computable Numbers
timeline.summary_zh: 1936 年，艾伦·图灵发表《论可计算数及其在判定问题上的应用》。为了证明希尔伯特判定问题无解，他设想了一种假想机器——无限长纸带、读写头、简单规则表——这就是图灵机，所有现代计算机的抽象蓝图。
timeline.source_name: Fireship - 10 Classic CS Papers
timeline.summary_en: In 1936, Alan Turing published "On Computable Numbers, with an Application to the Entscheidungsproblem." To prove that Hilbert's decision problem was unsolvable, he conceived a hypothetical machine—consisting of an infinite paper tape, a read-write head, and a simple table of rules—which became the Turing machine, the abstract blueprint for all modern computers.

timeline.title_zh: 西蒙获诺贝尔经济学奖：唯一同时拿图灵奖和诺贝尔奖的人
timeline.title_en: Herbert Simon Wins Nobel Prize in Economics
timeline.summary_zh:
1978 年 10 月 16 日，瑞典皇家科学院宣布将当年诺贝尔经济学奖授予赫伯特·西蒙，表彰他对经济组织决策过程的开创性研究。
西蒙提出的「有限理性」（Bounded Rationality）和「满意即可」（Satisficing）颠覆了传统经济学的完全理性假设。他指出：人在决策时信息有限、认知有限、时间有限，因此只会追求「够好」的方案而非「最优」方案。
这个思想为行为经济学奠基，也深刻影响了管理学和组织理论。
西蒙 1975 年已与纽厄尔共同获得图灵奖。他至今仍是历史上唯一同时获得图灵奖和诺贝尔奖的人。
timeline.source_name: Nobel Prize Official Website: Herbert A. Simon
timeline.summary_en: On October 16, 1978, the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences awarded the Nobel Prize in Economics to Herbert Simon for his pioneering research into the decision-making processes within economic organizations. Simon’s concepts of "Bounded Rationality" and "Satisficing" upended traditional economics' assumption of perfect rationality by showing that humans, constrained by limited information, cognition, and time, seek "good enough" rather than "optimal" solutions—a breakthrough that laid the foundation for behavioral economics and deeply influenced management and organizational theory. Having already co-won the Turing Award with Newell in 1975, Simon remains the only person in history to win both the Turing Award and the Nobel Prize.

timeline.title_zh: Lamport 提出逻辑时钟——分布式系统的基石
timeline.title_en: Lamport's Logical Clocks
timeline.summary_zh: 1978 年，莱斯利·兰伯特发表论文《分布式系统中的时间、时钟与事件排序》。他证明了独立计算机之间不存在统一的「现在」——并提出用因果关系的「先发生于」替代物理时间。
timeline.source_name: Fireship - 10 Classic CS Papers
timeline.summary_en: In 1978, Leslie Lamport published his paper "Time, Clocks, and the Ordering of Events in a Distributed System." He proved that a unified "now" does not exist between independent computers, proposing instead to replace physical time with a causal "happened-before" relationship.

timeline.title_zh: 美团长猫 2.0 发布——纯国产算力训出万亿参数模型
timeline.title_en: Meituan LongCat-2.0 Released
timeline.summary_zh:
2026 年 6 月 30 日，美团正式发布 LongCat-2.0（长猫 2.0），一个 1.6 万亿参数的 MoE 大模型。全流程在 5 万张国产算力卡上完成训练和推理，英伟达含量为零。这是目前公开信息里，第一个在纯国产算力集群上从零跑通的万亿参数大模型。支撑 100 万上下文窗口，Agent 和编程能力约等于 Claude Opus 4.6 水平。
同一天，寒武纪市值突破 1 万亿人民币，两个「万亿」撞在同一天——国产芯片证明了市场价值，国产模型证明了芯片能力。
timeline.summary_en: On June 30, 2026, Meituan officially released LongCat-2.0, a 1.6-trillion-parameter MoE model trained and run entirely on 50,000 domestic computing cards with zero Nvidia components, making it the first trillion-parameter model in public records to be trained from scratch on a purely domestic cluster. Boasting a 1-million-token context window, its agentic and programming capabilities are roughly equivalent to Claude Opus 4.6. That same day, Cambricon's market value crossed 1 trillion RMB, a dual-trillion collision where domestic chips proved their market value, and a domestic model proved the chips' capabilities.

timeline.title_zh: 寒武纪市值突破 1 万亿人民币——科创板首家万亿公司
timeline.title_en: Cambricon Reaches 1 Trillion RMB Market Cap
timeline.summary_zh:
2026 年 6 月 30 日，寒武纪股价涨近 8%，突破历史新高，总市值正式突破 1 万亿人民币，成为科创板历史上第一家万亿市值公司。
这一天碰巧和美团长猫 2.0 的发布同一天——模型侧证明了国产芯片能训万亿参数的前沿模型，芯片侧证明了这个市场大到足以撑起万亿市值。
一个万亿是国产算力训出来的模型参数，一个万亿是二级市场给国产算力的估值。
timeline.summary_en: On June 30, 2026, Cambricon’s stock surged nearly 8% to a record high, pushing its total market cap past 1 trillion RMB and making it the first-ever trillion-yuan company on the STAR Market. This milestone coincided with the debut of Meituan’s Changmao 2.0—proving on the model side that domestic chips can train trillion-parameter frontier AI, and on the chip side that the market is vast enough to sustain a trillion-yuan valuation. One trillion represents the parameters trained on domestic compute; the other is the valuation awarded to domestic compute by the secondary market.

timeline.title_zh: 商汤科技成立——中国计算机视觉先驱
timeline.title_en: SenseTime Founded
timeline.summary_zh: 2014 年，汤晓鸥教授在香港创立商汤科技（SenseTime）。创始团队来自香港中文大学多媒体实验室。商汤以计算机视觉技术为突破口，在人脸识别、图像分析等领域迅速成长，2018 年成为全球估值最高的 AI 独角兽。
timeline.source_name: 公开资料
timeline.summary_en: In 2014, Professor Tang Xiao'ou founded SenseTime in Hong Kong, with a founding team hailing from the Multimedia Laboratory at the Chinese University of Hong Kong. Using computer vision as its breakthrough, the company grew rapidly in facial recognition and image analysis, becoming the world's most valuable AI unicorn by 2018.

timeline.title_zh: 阿里巴巴达摩院成立——中国 AI 基础研究重镇
timeline.title_en: Alibaba DAMO Academy Founded
timeline.summary_zh: 2017 年 10 月，阿里巴巴宣布成立达摩院（DAMO Academy），计划三年投入超 1000 亿人民币。达摩院在全球设立实验室，覆盖机器视觉、NLP、自动驾驶、量子计算等方向。这是中国互联网公司最大规模的 AI 基础研究投资。
timeline.source_name: 公开资料
timeline.summary_en: In October 2017, Alibaba announced the establishment of the DAMO Academy, planning to invest over 100 billion RMB over three years. Setting up laboratories globally to cover fields like machine vision, NLP, autonomous driving, and quantum computing, this marked the largest investment in basic AI research by a Chinese internet company.

timeline.title_zh: 华为昇腾 910 发布——国产 AI 训练芯片里程碑
timeline.title_en: Huawei Ascend 910 AI Chip Released
timeline.summary_zh: 2018 年 10 月，华为在 HUAWEI CONNECT 大会上首次发布昇腾（Ascend）系列 AI 芯片——昇腾 910 训练芯片和昇腾 310 推理芯片。昇腾基于自研达芬奇（Da Vinci）架构，这是中国在 AI 训练芯片领域从零到一的突破。
timeline.source_name: 公开资料
timeline.summary_en: In October 2018, Huawei unveiled its Ascend series of AI chips at the HUAWEI CONNECT conference, debuting the Ascend 910 training chip and the Ascend 310 inference chip. Built on the self-developed Da Vinci architecture, the launch marked China's zero-to-one breakthrough in the AI training chip field.

timeline.title_zh: 智谱 ChatGLM 发布——国产大模型学术路线代表
timeline.title_en: Zhipu ChatGLM Released
timeline.summary_zh: 2023 年 3 月，智谱 AI 发布 ChatGLM——基于清华唐杰团队 GLM 架构的双向注意力大模型。与当时主流的 GPT 单向注意力不同，GLM 采用了创新的双向注意力设计。ChatGLM-6B 以 62 亿参数在开源社区迅速走红。
timeline.source_name: 公开资料
timeline.summary_en: In March 2023, Zhipu AI released ChatGLM, a bidirectional attention large model based on the GLM architecture developed by Tang Jie's team at Tsinghua University. Unlike the unidirectional attention of the mainstream GPT models at the time, GLM adopted an innovative bidirectional attention design. ChatGLM-6B, featuring 6.2 billion parameters, quickly went viral in the open-source community.

timeline.title_zh: 字节跳动豆包上线——国内 DAU 增长最快的大模型产品
timeline.title_en: ByteDance Doubao Released
timeline.summary_zh: 2023 年 8 月，字节跳动推出豆包（Doubao）大模型产品。背靠字节的推荐算法和流量优势，豆包在国内大模型产品中用户量增长最快。字节还通过火山引擎提供豆包 API 服务，并推出了扣子（Coze）等 AI 应用开发平台。
timeline.source_name: 公开资料
timeline.summary_en: In August 2023, ByteDance launched its Doubao large model product, which quickly achieved the fastest user growth among domestic AI models by leveraging the company's recommendation algorithms and massive traffic. ByteDance also began offering the Doubao API through Volcano Engine and rolled out AI application development platforms like Coze.
